### Keyboard shortcut

Set `shortcut` to show its keys after the label, in the tooltip of an icon-only button, and to the screen reader through `aria-keyshortcuts`. Pressing the keys clicks the button, so `on:click` runs, as does a form's submit or a link's navigation. `mod` is the platform's main modifier, so `"mod+s"` shows <DocKbd shortcut="mod+s" /> on your platform. The examples run in a frame, so click in one before you press its keys.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Save from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Save.svelte";

  let saves = 0;
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={5} align="center">
  <Button shortcut="mod+s" on:click={() => saves++}>Save</Button>
  <Button
    kind="ghost"
    shortcut="mod+shift+s"
    icon={Save}
    iconDescription="Save as"
  />
  <span>Saved {saves} {saves === 1 ? "time" : "times"}</span>
</Stack>
```

The button only answers while it's enabled and shown, and while a modal is open, only if it's inside it, so a page's Save never fires behind a dialog. When two shown buttons share a shortcut, the one rendered last answers. A shortcut you bind yourself with `onShortcut` comes first.

To do something other than click, handle `on:shortcut`, dispatched before the click, and call `preventDefault()` to skip the click.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let exports = 0;
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={5} align="center">
  <Button
    kind="tertiary"
    shortcut="mod+e"
    on:shortcut={(e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      exports++;
    }}
  >
    Export
  </Button>
  <span>Exported {exports} {exports === 1 ? "time" : "times"} by shortcut</span>
</Stack>
```

| Do | Why |
| :-- | :-- |
| Use `mod` for the platform's main modifier | One shortcut reads and works on every platform |
| Pick shortcuts the browser doesn't keep, such as `mod+s` over `mod+w` | Browsers don't let a page take `mod+w`, `mod+t` or `mod+n` |
| Avoid the editing keys: `mod+a`, `mod+c`, `mod+v`, `mod+x` and `mod+z` | A shortcut with a modifier also fires in text fields, so it takes select all, copy, paste, cut or undo from every field |
| Keep single-key shortcuts such as `/` for actions that make sense while reading | They don't fire while typing in a field, but they do everywhere else |
| Let users turn off single-key shortcuts, or add a modifier to them | Speech input and stray key presses fire them by accident. WCAG 2.1.4 asks for a way to turn them off or remap them |

### Expressive styles

Set `expressive` to `true` to use Carbon's expressive typesetting. Use expressive styles with the default, "lg", or "xl" button sizes.

```svelte
<Button expressive size="xl" kind="danger">Danger</Button>

<Button expressive size="lg">Primary</Button>
<Button expressive size="lg" kind="secondary">Secondary</Button>
<Button expressive size="lg" kind="tertiary">Tertiary</Button>
<Button expressive size="lg" kind="ghost">Ghost</Button>

<Button expressive kind="secondary">Secondary</Button>
```

### Programmatic focus

Bind to the `ref` prop to access the button element for programmatic focus.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let ref;
</script>

<Button bind:ref>Primary button</Button>
<Button
  kind="ghost"
  on:click={() => {
    ref?.focus();
  }}
>
  Click to focus the Primary button
</Button>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Button` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLAnchorElement \| HTMLButtonElement` | Obtain a reference to the HTML element.<br />Stays `null` when `as` is set; use `bind:this` on your own element instead. | `null` |
| `kind` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "tertiary" \| "ghost" \| "danger" \| "danger-tertiary" \| "danger-ghost"` | Specify the kind of button. | `"primary"` |
| `size` | `"default" \| "field" \| "small" \| "xs" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "2xl" \| undefined` | Specify the size of button.<br />When the `badge` slot is used, size is set to `lg` per Carbon design guidelines.<br />Falls back to the size set by an ancestor `ActionSet` when unset, then<br />to the height of a parent `Form`'s size (`xs`, `small` for `sm`,<br />`default` for `xl`).<br />Use `"xs"` for icon-only buttons in dense layouts.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"sm"` (`"small"`), `"md"` (`"field"`) and<br />`"2xl"` (`"xl"`). `"lg"` and `"xl"` keep this library's 64px and 80px;<br />Carbon v11's 48px `lg` and 64px `xl` are `"default"` and `"lg"` here. | `"default"` |
| `expressive` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use Carbon's expressive typesetting | `false` |
| `isSelected` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to enable the selected state for an icon-only, ghost button.<br />Set to `false` to render it as a toggle that is not pressed. Left unset,<br />the button is not a toggle and renders no `aria-pressed`. | _undefined_ |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to render an icon-only button even when default content<br />is passed (default content isn't rendered), as from a wrapper that<br />forwards optional text; `false` to always render a labelled button.<br />Unset, a button with an icon and no default content is icon-only.<br />Without an icon, the button is always labelled. | _undefined_ |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to span the full width of the container | `false` |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify the icon to render.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "icon". | _undefined_ |
| `iconDescription` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the ARIA label for the button icon.<br />On an icon-only button, this also drives Carbon's tooltip. If omitted,<br />the icon-only button renders without a tooltip; supply your own<br />`aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` for accessibility in that case. | _undefined_ |
| `shortcut` | `string` | Specify a keyboard shortcut for the button, such as `"mod+s"`. `mod` is<br />Command on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere. The button shows the<br />keys (in its tooltip when icon-only), sets `aria-keyshortcuts`, and is<br />clicked when the shortcut is pressed while it's enabled and shown, and,<br />while a modal is open, inside it. A shortcut the app binds with<br />`onShortcut` takes precedence. | `""` |
| `tooltipAlign` | `"top" \| "top-start" \| "top-end" \| "bottom" \| "bottom-start" \| "bottom-end" \| "left" \| "left-start" \| "left-end" \| "right" \| "right-start" \| "right-end" \| undefined` | Set the tooltip placement in floating-ui form: the side, then `start`<br />or `end` along it, as Popover's `align` takes. Above and below,<br />`start` and `end` name inline sides, so they swap under `dir="rtl"`.<br />When set, takes precedence over `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipAlignment` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the icon.<br />Only applies to icon-only buttons. | `"center"` |
| `tooltipPosition` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Set the position of the tooltip relative to the icon. | `"bottom"` |
| `hideTooltip` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the tooltip while maintaining accessibility.<br />Only applies to icon-only buttons.<br />When `true`, the tooltip is visually hidden but the `iconDescription` remains accessible to screen readers. | `false` |
| `as` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render a custom HTML element.<br />Props are destructured as `props` in the default slot. | `false` |
| `skeleton` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to display the skeleton state | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the button | `false` |
| `href` | `string \| undefined` | Set the `href` to use an anchor link. | _undefined_ |
| `tabindex` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Specify the tabindex | `"0"` |
| `type` | `string` | Specify the `type` attribute for the button element | `"button"` |
| `portalTooltip` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to always render the icon-only tooltip in a portal, which<br />also flips it when the preferred direction lacks space, or `false` to<br />keep it in place. Left unset, the tooltip opens in a portal inside a<br />`Modal`, or when a box around it (`overflow` other than `visible`, such<br />as a `DataTable`) would cut it off. | _undefined_ |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to display a loading spinner in place of the icon<br />and prevent the button from being activated.<br />Unlike `disabled`, the button remains focusable; use `disabled`<br />as well if it should also be removed from the tab order. | `false` |
| `loadingDescription` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the accessible description for the loading spinner. | _undefined_ |
| `loadingDelay` | `number` | Wait this many milliseconds after `loading` turns `true` before showing<br />the spinner. Once shown, the spinner stays for at least 500 ms, so fast<br />work shows nothing and slow work never flashes. The button blocks clicks<br />and sets `aria-busy` as soon as `loading` is `true`.<br />Set to `0` to show the spinner at once. | `0` |

#### `Button` slots

| Slot | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | `{<br />  props: {<br />    role: "button";<br />    type?: string;<br />    tabindex: any;<br />    disabled: boolean;<br />    href?: string;<br />    class: string;<br />    [key: string]: any;<br />  };<br />}` |
| `badge` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `icon` | `{<br />  style: undefined \| string;<br />}` |

#### `Button` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:mousedown`  |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `Button` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:shortcut` | `KeyboardEvent` | Dispatched when `shortcut` is pressed, before the button is clicked. Call `preventDefault()` to skip the click. |

#### `Button` $$restProps

`Button` spreads `$$restProps` to the `button | a | div` element.

#### `ButtonSkeleton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `href` | `string \| undefined` | Set the `href` to use an anchor link. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `"default" \| "field" \| "small" \| "xs" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "2xl" \| undefined` | Specify the size of button skeleton.<br />Falls back to the height of a parent `Form`'s size, as Button does.<br />Accepts the same Carbon v11 aliases as Button. | `"default"` |

#### `ButtonSkeleton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ButtonSkeleton` $$restProps

`ButtonSkeleton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `a` element.


## ButtonSet

### Basic

Place buttons side by side in a horizontal layout. For a custom modal or panel footer that needs size-aware stacking (one to four actions, ordered automatically by `kind`), use [ActionSet](/components/ActionSet) instead, which wraps `ButtonSet` with that behavior built in. [Modal](/components/Modal) builds its footer from props.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ButtonSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ButtonSet>
  <Button kind="secondary">Cancel</Button>
  <Button>Submit</Button>
</ButtonSet>
```

### Stacked

Set `stacked` to `true` to stack the buttons vertically instead of side by side.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ButtonSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Login from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Login.svelte";
</script>

<ButtonSet stacked>
  <Button icon={Login}>Log in</Button>
  <Button kind="ghost">Sign up</Button>
</ButtonSet>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ButtonSet` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the HTML element. | `null` |
| `stacked` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to stack the buttons vertically | `false` |

#### `ButtonSet` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ButtonSet` $$restProps

`ButtonSet` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## Callout

### Basic

Place a callout next to the content it explains. The default kind is `"info"`. See [detailed usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/notification/usage) for Carbon's guidance.

Long titles and subtitles wrap onto more lines. They don't truncate.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Callout } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Callout
  titleText="Scheduled downtime"
  subtitleText="Billing is read-only on Saturday from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC."
/>
```

### Callout or InlineNotification

Use a callout for information that is true for as long as the page is open: a limit, a prerequisite, or a side effect of the form below it. It renders when the page renders, so it has no live region and no close button.

Use an [InlineNotification](/components/InlineNotification) for the result of something the user just did, such as a failed save. Its `role="status"` makes screen readers announce it when it appears, and the user can close it.

| Need | Use |
| :-- | :-- |
| Guidance that is part of the page | Callout |
| Feedback on an action, announced when it appears | InlineNotification |
| Feedback that floats over the page and can time out | [ToastNotification](/components/ToastNotification) |

### Kinds

Set `kind` to match the message. Callouts are mostly `"info"` or `"warning"`. The status icon has a label, such as "Warning", so screen readers convey the kind without color.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Callout, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Callout
    kind="info"
    titleText="Read-only role"
    subtitleText="You can view this project. Ask a workspace admin for edit access."
  />
  <Callout
    kind="warning"
    titleText="Shared credentials"
    subtitleText="Changing this key signs out every service that uses it."
  />
  <Callout
    kind="success"
    titleText="Verified domain"
    subtitleText="Mail from acme.com passes SPF and DKIM checks."
  />
  <Callout
    kind="error"
    titleText="Unsupported region"
    subtitleText="GPU instances aren't available in eu-west-3."
  />
  <Callout
    kind="info-square"
    titleText="Beta feature"
    subtitleText="Usage-based alerts may change before general availability."
  />
  <Callout
    kind="warning-alt"
    titleText="Retention limit"
    subtitleText="Logs older than 30 days are deleted on the Starter plan."
  />
</Stack>
```

### Low contrast

Set `lowContrast` to `true` for a lighter callout that sits inside page content without drawing as much attention.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Callout, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Callout
    lowContrast
    kind="info"
    titleText="Read-only role"
    subtitleText="You can view this project. Ask a workspace admin for edit access."
  />
  <Callout
    lowContrast
    kind="warning"
    titleText="Shared credentials"
    subtitleText="Changing this key signs out every service that uses it."
  />
  <Callout
    lowContrast
    kind="success"
    titleText="Verified domain"
    subtitleText="Mail from acme.com passes SPF and DKIM checks."
  />
  <Callout
    lowContrast
    kind="error"
    titleText="Unsupported region"
    subtitleText="GPU instances aren't available in eu-west-3."
  />
</Stack>
```

### Title only

Leave out `subtitleText` when the title says it all.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Callout } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Callout kind="warning" titleText="This workspace is archived." />
```

### Subtitle with a link

Use the "subtitleChildren" slot for rich content, such as a link. Set `titleId` and point the link's `aria-describedby` at it, so screen readers read the title along with the link.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Callout, Link } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Callout
  kind="warning"
  titleText="Storage almost full"
  titleId="storage-callout-title"
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="subtitleChildren">
    Builds stop at 100%.
    <Link href="/settings/billing" aria-describedby="storage-callout-title">
      Upgrade your plan
    </Link>
  </svelte:fragment>
</Callout>
```

### Actions

Add a `NotificationActionButton` in the "actions" slot. The callout's title describes the button for screen readers, with no extra setup.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Callout, NotificationActionButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Callout
  kind="info"
  titleText="New audit log format"
  subtitleText="Exports now include the actor's IP address and session id."
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="actions">
    <NotificationActionButton>View changes</NotificationActionButton>
  </svelte:fragment>
</Callout>
```

### Extra content

Put more content, such as a list, in the default slot. It renders under the subtitle. Components such as `UnorderedList` set their own text color, so use them in a low-contrast callout.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Callout, ListItem, UnorderedList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Callout
  lowContrast
  kind="warning"
  titleText="Before you migrate"
  subtitleText="Check these settings on the old cluster:"
>
  <UnorderedList>
    <ListItem>Backups are on.</ListItem>
    <ListItem>No jobs are running.</ListItem>
  </UnorderedList>
</Callout>
```

### Status icon label

Translate the status icon's label with `statusIconDescription`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Callout } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Callout
  kind="warning"
  titleText="Maintenance planifiée"
  subtitleText="La facturation est en lecture seule samedi de 02:00 à 04:00 UTC."
  statusIconDescription="Avertissement"
/>
```

### In a form

Put a callout above the fields it explains. Set `fullWidth` to `true` so it lines up with the fields instead of the page's width limits.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Callout,
    Form,
    Stack,
    TextInput,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Form on:submit={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
  <Stack gap={6}>
    <Callout
      fullWidth
      lowContrast
      kind="warning"
      titleText="Changing the domain"
      subtitleText="Members sign in again, and old invite links stop working."
    />
    <TextInput name="domain" labelText="Workspace domain" value="acme" />
    <Button type="submit">Save domain</Button>
  </Stack>
</Form>
```

### In a tile

Set `fullWidth` to `true` to fill a tile or card.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Callout, Stack, Tile } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tile>
  <Stack gap={5}>
    <h4>Payments API</h4>
    <p>Handles card and bank transfers for every workspace.</p>
    <Callout
      fullWidth
      lowContrast
      kind="info"
      titleText="Rate limit"
      subtitleText="Each key can make 100 requests per second."
    />
  </Stack>
</Tile>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Callout` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"error" \| "info" \| "info-square" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "warning-alt"` | Specify the kind of callout. | `"info"` |
| `lowContrast` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the low contrast variant | `false` |
| `titleText` | `string` | Specify the title text.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "titleChildren". | `""` |
| `subtitleText` | `string` | Specify the subtitle text.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "subtitleChildren", such as for a link. | `""` |
| `titleId` | `string` | Specify the id of the title element. A `NotificationActionButton` in<br />the callout is described by it. Point the `aria-describedby` of other<br />interactive content, such as a link, at the same id. | `uniqueId()` |
| `statusIconDescription` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the label of the status icon for screen readers.<br />Defaults to the kind, such as "Warning". | _undefined_ |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for the callout to fill its parent's width, without the<br />default width limits, as when it sits inside a tile or a form. | `false` |

#### `Callout` slots

| Slot               | Detail                  |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- |
| `default`          | `Record<string, never>` |
| `actions`          | `Record<string, never>` |
| `subtitleChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `titleChildren`    | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Callout` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `Callout` $$restProps

`Callout` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `NotificationActionButton` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `NotificationActionButton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `NotificationActionButton` $$restProps

`NotificationActionButton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `Button` component.


## Card

### Basic

Compose a card from `CardHeader`, `CardBody` and `CardFooter`, the same way as a [ComposedModal](/components/ComposedModal). Use a [Tile](/components/Tile) for a plain container without these regions.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Button,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardFooter,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Quarterly report</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>
      Usage grew 12% over the last quarter, led by object storage.
    </CardBody>
    <CardFooter>
      <Button kind="ghost" size="sm">View report</Button>
    </CardFooter>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

### Clickable

Set `clickable` to `true` to make the whole card one interactive element, with hover, press and focus styles. The `CardTitle` gives the card its accessible name. Set `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` to use a different name.

A clickable card can't hold other buttons or links, so it doesn't render a `CardFooter` or `CardActions`. It shows an arrow at the bottom instead.

#### Link

Set `href` to render the card as a link.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card clickable href="/components/Tile">
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Object storage</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>82% of capacity used across three buckets.</CardBody>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

#### Button

Without `href`, the card renders as a button. <kbd>Enter</kbd> and <kbd>Space</kbd> both click it.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card clickable on:click={() => console.log("Open project settings")}>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Project settings</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>Manage members, permissions and integrations.</CardBody>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

#### Icon

Set `icon` to change the arrow, such as `Launch` for a link that leaves the app. In a right-to-left layout, the icon mirrors, so an arrow points left. The prop is `icon`, as on [ClickableTile](/components/ClickableTile). When you port code from Carbon React, use it for `renderFooterIcon`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Launch from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Launch.svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card
    clickable
    href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/"
    target="_blank"
    icon={Launch}
  >
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Carbon Design System</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>Guidelines, components and patterns.</CardBody>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

### Expressive

Set `density` to `"expressive"` for a larger title. The default is `"productive"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card density="expressive">
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Quarterly report</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>
      Usage grew 12% over the last quarter, led by object storage.
    </CardBody>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

### Media

Put a `CardMedia` in the `media` slot. It renders above the content at the aspect ratio set with `ratio`. An image fills it and is cropped to fit. Use an empty `alt` for a decorative image.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardMedia,
    CardTitle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card>
    <CardMedia slot="media" ratio="2x1">
      <img src="/card-media.svg" alt="" />
    </CardMedia>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Cloud spend</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>Spend by service across 12 accounts, updated daily.</CardBody>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

#### Horizontal

Set `horizontal` to `true` to put the media beside the content. It fills the card's height, at the width set with `mediaWidth` on `CardMedia`. Set `mediaPosition` to `"end"` to move it to the other side.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardMedia,
    CardTitle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="32rem">
  <Card horizontal>
    <CardMedia slot="media" mediaWidth="40%">
      <img src="/card-media.svg" alt="" />
    </CardMedia>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Cloud spend</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>Spend by service across 12 accounts, updated daily.</CardBody>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

### Body without padding

Set `noPadding` on `CardBody` for content with its own spacing, such as a list, a table or a chart. The prop is `noPadding`, as on [Tile](/components/Tile). When you port code from Carbon React, use it for `isFlush`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
    ContainedList,
    ContainedListItem,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Buckets</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody noPadding>
      <ContainedList labelText="Buckets" hideLabel>
        <ContainedListItem>billing-exports</ContainedListItem>
        <ContainedListItem>usage-archive</ContainedListItem>
        <ContainedListItem>support-uploads</ContainedListItem>
      </ContainedList>
    </CardBody>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

### Title

`CardTitle` takes a `labelChildren` slot above the title and a `description` slot below it. Put an icon before the title with `CardTitleMedia`, or in the `titleStart` and `titleEnd` slots.

The title is a heading. Inside a [Section](/components/Heading), it is one level below the section's heading; otherwise it is an `h3`. Set `headingLevel` to fit the page outline.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Card,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
    CardTitleMedia,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Report from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Report.svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitleMedia>
        <Report size={20} />
      </CardTitleMedia>
      <CardTitle>
        <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">Billing</svelte:fragment>
        Quarterly report
        <svelte:fragment slot="description">Updated 2 hours ago</svelte:fragment
        >
      </CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

#### Truncate

Set `titleTruncate` to `true` to cut the title to one line, or to a number to clamp it to that many lines. Set `maxWidth` to choose where it cuts. `labelTruncate` and `descriptionTruncate` work the same way.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Card, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle titleTruncate>
        Quarterly usage report for the production object storage account
      </CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

### Actions

Put `CardActions` in the `actions` slot of `CardHeader` for quick actions, with each button in a `CardAction`. They sit in the top corner, and the title leaves room for them.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Button,
    Card,
    CardAction,
    CardActions,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Quarterly report</CardTitle>
      <CardActions slot="actions">
        <CardAction>
          <Button
            kind="ghost"
            size="sm"
            icon={favorite ? StarFilled : Star}
            iconDescription={favorite
              ? "Remove from favorites"
              : "Add to favorites"}
            isSelected={favorite}
            on:click={() => (favorite = !favorite)}
          />
        </CardAction>
      </CardActions>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>
      Usage grew 12% over the last quarter, led by object storage.
    </CardBody>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

#### Footer actions

Set `actionSet` on `CardFooter` to fill the footer with `CardAction`s. The footer gets a top border and the actions share the row. Set `iconOnly` on a `CardAction` that holds an icon-only control, such as an [OverflowMenu](/components/OverflowMenu), so it keeps its width at the end of the row.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Button,
    Card,
    CardAction,
    CardBody,
    CardFooter,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
    OverflowMenu,
    OverflowMenuItem,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Staging bucket</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>1,204 objects, updated 2 hours ago.</CardBody>
    <CardFooter actionSet>
      <CardAction>
        <Button kind="secondary">Share</Button>
      </CardAction>
      <CardAction>
        <Button>Open</Button>
      </CardAction>
      <CardAction iconOnly>
        <OverflowMenu size="xl" flipped iconDescription="More options">
          <OverflowMenuItem text="Rename" />
          <OverflowMenuItem text="Duplicate" />
          <OverflowMenuItem danger text="Delete" />
        </OverflowMenu>
      </CardAction>
    </CardFooter>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

### AI label

Put an `AILabel` in the `decorator` slot to mark the card's content as AI-generated. The card shows the AI surface, and the label sits at the `"xs"` size in the header's top corner, below any media on top. On a clickable card, it sits beside the link or button, not inside it.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    AILabel,
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardMedia,
    CardTitle,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Stack gap={5}>
    <Card>
      <CardMedia slot="media" ratio="2x1">
        <img src="/card-media.svg" alt="" />
      </CardMedia>
      <AILabel slot="decorator">
        <p>Generated from 90 days of billing data.</p>
      </AILabel>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Usage forecast</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardBody>Spend is projected to grow 12% next month.</CardBody>
    </Card>
    <Card clickable href="/components/AILabel">
      <AILabel slot="decorator">
        <p>Generated from 90 days of billing data.</p>
      </AILabel>
      <CardHeader>
        <CardTitle>Usage forecast</CardTitle>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardBody>Spend is projected to grow 12% next month.</CardBody>
    </Card>
  </Stack>
</Box>
```

#### Horizontal

With media at the end, the label sits at the corner of the content, clear of the media.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    AILabel,
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardMedia,
    CardTitle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="32rem">
  <Card horizontal mediaPosition="end">
    <CardMedia slot="media" mediaWidth="40%">
      <img src="/card-media.svg" alt="" />
    </CardMedia>
    <AILabel slot="decorator">
      <p>Generated from 90 days of billing data.</p>
    </AILabel>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Usage forecast</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>Spend is projected to grow 12% next month.</CardBody>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

### On a layer

Place the card in a [Layer](/components/Layer) to put it on the next surface, so it contrasts with the surface below.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
    Layer,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Layer withBackground>
  <Box padding={5}>
    <Box maxWidth="20rem">
      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Quarterly report</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardBody>
          Usage grew 12% over the last quarter, led by object storage.
        </CardBody>
      </Card>
    </Box>
  </Box>
</Layer>
```

### Disabled

Set `disabled` to `true` to prevent interaction.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Card,
    CardBody,
    CardHeader,
    CardTitle,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Card clickable disabled>
    <CardHeader>
      <CardTitle>Quarterly report</CardTitle>
    </CardHeader>
    <CardBody>This report is archived and can no longer be opened.</CardBody>
  </Card>
</Box>
```

### Component API

#### `Card` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement \| HTMLAnchorElement` | Obtain a reference to the card element. | `null` |
| `clickable` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to make the whole card interactive. It renders as a<br />button, or as a link when `href` is set, and shows `icon` at the<br />bottom. Its accessible name is the `CardTitle`; set `aria-label` or<br />`aria-labelledby` to replace it. | `false` |
| `href` | `string \| undefined` | Set the `href` to render a clickable card as a link.<br />Only applies when `clickable` is `true`. | _undefined_ |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the card | `false` |
| `density` | `"productive" \| "expressive"` | Specify the title type style: `"productive"` for product UI, or<br />`"expressive"` for a larger title. | `"productive"` |
| `horizontal` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render the `media` slot beside the content instead<br />of above it. | `false` |
| `mediaPosition` | `"start" \| "end"` | Place the `media` slot before or after the content.<br />Only applies when `horizontal` is `true`. | `"start"` |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon a clickable card shows in its bottom inline-end<br />corner (mirrored in right-to-left layouts), such as `Launch` for an<br />external link. The icon is decorative<br />and hidden from assistive technology. Named `icon` as on<br />`ClickableTile`; Carbon React calls it `renderFooterIcon`.<br />Only applies when `clickable` is `true`. | `ArrowRight` |

#### `Card` slots

| Slot        | Detail                  |
| ----------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`   | `Record<string, never>` |
| `decorator` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `media`     | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Card` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:keydown`    |
| `on:keyup`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `Card` $$restProps

`Card` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div | a` element.

#### `CardHeader` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `actions` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `CardHeader` $$restProps

`CardHeader` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `CardBody` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `noPadding` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to remove the body's padding, for content with its own<br />spacing, such as a table, a chart or an image. Named `noPadding` as on<br />`Tile`; Carbon React calls it `isFlush`. | `false` |

#### `CardBody` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `CardBody` $$restProps

`CardBody` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `CardFooter` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actionSet` | `boolean` | Set to `true` when the footer holds `CardAction`s. The footer drops<br />its padding and gains a top border, and the actions fill the row. | `false` |

#### `CardFooter` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `CardFooter` $$restProps

`CardFooter` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `CardTitle` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `titleTruncate` | `boolean \| number` | Truncate the title: `true` cuts it to one line with an ellipsis, and<br />a number clamps it to that many lines. | `false` |
| `maxWidth` | `string` | Specify the maximum width of the title, as any CSS width.<br />Only applies when `titleTruncate` is set. | `"100%"` |
| `labelTruncate` | `boolean \| number` | Truncate the `labelChildren` slot. Takes the same values as `titleTruncate`. | `false` |
| `descriptionTruncate` | `boolean \| number` | Truncate the `description` slot. Takes the same values as<br />`titleTruncate`. | `false` |
| `headingLevel` | `1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| undefined` | Specify the heading level of the title, to fit the page outline.<br />Inside a `Section`, defaults to one level below the section's heading;<br />otherwise to 3. | _undefined_ |

#### `CardTitle` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |

| `titleStart`    | `Record<string, never>` |

| `mediaWidth` | `string` | Specify the width of the media, as any CSS width.<br />Only applies when the card is `horizontal`. | `"33.33%"` |

## Carousel

### Basic

Wrap each slide in a `CarouselItem`. Only the active slide is visible, and the previous and next buttons are disabled on the first and last slide unless `wrap` is set (see [Navigation](#navigation)). When focus is inside the carousel, press <kbd>Left</kbd> and <kbd>Right</kbd> to move to the previous and next slide, except inside form fields, which keep their own arrow key behavior. In RTL the keys swap: <kbd>Left</kbd> moves to the next slide.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Carousel,
    CarouselItem,
    Link,
    Stack,
    Tag,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Carousel labelText="What's new in 4.2">
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <div><Tag type="green" size="sm">New</Tag></div>
      <h4>Scheduled deployments</h4>
      <p>
        Queue a release for a maintenance window and it ships automatically,
        with a rollback point created five minutes before it starts.
      </p>
      <Link href="#">Read the release notes</Link>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <div><Tag type="blue" size="sm">Improved</Tag></div>
      <h4>Faster log search</h4>
      <p>
        Queries across 30 days of logs now return in under two seconds, and
        saved searches can be pinned to a dashboard.
      </p>
      <Link href="#">Try log search</Link>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <div><Tag type="purple" size="sm">Beta</Tag></div>
      <h4>Cost anomaly alerts</h4>
      <p>
        Get notified when a service's daily spend moves more than 20% from its
        14-day baseline.
      </p>
      <Link href="#">Join the beta</Link>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
</Carousel>
```

### Usage

| Do | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Use a carousel for a short, ordered set of related content, such as release highlights or a first-run tour. | Only one slide is visible at a time, so content the user must compare side by side belongs in a grid or table. |
| Keep the set small, typically three to five slides. | There is no slide picker; reaching the last slide takes one press per slide. |
| Put a call to action on the slide it belongs to. | The prev/next buttons only move between slides; they do not confirm or submit anything. |
| Set `labelText` to describe the set, for example "What's new in 4.2". | Screen readers announce the region as a carousel with this name. |
| Turn on `showCounter` whenever you set `wrap`. | With `wrap`, the buttons never disable, so the counter is the only sign of where the set starts and ends. |

### Content

Slides accept any markup. Combine them with other components to fit the context the carousel sits in.

#### Feature tour

Pair a pictogram with short copy for a first-run tour, and end on the slide that starts the task.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Carousel,
    CarouselItem,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import ContinuousDelivery from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/ContinuousDelivery.svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import Rocket from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Rocket.svelte";
  import Security from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Security.svelte";
</script>

<Carousel labelText="Getting started">
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={6} align="center">
      <Rocket />
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <h4>Deploy from any branch</h4>
        <p>
          Connect a repository and every push to a branch gets its own preview
          URL.
        </p>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={6} align="center">
      <ContinuousDelivery />
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <h4>Promote with confidence</h4>
        <p>
          Promote a preview to production once checks pass. Every promotion can
          be rolled back in one click.
        </p>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={6} align="center">
      <Security />
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <h4>Secrets stay secret</h4>
        <p>
          Environment variables are encrypted at rest and only exposed to the
          environments you choose.
        </p>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={6} align="center">
      <Dashboard />
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <h4>You're all set</h4>
        <p>
          Create your first project to see builds, logs, and usage in one place.
```
