
#### Metrics

Cycle through key metrics in a space that only fits one. Each slide is labeled "Slide N of M" by default; set `label` on a `CarouselItem` to name it after its content instead.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    BigNumber,
    Carousel,
    CarouselItem,
    Tile,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tile>
  <Carousel
    labelText="Service health"
    prevButtonLabelText="Previous metric"
    nextButtonLabelText="Next metric"
  >
    <CarouselItem label="Requests">
      <BigNumber
        labelText="Requests (24h)"
        value={1843200}
        size="lg"
        trend="up"
      />
    </CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem label="Latency">
      <BigNumber
        labelText="p95 latency (ms)"
        value={212}
        size="lg"
        trend="down"
        trendColor="success"
      />
    </CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem label="Error rate">
      <BigNumber
        labelText="Error rate"
        value={0.4}
        percentage
        size="lg"
        trend="flat"
      />
    </CarouselItem>
  </Carousel>
</Tile>
```

### Navigation

Control what happens at the ends of the set and how the user's position is shown.

#### Wrap around

Set `wrap` to `true` to go from the last slide back to the first, and from the first to the last, with the buttons or <kbd>Left</kbd> and <kbd>Right</kbd>. Use it for sets with no natural order, like rotating tips. Pair it with `showCounter`, since the buttons no longer disable at the ends. A bound `selectedIndex` is still clamped, not wrapped.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Carousel,
    CarouselItem,
    Stack,
    Tile,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tile>
  <Carousel
    labelText="Tip of the day"
    wrap
    showCounter
    prevButtonLabelText="Previous tip"
    nextButtonLabelText="Next tip"
  >
    <CarouselItem>
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <h5>Filter logs by trace</h5>
        <p>
          Click any trace ID in a log line to show only the lines from that
          request.
        </p>
      </Stack>
    </CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem>
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <h5>Pin a deploy</h5>
        <p>
          Pinned deploys are skipped by automatic cleanup, so you can always
          roll back to them.
        </p>
      </Stack>
    </CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem>
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <h5>Share a dashboard view</h5>
        <p>
          The URL keeps your time range and filters. Paste it into an incident
          channel to share exactly what you see.
        </p>
      </Stack>
    </CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem>
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <h5>Mute a noisy alert</h5>
        <p>
          Snooze an alert for an hour or a day from the notification itself,
          without editing the rule.
        </p>
      </Stack>
    </CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem>
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <h5>Compare two builds</h5>
        <p>
          Select two builds in the history to see which dependencies and
          settings changed between them.
        </p>
      </Stack>
    </CarouselItem>
  </Carousel>
</Tile>
```

#### Counter

Set `showCounter` to `true` to show the active slide's position next to the buttons. Override the wording with `counterText`, which receives the 1-based position and the total.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Carousel, CarouselItem, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Carousel
  labelText="Database failover runbook"
  showCounter
  counterText={(current, total) => `Step ${current} of ${total}`}
  prevButtonLabelText="Previous step"
  nextButtonLabelText="Next step"
>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <h5>Confirm the primary is down</h5>
      <p>
        Check the health dashboard and verify writes are failing for at least
        two minutes.
      </p>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <h5>Freeze deploys</h5>
      <p>
        Post in the incident channel and pause the deploy pipeline so no
        migrations run mid-failover.
      </p>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <h5>Promote the replica</h5>
      <p>
        Run the promote command against the replica with the lowest replication
        lag.
      </p>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <h5>Verify and unfreeze</h5>
      <p>
        Confirm writes succeed on the new primary, then resume the deploy
        pipeline.
      </p>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
</Carousel>
```

### Height

By default, the viewport is sized to the tallest slide so the controls stay put while slides of different lengths cycle through.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Carousel,
    CarouselItem,
    Stack,
    UserAvatar,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Carousel labelText="Customer stories">
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <p>"We cut our release cycle from two weeks to two days."</p>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} align="center">
        <UserAvatar name="Priya Raman" size="sm" />
        <span>Priya Raman, Platform Lead at Northwind</span>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <p>
        "Before the migration, every deploy meant a late night and a runbook
        nobody trusted. Now previews catch most regressions before review,
        rollbacks take seconds, and on-call has gone from the most dreaded
        rotation on the team to one people barely notice."
      </p>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} align="center">
        <UserAvatar name="Tomás Ferreira" size="sm" />
        <span>Tomás Ferreira, SRE at Contoso</span>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={4}>
      <p>"Onboarding a new engineer takes an afternoon, not a week."</p>
      <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} align="center">
        <UserAvatar name="Amara Okafor" size="sm" />
        <span>Amara Okafor, Engineering Manager at Fabrikam</span>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
</Carousel>
```

Set `useMaxHeight` to `false` to size the viewport to the active slide instead. The controls then move with the content, so use it where the carousel is the last thing in its container.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Carousel, CarouselItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Carousel labelText="Customer stories" useMaxHeight={false}>
  <CarouselItem>
    <p>"We cut our release cycle from two weeks to two days."</p>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <p>
      "Before the migration, every deploy meant a late night and a runbook
      nobody trusted. Now previews catch most regressions before review,
      rollbacks take seconds, and on-call has gone from the most dreaded
      rotation on the team to one people barely notice."
    </p>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <p>"Onboarding a new engineer takes an afternoon, not a week."</p>
  </CarouselItem>
</Carousel>
```

### Selection

Choose which slide is active, and read or drive it from outside the carousel.

#### Initial slide

Set `selectedIndex` to start on a slide other than the first, for example to resume a checklist where the user left off. Out-of-range values are clamped to the first or last slide.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Carousel,
    CarouselItem,
    Stack,
    Tag,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Carousel labelText="Account setup checklist" selectedIndex={2}>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <div><Tag type="green" size="sm">Done</Tag></div>
      <h4>Verify your email</h4>
      <p>Confirmed on March 4.</p>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <div><Tag type="green" size="sm">Done</Tag></div>
      <h4>Add a payment method</h4>
      <p>Visa ending in 4242.</p>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <div><Tag type="red" size="sm">Required</Tag></div>
      <h4>Turn on two-factor authentication</h4>
      <p>Protect your account with an authenticator app or a security key.</p>
      <div><Button size="small">Set up 2FA</Button></div>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
  <CarouselItem>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <div><Tag type="gray" size="sm">Optional</Tag></div>
      <h4>Invite your team</h4>
      <p>Add collaborators now or later from project settings.</p>
    </Stack>
  </CarouselItem>
</Carousel>
```

#### Two-way binding

Bind `selectedIndex` to keep the carousel in sync with another control. Here, a `ProgressIndicator` tracks the active step and moves the carousel when a completed step is clicked. Arrow keys typed in the text input and radio buttons stay in those fields instead of changing the slide.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Carousel,
    CarouselItem,
    ProgressIndicator,
    ProgressStep,
    RadioButton,
    RadioButtonGroup,
    Stack,
    TextInput,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const steps = ["Project", "Region", "Review"];

  let selectedIndex = 0;
  let projectName = "checkout-service";
  let region = "us-east";
</script>

<Stack gap={7}>
  <ProgressIndicator
    currentIndex={selectedIndex}
    spaceEqually
    on:change={(e) => (selectedIndex = e.detail)}
  >
    {#each steps as step, index}
      <ProgressStep label={step} complete={index < selectedIndex} />
    {/each}
  </ProgressIndicator>

  <Carousel
    labelText="Create project"
    prevButtonLabelText="Previous step"
    nextButtonLabelText="Next step"
    bind:selectedIndex
  >
    <CarouselItem label="Step 1: Project">
      <TextInput
        labelText="Project name"
        helperText="Lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes"
        bind:value={projectName}
      />
    </CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem label="Step 2: Region">
      <RadioButtonGroup
        legendText="Region"
        orientation="vertical"
        bind:selected={region}
      >
        <RadioButton labelText="US East (Virginia)" value="us-east" />
        <RadioButton labelText="EU West (Frankfurt)" value="eu-west" />
        <RadioButton labelText="AP South (Mumbai)" value="ap-south" />
      </RadioButtonGroup>
    </CarouselItem>
    <CarouselItem label="Step 3: Review">
      <Stack gap={3}>
        <h4>Ready to create</h4>
        <p>
          <strong>{projectName || "Untitled"}</strong>
          will be created in <strong>{region}</strong>.
        </p>
      </Stack>
    </CarouselItem>
  </Carousel>
</Stack>
```

### Dynamic slides

Add or remove `CarouselItem`s with `{#each}` or `{#if}`. The carousel keeps the active index, clamps it if the last slide is removed, and renumbers the default slide labels.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Carousel,
    CarouselItem,
    Stack,
    Tag,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
  import Close from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Close.svelte";

  const backlog = [
    {
      tag: "Incident",
      type: "red",
      title: "Degraded builds in EU West",
      body: "Queue times are elevated. Builds are running but may take up to 10 minutes to start.",
    },
    {
      tag: "Billing",
      type: "cyan",
      title: "New invoice available",
      body: "Your September invoice is ready to download from the billing page.",
    },
    {
      tag: "Security",
      type: "purple",
      title: "Rotate your API tokens",
      body: "Tokens created before 2024 will stop working on November 1.",
    },
  ];

  let nextId = 3;
  let selectedIndex = 0;
  let announcements = [
    {
      id: 1,
      tag: "Maintenance",
      type: "warm-gray",
      title: "Database maintenance on Sunday",
      body: "Expect up to 5 minutes of read-only mode between 02:00 and 02:30 UTC.",
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      tag: "Feature",
      type: "green",
      title: "Preview environments are GA",
      body: "Every pull request now gets its own URL. No configuration needed.",
    },
  ];

  function add() {
    const next = backlog[(nextId - 3) % backlog.length];
    announcements = [...announcements, { id: nextId++, ...next }];
    selectedIndex = announcements.length - 1;
  }

  /** @param {number} id */
  function dismiss(id) {
    announcements = announcements.filter((item) => item.id !== id);
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Stack orientation="horizontal" justify="space-between" align="center">
    <span>
      {announcements.length}
      {announcements.length === 1 ? "announcement" : "announcements"}
    </span>
    <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" icon={Add} on:click={add}>
      Add announcement
    </Button>
  </Stack>

  {#if announcements.length > 0}
    <Carousel labelText="Announcements" bind:selectedIndex>
      {#each announcements as item (item.id)}
        <CarouselItem>
          <Stack gap={3}>
            <Stack
              orientation="horizontal"
              justify="space-between"
              align="center"
            >
              <Tag type={item.type} size="sm">{item.tag}</Tag>
              <Button
                kind="ghost"
                size="small"
                icon={Close}
                iconDescription="Dismiss announcement"
                tooltipPosition="left"
                on:click={() => dismiss(item.id)}
              />
            </Stack>
            <h4>{item.title}</h4>
            <p>{item.body}</p>
          </Stack>
        </CarouselItem>
      {/each}
    </Carousel>
  {:else}
    <p>You're all caught up.</p>
  {/if}
</Stack>
```

### Events

Listen for `change` to react to navigation from the buttons, arrow keys, or a bound `selectedIndex`. `event.detail` contains `currentIndex`, `previousIndex`, and `totalViews`. It does not fire for the initial `selectedIndex`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Carousel,
    CarouselItem,
    Stack,
    StructuredList,
    StructuredListBody,
    StructuredListCell,
    StructuredListHead,
    StructuredListRow,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const plans = [
    {
      name: "Lite",
      price: "$0",
      detail: "1 project, 100 build minutes per month, community support.",
    },
    {
      name: "Team",
      price: "$29 per seat",
      detail:
        "Unlimited projects, 3,000 build minutes, preview environments, email support.",
    },
    {
      name: "Enterprise",
      price: "Contact sales",
      detail: "SSO, audit logs, dedicated runners, and a 99.99% uptime SLA.",
    },
  ];

  let events = [];

  function track(e) {
    const { currentIndex, previousIndex, totalViews } = e.detail;
    events = [
      {
        time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(),
        from: plans[previousIndex].name,
        to: plans[currentIndex].name,
        position: `${currentIndex + 1} of ${totalViews}`,
      },
      ...events,
    ].slice(0, 4);
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={7}>
  <Carousel labelText="Plans" on:change={track}>
    {#each plans as plan}
      <CarouselItem label={plan.name}>
        <Stack gap={3}>
          <h4>{plan.name}</h4>
          <p><strong>{plan.price}</strong></p>
          <p>{plan.detail}</p>
        </Stack>
      </CarouselItem>
    {/each}
  </Carousel>

  <StructuredList condensed>
    <StructuredListHead>
      <StructuredListRow head>
        <StructuredListCell head>Time</StructuredListCell>
        <StructuredListCell head>From</StructuredListCell>
        <StructuredListCell head>To</StructuredListCell>
        <StructuredListCell head>Position</StructuredListCell>
      </StructuredListRow>
    </StructuredListHead>
    <StructuredListBody>
      {#each events as event}
        <StructuredListRow>
          <StructuredListCell>{event.time}</StructuredListCell>
          <StructuredListCell>{event.from}</StructuredListCell>
          <StructuredListCell>{event.to}</StructuredListCell>
          <StructuredListCell>{event.position}</StructuredListCell>
        </StructuredListRow>
      {:else}
        <StructuredListRow>
          <StructuredListCell
            >Navigate the carousel to log change events.</StructuredListCell
          >
        </StructuredListRow>
      {/each}
    </StructuredListBody>
  </StructuredList>
</Stack>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Carousel` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedIndex` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the active slide index.<br />Out-of-range values are clamped to the first or last slide. | `0` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the accessible label for the carousel region. | `"Carousel"` |
| `prevButtonLabelText` | `string` | Specify the accessible label for the previous-slide button. | `"Previous slide"` |
| `nextButtonLabelText` | `string` | Specify the accessible label for the next-slide button. | `"Next slide"` |
| `useMaxHeight` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to size the viewport to each active slide's own height<br />instead of the tallest slide. | `true` |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to wrap around: next on the last slide goes to the first,<br />and previous on the first slide goes to the last. Applies to the buttons<br />and arrow keys; a bound `selectedIndex` is still clamped. | `false` |
| `showCounter` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to show the active slide's position next to the buttons.<br />Pair it with `wrap`, where the buttons no longer disable at the bounds. | `false` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the top-level element.<br />The viewport id derives from it as `{id}-viewport`. | `uniqueId()` |
| `counterText` | `(current: number, total: number) => string` | Override the counter text. | `(current, total) => `${current} of ${total}`` |

#### `Carousel` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Carousel` dispatched events

| Event | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `on:change` | `{<br />  currentIndex: number;<br />  previousIndex: number;<br />  totalViews: number;<br />}` |

#### `Carousel` $$restProps

`Carousel` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## ChatButton

### Kinds

ChatButton is a [Button](/components/Button) with fully rounded ends, for actions in a chat, such as in a ChatLog or beside its composer. It takes Button's props, such as `href`, `type` and `loading`, and forwards its events.

Set `kind` to `"primary"` (the default), `"secondary"`, `"tertiary"`, `"ghost"` or `"danger"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} wrap="wrap">
  <ChatButton>Primary</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton kind="secondary">Secondary</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton kind="tertiary">Tertiary</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton kind="ghost">Ghost</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton kind="danger">Danger</ChatButton>
</Stack>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to `"field"` or `"small"` for a shorter button. Each size stays fully rounded.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} align="center" wrap="wrap">
  <ChatButton>Default</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton size="field">Field</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton size="small">Small</ChatButton>
</Stack>
```

### With icon

Set `icon` to show an icon after the label.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
  import Send from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Send.svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} wrap="wrap">
  <ChatButton icon={Send}>Send</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton kind="tertiary" icon={Add}>New chat</ChatButton>
</Stack>
```

### Quick action

Set `quickAction` for a quick action: a small pill with an outline in place of a fill, such as a suggested reply or a follow-up question. A quick action is always small and ghost, so it ignores `kind` and `size`. It fills on hover.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} wrap="wrap">
  <ChatButton quickAction>Summarize</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton quickAction>Translate</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton quickAction icon={Add}>Add a source</ChatButton>
</Stack>
```

#### Selected

Set `selected` to mark the quick action someone chose. It fills in a quieter color. Screen readers hear a quick action as a toggle button, pressed when selected, from `aria-pressed`. A quick action rendered as a link with `href` has no pressed state.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} wrap="wrap">
  <ChatButton quickAction selected>Summarize</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton quickAction>Translate</ChatButton>
</Stack>
```

#### Disabled

Set `disabled` to turn off a button. A selected quick action keeps its fill when disabled, so once a choice is made, the others can be disabled and the chosen one still shows.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} align="center" wrap="wrap">
  <ChatButton quickAction selected disabled>Summarize</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton quickAction disabled>Translate</ChatButton>
  <ChatButton disabled>Primary</ChatButton>
</Stack>
```

### Quick actions under a message

Put quick actions in a ChatMessage's `attachments` slot, so they sit under the bubble. Here, choosing one sends it as your reply, keeps it selected, and disables the others. The chosen button stays enabled, so keyboard focus isn't lost.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ChatButton,
    ChatLog,
    ChatMessage,
    Stack,
    UserAvatar,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Bot from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Bot.svelte";

  const actions = ["Send reminders", "Export as CSV", "Show the oldest"];

  // The chosen reply stays selected, and the others are disabled.
  let chosen;
</script>

<ChatLog labelText="Conversation with the assistant">
  <ChatMessage from="me" author="You">Which invoices are overdue?</ChatMessage>
  <ChatMessage author="Assistant">
    <UserAvatar slot="avatar" size="sm" icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
    Three invoices are overdue, for $4,200 in total. What would you like to do?
    <Stack slot="attachments" orientation="horizontal" gap={3} wrap="wrap">
      {#each actions as action}
        <ChatButton
          quickAction
          selected={chosen === action}
          disabled={chosen !== undefined && chosen !== action}
          on:click={() => {
            if (!chosen) chosen = action;
          }}
        >
          {action}
        </ChatButton>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
  </ChatMessage>
  {#if chosen}
    <ChatMessage from="me" author="You">{chosen}</ChatMessage>
  {/if}
</ChatLog>
```

### Skeleton

Use ChatButtonSkeleton while the buttons load. Set `size` to match the buttons it stands in for, such as `"small"` for quick actions.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatButtonSkeleton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} align="center" wrap="wrap">
  <ChatButtonSkeleton />
  <ChatButtonSkeleton size="field" />
  <ChatButtonSkeleton size="small" />
</Stack>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ChatButton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLAnchorElement \| HTMLButtonElement` | Obtain a reference to the HTML element. | `null` |
| `kind` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "tertiary" \| "ghost" \| "danger"` | Specify the kind of button.<br />A quick action is always `"ghost"`. | `"primary"` |
| `size` | `"default" \| "field" \| "small" \| undefined` | Specify the size of button.<br />A quick action is always `"small"`.<br />Falls back to the height of a parent `Form`'s size, as Button does. | `"default"` |
| `quickAction` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render a quick action: a small, outlined pill, such<br />as a suggested reply under a chat message. | `false` |
| `selected` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to mark a quick action as selected.<br />Screen readers hear it as a pressed toggle button.<br />Only applies to quick actions. | `false` |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify the icon to render. | _undefined_ |

#### `ChatButton` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ChatButton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:mousedown`  |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ChatButton` $$restProps

`ChatButton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `Button` component.

#### `ChatButtonSkeleton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"default" \| "field" \| "small" \| undefined` | Specify the size of the skeleton, to match the ChatButton it stands in for.<br />Falls back to the height of a parent `Form`'s size, as ButtonSkeleton does. | `"default"` |

#### `ChatButtonSkeleton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ChatButtonSkeleton` $$restProps

`ChatButtonSkeleton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `ButtonSkeleton` component.


## ChatLog

### Basic

ChatLog is a `role="log"` region around a list of messages that scrolls itself. It starts at the latest message and keeps new messages in view while the reader is at the end, but leaves the scroll alone while they read back; a message the user sends always comes into view. It takes focus so keyboard users can scroll it. Name it with `labelText`, and give it a height, such as by placing it in a flex column, where it fills the space left.

Each ChatMessage sets `from` to `"me"` (end-aligned, in a filled bubble) or `"them"` (start-aligned, beside the `avatar` slot), and `author` to who sent it, such as "Sam", or "You" for the user's own. Alignment alone doesn't tell screen reader users who is speaking, so they hear the author before each message. Set `continued` on a message from the same author as the one before, to group them. ChatDivider labels a break, such as a new day.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Button,
    ChatDivider,
    ChatLog,
    ChatMessage,
    groupChatMessages,
    InputGroup,
    RelativeTime,
    TextArea,
    UserAvatar,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Send from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Send.svelte";

  const minutesAgo = (minutes) => Date.now() - minutes * 60_000;

  let messages = [
    {
      id: 1,
      from: "them",
      author: "Sam",
      time: minutesAgo(26 * 60),
      text: "Your order left the warehouse. It should arrive tomorrow.",
    },
    {
      id: 2,
      from: "them",
      author: "Sam",
      time: minutesAgo(12),
      text: "Hi again! Anything else I can help with?",
    },
    {
      id: 3,
      from: "them",
      author: "Sam",
      time: minutesAgo(11),
      text: "I can change the address or the delivery day.",
    },
    {
      id: 4,
      from: "me",
      author: "You",
      time: minutesAgo(2),
      text: "Can it come to my office instead?",
      status: "read",
    },
  ];
  let draft = "";
  let typing = false;

  // For demo purposes only: stands in for sending the message and the reply.
  function send() {
    const text = draft.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    const id = Date.now();
    messages = [
      ...messages,
      { id, from: "me", author: "You", time: id, text, status: "sending" },
    ];
    draft = "";
    const setStatus = (status) =>
      (messages = messages.map((message) =>
        message.id === id ? { ...message, status } : message,
      ));
    setTimeout(() => setStatus("delivered"), 500);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setStatus("read");
      typing = true;
    }, 900);
    setTimeout(() => {
      typing = false;
      messages = [
        ...messages,
        {
          id: Date.now(),
          from: "them",
          author: "Sam",
          time: Date.now(),
          text: "Done. I've updated the address.",
        },
      ];
    }, 2100);
  }
</script>

<Box display="flex" direction="column" height="calc(100vh - 3rem)">
  <ChatLog labelText="Conversation with Sam">
    {#each groupChatMessages(messages) as item (item.key)}
      {#if item.type === "divider"}
        <ChatDivider>{item.label}</ChatDivider>
      {:else}
        <ChatMessage
          from={item.message.from}
          author={item.message.author}
          continued={item.continued}
          status={item.last ? item.message.status : undefined}
        >
          <UserAvatar slot="avatar" size="sm" name="Sam Carter" />
          {item.message.text}
          <svelte:fragment slot="meta">
            {#if item.last}
              <RelativeTime
                date={item.message.time}
                minUnit="minute"
                absoluteAfter={60 * 60 * 1000}
              />
            {/if}
          </svelte:fragment>
        </ChatMessage>
      {/if}
    {/each}
    {#if typing}
      <ChatMessage typing typingText="Sam is typing">
        <UserAvatar slot="avatar" size="sm" name="Sam Carter" />
      </ChatMessage>
    {/if}
  </ChatLog>
  <form on:submit|preventDefault={send}>
    <InputGroup>
      <TextArea
        hideLabel
        labelText="Message"
        placeholder="Write a message"
        rows={1}
        grow
        maxRows={4}
        bind:value={draft}
        on:keydown={(event) => {
          // Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line. Skip while an IME
          // is composing, where Enter confirms the text.
          if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey && !event.isComposing) {
            event.preventDefault();
            send();
          }
        }}
      />
      <Button type="submit" icon={Send} iconDescription="Send" />
    </InputGroup>
  </form>
</Box>
```

The composer is a TextArea that grows with the message up to four lines (`grow`, `maxRows`). Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a new line.

### Grouping and time

`groupChatMessages` works out the grouping from your messages' `author` and `time`. A message continues the group when it follows one from the same author within five minutes (`groupGap`), and the last message of each group is marked `last`, the place for its time and delivery status. A divider comes before each new day ("Today", "Yesterday", or a date) and after a pause of more than an hour (`dividerGap`), showing the time. Labels use `locale`; pass `label` to write your own.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ChatDivider,
    ChatMessage,
    RelativeTime,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

{#each groupChatMessages(messages) as item (item.key)}
  {#if item.type === "divider"}
    <ChatDivider>{item.label}</ChatDivider>
  {:else}
    <ChatMessage
      from={item.message.from}
      author={item.message.author}
      continued={item.continued}
      status={item.last ? item.message.status : undefined}
    >
      {item.message.text}
      <svelte:fragment slot="meta">
        {#if item.last}
          <RelativeTime
            date={item.message.time}
            minUnit="minute"
            absoluteAfter={60 * 60 * 1000}
          />
        {/if}
      </svelte:fragment>
    </ChatMessage>
  {/if}
{/each}
```

### Group chats

Set `showAuthor` to also show the author's name above the first message of each group, so readers can tell several people apart.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatLog, ChatMessage, UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ChatLog labelText="Launch planning">
  <ChatMessage author="Sam Carter" showAuthor>
    <UserAvatar slot="avatar" size="sm" name="Sam Carter" />
    The release notes are ready for review.
  </ChatMessage>
  <ChatMessage author="Priya Shah" showAuthor>
    <UserAvatar slot="avatar" size="sm" name="Priya Shah" />
    I'll take a look this afternoon.
  </ChatMessage>
  <ChatMessage author="Priya Shah" showAuthor continued>
    <UserAvatar slot="avatar" size="sm" name="Priya Shah" />
    Can we ship on Thursday?
  </ChatMessage>
</ChatLog>
```

### Streaming replies

Set `streaming` on a message while it is still arriving, such as an assistant's reply streamed word by word. A caret blinks at the end of the text, holding still when reduced motion is preferred. The log announces new messages as they arrive, so without `streaming` screen readers would read every chunk; with it, they wait and read the reply once, in full.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatMessage } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ChatMessage author="Assistant" streaming={!reply.done}
  >{reply.text}</ChatMessage
>
```

### Delivery status

Set `status` on your own message to `"sending"`, `"sent"`, `"delivered"`, `"read"` or `"failed"`, on the last message of a group. Each shows an icon and a word, which `statusText` can translate. A failed message adds a Retry button that dispatches `retry`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatLog, ChatMessage } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ChatLog labelText="Conversation with Sam">
  <ChatMessage from="me" author="You" status="read">
    Can it come to my office instead?
  </ChatMessage>
  <ChatMessage from="me" author="You" status="failed">
    It's the building on Pine Street.
  </ChatMessage>
</ChatLog>
```

### Attachments

Put cards, files, images and code blocks in the `attachments` slot. They sit under the bubble on the page's background, so they read the same in a message from anyone. Use the components you would use elsewhere: CodeSnippet for code, and ClickableTile for a link preview, so the whole card is the link. For an assistant, give UserAvatar an `icon`. Suggested replies go here too, as [quick actions](/components/ChatButton#quick-actions-under-a-message).

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ChatLog,
    ChatMessage,
    ClickableTile,
    CodeSnippet,
    Stack,
    Text,
    UserAvatar,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Bot from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Bot.svelte";
</script>

<ChatLog labelText="Conversation with the assistant">
  <ChatMessage from="me" author="You" status="read">
    How do I list overdue invoices?
  </ChatMessage>
  <ChatMessage author="Assistant">
    <UserAvatar slot="avatar" size="sm" icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
    Call the invoices endpoint with a status filter.
    <svelte:fragment slot="attachments">
      <CodeSnippet code="GET /v1/invoices?status=overdue" />
      <ClickableTile size="sm" href="#attachments">
        <Stack gap={2}>
          <Text type="heading-01">API reference: Invoices</Text>
          <Text type="body-compact-01" color="secondary"
            >List, filter and page through invoices.</Text
          >
        </Stack>
      </ClickableTile>
    </svelte:fragment>
  </ChatMessage>
</ChatLog>
```

#### Files

Show a file someone sent with FileDownloadItem, a link that downloads it, and a file you are sending with FileUploaderItem, whose `status` follows the upload. Both are the same row, so a thread reads the same either way.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ChatLog,
    ChatMessage,
    FileDownloadItem,
    FileUploaderItem,
    UserAvatar,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import DocumentPdf from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/DocumentPdf.svelte";
</script>

<ChatLog labelText="Conversation with Jordan">
  <ChatMessage author="Jordan">
    <UserAvatar slot="avatar" size="sm" name="Jordan Kim" />
    Notes from today's review.
    <svelte:fragment slot="attachments">
      <FileDownloadItem
        noMargin
        href="#files"
        icon={DocumentPdf}
        name="Q3-roadmap.pdf"
        fileSize="2.4 MB · PDF"
      />
    </svelte:fragment>
  </ChatMessage>
  <ChatMessage from="me" author="You" status="sending">
    Here are my comments.
    <svelte:fragment slot="attachments">
      <FileUploaderItem
        noMargin
        status="uploading"
        name="Q3-roadmap-comments.pdf"
        fileSize={310_000}
      />
    </svelte:fragment>
  </ChatMessage>
</ChatLog>
```

### Links and rich text

Message text rendered with `{text}` is escaped, so it can't inject markup, but its URLs aren't links. `linkSegments` splits plain text into text and links without parsing HTML. Only `http:`, `https:` and `mailto:` URLs become links (pass `schemes` to change them), so `javascript:` and `data:` stay text, and a link's text is its own URL.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatLog, ChatMessage, Link } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ChatLog labelText="Conversation with support">
  <ChatMessage author="Dana">
    {#each linkSegments(tracking) as part}{#if part.href}<Link
          href={part.href}
          target="_blank"
          rel="noopener noreferrer">{part.text}</Link
        >{:else}{part.text}{/if}{/each}
  </ChatMessage>
</ChatLog>
```

| Do | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Render message text with `{text}`, or with `linkSegments` for clickable URLs. | Both treat the message as text, so nothing in it can run as markup. |
| Never pass a message, or a model's reply, to `{@html}` as it is. | Svelte doesn't sanitize `{@html}`, and an assistant can repeat HTML injected into a page it read. |
| Sanitize Markdown or rich text with a library such as DOMPurify before `{@html}`, allowing only the tags you need. | Which tags are safe depends on what your app shows. |
| Check a link's scheme before putting user text in `href`. | Svelte doesn't block `javascript:` URLs in attributes; `linkSegments` does this for you. |
| Set `rel="noopener noreferrer"` on links that open a new tab. | The new page can't reach back into yours or see where it came from. |

### Meta and actions

The `meta` slot sits under a message, such as for the time, and the `actions` slot beside it, such as for a reply button. Show the time on the last message of a group, as `groupChatMessages` marks it. Actions appear on hover or focus where the device can hover, and always on touch screens.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ChatLog,
    ChatMessage,
    UserAvatar,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Copy from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Copy.svelte";
</script>

<ChatLog labelText="Conversation with Sam">
  <ChatMessage author="Sam">
    <UserAvatar slot="avatar" size="sm" name="Sam Carter" />
    Your order shipped this morning.
    <Button
      slot="actions"
      kind="ghost"
      size="small"
      icon={Copy}
      iconDescription="Copy message"
    />
    <span slot="meta">9:41 AM</span>
  </ChatMessage>
</ChatLog>
```

### Typing indicator

Set `typing` to show animated dots in place of the content. Screen readers hear `typingText`, announced as a status. The dots hold still when reduced motion is preferred.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ChatLog, ChatMessage, UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ChatLog labelText="Conversation with Sam">
  <ChatMessage typing typingText="Sam is typing">
    <UserAvatar slot="avatar" size="sm" name="Sam Carter" />
  </ChatMessage>
</ChatLog>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ChatLog` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the scrolling log element. | `null` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the accessible name of the conversation, such as "Conversation with Sam" | `""` |

#### `ChatLog` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ChatLog` $$restProps

`ChatLog` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `ChatMessage` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from` | `"me" \| "them"` | Specify who sent the message: `"me"` aligns it to the end with the<br />accent color, `"them"` to the start with the avatar. | `"them"` |
| `author` | `string` | Specify who sent the message, such as "Sam", or "You" for your own.<br />Screen readers announce it before the message, since alignment alone<br />doesn't say who is speaking. | `""` |
| `showAuthor` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to also show `author` above the first message of a<br />group, as in a group chat. | `false` |
| `continued` | `boolean` | Set to `true` when the previous message has the same author, to group<br />them: the avatar is left out and the gap is smaller. | `false` |
| `streaming` | `boolean` | Set to `true` while the message is still arriving, such as a reply<br />streamed word by word. Screen readers wait and announce it once, in<br />full, instead of every chunk. | `false` |
| `typing` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to show a typing indicator in place of the content. | `false` |
| `typingText` | `string` | Specify the text screen readers announce for the typing indicator | `"Typing"` |
| `status` | `undefined \| "sending" \| "sent" \| "delivered" \| "read" \| "failed"` | Set the delivery status of your own message, shown with the meta line.<br />Show it on the last message of a group. `"failed"` adds a Retry button<br />that dispatches `retry`. | _undefined_ |
| `statusText` | `(status: "sending" \| "sent" \| "delivered" \| "read" \| "failed") => string` | Specify the text for each delivery status. | `(status) =><br />  ({<br />    sending: "Sending",<br />    sent: "Sent",<br />    delivered: "Delivered",<br />    read: "Read",<br />    failed: "Not sent",<br />  })[status]` |
| `retryText` | `string` | Specify the text of the Retry button for a failed message | `"Retry"` |

#### `ChatMessage` slots

| Slot          | Detail                  |
| ------------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`     | `Record<string, never>` |
| `actions`     | `Record<string, never>` |
| `attachments` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `avatar`      | `Record<string, never>` |
| `meta`        | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ChatMessage` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail |
| ---------- | ------ |
| `on:retry` | `null` |

`ChatMessage` spreads `$$restProps` to the `li` element.

#### `ChatDivider` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

`ChatDivider` spreads `$$restProps` to the `li` element.


## Checkbox

### Basic

Create a checkbox with a label using `labelText`.

By default, the checkbox is unchecked.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox labelText="Sync data automatically" />
```

### Checked

Set `checked` to `true` to pre-select the checkbox.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox labelText="Remember this device" checked />
```

### Indeterminate

Set `indeterminate` to `true` to show a mixed state, typically used in parent checkboxes with some children selected.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox labelText="Select all permissions" indeterminate />
```

### Labels

Control the visibility and content of the checkbox label.

#### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox labelText="Select row" hideLabel />
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to provide custom label content instead of `labelText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox labelText="Fallback label">
  <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
    I agree to the <strong>terms and conditions</strong>
  </svelte:fragment>
</Checkbox>
```

#### Label title

A label too long for its container shows its full text in the native `title` attribute while it is cut off. Set `title` to choose that text yourself. It then applies at every width.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox
  labelText="Email notifications"
  title="Sent to the address on your profile"
/>
```

### No margin

By default, a checkbox renders with outer margin to space it within a stack of checkboxes. Set `noMargin` to `true` to omit the margin when the checkbox sits in a table cell or a row that spaces its own content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={5} align="center">
  <Checkbox noMargin labelText="Mark as reviewed" />
  <span>3 files changed</span>
</Stack>
```

### Helper text

Use `helperText` to provide additional context or instructions below the checkbox.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox
  labelText="Subscribe to newsletter"
  helperText="You can unsubscribe at any time"
/>
```

### AI label

Put an `AILabel` in the `decorator` slot to mark the option as AI-generated. The label renders at the `"mini"` size, or `"md"` for the inline kind. On a `CheckboxGroup`, the label follows the legend.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    AILabel,
    Checkbox,
    CheckboxGroup,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Checkbox labelText="Enable automatic failover" checked>
    <AILabel slot="decorator">
      <p>Recommended because this database had two outages last quarter.</p>
    </AILabel>
  </Checkbox>
  <CheckboxGroup legendText="Alert channels">
    <AILabel slot="decorator">
      <p>
        Picked from the channels your team acknowledged alerts in last month.
      </p>
    </AILabel>
    <Checkbox labelText="Email" checked />
    <Checkbox labelText="Slack" checked />
    <Checkbox labelText="PagerDuty" />
  </CheckboxGroup>
</Stack>
```

### States

Reflect validation and interaction states.

#### Disabled

Set `disabled` to `true` to prevent user interaction.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox labelText="Enable single sign-on (SSO)" disabled />
```

#### Read-only

Set `readonly` to `true` to make the checkbox non-interactive while keeping the label text readable. Unlike disabled, the readonly state is intended for displaying checkbox values that can only be changed programmatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox
  labelText="Require multi-factor authentication (unchecked)"
  readonly
/>
<Checkbox
  labelText="Require multi-factor authentication (checked)"
  checked
  readonly
/>
```

#### Invalid

Set `invalid` to `true` and provide `invalidText` to show a validation error.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox
  labelText="I agree to the terms and conditions"
  invalid
  invalidText="You must agree to the terms and conditions to continue"
/>
```

#### Warning

Set `warn` to `true` and provide `warnText` to show a warning message. `invalid` takes precedence over `warn` when both are set.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox
  labelText="Subscribe to promotional emails"
  warn
  warnText="You may receive fewer updates about your account"
/>
```

### Decorative

Set `decorative` to `true` to hide the checkbox from the accessibility tree using CSS, rather than just `tabindex`/`aria-hidden` (which axe-core's nested-interactive check doesn't treat as sufficient). Use this when the checkbox is nested inside another interactive, widget-role element that already owns the checked-state semantics, such as a custom listbox option.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div role="option" aria-selected="true" aria-checked="true">
  <Checkbox decorative checked labelText="Option A" hideLabel />
  Option A
</div>
```

### Reactive

Bind to track and update the checkbox state.

#### bind:checked

Use two-way binding with `bind:checked` to track the checkbox state.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Checkbox, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let checked = false;
</script>

<Stack inline gap={4}>
  <Checkbox labelText="Enable maintenance mode" bind:checked />
  <Button on:click={() => (checked = !checked)}>Toggle</Button>
  <div>
    <strong>checked:</strong>
    {checked}
  </div>
</Stack>
```

#### bind:group

Bind an array to `group` so each checkbox adds or removes its value when toggled. This API is inspired by Svelte [group inputs](https://svelte.dev/tutorial/svelte/group-inputs).

When using `bind:group`, the checked state is derived from the group array: use `bind:group` (not `bind:checked`) to control selection, since updating checked directly will be overwritten.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Checkbox, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const values = ["Production", "Staging", "Development"];
  let group = values.slice(0, 2);
</script>

<Stack inline gap={4}>
  <div>
    {#each values as value}
      <Checkbox bind:group labelText={value} {value} />
    {/each}
  </div>

  <Button on:click={() => (group = ["Staging"])}>Set to ["Staging"]</Button>

  <div>
    <strong>Selected:</strong>
    {JSON.stringify(group)}
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Events

Use `on:check` to listen for changes to a standalone checkbox. The event dispatches the new checked state as `event.detail`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Checkbox
  labelText="Enable audit logging"
  on:check={(e) => console.log(e.detail)} // boolean
/>
```

### Skeleton

Use `CheckboxSkeleton` to show a loading state.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CheckboxSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxSkeleton />
```

### CheckboxGroup

Use a checkbox group to wrap multiple checkbox components with a shared legend, layout, and validation. This mirrors the [RadioButtonGroup](/components/RadioButton) API but supports multiple selections.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup
  legendText="Notification preferences"
  name="prefs"
  selected={["email"]}
>
  <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email" />
  <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
  <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications" />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

#### Reactive

Use two-way binding with `bind:selected` to track and update the selected values.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    CheckboxGroup,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selected = ["email"];
</script>

<Stack inline gap={4}>
  <CheckboxGroup
    legendText="Notification preferences"
    name="prefs"
    bind:selected
  >
    <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email" />
    <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
    <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications" />
  </CheckboxGroup>

  <Button on:click={() => (selected = ["email", "push"])}>
    Select Email + Push
  </Button>

  <div>
    <strong>selected:</strong>
    {JSON.stringify(selected)}
  </div>
</Stack>
```

#### Horizontal

Set `orientation` to `"horizontal"` to lay the checkboxes out in a row. Each checkbox is sized to its label, and the row wraps when it runs out of space. The legend, helper text, and validation text stay above and below the row.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup
  orientation="horizontal"
  legendText="Show"
  name="prefs-horizontal"
  selected={["page", "markdown"]}
  helperText="Pick the views to compare"
>
  <Checkbox value="page" labelText="Page" />
  <Checkbox value="markdown" labelText="Markdown" />
  <Checkbox value="compiled" labelText="Compiled" />
  <Checkbox value="source" labelText="Source" />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

#### Hidden legend

Hide the legend visually by setting `hideLegend` to `true`. The legend remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup
  hideLegend
  legendText="Notification preferences"
  name="prefs-hidden"
  selected={["email"]}
>
  <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email" />
  <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
  <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications" />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

#### Custom label

Use the `legendChildren` slot to provide custom legend content instead of `legendText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Checkbox,
    CheckboxGroup,
    Stack,
    Tooltip,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup name="prefs-legend-slot" selected={["email"]}>
  <Stack slot="legendChildren" orientation="horizontal">
    Notification preferences
    <Tooltip>
      <p>You can change these settings at any time.</p>
    </Tooltip>
  </Stack>
  <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email" />
  <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
  <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications" />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

#### Helper text

Use `helperText` to provide additional context below the checkbox group.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup
  legendText="Notification preferences"
  name="prefs-helper"
  selected={["email"]}
  helperText="You can change these settings at any time"
>
  <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email" />
  <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
  <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications" />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

#### Disabled

Disable all checkboxes in the group.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup
  disabled
  legendText="Notification preferences"
  name="prefs-disabled"
  selected={["email"]}
>
  <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email" />
  <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
  <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications" />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

#### Read-only

Set `readonly` to `true` on CheckboxGroup to display non-editable values. Unlike disabled, the readonly state keeps labels readable. You can also set readonly on individual checkboxes when needed.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup
  readonly
  legendText="Notification preferences"
  name="prefs-readonly"
  selected={["email", "push"]}
>
  <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email" />
  <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
  <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications" />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

#### Invalid

Set `invalid` to `true` and provide `invalidText` to show a validation error for the group. The group's invalid state propagates to every checkbox in the group, so each one is styled as invalid and marked with `aria-invalid` without setting the prop individually.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup
  invalid
  invalidText="Select at least one notification preference"
  legendText="Notification preferences"
  name="prefs-invalid"
>
  <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email" />
  <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
  <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications" />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

#### Warning

Set `warn` to `true` and provide `warnText` to show a warning message for the group. Like `invalid`, the group's warning state propagates to every checkbox in the group.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup
  warn
  warnText="Push notifications may be delayed"
  legendText="Notification preferences"
  name="prefs-warn"
  selected={["email"]}
>
  <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email" />
  <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
  <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications" />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

#### Validation within a group

Set validation on the group rather than on individual checkboxes. Carbon hides a checkbox's own `invalidText` and `warnText` inside a group and resets its invalid styling unless the group itself is invalid, so the group owns the validation message for all of its checkboxes.

Disabled and read-only checkboxes are exempt from the group's validation styling.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup
  invalid
  invalidText="Select at least one notification preference"
  legendText="Notification preferences"
  name="prefs-invalid-suppressed"
  selected={["push"]}
>
  <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email (disabled)" disabled />
  <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
  <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications (read-only)" readonly />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

#### Events

Use `on:change` to listen for changes to the group's selected values. The event dispatches the updated array as `event.detail`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Checkbox, CheckboxGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CheckboxGroup
  legendText="Notification preferences"
  name="prefs-events"
  selected={["email"]}
  on:change={(e) => console.log(e.detail)} // Array<string | number>
>
  <Checkbox value="email" labelText="Email" />
  <Checkbox value="sms" labelText="SMS" />
  <Checkbox value="push" labelText="Push notifications" />
</CheckboxGroup>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Checkbox` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Specify whether the checkbox is checked.<br />Follows the box when the owning form resets. | `false` |
| `group` (Reactive) | `ReadonlyArray<T> \| undefined` | Specify the bound group. | _undefined_ |
| `indeterminate` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Specify whether the checkbox is indeterminate. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLInputElement` | Obtain a reference to the input HTML element. | `null` |
| `value` | `T` | Specify the value of the checkbox.<br />Submitted as `"on"` when empty, like a native checkbox. | `""` |
| `skeleton` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to display the skeleton state | `false` |
| `required` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to mark the field as required | `false` |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for the checkbox to be read-only | `false` |
| `readonlyText` | `string` | Specify the assistive text announced to screen readers when read-only.<br />Exposed because VoiceOver does not announce `aria-readonly`. | `"Read-only"` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the checkbox | `false` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text | `false` |
| `noMargin` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to omit the outer margin that spaces a stack of<br />checkboxes, as when the checkbox sits in a table cell or a row<br />that spaces its own content. | `false` |
| `helperText` | `string` | Specify the helper text | `""` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state | `false` |
| `invalidText` | `string` | Specify the invalid state text | `""` |
| `warn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate a warning state | `false` |
| `warnText` | `string` | Specify the warning state text | `""` |
| `name` | `string` | Set a name for the input element | `""` |
| `form` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the id of a form element outside the component to associate<br />the checkbox with. | _undefined_ |
| `title` | `string \| undefined` | Set the native `title` attribute on the label element. When unset,<br />the label takes its full text as `title` while it is truncated. | _undefined_ |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the input label | `uniqueId()` |
| `tabindex` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Set the tabindex for the input element. | _undefined_ |
| `decorative` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the input from the accessibility tree via CSS<br />(not just tabindex/aria-hidden, which axe-core's nested-interactive<br />check does not treat as sufficient). Use when this Checkbox is<br />nested inside another interactive/widget-role element that already<br />owns the checked-state semantics (e.g. a listbox option) and the<br />checkbox itself is purely decorative. | `false` |

#### `Checkbox` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `decorator`     | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Checkbox` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:change`     |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `Checkbox` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail    |
| ---------- | --------- |
| `on:check` | `boolean` |

#### `Checkbox` $$restProps

`Checkbox` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `CheckboxGroup` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` (Reactive) | `ReadonlyArray<Value>` | Set the selected checkbox values. | `[]` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable all checkboxes | `false` |
| `required` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to require at least one selection. | _undefined_ |
| `name` | `string \| undefined` | Specify a name attribute for the checkbox inputs. | _undefined_ |
| `form` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the id of a form element outside the component to associate<br />the fieldset and checkbox inputs with. Overrides each checkbox's own `form`. | _undefined_ |
| `legendText` | `string` | Specify the legend text.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "legendChildren". | `""` |
| `hideLegend` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the legend | `false` |
| `orientation` | `"vertical" \| "horizontal"` | Specify the orientation of the checkboxes.<br />`"horizontal"` lays them out in a wrapping row, each sized to its label. | `"vertical"` |
| `helperText` | `string` | Specify the helper text | `""` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state | `false` |
| `invalidText` | `string` | Specify the invalid state text | `""` |
| `warn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate a warning state | `false` |
| `warnText` | `string` | Specify the warning state text | `""` |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the read-only variant | `false` |
| `readonlyText` | `string` | Specify the assistive text announced to screen readers when read-only.<br />Exposed because VoiceOver does not announce `aria-readonly`. | `"Read-only"` |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | Set an id for the container div element. | _undefined_ |
