## ClickableTile

### Basic

Create a clickable tile with an href to link to another page. Press <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd> to follow the link; both fire `on:click` like a mouse click.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ClickableTile } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ClickableTile href="https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/api-gateway/">
  API documentation
</ClickableTile>
```

### Reactive example

Bind to `clicked` to read whether the tile has been activated. Without `href`, the tile acts as a button: <kbd>Tab</kbd> to it and press <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd> to toggle `clicked`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ClickableTile, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let clicked = false;
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <div>Acknowledged: <strong>{clicked}</strong></div>
  <ClickableTile bind:clicked>Acknowledge incident</ClickableTile>
</Stack>
```

### With icon

Set `icon` to show an icon in the bottom-right corner. In a right-to-left layout, it moves to the bottom-left corner and mirrors, so an arrow points left. Use `ArrowRight` for a page in your app and `Launch` for a link that opens another site. The icon is decorative and hidden from screen readers, so let the tile's text name the destination.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ClickableTile, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import ArrowRight from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/ArrowRight.svelte";
  import Launch from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Launch.svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <ClickableTile href="/docs/deploy" icon={ArrowRight}>
    Deployment guide
  </ClickableTile>
  <ClickableTile
    href="https://status.cloud.ibm.com/"
    target="_blank"
    icon={Launch}
  >
    Service status
  </ClickableTile>
</Stack>
```

### Prevent default

Handle the `click` event to override default link behavior. Call `e.preventDefault()` to stop navigation.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ClickableTile } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ClickableTile
  href="/incidents/new"
  on:click={(e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    // custom behavior
  }}
>
  Create incident
</ClickableTile>
```

### AI label

Put an `AILabel` in the `decorator` slot to mark the tile's content as AI-generated. The tile shows the AI surface, and the label sits in the top-right corner, outside the link at the `"xs"` size.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AILabel, ClickableTile } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ClickableTile href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/">
  Open the usage forecast
  <AILabel slot="decorator">
    <p>Projected from the last six months of spend.</p>
  </AILabel>
</ClickableTile>
```

#### Rounded corners

Set `rounded` to `true` to round the corners of a tile with a decorator. Carbon reserves rounded tiles for AI content, so a tile without a decorator stays square.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AILabel, ClickableTile } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ClickableTile href="https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/" rounded>
  Open the usage forecast
  <AILabel slot="decorator">
    <p>Projected from the last six months of spend.</p>
  </AILabel>
</ClickableTile>
```

### On a layer

Place the component in a [`Layer`](/components/Layer) to put it on the next surface, so it contrasts with the surface below. `Layer` replaces the v10 `light` prop.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, ClickableTile, Layer } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Layer withBackground>
  <Box padding={5}>
    <ClickableTile href="/services/object-storage">
      Object storage
    </ClickableTile>
  </Box>
</Layer>
```

### Disabled

Prevent interaction with `disabled`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ClickableTile } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ClickableTile disabled href="/audit-logs">Audit logs</ClickableTile>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ClickableTile` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clicked` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Whether the tile has been clicked.<br />Toggles on click and on Space/Enter. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLAnchorElement` | Obtain a reference to the underlying anchor HTML element. | `null` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| undefined` | Set the size: `"sm"` for a compact tile, such as a row in a list of<br />choices, with less padding and no minimum height. | _undefined_ |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the tile | `false` |
| `fullHeight` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to stretch the tile to fill the height of its container | `false` |
| `noPadding` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to remove the tile's padding | `false` |
| `rounded` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to round the tile's corners when it has a `decorator`,<br />such as an `AILabel`. Carbon reserves rounded tiles for AI content. | `false` |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify an icon to render in the bottom-right corner (bottom-left and<br />mirrored in right-to-left layouts), such as `ArrowRight` for a link<br />within the app or `Launch` for an external link. The icon is<br />decorative and hidden from assistive technology. | _undefined_ |
| `href` | `string \| undefined` | Set the `href`. | _undefined_ |

#### `ClickableTile` slots

| Slot        | Detail                  |
| ----------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`   | `Record<string, never>` |
| `decorator` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ClickableTile` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:keydown`    |
| `on:keyup`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ClickableTile` $$restProps

`ClickableTile` spreads `$$restProps` to the `a` element.


## CodeSnippet

### Basic

Display a single-line code snippet by default. By default, the copy button uses the native [Clipboard API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Clipboard/writeText) to copy text, with a `document.execCommand("copy")` fallback when that API is unavailable or rejects (for example in an insecure context). Pass a function to `copy` to replace it. See [Override](#override).

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet code="npm i carbon-components-svelte" />
```

### On a layer

Place the component in a [`Layer`](/components/Layer) to put it on the next surface, so it contrasts with the surface below. `Layer` replaces the v10 `light` prop.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, CodeSnippet, Layer } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Layer withBackground>
  <Box padding={5}>
    <CodeSnippet code="npm i carbon-components-svelte" />
  </Box>
</Layer>
```

### Right-to-left

Code reads left to right in any language. In a right-to-left layout, each line keeps its order and starts at the left, and the copy and expand buttons move to the left. Inline code keeps its order inside right-to-left text. See [LayoutDirection](/components/LayoutDirection).

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    CodeSnippet,
    LayoutDirection,
    Stack,
    Text,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const code =
    "export function isAdmin(role: string) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt: number) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}\n\nexport function toPercent(value: number) {\n  return (value * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';\n}\n\nexport function maskSecret(value: string) {\n  return value.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(value.length - 8, 0)) + value.slice(-4);\n}\n\nexport function isRateLimited(remaining: number) {\n  return remaining <= 0;\n}\n\nexport function toBackoffDelay(attempt: number) {\n  return Math.min(2 ** attempt * 1000, 30000);\n}\n\nexport function isStale(updatedAt: number, maxAgeMs: number) {\n  return Date.now() - updatedAt > maxAgeMs;\n}";
</script>

<LayoutDirection dir="rtl" lang="ar">
  <Stack gap={5}>
    <Text>
      شغّل <CodeSnippet type="inline" code="rm -rf node_modules/" /> قبل إعادة التثبيت.
    </Text>
    <CodeSnippet code={'npm run deploy -- --service="api-gateway"'} />
    <CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} />
  </Stack>
</LayoutDirection>
```

### Inline

Set `type="inline"` to display code inline with text. Click the snippet to copy it. Press <kbd>Escape</kbd> to hide the copy feedback early.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet type="inline" code="rm -rf node_modules/" />
```

### Multi-line

Set `type="multi"` to display multiple lines of code with expand/collapse functionality.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const code =
    "export function isAdmin(role: string) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt: number) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}\n\nexport function toPercent(value: number) {\n  return (value * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';\n}\n\nexport function maskSecret(value: string) {\n  return value.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(value.length - 8, 0)) + value.slice(-4);\n}\n\nexport function isRateLimited(remaining: number) {\n  return remaining <= 0;\n}\n\nexport function toBackoffDelay(attempt: number) {\n  return Math.min(2 ** attempt * 1000, 30000);\n}\n\nexport function isStale(updatedAt: number, maxAgeMs: number) {\n  return Date.now() - updatedAt > maxAgeMs;\n}";
</script>

<CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} />
```

#### Overflow detection

The "Show more"/"Show less" button only appears when the multi-line snippet content exceeds the collapsed height. Because the visibility is based on the snippet's measured height, it adapts to the consumer's font size and line height, and updates automatically if the content or layout changes.

Toggle the example below to grow the content past the threshold and reveal the expand button.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet, Stack, Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let expandable = false;

  $: length = expandable ? 24 : 4;
  $: code = Array.from(
    { length },
    (_, i) => `const line${i + 1} = ${i + 1};`,
  ).join("\n");
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Toggle bind:toggled={expandable} size="sm" labelText="Grow content" />
  <CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} />
</Stack>
```

#### Collapsed row count

Set `maxCollapsedNumberOfRows` to shorten the collapsed preview. Each row is 1rem tall, the code's line height, so the row counts hold at any text size; the default is `15`. Use `minCollapsedNumberOfRows`, `minExpandedNumberOfRows`, and `maxExpandedNumberOfRows` for the matching minimum and expanded limits.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const code =
    "export function isAdmin(role: string) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt: number) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}\n\nexport function toPercent(value: number) {\n  return (value * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';\n}\n\nexport function maskSecret(value: string) {\n  return value.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(value.length - 8, 0)) + value.slice(-4);\n}\n\nexport function isRateLimited(remaining: number) {\n  return remaining <= 0;\n}\n\nexport function toBackoffDelay(attempt: number) {\n  return Math.min(2 ** attempt * 1000, 30000);\n}\n\nexport function isStale(updatedAt: number, maxAgeMs: number) {\n  return Date.now() - updatedAt > maxAgeMs;\n}";
</script>

<CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} maxCollapsedNumberOfRows={6} />
```

#### Custom show more/less text

Set `showMoreText` and `showLessText` to customize the expand/collapse button text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const code =
    "export function isAdmin(role: string) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt: number) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}\n\nexport function toPercent(value: number) {\n  return (value * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';\n}\n\nexport function maskSecret(value: string) {\n  return value.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(value.length - 8, 0)) + value.slice(-4);\n}\n\nexport function isRateLimited(remaining: number) {\n  return remaining <= 0;\n}\n\nexport function toBackoffDelay(attempt: number) {\n  return Math.min(2 ** attempt * 1000, 30000);\n}\n\nexport function isStale(updatedAt: number, maxAgeMs: number) {\n  return Date.now() - updatedAt > maxAgeMs;\n}";
</script>

<CodeSnippet
  type="multi"
  {code}
  showMoreText="Expand"
  showLessText="Collapse"
/>
```

#### Full width

A single-line or multi-line snippet stops at 48rem. Set `fullWidth` to fill the container, such as a log or a response in a wide panel.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet
  type="multi"
  fullWidth
  code={`GET /v1/projects?limit=10
200 OK  80 ms  534 B`}
/>
```

#### Wrapped text

By default, the code snippet preserves text formatting and does not wrap text. Set `wrapText` to `true` to wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const comment =
    "> carbon-components-svelte is a Svelte component library that implements the [Carbon Design System](https://github.com/carbon-design-system), an open source design system by IBM.\n\n> A design system can facilitate frontend development and prototyping because it is encourages reuse, consistency, and extensibility.\n";
</script>

<CodeSnippet wrapText type="multi" code={comment} />
```

#### Expanded by default

Set `expanded` to `true` to show the full multi-line code snippet.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const code =
    "export function isAdmin(role: string) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt: number) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}\n\nexport function toPercent(value: number) {\n  return (value * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';\n}\n\nexport function maskSecret(value: string) {\n  return value.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(value.length - 8, 0)) + value.slice(-4);\n}\n\nexport function isRateLimited(remaining: number) {\n  return remaining <= 0;\n}\n\nexport function toBackoffDelay(attempt: number) {\n  return Math.min(2 ** attempt * 1000, 30000);\n}\n\nexport function isStale(updatedAt: number, maxAgeMs: number) {\n  return Date.now() - updatedAt > maxAgeMs;\n}";
</script>

<CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} expanded />
```

#### Events

Dispatches `expand` and `collapse` events when the snippet is toggled open and closed.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let expanded = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (expanded = !expanded)}>Toggle expansion</Button>

<CodeSnippet
  type="multi"
  code={Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => i + 1).join("\n")}
  bind:expanded
  on:expand={() => {
    console.log("on:expand");
  }}
  on:collapse={() => {
    console.log("on:collapse");
  }}
/>
```

#### Dynamic code

Use `code` instead of the default slot for dynamically updated code.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet, Stack, Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let toggled = false;

  $: length = toggled ? 20 : 10;
  $: code = Array.from({ length }, (_, i) => i + 1).join("\n");
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Toggle bind:toggled size="sm" labelText="Trigger snippet overflow" />
  <CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} />
</Stack>
```

#### Hidden content

A multi-line snippet that mounts inside a hidden container (for example, `display: none` or an inactive tab) measures its height again when the container becomes visible. The "Show more" button appears once the content is shown. You do not need to re-render the component.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, CodeSnippet, Stack, Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let toggled = false;

  const code = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => i + 1).join("\n");
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Toggle size="sm" labelText="Show code snippet" bind:toggled />
  <Box display={toggled ? undefined : "none"}>
    <CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} />
  </Box>
</Stack>
```

### Copy behavior

Customize, replace, or disable the default clipboard behavior.

#### Slot content

Omit `code` and pass the text in the default slot. The copy button copies the rendered text, with markup stripped. Set `code` to copy something other than what is shown.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet>npm i carbon-components-svelte</CodeSnippet>
```

#### Async

Pass an async function to `copy` when clipboard text is not ready at render time, such as a longer install command fetched on click. The copy feedback text appears after `copy()` resolves.

During the request, the copy control sets `aria-busy="true"` and ignores further clicks. A rejected copy shows `errorFeedback` (default `"Failed to copy"`) in the same tooltip slot as the success message and emits `copy:error`.

Prefetch on hover with `on:mouseenter:copy-button` on the copy control. The example below shows async copy for each variant (`single`, `inline`, `multi`).

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const displayCode = "npm i carbon-components-svelte";
  const fullInstallCommand =
    "npm install --save-dev carbon-components-svelte carbon-icons-svelte";

  const multiDisplayCode =
    "export function isAdmin(role) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}";

  const multiFullCode =
    "export function isAdmin(role) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}";

  let cachedSingleCommand = null;
  let cachedInlineCommand = null;
  let cachedMultiCommand = null;

  function logEvent(variant, event) {
    return () => {
      console.log(event, variant);
    };
  }

  async function prefetchSingle() {
    if (cachedSingleCommand) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    cachedSingleCommand = fullInstallCommand;
  }

  async function prefetchInline() {
    if (cachedInlineCommand) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    cachedInlineCommand = "rm -rf node_modules/ && npm install";
  }

  async function prefetchMulti() {
    if (cachedMultiCommand) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    cachedMultiCommand = multiFullCode;
  }

  async function copySingle() {
    if (!cachedSingleCommand) await prefetchSingle();
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(cachedSingleCommand);
  }

  async function copyInline() {
    if (!cachedInlineCommand) await prefetchInline();
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(cachedInlineCommand);
  }

  async function copyMulti() {
    if (!cachedMultiCommand) await prefetchMulti();
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(cachedMultiCommand);
  }

  function onMouseenterCopyButton(variant, prefetch) {
    return () => {
      console.log("mouseenter", variant);
      prefetch();
    };
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={4}>
  <div>
    <CodeSnippet
      type="inline"
      code="rm -rf node_modules/"
      copy={copyInline}
      on:mouseenter:copy-button={onMouseenterCopyButton(
        "inline",
        prefetchInline,
      )}
      on:mouseleave:copy-button={logEvent("inline", "mouseleave")}
      on:copy={logEvent("inline", "copy")}
      on:copy:error={(e) => {
        console.error("copy:error", e.detail.error);
      }}
    />
  </div>

  <CodeSnippet
    type="single"
    code={displayCode}
    copy={copySingle}
    on:mouseenter:copy-button={onMouseenterCopyButton("single", prefetchSingle)}
    on:mouseleave:copy-button={logEvent("single", "mouseleave")}
    on:copy={logEvent("single", "copy")}
    on:copy:error={(e) => {
      console.error("copy:error", e.detail.error);
    }}
  />

  <CodeSnippet
    type="multi"
    code={multiDisplayCode}
    copy={copyMulti}
    on:mouseenter:copy-button={onMouseenterCopyButton("multi", prefetchMulti)}
    on:mouseleave:copy-button={logEvent("multi", "mouseleave")}
    on:copy={logEvent("multi", "copy")}
    on:copy:error={(e) => {
      console.error("copy:error", e.detail.error);
    }}
  />
</Stack>
```

#### Override

Pass a function to `copy` to replace the default Clipboard API behavior.

This example calls the Clipboard API directly, without the `document.execCommand("copy")` fallback.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet
  code="npm i carbon-components-svelte"
  copy={(text) => navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)}
/>
```

#### Prevent

Set `copy` to a no-op function to disable copying.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet code="npm i carbon-components-svelte" copy={() => {}} />
```

### Custom feedback

Customize the message, icon, and duration shown after copying.

#### Text

Set `feedback` to customize the message shown after copying. Set `errorFeedback` to customize the message shown when copying fails (default `"Failed to copy"`).

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const code =
    "export function isAdmin(role: string) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt: number) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}\n\nexport function toPercent(value: number) {\n  return (value * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';\n}\n\nexport function maskSecret(value: string) {\n  return value.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(value.length - 8, 0)) + value.slice(-4);\n}";
</script>

<CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} feedback="Copied to clipboard" />
```

#### Icon

Set `feedbackIcon` to show a different icon while feedback is visible. The copy icon returns when feedback closes. Applies to `"single"` and `"multi"` types; has no effect on `"inline"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Checkmark from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Checkmark.svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet code="npm i carbon-components-svelte" feedbackIcon={Checkmark} />
```

#### Duration

Set `feedbackTimeout` to change how long the feedback stays visible, in milliseconds. Defaults to `2000`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet code="npm i carbon-components-svelte" feedbackTimeout={5000} />
```

### Custom labels

Customize the ARIA labels used for accessibility. Which prop applies depends on `type`.

#### Copy label

Set `copyLabel` to customize the ARIA label of the copy control. Applies to `"inline"` only; single and multi-line snippets use `codeLabel` and `copyButtonDescription` instead.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet
  type="inline"
  code="rm -rf node_modules/"
  copyLabel="Delete node_modules"
/>
```

#### Code label

Set `codeLabel` to customize the ARIA label of the code container (default `"Code snippet"`). Applies to `"single"` and `"multi"` only; inline snippets have no separate container.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet
  code="npm i carbon-components-svelte"
  codeLabel="npm install command"
/>
```

#### Copy button description

Set `copyButtonDescription` to customize the ARIA label of the copy button. It also shows as a proactive tooltip on hover or focus, before the button is clicked. Applies to `"single"` and `"multi"` only.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippet
  code="npm i carbon-components-svelte"
  copyButtonDescription="Copy install command"
/>
```

### Hidden buttons

Hide the copy or show-more controls.

#### Copy

Set `hideCopyButton` to `true` to hide the copy button.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const code =
    "export function isAdmin(role: string) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt: number) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}\n\nexport function toPercent(value: number) {\n  return (value * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';\n}\n\nexport function maskSecret(value: string) {\n  return value.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(value.length - 8, 0)) + value.slice(-4);\n}\n\nexport function isRateLimited(remaining: number) {\n  return remaining <= 0;\n}\n\nexport function toBackoffDelay(attempt: number) {\n  return Math.min(2 ** attempt * 1000, 30000);\n}\n\nexport function isStale(updatedAt: number, maxAgeMs: number) {\n  return Date.now() - updatedAt > maxAgeMs;\n}";
</script>

<CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} hideCopyButton />
```

#### Show more

Set `showMoreLess` to `false` to hide the expand/collapse button on multi-line snippets. Overflowing content scrolls inside the collapsed container instead of being clipped with no way to reach the rest.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const code =
    "export function isAdmin(role: string) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt: number) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}\n\nexport function toPercent(value: number) {\n  return (value * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';\n}\n\nexport function maskSecret(value: string) {\n  return value.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(value.length - 8, 0)) + value.slice(-4);\n}\n\nexport function isRateLimited(remaining: number) {\n  return remaining <= 0;\n}\n\nexport function toBackoffDelay(attempt: number) {\n  return Math.min(2 ** attempt * 1000, 30000);\n}\n\nexport function isStale(updatedAt: number, maxAgeMs: number) {\n  return Date.now() - updatedAt > maxAgeMs;\n}";
</script>

<CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} showMoreLess={false} />
```

#### Copy and show more

Hide both the copy and expand/collapse buttons.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const code =
    "export function isAdmin(role: string) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt: number) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}\n\nexport function toPercent(value: number) {\n  return (value * 100).toFixed(1) + '%';\n}\n\nexport function maskSecret(value: string) {\n  return value.slice(0, 4) + '*'.repeat(Math.max(value.length - 8, 0)) + value.slice(-4);\n}\n\nexport function isRateLimited(remaining: number) {\n  return remaining <= 0;\n}\n\nexport function toBackoffDelay(attempt: number) {\n  return Math.min(2 ** attempt * 1000, 30000);\n}\n\nexport function isStale(updatedAt: number, maxAgeMs: number) {\n  return Date.now() - updatedAt > maxAgeMs;\n}";
</script>

<CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} hideCopyButton showMoreLess={false} />
```

### Syntax highlighting

CodeSnippet does not ship a syntax highlighter. Pass the plain source to `code` so copy uses unstyled text, and color the rendered code with one of the approaches below.

#### Syntax subpackage

`carbon-components-svelte/syntax` has a small highlighter for JavaScript, TypeScript, Svelte 4 and 5, HTML, CSS, SCSS, JSON, shell, and diffs, colored with Carbon's syntax tokens. Its styles are separate stylesheets, so apps that don't highlight code don't load them.

| Stylesheet | Contains | Load with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `css/syntax-tokens.css` | `--cds-syntax-*` custom properties for Carbon's 88 syntax tokens, switched by `<html theme>` | `all.css` |
| `css/syntax-tokens-<theme>.css` | The same properties for one theme | `<theme>.css` |
| `css/syntax.css` | `.tok-*` classes and `::highlight(syntax-*)` rules that read the properties | Either tokens stylesheet |

```js
import "carbon-components-svelte/css/all.css";
import "carbon-components-svelte/css/syntax-tokens.css";
import "carbon-components-svelte/css/syntax.css";
```

| Export | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `highlight(code, language)` | HTML with `tok-*` spans, for `{@html}` in the default slot |
| `highlightCode` | Svelte action that colors code with the CSS Custom Highlight API, without changing the DOM |
| `tokenize(code, language)` | `{ type, text }` runs, for your own renderer |

#### Build-time spans

`highlight` returns HTML with each token in a `tok-*` span. Render it in the default slot.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { highlight } from "carbon-components-svelte/syntax";

  const code = `import { onMount } from "svelte";

// Polls the status endpoint once a minute.
export function poll(url: string, every = 60_000) {
  const timer = setInterval(() => fetch(url), every);
  return { stop: () => clearInterval(timer), url };
}`;
</script>

<CodeSnippet type="multi" {code}>{@html highlight(code, "ts")}</CodeSnippet>
```

#### Highlight API

`highlightCode` colors the first `<code>` inside the element it's on, so put it on a wrapper around the snippet. Selection and copy see plain text. It re-highlights when the code's text changes, whether Svelte or your own code changes it. It sets `data-ccs-highlight` on the element, and the `::highlight()` rules in `syntax.css` apply only inside that element. If you register highlights with the API yourself, set the attribute on their container. The [CSS Custom Highlight API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/CSS_Custom_Highlight_API) is supported in Chrome 105, Safari 17.2, and Firefox 140; elsewhere the code stays plain.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { highlightCode } from "carbon-components-svelte/syntax";

  const code = `<Button kind="ghost" on:click={() => count++}>
  Clicked {count} times
</Button>

{#if count > 10}
  <p class="note">That's a lot of clicks.</p>
{/if}`;
</script>

<div use:highlightCode={"svelte"}>
  <CodeSnippet type="multi" {code} />
</div>
```

#### Carbon syntax tokens

`syntax-tokens.css` declares Carbon's values: one set for white and g10, and one for g80, g90, and g100 (Carbon defines no g80 values). Carbon tunes its dark set for g100, so on g80's and g90's lighter snippet backgrounds the tokens below 4.5:1 move to the next lighter step of the same color, such as blue 50 to blue 40 for `keyword` in g90. Each token `x` has a `--cds-syntax-x` property, and `syntax.css` adds a `.tok-x` class and a `::highlight(syntax-x)` rule. The highlighter emits these types:

| Group | Token types |
| --- | --- |
| Keywords | `keyword` (including runes such as `$state`, `$:`, and directive prefixes such as `on`), `control-keyword` (including `{#each}` and `{@html}`), `definition-keyword`, `module-keyword` (including `export default`) |
| Names | `variable-name`, `definition` (including parameters, imports, and the names that blocks and destructuring declare), `function`, `property-name`, `type-name`, `class-name`, `self`, `special` (including `$store` references and template `${}` delimiters), `annotation` (decorators) |
| Literals | `string`, `special-string` (module specifiers such as `"carbon-components-svelte"`), `escape` (escape sequences in strings), `number`, `bool`, `null`, `regexp`, `color`, `unit` |
| Markup | `tag-name`, `attribute-name`, `attribute-value`, `angle-bracket`, `modifier` (directive modifiers such as `preventDefault`), `character` (HTML character references) |
| Punctuation | `operator`, `punctuation`, `paren`, `brace`, `bracket` |
| Comments | `comment`, `meta` (including doctypes and diff headers) |
| Diffs | `inserted`, `deleted` (color the background, not the text) |

The other Carbon tokens, such as `heading-1`, `emphasis`, `link`, and `doc-comment`, are there for highlighters that emit them.

#### Custom token colors

Override a `--cds-syntax-*` property to change a token's color. Match the selectors in `syntax-tokens.css`, load your CSS after it, and keep 4.5:1 contrast on each theme's snippet background. Carbon leaves strings in the text color; this site colors them magenta:

```css
:root,
:root[theme="white"],
:root[theme="g10"] {
  --cds-syntax-string: #9f1853; /* magenta 70 */
  --cds-syntax-attribute-value: #9f1853;
}

:root[theme="g90"],
:root[theme="g100"] {
  --cds-syntax-string: #ff7eb6; /* magenta 40 */
  --cds-syntax-attribute-value: #ff7eb6;
}

:root[theme="g80"] {
  --cds-syntax-string: #ffafd2; /* magenta 30 */
  --cds-syntax-attribute-value: #ffafd2;
}
```

#### Third-party highlighter

Render highlighted HTML from Prism, Shiki, or another highlighter in the default slot with `{@html}`. To match Carbon, color its token classes with the `--cds-syntax-*` properties, as in this Prism example:

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Prism from "prismjs";
  import "prismjs/components/prism-typescript";

  const code = `export function isAdmin(role: string) {
  return role === "admin";
}`;

  const highlighted = Prism.highlight(
    code,
    Prism.languages.typescript,
    "typescript",
  );
</script>

<CodeSnippet type="multi" {code}>{@html highlighted}</CodeSnippet>

<style>
  /* Color Prism's token classes with the Carbon syntax tokens. */
  :global(.token.keyword) {
    color: var(--cds-syntax-keyword);
  }

  :global(.token.function) {
    color: var(--cds-syntax-function);
  }

  :global(.token.string) {
    color: var(--cds-syntax-string);
  }

  :global(.token.number),
  :global(.token.boolean) {
    color: var(--cds-syntax-number);
  }

  :global(.token.builtin),
  :global(.token.class-name) {
    color: var(--cds-syntax-type-name);
  }

  :global(.token.operator),
  :global(.token.punctuation) {
    color: var(--cds-syntax-punctuation);
  }

  :global(.token.comment) {
    color: var(--cds-syntax-comment);
  }
</style>
```

### Tooltip

The copy button shows a tooltip: a proactive hint on hover or focus for single and multi-line snippets (see [Copy button description](#copy-button-description)), and copy feedback for every variant, including inline. Both render in the same floating portal.

#### Position

Set `tooltipAlign` to place the tooltip relative to the copy button, with Popover's `align` names. Applies to every variant, including the inline snippet. It replaces `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`, which still work and are deprecated.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<!-- Click a snippet to copy; the "Copied!" feedback tooltip uses tooltipAlign. -->
<Stack gap={6}>
  <CodeSnippet code="position: top" tooltipAlign="top" />
  <CodeSnippet code="position: right" tooltipAlign="right" />
  <CodeSnippet code="position: bottom" tooltipAlign="bottom" />
  <CodeSnippet code="position: left" tooltipAlign="left" />
  <CodeSnippet type="inline" code="inline" tooltipAlign="right" />
</Stack>
```

#### Alignment

Add `-start` or `-end` to align the tooltip with one end of the copy button.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<!-- Alignment positions the tooltip along the copy button edge. -->
<Stack gap={6}>
  <CodeSnippet code="alignment: bottom-start" tooltipAlign="bottom-start" />
  <CodeSnippet code="alignment: bottom" tooltipAlign="bottom" />
  <CodeSnippet code="alignment: bottom-end" tooltipAlign="bottom-end" />
</Stack>
```

### Portal tooltip

The "Copied!" feedback tooltip is rendered in a floating portal by default, so it is never clipped by a parent container with hidden overflow or a z-index stacking context. Set `portalTooltip` to `false` to use Carbon's inline feedback caret instead. The example renders each variant inside a container with hidden overflow.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, CodeSnippet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const multiCode =
    "export function isAdmin(role) {\n  return role === 'admin';\n}\n\nexport function isExpired(expiresAt) {\n  return Date.now() > expiresAt;\n}";
</script>

<!--
  The feedback tooltip is portalled by default, so it is not clipped even when
  the snippet sits in an `overflow: hidden` container. Set `portalTooltip` to
  `false` on any variant to use Carbon's inline feedback caret instead.
-->
<Box
  display="flex"
  direction="column"
  gap={4}
  overflow="hidden"
  border="subtle"
  borderStyle="dashed"
  padding={5}
  maxHeight="200px"
>
  <div>
    <CodeSnippet type="inline" code="rm -rf node_modules/" feedback="Copied!" />
  </div>

  <CodeSnippet code="npm i carbon-components-svelte" feedback="Copied!" />

  <CodeSnippet type="multi" code={multiCode} feedback="Copied!" />
</Box>
```

### Inside a modal

Because the feedback tooltip is portalled by default, it is not clipped inside a [Modal](/components/Modal). Set `portalTooltip` to `false` to use the inline caret.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, CodeSnippet, Modal } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button>

<Modal
  bind:open
  modalHeading="Install instructions"
  primaryButtonText="Done"
  secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
  on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
>
  <CodeSnippet code="npm i carbon-components-svelte" />
</Modal>
```

### Skeleton

Use `CodeSnippetSkeleton` to show a loading state. Defaults to `"single"` type.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippetSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippetSkeleton />
```

#### Multi-line

Set `type="multi"` on `CodeSnippetSkeleton` to show a multi-line loading state.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippetSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CodeSnippetSkeleton type="multi" />
```

#### Inline

Set `type="inline"` on `CodeSnippetSkeleton` to hold the place of an inline snippet in a line of text. Set `chars` to the length of the code it stands in for; `CodeSnippet` with `skeleton` sets it from `code`.

Run <CodeSnippetSkeleton type="inline" chars={20} /> to clean up the install.

### Component API

#### `CodeSnippet` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expanded` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to expand a multi-line code snippet (type="multi"). | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLPreElement` | Obtain a reference to the pre HTML element. | `null` |
| `copyRef` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLButtonElement` | Obtain a reference to the underlying copy button element. | `null` |
| `type` | `"single" \| "inline" \| "multi"` | Set the type of code snippet. | `"single"` |
| `code` | `string \| undefined` | Set the code snippet text.<br />Alternatively, use the default slot.<br /><br />When `code` is unset, the copy button copies the rendered text of the default slot. | _undefined_ |
| `copy` | `(code: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | By default, this component uses `navigator.clipboard.writeText` API to copy text to the user's clipboard,<br />with a `document.execCommand("copy")` fallback. Failures reject so the component can show<br />`errorFeedback` and dispatch `copy:error`.<br /><br />Provide a custom function to override this behavior. | `copyText` |
| `hideCopyButton` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the copy button | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for the disabled variant. | `false` |
| `wrapText` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to wrap the text.<br /><br />NOTE: this prop only works with the `type="multi"` variant. | `false` |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for a single-line or multi-line snippet to fill its<br />container instead of stopping at 48rem. | `false` |
| `skeleton` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to display the skeleton state | `false` |
| `copyButtonDescription` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the ARIA label for the copy button icon. | _undefined_ |
| `copyLabel` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label of the copy button. | `"Copy code"` |
| `codeLabel` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label of the code snippet container (single/multi variants). | `"Code snippet"` |
| `feedback` | `string` | Specify the feedback text displayed when clicking the snippet | `"Copied!"` |
| `errorFeedback` | `string` | Specify the feedback text displayed when copying fails | `"Failed to copy"` |
| `feedbackTimeout` | `number` | Set the timeout duration (ms) to display feedback text | `2000` |
| `feedbackIcon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify an icon to render on the copy button during the feedback window<br />(e.g. after copying). When unset, the copy icon is always shown.<br /><br />NOTE: this prop does not apply to the `type="inline"` variant. | _undefined_ |
| `showLessText` | `string` | Specify the show less text.<br /><br />NOTE: this prop only works with the `type="multi"` variant. | `"Show less"` |
| `showMoreText` | `string` | Specify the show more text.<br /><br />NOTE: this prop only works with the `type="multi"` variant. | `"Show more"` |
| `showMoreLess` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to hide the show more/less button.<br /><br />When hidden, overflowing multi-line content scrolls inside the<br />collapsed container instead of being clipped with no affordance.<br /><br />NOTE: this prop only works with the `type="multi"` variant. | `true` |
| `maxCollapsedNumberOfRows` | `number` | Specify the maximum number of rows shown when collapsed.<br />Set to `0` for no maximum.<br /><br />NOTE: this prop only works with the `type="multi"` variant.<br />A row is 1rem, the code's line height (16px by default). | `15` |
| `maxExpandedNumberOfRows` | `number` | Specify the maximum number of rows shown when expanded.<br />Set to `0` for no maximum (default).<br /><br />NOTE: this prop only works with the `type="multi"` variant.<br />A row is 1rem, the code's line height (16px by default). | `0` |
| `minCollapsedNumberOfRows` | `number` | Specify the minimum number of rows shown when collapsed.<br />Set to `0` for no minimum.<br /><br />NOTE: this prop only works with the `type="multi"` variant.<br />A row is 1rem, the code's line height (16px by default). | `3` |
| `minExpandedNumberOfRows` | `number` | Specify the minimum number of rows shown when expanded.<br />Set to `0` for no minimum.<br /><br />NOTE: this prop only works with the `type="multi"` variant.<br />A row is 1rem, the code's line height (16px by default). | `16` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the code element | `uniqueId()` |
| `portalTooltip` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set how the "Copied!" feedback tooltip is rendered.<br />By default, it is rendered in a portal so it is never clipped by an<br />`overflow: hidden` container. Set to `false` to use Carbon's inline<br />feedback caret instead. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipAlign` | `"top" \| "top-start" \| "top-end" \| "bottom" \| "bottom-start" \| "bottom-end" \| "left" \| "left-start" \| "left-end" \| "right" \| "right-start" \| "right-end" \| undefined` | Set the tooltip placement in floating-ui form: the side, then `start`<br />or `end` along it, as Popover's `align` takes. Above and below,<br />`start` and `end` name inline sides, so they swap under `dir="rtl"`.<br />When set, takes precedence over `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipPosition` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Set the position of the feedback tooltip relative to the copy button. | `"bottom"` |
| `tooltipAlignment` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the feedback tooltip relative to the copy button. | `"center"` |

## ComboBox

### Basic

Create a combobox with a title and placeholder text. Each item needs a unique id and display text. Combo boxes key items by id for performance.

<kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> or <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> opens the menu and highlights the selected item, or the first or last option. Once open, they move the highlight, and <kbd>Home</kbd> and <kbd>End</kbd> jump to the first or last option. <kbd>PageUp</kbd> and <kbd>PageDown</kbd> move the highlight 10 options and stop at either end. <kbd>Alt</kbd> + <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> opens the menu without moving the highlight, and <kbd>Alt</kbd> + <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> closes it. <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Tab</kbd> selects the keyboard-highlighted option. With no keyboard highlight, <kbd>Enter</kbd>, <kbd>Tab</kbd>, or a click outside selects the option whose label matches the typed text, ignoring case. Text that browser autofill writes into the field selects a matching option the same way.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboBox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboBox
  labelText="Alert channel"
  placeholder="Select alert channel"
  items={[
    { id: "0", text: "Slack" },
    { id: "1", text: "Email" },
    { id: "2", text: "Webhook" },
  ]}
/>
```

### Content

Customize how items render and how the label and helper text appear.

#### Custom slot

Override the default slot to customize how each item displays. Use `let:item`, `let:index`, `let:selected`, and `let:highlighted` to style highlighted and selected rows.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboBox } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboBox
  labelText="Alert channel"
  placeholder="Select alert channel"
  items={[
    { id: "0", text: "Slack" },
    { id: "1", text: "Email" },
    { id: "2", text: "Webhook" },
  ]}
  let:item
  let:index
  let:selected
  let:highlighted
>
  <div>
    <strong>{item.text}</strong>
  </div>
  <div>
    id: {item.id} - index: {index} - selected: {selected} - highlighted:
    {highlighted}
  </div>
</ComboBox>

<style>
  :global(.bx--list-box__menu-item),
  :global(.bx--list-box__menu-item__option) {
    height: auto;
  }
</style>
```

#### Item icons

Set icon on an item for a left icon. The label sits between the icon and the checkmark. Use the icon slot for custom markup.

### Selection

Bind to the selection, pre-select items, clear the current selection, and coordinate multiple combo boxes.

#### Reactive

See how the combobox responds to user input and selection changes.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ComboBox } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedId = "1";
</script>

<ComboBox

  placeholder="Select alert channel"

  items={[

<br />
<Button on:click={() => (selectedId = undefined)}>
  Set to undefined (unselected)
</Button>

```

#### Initial selection

Set `selectedId` to pre-select an item when the combobox loads.

```svelte
<script>

</script>
```
