## ComboButton

### Basic

Wrap `MenuItem` components in `ComboButton` and set `labelText` for the primary action button. Clicking the label fires `on:click`; clicking the chevron trigger opens the menu. See [Events](#events) for the trigger's other events and the menu's `close` event.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save and close")}
    >Save and close</MenuItem
  >
</ComboButton>
```

### Reactive example

Control the menu state programmatically by binding to `open`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComboButton,
    MenuItem,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Stack gap={6} align="start">
  <ComboButton labelText="Save" bind:open>
    <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
    <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
  </ComboButton>
  <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" on:click={() => (open = !open)}>
    {open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu"}
  </Button>
</Stack>
```

### Label children

Use the `labelChildren` slot for custom content in the primary action button. `labelText` is still used as the accessible name in that case.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save document">
  <strong slot="labelChildren">Save</strong>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

### Trigger

Customize the icon-only chevron button that opens the menu.

#### Icon description

The icon-only trigger needs its own accessible label, since it has no visible text. Override `iconDescription` to change it; the default is `"Additional actions"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" iconDescription="More save options">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

#### Tooltip position

Set `tooltipAlign` to control where the trigger's tooltip appears, with Popover's `align` names. It replaces `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`, which still work and are deprecated. This is independent of `direction`, which controls where the menu opens - the two are separate concerns and can point different ways.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" tooltipAlign="right">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

Set `tooltipAlign` to `"bottom-end"` to align the tooltip with the trigger's end edge, so it stays on screen when the button sits at the end of a row.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" tooltipAlign="bottom-end">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

#### No tooltip

Set `iconDescription` to an empty string to render the trigger without Carbon's tooltip, the same way [Button](/components/Button#icons) handles an empty `iconDescription`. The trigger then has no accessible name of its own, so only do this when something else in the surrounding context labels it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" iconDescription="">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

### Size

Set `size` to scale both buttons and each menu item's row height together. The default is `"md"`. `ComboButton` only supports the `"primary"` kind.

#### Extra small

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" size="xs">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

#### Small

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" size="sm">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

#### Large

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" size="lg">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

### Direction

Set `direction` to `"top"` or `"bottom"` (default) for which side of the trigger the menu opens on. The menu flips to the opposite side when there isn't room on the preferred side. See [Menu placement](/components/Menu#placement) for gap and offset props.

#### Top

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" direction="top">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

#### Alignment

Set `intrinsicAlign` to `"start"`, `"center"`, or `"end"` (default) to align the menu with the button group: the primary action and the trigger together.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" intrinsicAlign="start">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

### Disabled

Set `disabled` to `true` to disable both the primary action and trigger buttons.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" disabled>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

### Loading

Set `loading` to `true` to show a loading spinner on the primary action button and prevent it from being activated. Use `loadingDescription` to set the accessible description announced while loading. Unlike `disabled`, the trigger button is unaffected -- the menu can still be opened while the primary action is in flight.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" loading loadingDescription="Saving">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

### Menu items

`MenuItem` takes `disabled`, an `icon`, `kind="danger"` for destructive rows, and nested children for submenus. Use `MenuDivider` between groups. See [MenuButton](/components/MenuButton#menu-items) for the full set of examples and keyboard/hover behavior for submenus.

#### Disabled

Set `disabled` on a `MenuItem` to make it non-interactive.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem disabled on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}
    >Save a copy</MenuItem
  >
</ComboButton>
```

#### Icons

Pass a Carbon icon to `icon`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Copy from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Copy.svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save">
  <MenuItem icon={Copy} on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}
    >Save a copy</MenuItem
  >
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

#### Danger

Set `kind="danger"` on `MenuItem` for a destructive action.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuDivider, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
  <MenuDivider />
  <MenuItem
    icon={TrashCan}
    kind="danger"
    on:click={() => console.log("Delete draft")}
  >
    Delete draft
  </MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

#### Nested

Set `labelText` on a `MenuItem` and nest child `MenuItem` rows to get a submenu.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save">
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem labelText="Export as">
    <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("PDF")}>PDF</MenuItem>
    <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("JPG")}>JPG</MenuItem>
    <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("PNG")}>PNG</MenuItem>
  </MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

### Events

Respond to trigger button clicks and menu close attempts.

#### Trigger events

Clicking the chevron trigger fires `on:click:trigger`, separate from the primary action's `on:click`. The trigger's other native events (`mousedown`, `focus`, `blur`, `mouseover`, `mouseenter`, `mouseleave`) dispatch the same way, each with a `:trigger`-suffixed counterpart alongside the shared, unscoped event.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton
  labelText="Save"
  on:click:trigger={() => console.log("Trigger clicked")}
>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

#### Close event

Use `on:close` to respond to every close attempt, regardless of cause. The event detail's `trigger` is `"escape-key"`, `"outside-click"`, or `"select"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ComboButton, MenuItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComboButton labelText="Save" on:close={(e) => console.log(e.detail.trigger)}>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save as")}>Save as</MenuItem>
  <MenuItem on:click={() => console.log("Save a copy")}>Save a copy</MenuItem>
</ComboButton>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ComboButton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `labelText` (Required) | `string` | Required. Specify the primary action button text.<br />Alternatively, use the "labelChildren" slot for custom button content;<br />`labelText` is still used as the accessible name in that case. | _undefined_ |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the menu. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the outer HTML element. | `null` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable both the primary action and trigger buttons. | `false` |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to show a loading spinner on the primary action button<br />and prevent it from being activated. Unlike `disabled`, the trigger<br />button is unaffected -- the menu can still be opened while the primary<br />action is in flight. | `false` |
| `loadingDescription` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the accessible description for the primary action's loading<br />spinner. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Specify the size of both buttons and the menu row height. | `"md"` |
| `direction` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | Set the preferred direction the menu opens toward.<br />The menu flips to the opposite direction if there is not enough space. | `"bottom"` |
| `intrinsicAlign` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Align the menu to the button group, the primary action and the<br />trigger together. `start` and `end` are the group's inline start and<br />end, which swap under `dir="rtl"`.<br />A menu that would run past a side of the window takes another<br />alignment for that open. | `"end"` |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | Specify the accessible label for the icon-only trigger button.<br />Set to an empty string to render the trigger without a tooltip, the<br />same way `Button` handles an empty `iconDescription` - the trigger then<br />has no accessible name of its own, so only do this when something else<br />in the surrounding context labels it. | `"Additional actions"` |
| `tooltipAlign` | `"top" \| "top-start" \| "top-end" \| "bottom" \| "bottom-start" \| "bottom-end" \| "left" \| "left-start" \| "left-end" \| "right" \| "right-start" \| "right-end" \| undefined` | Set the tooltip placement in floating-ui form: the side, then `start`<br />or `end` along it, as Popover's `align` takes. Above and below,<br />`start` and `end` name inline sides, so they swap under `dir="rtl"`.<br />When set, takes precedence over `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipPosition` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Set the position of the icon-only trigger's tooltip.<br />Independent of `direction`, which controls where the menu opens. | `"bottom"` |
| `tooltipAlignment` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the icon-only trigger's tooltip relative to the<br />trigger. Use `"end"` when the button sits at the right edge of a page. | `"center"` |

#### `ComboButton` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`       | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ComboButton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:close`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:mousedown`  |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ComboButton` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:blur:trigger` | `FocusEvent` |  |
| `on:click:trigger` | `MouseEvent` | Fires when the menu trigger button is clicked, separate from the primary action's `click` event. |
| `on:focus:trigger` | `FocusEvent` |  |
| `on:mousedown:trigger` | `MouseEvent` |  |
| `on:mouseenter:trigger` | `MouseEvent` |  |
| `on:mouseleave:trigger` | `MouseEvent` |  |
| `on:mouseover:trigger` | `MouseEvent` |  |

#### `ComboButton` $$restProps

`ComboButton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `MenuItem` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to select the item.<br />Only applies to a selectable item or one inside<br />`MenuItemGroup` or `MenuItemRadioGroup`. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLLIElement` | Obtain a reference to the list item HTML element. | `null` |
| `kind` | `"default" \| "danger"` | Specify the kind of item. | `"default"` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the item | `false` |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify the icon to render.<br />Icon is rendered to the left of the label text. | _undefined_ |
| `labelText` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the label text.<br />Required to nest `MenuItem` children and create a submenu: once set,<br />the default slot holds the nested items instead of the label.<br />Alternatively, use the "labelChildren" slot for custom label content;<br />`labelText` is still used as the accessible name and title in that case. | _undefined_ |
| `shortcutText` | `string` | Specify the shortcut text.<br />Alternatively, use the "shortcutChildren" slot.<br />Display only; does not register a keybinding. | `""` |
| `shortcut` | `string` | Specify a keyboard shortcut to show, such as `"mod+s"`. `mod` is<br />Command on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere. The keys show where<br />`shortcutText` goes, and the item gets `aria-keyshortcuts`. Display only:<br />bind the command itself with `onShortcut`, since the menu is usually<br />closed. `shortcutText` and its slot take precedence. A value that isn't<br />a shortcut, such as `"Ctrl C"`, shows as written. | `""` |
| `selectable` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to make the item a standalone checkbox.<br />Automatically enabled when `selected` is `true` or when the item<br />is inside `MenuItemGroup`. | `false` |
| `id` | `string` | Specify the id.<br />It's recommended to provide an id as a value to bind to<br />within a selectable or radio menu group. | `uniqueId()` |

#### `MenuItem` slots

| Slot               | Detail                  |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- |
| `default`          | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelChildren`    | `Record<string, never>` |
| `shortcutChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `shortcutText`     | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `MenuItem` forwarded events

| Event        |
| ------------ |
| `on:keydown` |

#### `MenuItem` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:click` | `MouseEvent` | Dispatched on selection. Cancelable: call `preventDefault()` to keep<br />the menu open. A selectable or radio item's selection still updates. |

#### `MenuItem` $$restProps

`MenuItem` spreads `$$restProps` to the `li` element.


## ComposedModal

### ComposedModal vs Modal

The composed modal provides a composition-based approach with modal header, modal body, and modal footer sub-components for maximum flexibility. For simpler use cases, use [Modal](/components/Modal) instead. Both components share the same events, accessibility features, and [focus behavior](/components/Modal#focus-behavior).

### Basic

Create a modal with a header, body, and footer. Each section can be customized independently.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Checkbox,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let checked = false;
</script>

<ComposedModal open>
  <ModalHeader label="Changes" title="Confirm changes" />
  <ModalBody hasForm>
    <Checkbox labelText="I have reviewed the changes" bind:checked />
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter primaryButtonText="Proceed" primaryButtonDisabled={!checked} />
</ComposedModal>
```

### Focus

Control how focus moves when the composed modal opens, and override the default target when needed. Focus follows the same priority order as Modal. See [focus behavior](/components/Modal#focus-behavior).

The `ModalHeader` close button shows `iconDescription` in a tooltip on hover and focus. When the modal opens with focus on the close button, the tooltip stays closed until the next hover or focus. While the tooltip shows, <kbd>Escape</kbd> hides it first. The next <kbd>Escape</kbd> closes the modal.

#### Custom focus

Use `selectorPrimaryFocus` on `ComposedModal` to override the default and target a specific element when the automatic first-input focus is not desired.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
    Stack,
    TextInput,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Create database</Button>

<ComposedModal
  bind:open
  selectorPrimaryFocus="#advanced-options"
  on:submit={() => (open = false)}
>
  <ModalHeader title="Create database" />
  <ModalBody>
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <p>Create a new Cloudant database in the US South region.</p>
      <TextInput
        id="db-name"
        labelText="Database name"
        placeholder="Enter database name..."
      />
      <Button id="advanced-options" kind="ghost" size="small">
        Advanced options
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Confirm"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

### Alert mode

Set `alert` to `true` on `ComposedModal` for a time-sensitive dialog. The ARIA `role` changes from `"dialog"` to `"alertdialog"` and `ModalBody` is linked with `aria-describedby`, so assistive technology announces the body when the modal opens.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComposedModal bind:open alert>
  <ModalHeader title="Session expiring" />
  <ModalBody
    >Your session ends in 2 minutes. Save your work to continue.</ModalBody
  >
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Stay signed in"
    secondaryButtonText="Sign out"
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

### Variants

Change the composed modal's tone and purpose.

#### Danger

Display critical or destructive actions with the danger variant. Set `danger` on both ComposedModal and ModalFooter for the red danger styling.

By default, the cancel button receives focus instead of the critical button to prevent accidental destructive actions.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button kind="danger" on:click={() => (open = true)}>Delete all</Button>

<ComposedModal
  danger
  bind:open
  on:open
  on:close
  on:submit={() => (open = false)}
>
  <ModalHeader title="Delete all instances" />
  <ModalBody>
    <p>This is a permanent action and cannot be undone.</p>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter primaryButtonText="Delete" secondaryButtonText="Cancel" danger />
</ComposedModal>
```

### Content

Customize the header content and body layout. Set `hasForm` on `ModalBody` when it directly contains form elements (see the [Basic](#basic) example above). It adjusts the body padding to match Carbon's form spacing.

#### Build the content on first open

Set `lazy` to build the header, body, and footer the first time the modal opens, then keep them. A closed modal is invisible but still laid out, so this matters on pages with several modals or heavy content.

| Do | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Set `lazy` on modals most visitors never open. | Their content costs nothing until it's needed. |
| Leave it off when you bind to or read the content before the first open. | That content doesn't exist yet. |
| Leave it off when the content must be in server-rendered markup. | It isn't rendered until the modal opens. |

#### Custom heading

Use `ModalHeader`'s default slot to add extra content, such as a status tag, below the title. This is in addition to (or instead of) the plain-text `title` and `label` props.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
    Tag,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Create database</Button>

<ComposedModal bind:open on:submit={() => (open = false)}>
  <ModalHeader title="Create database">
    <Tag type="green" size="sm">Beta</Tag>
  </ModalHeader>
  <ModalBody>
    <p>Create a new Cloudant database in the US South region.</p>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Confirm"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Full width

Remove modal body padding so content spans edge to edge with `fullWidth`. Use it for content that supplies its own layout, such as a table or fluid form.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    DataTable,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>View webhook deliveries</Button>

<ComposedModal fullWidth bind:open>
  <ModalHeader label="Webhooks" title="Delivery history" />
  <ModalBody hasScrollingContent>
    <DataTable
      headers={[
        { key: "endpoint", value: "Endpoint" },
        { key: "event", value: "Event" },
        { key: "status", value: "Status" },
      ]}
      rows={[
        {
          id: "1",
          endpoint: "https://hooks.example.com/deploy",
          event: "deployment.succeeded",
          status: "Delivered in 214ms; response 200 OK.",
        },
        {
          id: "2",
          endpoint: "https://hooks.example.com/alerts",
          event: "incident.created",
          status: "Retrying after timeout; next attempt in 5 minutes.",
        },
      ]}
    />
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Add endpoint"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Has scrolling content

Set `hasScrollingContent` on `ModalBody` to enable vertical scrolling for lengthy content, matching Modal's [Has scrolling content](/components/Modal#has-scrolling-content). Omitting `ModalFooter`, as in this example, creates a passive, information-only modal, the composed equivalent of Modal's `passiveModal`. A passive modal closes on an outside click; see [Outside click](#outside-click).

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>About Cloudant</Button>

<ComposedModal bind:open>
  <ModalHeader title="About Cloudant" />
  <ModalBody hasScrollingContent>
    <p>
      Cloudant is a fully managed, distributed database optimized for heavy
      workloads and fast-growing web and mobile apps, IBM Cloudant is available
      as an IBM Cloud® service with a 99.99% SLA.
    </p>
    <br />
    <p>
      The database elastically scales throughput and storage, and its API and
      replication protocols are compatible with Apache CouchDB for hybrid or
      multicloud architectures.
    </p>
  </ModalBody>
</ComposedModal>
```

### AI label

Put an `AILabel` in the `decorator` slot to mark the modal's content as AI-generated. The label sits beside the close button, and the modal shows the AI surface.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    AILabel,
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Review forecast</Button>

<ComposedModal bind:open on:submit={() => (open = false)}>
  <ModalHeader title="Usage forecast" />
  <ModalBody>
    Spend is projected to grow 12% next month. Raise the monthly budget to
    $4,800 to avoid overage alerts.
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter primaryButtonText="Apply budget" />
  <AILabel slot="decorator">
    <p>Generated from 90 days of billing data across your workspace.</p>
  </AILabel>
</ComposedModal>
```

### Buttons

Configure the footer actions.

#### Multiple secondary buttons

Set `secondaryButtons` in the modal footer to create a 3-button modal. This replaces secondaryButtonText and takes a tuple of two button configurations.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = true;
  let checked = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Review changes</Button>

<ComposedModal bind:open on:submit={() => (open = false)}>
  <ModalHeader label="Changes" title="Confirm changes" />
  <ModalBody hasForm>
    <Checkbox labelText="I have reviewed the changes" bind:checked />
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Proceed"
    primaryButtonDisabled={!checked}
    secondaryButtons={[{ text: "Cancel" }, { text: "Review" }]}
    on:click:button--secondary={({ detail }) => {
      if (detail.text === "Cancel") open = false;
      if (detail.text === "Review") console.log("Review");
    }}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Custom footer with ActionSet

Slot [ActionSet](/components/ActionSet) into `ModalFooter` for a custom action row composed from `Button`s. Set `disableStacking` so the set stays horizontal inside the 64px footer, and `size="lg"` so child buttons stay `"default"` instead of shrinking to `"field"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ActionSet,
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = true;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Continue setup</Button>

<ComposedModal bind:open>
  <ModalHeader title="Continue setup" />
  <ModalBody>
    <p>Review this step, go back, or continue to the next one.</p>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter>
    <ActionSet size="lg" disableStacking>
      <Button kind="ghost" on:click={() => (open = false)}>Cancel</Button>
      <Button kind="secondary">Previous</Button>
      <Button on:click={() => (open = false)}>Next</Button>
    </ActionSet>
  </ModalFooter>
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Button with icon

Enhance the primary button with an icon using `primaryButtonIcon` on `ModalFooter`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Send from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Send.svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Invite teammate</Button>

<ComposedModal bind:open on:submit={() => (open = false)}>
  <ModalHeader title="Invite teammate" />
  <ModalBody>
    <p>An email invitation with a link to join the workspace will be sent.</p>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Send invitation"
    primaryButtonIcon={Send}
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Primary button loading

Set `primaryButtonLoading` on `ModalFooter` while an async submit is in progress. The primary button shows an [InlineLoading](/components/InlineLoading) spinner, becomes non-interactive, and suppresses `submit` until loading finishes. The modal stays open.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let saving = false;

  function onSave() {
    saving = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
      saving = false;
      open = false;
    }, 2000);
  }
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Save changes</Button>

<ComposedModal bind:open on:submit={onSave}>
  <ModalHeader title="Save changes" />
  <ModalBody>
    <p>Save your changes to the Cloudant database configuration.</p>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Save"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    primaryButtonLoading={saving}
    primaryButtonLoadingDescription="Saving..."
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Loading status

Set `loadingStatus` on `ModalFooter` to show the progress of the primary action in its button: `"active"` while the work runs, then `"finished"` or `"error"`. Any status other than `"inactive"` disables the footer buttons and suppresses `submit`. After `"finished"`, the footer dispatches `loading:success` when the [InlineLoading](/components/InlineLoading) success delay ends. Close the modal there.

`primaryButtonLoading` is the same as `"active"`, except that the secondary buttons stay enabled.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let failSave = false;
  let loadingStatus = "inactive";

  $: loadingDescription =
    loadingStatus === "error"
      ? "Save failed"
      : loadingStatus === "finished"
        ? "Saved"
        : "Saving...";

  async function save() {
    loadingStatus = "active";
    // For demo purposes only: simulate a network request.
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
    loadingStatus = failSave ? "error" : "finished";
    if (failSave) {
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
      loadingStatus = "inactive";
    }
  }
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Save changes</Button>

<ComposedModal
  bind:open
  preventCloseOnClickOutside={loadingStatus !== "inactive"}
  on:submit={save}
>
  <ModalHeader title="Save changes" />
  <ModalBody>
    <p>Save your changes to the Cloudant database configuration.</p>
    <Checkbox labelText="Simulate a failed save" bind:checked={failSave} />
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Save"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    {loadingStatus}
    primaryButtonLoadingDescription={loadingDescription}
    on:loading:success={() => {
      open = false;
      loadingStatus = "inactive";
    }}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Secondary button loading

Secondary buttons support their own, independent loading state, useful when a secondary action (such as "Save as draft") is itself async. For `secondaryButtons`, set `loading` (and optionally `loadingDescription`) on the entry; for `secondaryButtonText`, use `secondaryButtonLoading` and `secondaryButtonLoadingDescription` on `ModalFooter`. A loading secondary button shows its own `InlineLoading` spinner and becomes non-interactive, independent of `primaryButtonLoading`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let savingDraft = false;

  function onSaveDraft() {
    savingDraft = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
      savingDraft = false;
    }, 2000);
  }
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Save changes</Button>

<ComposedModal bind:open on:submit={() => (open = false)}>
  <ModalHeader title="Save changes" />
  <ModalBody>
    <p>Save your changes to the Cloudant database configuration.</p>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Save"
    secondaryButtons={[
      {
        text: "Save as draft",
        kind: "secondary",
        loading: savingDraft,
        loadingDescription: "Saving...",
      },
    ]}
    on:click:button--secondary={({ detail }) => {
      if (detail.text === "Save as draft") onSaveDraft();
    }}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

### Progress

Combine the composed modal with a progress indicator to create a multi-step flow within a modal. Use the modal footer's default slot to render Cancel (ghost), Previous (secondary), and Next (primary) buttons. Track the current step to control which content is displayed and update the button label on the final step.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
    ProgressIndicator,
    ProgressStep,
    Stack,
    TextInput,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { tick } from "svelte";

  let open = false;
  let step = 0;
  let name = "";
  let region = "";

  async function goNext() {
    if (step < 2) {
      step++;
      await tick();
      const nextInput = document.querySelector(
        step === 1 ? "#region-input" : ".bx--modal-container .bx--btn--primary",
      );
      nextInput?.focus();
    } else {
      open = false;
    }
  }

  function handleSubmit() {
    goNext();
  }
</script>

<Button
  on:click={() => {
    open = true;
    step = 0;
    name = "";
    region = "";
  }}
>
  Create workspace
</Button>

<ComposedModal bind:open>
  <ModalHeader title="Create workspace" />
  <ModalBody hasForm>
    <form id="workspace-form" on:submit|preventDefault={handleSubmit}>
      <Stack gap={6}>
        <ProgressIndicator
          currentIndex={step}
          spaceEqually
          preventChangeOnClick
        >
          <ProgressStep complete={step > 0} label="General" />
          <ProgressStep complete={step > 1} label="Configure" />
          <ProgressStep label="Review" />
        </ProgressIndicator>
        {#if step === 0}
          <TextInput
            id="name-input"
            bind:value={name}
            labelText="Name"
            placeholder="e.g., My workspace"
          />
        {:else if step === 1}
          <TextInput
            id="region-input"
            bind:value={region}
            labelText="Region"
            placeholder="e.g., us-east-1"
          />
        {:else}
          <p>Review your workspace configuration before creating.</p>
          {#if name || region}
            <p>
              <strong>Name:</strong>
              {name || "(not set)"}
              · <strong>Region:</strong>
              {region || "(not set)"}
            </p>
          {/if}
        {/if}
      </Stack>
    </form>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter>
    <Button kind="ghost" on:click={() => (open = false)}>Cancel</Button>
    <Button kind="secondary" disabled={step === 0} on:click={() => step--}>
      Previous
    </Button>
    <Button type="submit" form="workspace-form">
      {step < 2 ? "Next" : "Create"}
    </Button>
  </ModalFooter>
</ComposedModal>
```

### With portal

Wrap the composed modal in a portal to ensure it renders above all z-index stacking contexts and parent overflow constraints, preventing visual clipping and layering issues.

Components with menus (combo box, dropdown, date picker, and so on) placed inside a composed modal also auto-portal their menus the same way as in Modal. See [Modal with dropdowns](/components/Modal#modal-with-dropdowns).

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
    Portal,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Box
  display="flex"
  direction="column"
  gap={5}
  overflow="hidden"
  position="relative"
  height="200px"
  border="subtle"
  borderStyle="dashed"
  padding={5}
>
  <p>
    This container hides overflowing content. Without a portal, the modal would
    be clipped.
  </p>
  <div><Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button></div>
  <Portal>
    <ComposedModal bind:open>
      <ModalHeader title="Composed Modal in Portal" />
      <ModalBody>
        <p>
          This composed modal is rendered in a portal, ensuring it appears above
          all z-index stacking contexts and parent overflow constraints.
        </p>
      </ModalBody>
      <ModalFooter
        primaryButtonText="Confirm"
        secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
        on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
      />
    </ComposedModal>
  </Portal>
</Box>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` on `ComposedModal` to control modal width: `"xs"`, `"sm"`, or `"lg"`. The default (no `size`) matches Modal's `"md"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Create database</Button>

<ComposedModal size="sm" bind:open on:submit={() => (open = false)}>
  <ModalHeader title="Create database" />
  <ModalBody>
    <p>Create a new Cloudant database in the US South region.</p>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Confirm"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

### Closing

Control how the composed modal can be dismissed.

#### Prevent default

The modal dispatches a cancelable `close` event. Call `e.preventDefault()` to keep the modal open. The event includes a `trigger` property indicating what triggered the close attempt: `"escape-key"` (<kbd>Escape</kbd>), `"outside-click"`, `"close-button"`, or `"programmatic"` (the `open` prop was set to `false` from outside the component, for example through `bind:open`, rather than through one of the modal's own dismiss controls).

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    InlineNotification,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let hasUnsavedChanges = true;
  let showWarning = false;
</script>

<Button
  on:click={() => {
    open = true;
    hasUnsavedChanges = true;
    showWarning = false;
  }}
>
  Open modal with unsaved changes
</Button>

<ComposedModal
  bind:open
  on:close={(e) => {
    console.log("Close triggered by:", e.detail.trigger);
    if (hasUnsavedChanges) {
      e.preventDefault();
      showWarning = true;
    }
  }}
  on:submit={() => {
    hasUnsavedChanges = false;
    open = false;
  }}
>
  <ModalHeader title="Edit profile" />
  <ModalBody>
    {#if showWarning}
      <InlineNotification
        kind="warning"
        title="Unsaved changes"
        subtitle="Please save or discard your changes before closing."
        hideCloseButton
      />
    {/if}
    <p>You have unsaved changes. Click "Save" to apply them.</p>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Save"
    secondaryButtonText="Discard changes"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => {
      hasUnsavedChanges = false;
      showWarning = false;
      open = false;
    }}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Outside click

A modal with a `ModalFooter` stays open when the user clicks outside it, so the user has to choose an action. A modal without one is passive and closes. This matches Carbon v11.

Set `preventCloseOnClickOutside` to `true` to keep a passive modal open, for example while it shows a value the user must copy. Set it to `false` to close a modal with a footer on an outside click. Carbon advises against this, since the user can lose their input.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    CodeSnippet,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalHeader,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Create API key</Button>

<ComposedModal preventCloseOnClickOutside bind:open>
  <ModalHeader title="API key created" />
  <ModalBody>
    <Stack gap={5}>
      <p>
        Copy this key now. You can't view it again after you close this dialog.
      </p>
      <CodeSnippet code="cld_live_8f3a2c91e4b7d605" />
    </Stack>
  </ModalBody>
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Hide close button

Set `hideCloseButton` on `ModalHeader` to remove the header close button. Use this for forced-choice dialogs such as auth walls or terms acceptance. Always provide an alternative dismiss path, typically footer actions. A modal with a `ModalFooter` already stays open on an outside click. <kbd>Escape</kbd> still closes the modal unless you cancel the `close` event.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Review terms</Button>

<ComposedModal bind:open on:submit={() => (open = false)}>
  <ModalHeader title="Accept terms of use" hideCloseButton />
  <ModalBody>
    <p>
      You must accept or decline the terms. The header close button is hidden,
      so use the footer actions to leave this dialog.
    </p>
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Accept"
    secondaryButtonText="Decline"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Secondary button

`secondaryButtonText` closes the modal by default. The footer dispatches a cancelable `click:button--secondary` event first. Call `e.preventDefault()` to keep the modal open, for example when Cancel should stay put for a dirty form.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ComposedModal,
    InlineNotification,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
    TextInput,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let name = "Ada Lovelace";
  let draft = name;
  let showWarning = false;

  $: isDirty = draft !== name;
</script>

<Button
  on:click={() => {
    open = true;
    draft = name;
    showWarning = false;
  }}
>
  Edit name
</Button>

<ComposedModal
  bind:open
  on:submit={() => {
    name = draft;
    open = false;
  }}
>
  <ModalHeader title="Edit name" />
  <ModalBody hasForm>
    {#if showWarning}
      <InlineNotification
        kind="warning"
        title="Unsaved changes"
        subtitle="Save your changes, or keep editing. Cancel stays open while the form is dirty."
        hideCloseButton
      />
    {/if}
    <TextInput labelText="Name" bind:value={draft} />
  </ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter
    primaryButtonText="Save"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={(e) => {
      if (isDirty) {
        e.preventDefault();
        showWarning = true;
      }
    }}
  />
</ComposedModal>
```

### Events

ComposedModal and ModalFooter dispatch events for the modal's lifecycle and button interactions. The close button, <kbd>Escape</kbd>, an outside click on a passive modal, and `ModalFooter`'s `secondaryButtonText` button close the modal automatically. See [Closing](#closing) above. Every other action, including the primary button and `secondaryButtons` entries, leaves `open` untouched; handle the event and set `open` to `false` yourself when the action should dismiss the dialog.

#### Open

Listen for `on:open` to know when `open` becomes `true`. It fires before the modal is visible and before focus moves into it. To run code after focus has moved, listen for `on:transitionend` and check `event.detail.open`.

```svelte
<ComposedModal bind:open on:open={() => console.log("opened")}>
```

#### Submit and button clicks

Clicking the primary button in `ModalFooter` dispatches `submit` and `click:button--primary` on `ComposedModal`. `ModalFooter` dispatches `click:button--secondary` with the button's `text`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ComposedModal,
    ModalBody,
    ModalFooter,
    ModalHeader,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ComposedModal bind:open on:submit={() => (open = false)}>
  <ModalHeader title="Confirm changes" />
  <ModalBody>...</ModalBody>
  <ModalFooter primaryButtonText="Confirm" secondaryButtonText="Cancel" />
</ComposedModal>
```

#### Transition end

Listen for `on:transitionend` to know when the modal's open or close animation finishes. `event.detail.open` reflects the modal's state at the end of the transition.

```svelte
<ComposedModal
  bind:open
  on:transitionend={(e) => console.log("open:", e.detail.open)}
>
```

### Component API

#### `ComposedModal` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the top-level HTML element. | `null` |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| undefined` | Set the size of the composed modal.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"`, the default width. | _undefined_ |
| `danger` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the danger variant | `false` |
| `alert` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to enable alert mode.<br />The dialog uses `role="alertdialog"` and is described by `ModalBody`. | `false` |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to remove the modal body padding so content spans edge to edge | `false` |
| `preventCloseOnClickOutside` | `boolean \| undefined` | Control whether clicking outside the modal closes it.<br />By default, a passive modal (one without a `ModalFooter`) closes and a<br />modal with a `ModalFooter` stays open, as in Carbon v11.<br />Set to `true` to always keep the modal open on an outside click, or<br />`false` to always close it. | _undefined_ |
| `containerClass` | `string` | Specify a class for the inner modal | `""` |
| `selectorPrimaryFocus` | `null \| string` | Specify a selector to be focused when opening the modal. | `"[data-modal-primary-focus]"` |
| `lazy` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to build the modal's content the first time it opens<br />instead of at mount, and keep it afterwards. A closed modal is still<br />laid out (it is only made invisible), so this saves its nodes on pages<br />that hold modals most visitors never open. Content is not in the DOM,<br />or in server-rendered markup, until then. | `false` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the top-level element.<br />The header label, header title, and body ids derive from it as<br />`{id}-label`, `{id}-title`, and `{id}-body`. | `uniqueId()` |

| `secondaryButtonLoadingDescription` | `string` | Specify the description for the secondary button loading state.<br />Passed to `InlineLoading` as `description`. | `"Loading"` |
| `secondaryButtons` | `ReadonlyArray<{ text: string; kind?: import("../Button/Button.svelte").ButtonProps["kind"]; disabled?: boolean; loading?: boolean; loadingDescription?: string }>` | One or two secondary buttons for the modal footer.<br />Supersedes `secondaryButtonText`. Each entry needs `text`; optional<br />`kind` (defaults to `"secondary"`), `disabled`, `loading`, and<br />`loadingDescription` (defaults to `"Loading"`) pass through to Button /<br />the loading state. | `secondaryClass` | `string \| undefined` | Specify a class for the secondary button. | _undefined_ |
| `danger` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the danger variant | `false` |

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |

| Event | Detail | Description |
