## ConfirmModal

### Basic

Ask the user to confirm or cancel an action. `title` sets the modal's heading, and `confirmText`/`cancelText` label the two footer buttons. Listen for `on:confirm` and `on:cancel` to react to the choice; the modal closes itself in both cases. For anything beyond a yes/no decision, use [Modal](/components/Modal) directly.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ConfirmModal, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let result = "";
</script>

<Button kind="danger" on:click={() => (open = true)}>Delete file</Button>

{#if result}
  <Text>Result: {result}</Text>
{/if}

<ConfirmModal
  bind:open
  title="Delete this file?"
  confirmText="Delete"
  on:confirm={() => (result = "confirmed")}
  on:cancel={(e) => (result = `canceled (${e.detail.trigger})`)}
>
  <p>This action cannot be undone.</p>
</ConfirmModal>
```

### Kinds

Set `kind` to match the severity of the action. The default is `"danger"`.

#### Danger

Use `kind="danger"` for destructive, irreversible actions. The confirm button uses Modal's danger styling, the cancel button receives focus first so a stray keypress can't confirm by accident, and screen readers announce it as an alert dialog.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ConfirmModal } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button kind="danger" on:click={() => (open = true)}
  >Delete all instances</Button
>

<ConfirmModal
  bind:open
  kind="danger"
  title="Delete all instances"
  confirmText="Delete"
>
  <p>This is a permanent action and cannot be undone.</p>
</ConfirmModal>
```

#### Warning

Use `kind="warning"` for actions that need attention but aren't destructive. It shows a warning icon next to the heading and is also announced as an alert dialog.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ConfirmModal } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Leave page</Button>

<ConfirmModal
  bind:open
  kind="warning"
  title="You have unsaved changes"
  confirmText="Leave"
  cancelText="Stay"
>
  <p>Changes you made will be lost if you leave this page.</p>
</ConfirmModal>
```

#### Info

Use `kind="info"` for plain confirmations with no danger or warning styling.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ConfirmModal } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Sign out</Button>

<ConfirmModal
  bind:open
  kind="info"
  title="Sign out of your account?"
  confirmText="Sign out"
>
  <p>You can sign back in at any time.</p>
</ConfirmModal>
```

### Type to confirm

Set `confirmationPhrase` to require the user to type an exact phrase before the confirm button is enabled. `confirmationLabel` is a function that receives the phrase and returns the input's label, such as for a translation.

The match is case-sensitive but ignores spaces around the phrase, which pasting often adds. The field turns off autocapitalize and autocorrect, so a phone doesn't change the phrase as it's typed, and asks password managers not to fill it. The phrase in the label is marked not to translate, so a page translator doesn't change the word the user has to type.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ConfirmModal } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button kind="danger" on:click={() => (open = true)}>Delete project</Button>

<ConfirmModal
  bind:open
  title="Delete this project?"
  confirmText="Delete"
  confirmationPhrase="delete-project"
>
  <p>All resources associated with this project will be permanently removed.</p>
</ConfirmModal>
```

### Async confirm

Pass the work as `confirm`, a function that returns a promise. The confirm button shows a loading spinner, and the cancel button, <kbd>Escape</kbd> and outside clicks are blocked until it settles. On success the modal closes; on failure it stays open, focus returns to the confirm button, and `confirm:error` carries the error to show in the modal body. A result that arrives after the modal was closed and reopened is ignored.

For work you track yourself, set `loading` instead, and close the modal when it's done.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ConfirmModal,
    InlineNotification,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let error = "";

  // For demo purposes only: fails every other attempt.
  let attempts = 0;
  async function deleteAccount() {
    error = "";
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 600));
    attempts += 1;
    if (attempts % 2 === 1) throw new Error("The server didn't respond.");
  }
</script>

<Button kind="danger" on:click={() => (open = true)}>Delete account</Button>

<ConfirmModal
  bind:open
  title="Delete your account?"
  confirmText="Delete"
  loadingDescription="Deleting"
  confirm={deleteAccount}
  on:confirm:error={(e) => {
    // The rejection can be any value; show its message when it's an Error.
    const reason = e.detail.error;
    error = reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason);
  }}
>
  <p>This will permanently delete your account and all of its data.</p>
  {#if error}
    <InlineNotification
      kind="error"
      title="Couldn't delete the account."
      subtitle={error}
      hideCloseButton
      lowContrast
    />
  {/if}
</ConfirmModal>
```

#### Focus after closing

When the modal closes, focus returns to the button that opened it. If confirming removes that button, such as a delete button in a table row, move focus in `on:close` to what comes next, such as the next row or the table's heading.

### Custom body

Use the default slot to add richer content below the confirmation prompt, such as a list of the items an action will affect.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ConfirmModal,
    ListItem,
    UnorderedList,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button kind="danger" on:click={() => (open = true)}>Remove members</Button>

<ConfirmModal bind:open title="Remove these members?" confirmText="Remove">
  <p>The following members will lose access to this workspace:</p>
  <UnorderedList>
    <ListItem>Ava Chen</ListItem>
    <ListItem>Marcus Reed</ListItem>
    <ListItem>Priya Nair</ListItem>
  </UnorderedList>
</ConfirmModal>
```

### Events

#### Confirm

`on:confirm` fires when the confirm button is clicked (or activated via <kbd>Enter</kbd>) and, when `confirmationPhrase` is set, the typed phrase matches. It carries no detail.

```svelte
<ConfirmModal bind:open title="Delete this item?" on:confirm={handleDelete}>
```

#### Cancel

`on:cancel` fires when the user backs out. `event.detail.trigger` is `"cancel-button"`, `"close-button"`, `"escape-key"` or `"outside-click"`. Closing the modal yourself, such as after async work succeeds, isn't a cancel.

```svelte
<ConfirmModal
  bind:open
  title="Delete this item?"
  on:cancel={(e) => console.log(e.detail.trigger)}
>
```

#### Open, close, and transition end

`on:open` and `on:transitionend` forward the underlying [Modal](/components/Modal#events) events. `on:close` fires when the modal closes, with the same `trigger` values as Modal's; `"programmatic"` means `open` was set to `false`, after a confirm or by you. A close attempt while `loading` is blocked and not reported, and calling `event.preventDefault()` keeps the modal open.

---

### Component API

#### `ConfirmModal` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` (Required) | `string` | Specify the modal heading. | _undefined_ |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the modal. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the top-level HTML element. | `null` |
| `kind` | `"danger" \| "warning" \| "info"` | Set the kind of confirmation.<br />`"danger"` uses Modal's danger variant and `"warning"` adds a warning<br />icon next to the heading; both are announced as an alert dialog.<br />`"info"` is a plain dialog. | `"danger"` |
| `label` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the modal label. | _undefined_ |
| `confirmText` | `string` | Specify the confirm button text | `"Confirm"` |
| `cancelText` | `string` | Specify the cancel button text | `"Cancel"` |
| `confirmationPhrase` | `string \| undefined` | When set, the user must type this exact phrase before the confirm<br />button becomes enabled. | _undefined_ |
| `confirmationLabel` | `(phrase: string) => string` | Specify the label for the type-to-confirm input. | `(phrase) => `Type ${phrase} to confirm`` |
| `confirm` | `undefined \| (() => void \| Promise<unknown>)` | Specify the work to run on confirm. When it returns a promise, the<br />modal shows its loading state until the promise settles: it closes on<br />success, and on failure stays open and dispatches `confirm:error`.<br />Without it, or when it returns nothing, the modal closes on confirm. | _undefined_ |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to show a loading state on the confirm button and block<br />closing, for work the app tracks itself. `confirm` sets this state on<br />its own. | `false` |
| `loadingDescription` | `string` | Specify the description for the confirm button loading state | `"Working"` |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Set the size of the modal.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"`, the width of a `Modal` with no size. | `"xs"` |
| `preventCloseOnClickOutside` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to allow closing the modal when clicking outside | `true` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the top-level element | `uniqueId()` |

#### `ConfirmModal` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`       | `Record<string, never>` |
| `titleChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ConfirmModal` forwarded events

| Event              |
| ------------------ |
| `on:open`          |
| `on:transitionend` |

#### `ConfirmModal` dispatched events

| Event | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `on:cancel` | `{<br />  trigger:<br />    \| "escape-key"<br />    \| "outside-click"<br />    \| "close-button"<br />    \| "cancel-button";<br />}` |
| `on:close` | `{<br />  trigger:<br />    \| "escape-key"<br />    \| "outside-click"<br />    \| "close-button"<br />    \| "programmatic";<br />}` |
| `on:confirm` | `null` |
| `on:confirm:error` | `{ error: unknown }` |

#### `ConfirmModal` $$restProps

`ConfirmModal` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## ContainedList

### Basic

Display a basic contained list with a header label and list items. The default size is medium.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="Team members">
  <ContainedListItem>Jane Cooper</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Devon Lane</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Esther Howard</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot for custom label content instead of plain label text.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContainedList,
    ContainedListItem,
    Text,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList>
  <Text slot="labelChildren" tag="span" type="inherit" weight="regular"
    >Team members</Text
  >
  <ContainedListItem>Jane Cooper</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Devon Lane</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Esther Howard</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="Team members" hideLabel>
  <ContainedListItem>Jane Cooper</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Devon Lane</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Esther Howard</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

### Sizes

The default size is medium. See variants below for compact and larger layouts.

#### Small

Use the small size variant for more compact list items with reduced padding and height.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="API keys" size="sm">
  <ContainedListItem>Production key</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Staging key</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>CI/CD key</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

#### Large

Use the large size variant for larger list items with increased padding and height.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="API keys" size="lg">
  <ContainedListItem>Production key</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Staging key</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>CI/CD key</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

#### Extra-large

Use the extra-large size variant for the largest list items with maximum padding and height.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="API keys" size="xl">
  <ContainedListItem>Production key</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Staging key</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>CI/CD key</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

### Inset rulers

Set `inset` to inset divider lines from the edges for a more refined appearance.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="Connected integrations" inset>
  <ContainedListItem>Slack</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>GitHub</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>PagerDuty</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

### Disclosed

Set `kind` to `"disclosed"` for a compact header that sticks while scrolling. In long lists, the header stays visible at the top of the container.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    ContainedList,
    ContainedListItem,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box height="200px" overflowY="auto">
  <ContainedList labelText="Audit log -- Today" kind="disclosed">
    {#each ["User jane.cooper@acme.com signed in", "API key rotated for billing-service", "Role updated: admin granted to devon.lane", "Webhook endpoint added", "Deployment to production completed", "Password reset requested"] as entry}
      <ContainedListItem>{entry}</ContainedListItem>
    {/each}
  </ContainedList>
  <ContainedList labelText="Audit log -- Yesterday" kind="disclosed">
    {#each ["User esther.howard@acme.com signed in", "API key revoked for legacy-service", "Role updated: viewer granted to marcus.chen", "Webhook endpoint removed", "Deployment to staging completed", "Two-factor authentication enabled"] as entry}
      <ContainedListItem>{entry}</ContainedListItem>
    {/each}
  </ContainedList>
</Box>
```

### Icons

Add icons using the `icon` prop. Icons appear to the left of each item.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="Quick actions">
  <ContainedListItem icon={Add}>Invite team member</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem icon={Add}>Connect integration</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem icon={Add}>Generate API key</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

### Search

Add a search input to filter list items.

#### Expandable

Use the `action` slot on the list to add an expandable search control in the header. Set `size` to `"xl"` so the search fills the 48px header.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContainedList,
    ContainedListItem,
    Search,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="Team members">
  <Search slot="action" expandable size="xl" />
  <ContainedListItem>Jane Cooper</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Devon Lane</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem>Esther Howard</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

#### Persistent

Place the search as a direct child (not in the action slot) for a persistent filter below the title. The input is styled for list headers and works with sticky headers.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContainedList,
    ContainedListItem,
    Search,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let searchTerm = "";
  const searchResults = Array.from(
    { length: 50 },
    (_, i) => `Ticket #${10000 + i}`,
  );

  $: filteredResults = searchResults.filter((item) => {
    const lowerItem = item.toLowerCase();
    const lowerSearch = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    return lowerItem.includes(lowerSearch);
  });
</script>

<ContainedList kind="disclosed" labelText="Support tickets">
  <Search placeholder="Filter tickets" bind:value={searchTerm} />
  {#each filteredResults as item}
    <ContainedListItem>{item}</ContainedListItem>
  {/each}
</ContainedList>
```

### Clickable items

Make items respond to interaction with `interactive` for in-page actions or `href` for navigation. Both produce a clickable item; add trailing controls to either with the `action` slot.

#### Interactive

Set `interactive` on a list item to render it as a clickable button with keyboard support. Combine with `disabled` to prevent interaction.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="Notifications">
  <ContainedListItem interactive on:click={() => console.log("click")}>
    Deployment to production succeeded
  </ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem interactive disabled
    >New comment on PR #482</ContainedListItem
  >
  <ContainedListItem interactive>Build #1042 failed</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

#### With actions

Use the `action` slot on an item for trailing controls such as buttons or icons. Actions sit on the trailing edge and do not block the item click target.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ContainedList,
    ContainedListItem,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Close from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Close.svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="Notifications">
  <ContainedListItem interactive on:click={() => console.log("click")}>
    Deployment to production succeeded
    <Button
      slot="action"
      kind="ghost"
      iconDescription="Dismiss"
      icon={Close}
      on:click={() => console.log("click close")}
    />
  </ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem interactive disabled
    >New comment on PR #482</ContainedListItem
  >
  <ContainedListItem interactive>Build #1042 failed</ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

#### Link items

Set `href` to render a list item as an anchor with clickable styles. Prefer this for navigation so links support middle-click and SEO. `href` takes precedence over `interactive`. Pass `target` and `rel` through rest props on the item.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="Related resources">
  <ContainedListItem href="https://carbondesignsystem.com/">
    Carbon Design System
  </ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem href="https://svelte.dev/">Svelte</ContainedListItem>
  <ContainedListItem
    href="https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-components-svelte"
    target="_blank"
  >
    carbon-components-svelte
  </ContainedListItem>
</ContainedList>
```

#### Selected item

Set `selected` on the interactive or link item whose details show beside the list, such as the chosen job in a pipeline. It gets a selected fill, a bar on its leading edge, and `aria-current`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContainedList, ContainedListItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContainedList labelText="Jobs">
  {#each ["Lint", "Unit tests", "Build", "Deploy"] as name (name)}
    <ContainedListItem
      interactive
      selected={job === name}
      on:click={() => (job = name)}
    >
      {name}
    </ContainedListItem>
  {/each}
</ContainedList>
```

### Virtualization

Render thousands of items with [VirtualList](/components/VirtualList). Set `spacerTag` to `"li"` so it renders only the items in view, straight into the list. Each item overlaps the one above by 1px, so set `itemHeight` to the item height less 1px. Set `measured` if items can wrap. Wrap the `ContainedList` in a [ScrollGradient](/components/ScrollGradient) and pass its `scrollElementRef` as `scrollElement`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContainedList,
    ContainedListItem,
    ScrollGradient,
    VirtualList,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const regions = ["us-south", "us-east", "eu-de", "eu-gb", "jp-tok", "au-syd"];

  const instances = Array.from({ length: 5000 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: i,
    name: `web-prod-${String(i + 1).padStart(4, "0")}`,
    region: regions[i % regions.length],
  }));

  let scrollElementRef = null;
</script>

<ScrollGradient
  height="240px"
  background="background"
  color="background"
  hideStartGradient
  bind:scrollElementRef
>
  <ContainedList labelText="Instances">
    <VirtualList
      items={instances}
      itemHeight={47}
      containerHeight={240}
      scrollElement={scrollElementRef}
      spacerTag="li"
      measured
      getKey={(item) => item.id}
      let:item
    >
      <ContainedListItem>{item.name} ({item.region})</ContainedListItem>
    </VirtualList>
  </ContainedList>
</ScrollGradient>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ContainedList` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"on-page" \| "disclosed"` | Specify the kind of contained list. | `"on-page"` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "labelChildren". | `""` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | Specify the size of the list. | `"md"` |
| `inset` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for lines between list items to be inset | `false` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text.<br />The label remains available to screen readers.<br />Has no effect when the "action" slot is used. | `false` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the list element.<br />The label id derives from it as `label-{id}`. | `uniqueId()` |

#### `ContainedList` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`       | `Record<string, never>` |
| `action`        | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ContainedListItem` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render a `button` element instead of a `div` | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the list item | `false` |
| `selected` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to mark an `interactive` or `href` item as the current<br />one, such as the item whose details show beside the list. It gets a<br />selected fill and `aria-current`. | `false` |
| `href` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the `href` attribute.<br />Renders an anchor with clickable styles. Takes precedence over `interactive`. | _undefined_ |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify the icon to render.<br />Icon is rendered to the left of the item content. | _undefined_ |

#### `ContainedListItem` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `action`  | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ContainedListItem` forwarded events

| Event      |
| ---------- |
| `on:click` |

#### `ContainedListItem` $$restProps

`ContainedListItem` spreads `$$restProps` to the `a | button | div` element.


## ContentSwitcher

### Basic

Create a content switcher with switch components. Each switch needs a text label via `text`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher>
  <Switch text="Latest news" />
  <Switch text="Trending" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

### Switching views

Pass one `SwitchPanel` per switch to the `content` slot. Panels pair with switches by position. The component shows the panel for the selected switch and sets `role="tabpanel"`, `aria-labelledby`, and each switch's `aria-controls`. Name the switcher with `aria-label`.

Set `lazy` to mount a panel's content the first time its switch is selected, or `unmountOnHide` to unmount it when the switch is deselected.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    ContentSwitcher,
    Switch,
    SwitchPanel,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher aria-label="News feed">
  <Switch text="Latest news" />
  <Switch text="Trending" />
  <Switch text="Recommended" />
  <Box slot="content" paddingY={5}>
    <SwitchPanel>Headlines from the last 24 hours.</SwitchPanel>
    <SwitchPanel>Stories with the most reads this week.</SwitchPanel>
    <SwitchPanel>Picked from your reading history.</SwitchPanel>
  </Box>
</ContentSwitcher>
```

### Selection

Control which switch is selected by index, by a stable id, or by changing how arrow keys move the selection.

#### Initial selected index

Set `selectedIndex` to pre-select a switch when the content switcher loads.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher selectedIndex={1}>
  <Switch text="Latest news" />
  <Switch text="Trending" />
  <Switch text="Recommended" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

#### Selected by id

For dynamic switch sets, bind `selectedId` and give each `Switch` a stable `id`. Selection stays on the same logical switch when switches before it are added or removed. When set, `selectedId` takes precedence over `selectedIndex`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    ContentSwitcher,
    Stack,
    Switch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedId = "admin";
  let showDashboard = true;
  let showAdmin = true;
  let showSettings = true;
  let showProfile = true;

  $: visibleSwitches = [
    { id: "dashboard", text: "Dashboard", show: showDashboard },
    { id: "admin", text: "Admin", show: showAdmin },
    { id: "settings", text: "Settings", show: showSettings },
    { id: "profile", text: "Profile", show: showProfile },
  ].filter((s) => s.show);
</script>

<Stack gap={3}>
  <div>
    <Checkbox bind:checked={showDashboard} labelText="Show Dashboard" />
    <Checkbox bind:checked={showAdmin} labelText="Show Admin" />
    <Checkbox bind:checked={showSettings} labelText="Show Settings" />
    <Checkbox bind:checked={showProfile} labelText="Show Profile" />
  </div>
  <Stack gap={4} orientation="horizontal" align="center">
    <Button
      kind="tertiary"
      size="small"
      on:click={() => (selectedId = "settings")}
    >
      Select Settings by id
    </Button>
    <div><strong>selectedId:</strong> {selectedId}</div>
  </Stack>
  <ContentSwitcher bind:selectedId>
    {#each visibleSwitches as sw (sw.id)}
      <Switch id={sw.id} text={sw.text} />
    {/each}
  </ContentSwitcher>
</Stack>
```

#### Query string

Keep the selected switch in the URL so it survives a reload and can be shared. `queryParam` returns a store mirrored to a query parameter; bind `selectedId` to it. Use `parse` to reject unknown ids so they fall back to `defaultValue`; selecting `defaultValue` removes the parameter. In an app with a router, pass the router's navigation API as `replace`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContentSwitcher,
    queryParam,
    Stack,
    Switch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const views = [
    {
      id: "news",
      text: "Latest news",
      body: "Headlines from the last 24 hours.",
    },
    {
      id: "trending",
      text: "Trending",
      body: "Stories with the most reads this week.",
    },
    {
      id: "recommended",
      text: "Recommended",
      body: "Picked from your reading history.",
    },
  ];

  const selectedView = queryParam("view", {
    defaultValue: views[0].id,
    parse: (id) => (views.some((view) => view.id === id) ? id : undefined),
  });
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <ContentSwitcher bind:selectedId={$selectedView} aria-label="News feed">
    {#each views as view (view.id)}
      <Switch id={view.id} text={view.text} aria-controls="{view.id}-panel" />
    {/each}
  </ContentSwitcher>

  {#each views as view (view.id)}
    <div
      id="{view.id}-panel"
      role="tabpanel"
      aria-labelledby={view.id}
      tabindex="0"
      hidden={$selectedView !== view.id}
    >
      {view.body}
    </div>
  {/each}
</Stack>
```

#### Manual selection mode

By default, the content switcher changes the selection when the user moves focus with the arrow keys.

Set `selectionMode` to `"manual"` so that arrow keys only move focus without changing the selection. The user must press <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd> to select a switch.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher selectionMode="manual">
  <Switch text="Latest news" />
  <Switch text="Trending" />
  <Switch text="Recommended" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

#### Reactive

Programmatically control the content switcher with the `bind:selectedIndex` directive, updating the selected index based on user interactions or application state.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ContentSwitcher,
    Stack,
    Switch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedIndex = 1;
</script>

<ContentSwitcher bind:selectedIndex>
  <Switch text="Latest news" />
  <Switch text="Trending" />
  <Switch text="Recommended" />
</ContentSwitcher>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <div>
    <Button
      size="small"
      disabled={selectedIndex === 2}
      on:click={() => (selectedIndex = 2)}
    >
      Set selected to 2
    </Button>
  </div>
  <div>Selected index: {selectedIndex}</div>
</Stack>
```

### Events

Listen for content switcher selection changes.

#### Change

Listen for `on:change` to know when the selected switch index changes, whether from a click, keyboard navigation, or a `selectedIndex`/`selectedId` update. `event.detail` is the new selected index. The index and the selected switch can change independently when switches are added, removed, or reordered, so use `bind:selectedId` to track which switch is selected.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher on:change={(e) => console.log(e.detail)}>
  <Switch text="Latest news" />
  <Switch text="Trending" />
  <Switch text="Recommended" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

### Conditional switches

Switches can be conditionally rendered using Svelte's `{#if}` blocks. The component automatically maintains correct indices even when switches are dynamically added or removed.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Checkbox,
    ContentSwitcher,
    Stack,
    Switch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedIndex = 0;
  let showAdmin = true;
  let showSettings = true;
</script>

<Stack gap={3}>
  <div>
    <Checkbox bind:checked={showAdmin} labelText="Show Admin switch" />
    <Checkbox bind:checked={showSettings} labelText="Show Settings switch" />
  </div>
  <div>
    <strong>Selected index:</strong>
    {selectedIndex}
  </div>
  <ContentSwitcher bind:selectedIndex>
    <Switch text="Dashboard" />
    {#if showAdmin}
      <Switch text="Admin" />
    {/if}
    {#if showSettings}
      <Switch text="Settings" />
    {/if}
    <Switch text="Profile" />
  </ContentSwitcher>
</Stack>
```

### Custom switch slot

Override the default slot in the switch to customize how each option displays. An icon placed before the text is centered on it, and long text still truncates with an ellipsis.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Analytics from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Analytics.svelte";
  import Bullhorn from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Bullhorn.svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher>
  <Switch><Bullhorn /> Latest news</Switch>
  <Switch><Analytics /> Trending</Switch>
</ContentSwitcher>
```

#### Selected state

The default slot exposes `selected`, so custom content can change with the selection.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Checkmark from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Checkmark.svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher>
  <Switch text="Latest news" let:selected>
    {#if selected}<Checkmark />{/if} Latest news
  </Switch>
  <Switch text="Trending" let:selected>
    {#if selected}<Checkmark />{/if} Trending
  </Switch>
</ContentSwitcher>
```

### Icon-only

Set `icon` on every switch for compact, icon-only controls. The switcher becomes icon-only when all switches include an icon, once they register. Set `iconOnly` on the switcher to fit them from the first render, so server-rendered markup does not span its container until hydration. Use `text` for the accessible label and tooltip. Press <kbd>Escape</kbd> to hide the tooltip without moving the pointer or focus. It shows again on the next hover or focus.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import List from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/List.svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher>
  <Switch icon={TableOfContents} text="Table of contents" />
  <Switch icon={Dashboard} text="Dashboard" />
  <Switch icon={List} text="List" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

#### Tooltip alignment

Pass `tooltipAlignment` to individual icon-only switches to adjust tooltip alignment.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import List from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/List.svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher>
  <Switch
    icon={TableOfContents}
    text="Table of contents"
    tooltipAlignment="start"
  />
  <Switch icon={Dashboard} text="Dashboard" />
  <Switch icon={List} text="List" tooltipAlignment="end" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

#### Tooltip behavior

Within a content switcher, only one switch's tooltip stays open at a time -- hovering or focusing a new switch closes the previous one immediately.

Moving the pointer directly from one icon-only switch to a neighbor whose tooltip is already open skips the usual enter delay, so the tooltip swaps in immediately instead of waiting again. Hover across the icon-only switches in the examples above to feel this.

### Low contrast

Set `lowContrast` for the low contrast variant. The selected switch uses a light surface instead of the default inverse (dark) background, reducing the contrast between the switcher and surrounding content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher lowContrast>
  <Switch text="Latest news" />
  <Switch text="Trending" />
  <Switch text="Recommended" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

#### Disabled switches

Combine low contrast with disabled switches.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher lowContrast>
  <Switch text="Latest news" />
  <Switch text="Trending" />
  <Switch disabled text="Recommended" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

#### Sizes

The low contrast variant supports all sizes. Set `size` to `"sm"`, `"xl"`, or leave it unset for the default size.

```svelte
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>

    <Switch text="Latest news" />
    <Switch text="Trending" />
    <Switch text="Recommended" />
  </ContentSwitcher>
  <ContentSwitcher lowContrast>
    <Switch text="Latest news" />
    <Switch text="Trending" />
    <Switch text="Recommended" />
  </ContentSwitcher>
  <ContentSwitcher size="xl" lowContrast>
    <Switch text="Latest news" />
    <Switch text="Trending" />
    <Switch text="Recommended" />
```
```svelte
  </ContentSwitcher>
</Stack>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to control height. The default is `md`.

#### Extra-large

Set `size` to `"xl"` for an extra-large content switcher.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher size="xl">
  <Switch text="All" />
  <Switch text="Archived" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

#### Small

Set `size` to `"sm"` for a small content switcher.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher size="sm">
  <Switch text="All" />
  <Switch text="Archived" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

### Auto width

By default, switches split the width evenly, so a long label truncates while a short one leaves empty space. Set `autoWidth` to size each switch to its label. The switcher shrinks to fit its switches, and only truncates labels when its container is too narrow.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Stack, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <ContentSwitcher>
    <Switch text="All" />
    <Switch text="Recently updated by teammates" />
    <Switch text="Archived" />
  </ContentSwitcher>
  <ContentSwitcher autoWidth>
    <Switch text="All" />
    <Switch text="Recently updated by teammates" />
    <Switch text="Archived" />
  </ContentSwitcher>
</Stack>
```

### Disabled

Disable individual switches with `disabled`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcher, Switch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ContentSwitcher>
  <Switch disabled text="All" />
  <Switch disabled text="Archived" />
</ContentSwitcher>
```

### Skeleton

Show a loading state with `ContentSwitcherSkeleton`. Match the switcher's `count` and `size` so the swap doesn't move the content below.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ContentSwitcherSkeleton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <ContentSwitcherSkeleton />
  <ContentSwitcherSkeleton count={2} size="sm" />
</Stack>
```

### Component API

#### `ContentSwitcher` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedIndex` (Reactive) | `number` | Set the selected index of the switch item.<br />Ignored when `selectedId` is set.<br />An out-of-range value selects the nearest switch. | `0` |
| `selectedId` (Reactive) | `string \| undefined` | Specify the selected switch by id.<br />When set, takes precedence over `selectedIndex` and stays on the same<br />logical switch as switches are added or removed. Pair with a stable `id`<br />on each `Switch`. | _undefined_ |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the tablist HTML element. | `null` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| undefined` | Specify the size of the content switcher.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"` (the 40px default) and `"lg"` (`"xl"`). | _undefined_ |
| `selectionMode` | `"automatic" \| "manual"` | Choose whether or not to automatically change selection<br />on focus when using arrow keys. Defaults to "automatic". | `"automatic"` |
| `lowContrast` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the low contrast variant | `false` |
| `autoWidth` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to size each switch to its label instead of splitting the<br />width evenly. The switcher shrinks to fit its switches. | `false` |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` when every switch sets `icon`, so the switcher fits its<br />switches from the first render, server-rendered markup included. The<br />switcher infers icon-only once its switches register, and that wins. | `false` |

#### `ContentSwitcher` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `content` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ContentSwitcher` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ContentSwitcher` dispatched events

| Event       | Detail   |
| ----------- | -------- |
| `on:change` | `number` |

#### `ContentSwitcher` $$restProps

`ContentSwitcher` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `Switch` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` for the switch to be selected. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLButtonElement` | Obtain a reference to the button HTML element. | `null` |
| `text` | `string` | Specify the switch text.<br />Alternatively, use the default slot. | `"Provide text"` |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Render an icon-only switch.<br />The parent `ContentSwitcher` becomes icon-only when every `Switch` sets `icon`.<br />`text` is used as the accessible label and the tooltip shown on hover and focus. | _undefined_ |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the switch | `false` |
| `tooltipAlignment` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Align the portalled tooltip to the switch. | `"center"` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the button element | `uniqueId()` |

#### `Switch` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `{ selected: boolean }` |

#### `Switch` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:keydown`    |
| `on:keyup`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `Switch` $$restProps

`Switch` spreads `$$restProps` to the `button` element.

#### `SwitchPanel` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the panel HTML element. | `null` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the panel element.<br />Prefer a stable value when switches are added or removed. | `uniqueId()` |
| `lazy` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to defer mounting panel content until its switch is first selected | `false` |
| `unmountOnHide` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to unmount panel content when its switch is deselected | `false` |

#### `SwitchPanel` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `SwitchPanel` $$restProps

`SwitchPanel` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `ContentSwitcherSkeleton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `number` | Specify the number of switches | `3` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| undefined` | Specify the size of the content switcher it stands in for.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"` (the 40px default) and `"lg"` (`"xl"`). | _undefined_ |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to stand in for icon-only switches | `false` |

#### `ContentSwitcherSkeleton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ContentSwitcherSkeleton` $$restProps

`ContentSwitcherSkeleton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## ContextMenu

### Basic

In the examples, right click anywhere within the iframe. The context menu appears when right-clicking anywhere in the window. Use ContextMenuOption for menu items and ContextMenuDivider for visual separation.

The root element has `role="menu"`. Set `labelText` or `aria-label` on ContextMenu so assistive technologies get a meaningful name. This matters most for the default window-wide behavior (target unset), where there is no visible trigger to label the menu with `aria-labelledby`.

`open`, `x`, and `y` are also bindable, letting you trigger the menu from something other than a right-click; see [Programmatic position](#programmatic-position).

Once open, arrow keys move focus between options without wrapping past the first or last option. <kbd>Home</kbd> and <kbd>End</kbd> jump to the first and last option. Disabled options take focus so screen reader users can find them, but they do not run. Type a character to move focus to the next option whose label starts with it; type several characters quickly to match a longer prefix.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuOption,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import CopyFile from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/CopyFile.svelte";
  import Cut from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Cut.svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";
</script>

<ContextMenu labelText="Menu actions">
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Copy" shortcut="mod+c" icon={CopyFile} />
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Cut" shortcut="mod+x" icon={Cut} />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption kind="danger" labelText="Delete" icon={TrashCan} />
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p>Right click anywhere on this page</p>
</div>
```

### Menu items

`ContextMenuOption` supports the following props:

| Prop | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `labelText` | Primary label (or use the `labelChildren` slot; see the API reference). |
| `shortcut` | Keys shown on the right, such as `"mod+c"` (<DocKbd shortcut="mod+c" variant="muted" /> on your platform), announced with `aria-keyshortcuts`. Display only: bind the command with `onShortcut`. |
| `shortcutText` | Custom text on the right, such as `"F5"`, or use the `shortcutChildren` slot. Takes precedence over `shortcut`. Display only. |
| `icon` | Carbon icon component to the left of the label, or use the `icon` slot for custom content in its place. When an icon is set, the option is indented automatically so rows align; you do not need to pass `indented` for icon rows. |
| `indented` | Indent the label without an icon, for example to align with submenu parents or nested items (see [Nested menu](#nested-menu), [Custom target](#custom-target), and [Multiple targets](#multiple-targets)). |
| `disabled` | Non-interactive, dimmed row. |
| `kind` | `"default"` or `"danger"` for destructive actions. |

For options inside `ContextMenuGroup`, see [Selectable](#selectable), [Selectable (nested)](#selectable-nested), and [Radio group](#radio-group).

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuOption,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import CopyFile from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/CopyFile.svelte";
  import Cut from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Cut.svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";
</script>

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="View details" />
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Search" shortcut="mod+k" />
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Copy" shortcut="mod+c" icon={CopyFile} />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption indented labelText="Rename" />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption disabled labelText="Cut" shortcut="mod+x" icon={Cut} />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption kind="danger" labelText="Delete" icon={TrashCan} />
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p>Right click anywhere on this page</p>
</div>
```

#### Custom label content

Use the `labelChildren` slot to render custom label content, such as a tooltip icon, in place of `labelText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuOption,
    TooltipIcon,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Information from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Information.svelte";
</script>

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Deploy">
    <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
      Deploy
      <TooltipIcon
        tooltipText="Deploys the latest build to production."
        icon={Information}
      />
    </svelte:fragment>
  </ContextMenuOption>
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="View details" />
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p>Right click anywhere on this page</p>
</div>
```

#### Nested menu

Put children inside a parent `ContextMenuOption` to open a flyout submenu. Use `indented` on the parent when it has no icon so the label aligns with other rows.

Submenus can contain:

| Kind | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Plain options | Nested `ContextMenuOption` rows for ordinary actions (no selection state). This page's example below mixes plain rows with a selectable group; see **Open with** → Preview / Editor. |
| Selectable group | A nested `ContextMenuGroup` with an accessible label; options act as checkboxes and share `bind:selectedIds`. See [Selectable (nested)](#selectable-nested); the **Export as** branch in this example shows the same pattern alongside plain items. |
| Radio group | A nested `ContextMenuRadioGroup` with `bind:selectedId` so only one choice is active. See [Radio group (nested)](#radio-group-nested). |

Selecting an option closes only that option's own menu level. At the root, that closes the whole menu. Inside a submenu, it closes just that flyout and leaves the rest open. Call `event.preventDefault()` to keep a flyout open across several picks; see [Prevent menu from closing](#prevent-menu-from-closing).

Typing a character inside an open submenu searches only that submenu's options.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuGroup,
    ContextMenuOption,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import CopyFile from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/CopyFile.svelte";
  import Cut from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Cut.svelte";

  let selectedIds = [];
</script>

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Copy" shortcut="mod+c" icon={CopyFile} />
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Cut" shortcut="mod+x" icon={Cut} />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption indented labelText="Open with">
    <ContextMenuOption labelText="Preview" />
    <ContextMenuOption labelText="Editor" />
  </ContextMenuOption>
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption indented labelText="Export as">
    <ContextMenuGroup labelText="Export formats" bind:selectedIds>
      <ContextMenuOption id="pdf" labelText="PDF" />
      <ContextMenuOption id="svg" labelText="SVG" />
      <ContextMenuOption id="png" labelText="PNG" />
    </ContextMenuGroup>
  </ContextMenuOption>
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption disabled indented labelText="Share">
    <ContextMenuOption labelText="Email link" />
    <ContextMenuOption labelText="Copy link" />
  </ContextMenuOption>
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p>Right click anywhere on this page</p>
</div>
```

#### Selectable

Use selectable for a single toggle item, or wrap options in ContextMenuGroup with `bind:selectedIds` for a checkbox-style group. Provide an id on each option in the group. The standalone toggle and the group items are independent, and the group tracks every chosen option in selectedIds.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuGroup,
    ContextMenuOption,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedIds = [];

  $: console.log("selectedIds", selectedIds);
</script>

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuOption selectable labelText="Remove metadata" />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuGroup labelText="Style options" bind:selectedIds>
    <ContextMenuOption id="0" labelText="Font smoothing" selected />
    <ContextMenuOption id="1" labelText="Reduce noise" />
    <ContextMenuOption id="2" labelText="Auto-sharpen" />
  </ContextMenuGroup>
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p>Right click anywhere on this page</p>
</div>
```

#### Selectable (nested)

Put ContextMenuGroup inside a parent ContextMenuOption to show the checkbox-style group in a flyout submenu. Use `bind:selectedIds` for the chosen values. See [Nested menu](#nested-menu) for a full submenu example, and [Prevent menu from closing](#prevent-menu-from-closing) to keep the flyout open while changing several checkboxes.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuGroup,
    ContextMenuOption,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedIds = ["guides"];
</script>

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuOption indented labelText="Open" />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption indented labelText="Layers">
    <ContextMenuGroup labelText="Visible layers" bind:selectedIds>
      <ContextMenuOption id="guides" labelText="Guides" />
      <ContextMenuOption id="grid" labelText="Grid" />
      <ContextMenuOption id="annotations" labelText="Annotations" />
    </ContextMenuGroup>
  </ContextMenuOption>
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p>Right click anywhere on this page</p>
</div>
```

#### Radio group

Use ContextMenuRadioGroup to organize related options as a radio set: only one option can be selected at a time, and `bind:selectedId` reflects the active choice.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuOption,
    ContextMenuRadioGroup,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedId = "0";

  $: console.log("selectedId", selectedId);
</script>

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuOption indented labelText="Open" />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuRadioGroup bind:selectedId labelText="Radio group">
    <ContextMenuOption id="0" labelText="Set as foreground" />
    <ContextMenuOption id="1" labelText="Set as background" />
  </ContextMenuRadioGroup>
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p>Right click anywhere on this page</p>
</div>
```

#### Radio group (nested)

Put ContextMenuRadioGroup inside a parent ContextMenuOption to show the radio set in a flyout submenu, similar to the nested checkbox group in [Nested menu](#nested-menu). Use `bind:selectedId` for the active choice.

Selecting an option closes that flyout. Call `event.preventDefault()` in the option's `on:click` handler to leave it open; `selectedId` still updates. See [Prevent menu from closing](#prevent-menu-from-closing).

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuOption,
    ContextMenuRadioGroup,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectedId = "list";
</script>

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Open" />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="View as">
    <ContextMenuRadioGroup bind:selectedId labelText="View mode">
      <ContextMenuOption
        id="list"
        labelText="List"
        on:click={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
      />
      <ContextMenuOption
        id="grid"
        labelText="Grid"
        on:click={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
      />
      <ContextMenuOption
        id="compact"
        labelText="Compact"
        on:click={(e) => e.preventDefault()}
      />
    </ContextMenuRadioGroup>
  </ContextMenuOption>
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p>Right click anywhere on this page</p>
</div>
```

### Triggering

Control which element triggers the menu, or open it programmatically without a right-click at all.

#### Custom target

By default, the context menu triggers when you right-click anywhere in the window.

Set `target` to specify which element triggers the context menu.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuGroup,
    ContextMenuOption,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import CopyFile from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/CopyFile.svelte";
  import Cut from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Cut.svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";

  let target;
</script>

<ContextMenu {target} on:open={(e) => console.log(e.detail)}>
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Copy" shortcut="mod+c" icon={CopyFile} />
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Cut" shortcut="mod+x" icon={Cut} />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption indented labelText="Export as">
    <ContextMenuGroup labelText="Export options">
      <ContextMenuOption id="pdf" labelText="PDF" />
      <ContextMenuOption id="png" labelText="PNG" />
      <ContextMenuOption id="svg" labelText="SVG" />
    </ContextMenuGroup>
  </ContextMenuOption>
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption selectable labelText="Remove metadata" />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuGroup labelText="Style options">
    <ContextMenuOption id="0" labelText="Font smoothing" selected />
    <ContextMenuOption id="1" labelText="Reduce noise" />
    <ContextMenuOption id="2" labelText="Auto-sharpen" />
  </ContextMenuGroup>
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption kind="danger" labelText="Delete" icon={TrashCan} />
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p data-outline bind:this={target}>Right click this element</p>
</div>
```

#### Multiple targets

Set `target` to an array of elements to trigger the context menu from multiple sources.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuGroup,
    ContextMenuOption,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import CopyFile from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/CopyFile.svelte";
  import Cut from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Cut.svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";

  let target;
  let target2;
</script>

<ContextMenu target={[target, target2]} on:open={(e) => console.log(e.detail)}>
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Copy" shortcut="mod+c" icon={CopyFile} />
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Cut" shortcut="mod+x" icon={Cut} />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption indented labelText="Export as">
    <ContextMenuGroup labelText="Export options">
      <ContextMenuOption id="pdf" labelText="PDF" />
      <ContextMenuOption id="png" labelText="PNG" />
      <ContextMenuOption id="svg" labelText="SVG" />
    </ContextMenuGroup>
  </ContextMenuOption>
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption selectable labelText="Remove metadata" />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuGroup labelText="Style options">
    <ContextMenuOption id="0" labelText="Font smoothing" selected />
    <ContextMenuOption id="1" labelText="Reduce noise" />
    <ContextMenuOption id="2" labelText="Auto-sharpen" />
  </ContextMenuGroup>
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption kind="danger" labelText="Delete" icon={TrashCan} />
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p data-outline bind:this={target}>Right click this element</p>
  <p data-outline bind:this={target2}>... or this one</p>
</div>
```

#### Programmatic position

`open`, `x`, and `y` are bindable, so you can open the menu from something other than a right-click, such as a "..." overflow button. Compute a position (for example, from the trigger element's bounding rectangle) and set `x` and `y` before setting `open` to `true`.

This does not replace the right-click behavior described above; if `target` is left unset, the window-wide right-click trigger from [Basic](#basic) still applies alongside the button. Set `target` if you want the button to be the only way to open the menu.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuOption,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import CopyFile from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/CopyFile.svelte";
  import Cut from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Cut.svelte";
  import OverflowMenuVertical from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/OverflowMenuVertical.svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";

  let trigger;
  let open = false;
  let x = 0;
  let y = 0;

  function handleClick() {
    const { left, bottom } = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
    x = left;
    y = bottom;
    open = true;
  }
</script>

<Button
  kind="ghost"
  icon={OverflowMenuVertical}
  iconDescription="Open row actions"
  bind:ref={trigger}
  on:click={handleClick}
/>

<ContextMenu bind:open bind:x bind:y labelText="Row actions">
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Copy" icon={CopyFile} />
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Cut" icon={Cut} />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption kind="danger" labelText="Delete" icon={TrashCan} />
</ContextMenu>
```

### Events

ContextMenu dispatches `open` once it finishes opening, and `close` on every close attempt.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuOption,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import CopyFile from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/CopyFile.svelte";
  import Cut from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Cut.svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";
</script>

<ContextMenu
  labelText="Menu actions"
  on:open={(e) => console.log("open", e.detail)}
  on:close={(e) => console.log("close", e.detail.trigger)}
>
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Copy" shortcut="mod+c" icon={CopyFile} />
  <ContextMenuOption labelText="Cut" shortcut="mod+x" icon={Cut} />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption kind="danger" labelText="Delete" icon={TrashCan} />
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p>Right click anywhere on this page, then check the console.</p>
</div>
```

#### Open event

`open`'s detail is the DOM element that was right-clicked. When the menu is opened programmatically instead (see [Programmatic position](#programmatic-position)), the detail is `null` unless a prior right-click already populated it.

#### Close event

`close`'s detail contains `trigger`, one of `"escape-key"`, `"outside-click"`, or `"select"`, describing why the menu closed. <kbd>Tab</kbd> reports `"escape-key"`, like the other menus.

#### Prevent menu from closing

An option's `click` event is cancelable. Call `event.preventDefault()` in its `on:click` handler to keep the menu open. For a selectable or radio option, selection still updates; only the close is canceled. That is how you leave a nested submenu open while changing several choices. See [Radio group (nested)](#radio-group-nested).

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ContextMenu,
    ContextMenuDivider,
    ContextMenuOption,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Checkmark from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Checkmark.svelte";
  import Copy from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Copy.svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";

  let copying = false;
  let copied = false;

  async function copyToClipboard() {
    if (copying) return;
    copying = true;
    copied = false;
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(
      "https://app.example.com/tickets/48213",
    );
    copied = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
      copied = false;
    }, 2000);
    copying = false;
  }
</script>

<ContextMenu>
  <ContextMenuOption
    indented
    labelText={copied ? "Copied!" : "Copy text"}
    icon={copied ? Checkmark : Copy}
    disabled={copying}
    on:click={(e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      copyToClipboard();
    }}
  />
  <ContextMenuDivider />
  <ContextMenuOption kind="danger" labelText="Delete item" icon={TrashCan} />
</ContextMenu>

<div data-centered>
  <p>Right click anywhere on this page</p>
</div>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ContextMenu` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the menu.<br />Either `x` and `y` must be greater than zero. | `false` |
| `x` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the horizontal offset of the menu position. | `0` |
| `y` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the vertical offset of the menu position. | `0` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLUListElement` | Obtain a reference to the unordered list HTML element. | `null` |
| `target` | `null \| HTMLElement \| ReadonlyArray<null \| HTMLElement>` | Specify an element or list of elements to trigger the context menu.<br />If no element is specified, the context menu applies to the entire window. | `null` |
| `labelText` | `string \| undefined` | Accessible name for the menu.<br />Prefer setting this (or `aria-label`) when the menu is opened from the window<br />(`target` unset), where there is no visible trigger for `aria-labelledby`. | _undefined_ |

#### `ContextMenu` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ContextMenu` forwarded events

| Event        |
| ------------ |
| `on:click`   |
| `on:keydown` |

#### `ContextMenu` dispatched events

| Event | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `on:close` | `{<br />  trigger:<br />    \| "escape-key"<br />    \| "outside-click"<br />    \| "select";<br />}` |
| `on:open` | `HTMLElement` |

#### `ContextMenu` $$restProps

`ContextMenu` spreads `$$restProps` to the `ul` element.

#### `ContextMenuGroup` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedIds` (Reactive) | `ReadonlyArray<string>` |  | `[]` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |

#### `ContextMenuGroup` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ContextMenuRadioGroup` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectedId` (Reactive) | `string` | Set the selected radio group id. | `""` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |

#### `ContextMenuRadioGroup` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ContextMenuOption` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the selected variant. | `false` |
| `selectable` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to enable the selectable variant.<br />Automatically set to `true` if `selected` is `true`. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLLIElement` | Obtain a reference to the list item HTML element. | `null` |
| `kind` | `"default" \| "danger"` | Specify the kind of option. | `"default"` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to enable the disabled state | `false` |
| `indented` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indent the label.<br />Rendered indented regardless when `icon` is set, or when the option is selectable or part of a radio group. | `false` |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify the icon to render.<br />Icon is rendered to the left of the label text.<br />Overridden with a checkmark icon when the option is selectable or part of a radio group. | _undefined_ |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text.<br />Alternatively, use the "labelChildren" slot. | `""` |
| `shortcutText` | `string` | Specify the shortcut text.<br />Alternatively, use the "shortcutChildren" slot. | `""` |
| `shortcut` | `string` | Specify a keyboard shortcut to show, such as `"mod+s"`. `mod` is<br />Command on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere. The keys show where<br />`shortcutText` goes, and the item gets `aria-keyshortcuts`. Display only:<br />bind the command itself with `onShortcut`, since the menu is usually<br />closed. `shortcutText` and its slot take precedence. A value that isn't<br />a shortcut, such as `"Ctrl C"`, shows as written. | `""` |
| `id` | `string` | Specify the id.<br />It's recommended to provide an id as a value to bind to within a selectable/radio menu group. | `uniqueId()` |

#### `ContextMenuOption` slots

| Slot               | Detail                  |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- |
| `default`          | `Record<string, never>` |
| `icon`             | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelChildren`    | `Record<string, never>` |
| `shortcutChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `shortcutText`     | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ContextMenuOption` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:keydown`    |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |

#### `ContextMenuOption` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:click` | `Event` | Dispatched on selection. Cancelable: call `preventDefault()` to keep<br />this menu level open. A selectable or radio option's selection still<br />updates. |

#### `ContextMenuOption` $$restProps

`ContextMenuOption` spreads `$$restProps` to the `li` element.


## CopyButton

### Basic

Set `text` to the string to copy. By default, the copy button uses the native [Clipboard API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Clipboard/writeText), with a `document.execCommand("copy")` fallback when that API is unavailable or rejects (for example in an insecure context); pass a function to `copy` to replace it (see [Override](#override)). For code examples, use [CodeSnippet](/components/CodeSnippet); for content not ready at render time, see [Async copy](#async-copy).

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d" />
```

### Async copy

Pass an async `copy` function when the text is not available at render time, for example markdown fetched on click. Feedback appears after `copy()` resolves.

While `copy()` is pending, the button sets `aria-busy` and ignores clicks. On success, the button dispatches `copy`. On failure, it shows `errorFeedback` (default `"Failed to copy"`) and dispatches `copy:error`.

Prefetch on hover with `on:mouseenter`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const content = "api_9f2b41c9d8e34a1b8c6f2e0a1d9b3c47";
  let cachedContent = null;

  async function prefetchContent() {
    if (cachedContent) return;

    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300));
    cachedContent = content;
  }

  async function copyContent() {
    if (!cachedContent) {
      await prefetchContent();
    }

    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(cachedContent);
  }
</script>

<CopyButton
  iconDescription="Copy fetched content"
  feedback="Copied!"
  copy={copyContent}
  on:mouseenter={prefetchContent}
  on:copy:error={(e) => {
    console.error("Copy failed", e.detail.error);
  }}
/>
```

### Ghost kind

Set `kind` to `"ghost"` to render a transparent button that matches a [Button](/components/Button) with `kind="ghost"`. The default `kind` (`"primary"`) keeps Carbon's filled square.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  kind="ghost"
/>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to scale the square. Sizes align with the heights used by [Button](/components/Button).

#### Small

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d" size="sm" />
```

#### Medium

The default size (`md`) matches Carbon's native copy button.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d" />
```

#### Large

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d" size="lg" />
```

#### Extra large

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d" size="xl" />
```

### Custom feedback

Customize the message and icon shown after copying.

#### Text

Set `feedback` to customize the message shown after copying. Set `errorFeedback` to customize the message shown when copying fails (default `"Failed to copy"`).

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  feedback="Copied to clipboard"
/>
```

#### Icon

Set `feedbackIcon` to show a different icon while feedback is visible. The copy icon returns when feedback closes.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Checkmark from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Checkmark.svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  feedbackIcon={Checkmark}
/>
```

#### Duration

Set `feedbackTimeout` to change how long the feedback stays visible, in milliseconds. Defaults to `2000`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  feedbackTimeout={5000}
/>
```

### Copy behavior

Replace or disable the default clipboard behavior.

#### Override

Pass a function to `copy` to replace the default Clipboard API behavior.

This example calls the Clipboard API directly, without the `document.execCommand("copy")` fallback.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  copy={(text) => navigator.clipboard.writeText(text)}
  tooltipAlignment="start"
/>
```

#### Prevent

Set `copy` to a no-op function to disable copying.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton text="This text should not be copied" copy={() => {}} />
```

### Hover tooltip

On hover or focus, the button shows a proactive tooltip with the `iconDescription`. It renders in a floating portal so it is never clipped and flips when space is tight. Press Escape to hide the tooltip, or the copy feedback, without moving the pointer or focus.

#### Directions

Set `tooltipAlign` to place the tooltip relative to the button. It takes Popover's `align` names and replaces `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`, which still work and are deprecated.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  iconDescription="Top"
  tooltipAlign="top"
/>
<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  iconDescription="Right"
  tooltipAlign="right"
/>
<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  iconDescription="Bottom"
  tooltipAlign="bottom"
/>
<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  iconDescription="Left"
  tooltipAlign="left"
/>
```

#### Alignment

Add `-start` or `-end` to align the tooltip with one end of the button.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  iconDescription="Start"
  tooltipAlign="bottom-start"
/>
<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  iconDescription="Center"
  tooltipAlign="bottom"
/>
<CopyButton
  text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
  iconDescription="End"
  tooltipAlign="bottom-end"
/>
```

#### Tooltip group

Place the button in a [TooltipGroup](/components/TooltipGroup) with the icon-only buttons beside it. Once one tooltip is open, moving between the buttons shows each tooltip right away, with no enter delay.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    CopyButton,
    Stack,
    TooltipGroup,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Edit from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Edit.svelte";
  import Share from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Share.svelte";
</script>

<TooltipGroup>
  <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={1}>
    <Button kind="ghost" iconDescription="Edit webhook" icon={Edit} />
    <CopyButton
      kind="ghost"
      text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
      iconDescription="Copy webhook URL"
    />
    <Button kind="ghost" iconDescription="Share webhook" icon={Share} />
  </Stack>
</TooltipGroup>
```

### Portal tooltip

The "Copied!" feedback tooltip is rendered in a floating portal by default, so it shares the same surface as the hover tooltip (the text swaps in place) and is never clipped by an `overflow: hidden` container. Set `portalTooltip` to `false` to use Carbon's inline feedback caret instead. A `tooltipAlign` other than `"bottom"` is always portalled because the inline caret only supports the default placement.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, CopyButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<!--
  The feedback tooltip is portalled by default, so it is not clipped even when
  the button sits in an `overflow: hidden` container. Set `portalTooltip` to
  `false` to use Carbon's inline feedback caret, which is clipped here.
-->
<Box
  display="flex"
  direction="column"
  gap={4}
  overflow="hidden"
  border="subtle"
  borderStyle="dashed"
  padding={5}
  maxHeight="120px"
>
  <CopyButton
    text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
    feedback="Portalled (default)"
    tooltipAlignment="start"
  />
  <CopyButton
    text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d"
    feedback="Inline caret"
    portalTooltip={false}
    tooltipAlignment="start"
  />
</Box>
```

### Inside a modal

Because the feedback tooltip is portalled by default, it is not clipped inside a [Modal](/components/Modal). Set `portalTooltip` to `false` to use the inline caret.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, CopyButton, Modal } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button>

<Modal
  bind:open
  modalHeading="Copy example"
  primaryButtonText="Done"
  secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
  on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
>
  <CopyButton text="https://api.acme.io/webhooks/incoming/f8a2c91d" />
</Modal>
```

### Component API

#### `CopyButton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLButtonElement` | Obtain a reference to the underlying button element. | `null` |
| `feedback` | `string` | Set the feedback text shown after clicking the button | `"Copied!"` |
| `errorFeedback` | `string` | Set the feedback text shown when copying fails | `"Failed to copy"` |
| `feedbackTimeout` | `number` | Set the timeout duration (ms) to display feedback text | `2000` |
| `feedbackIcon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify an icon to render during the feedback window (for example, after copying).<br />When unset, the copy icon is always shown. | _undefined_ |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | Set the title and ARIA label for the copy button | `"Copy to clipboard"` |
| `kind` | `"primary" \| "ghost"` | Specify the kind of copy button.<br />Use `"ghost"` to match a `Button` with `kind="ghost"`. | `"primary"` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | Specify the size of the copy button.<br />`"md"` keeps Carbon's native 2.5rem square; the other sizes match `Button`. | `"md"` |
| `text` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the text to copy. | _undefined_ |
| `copy` | `(text: string) => void \| Promise<void>` | Override the default copy behavior (`navigator.clipboard.writeText` with<br />a `document.execCommand("copy")` fallback). Failures reject so the button<br />can show `errorFeedback` and dispatch `copy:error`. | `copyText` |
| `portalTooltip` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set how the "Copied!" feedback tooltip is rendered.<br />By default, it is rendered in a portal so it shares the same surface as the<br />hover tooltip (the text swaps in place) and is never clipped by an<br />`overflow: hidden` container. Set to `false` to use Carbon's inline feedback<br />caret instead; a non-default `tooltipPosition`/`tooltipAlignment` still<br />portals because the inline caret only supports the default placement. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipAlign` | `"top" \| "top-start" \| "top-end" \| "bottom" \| "bottom-start" \| "bottom-end" \| "left" \| "left-start" \| "left-end" \| "right" \| "right-start" \| "right-end" \| undefined` | Set the tooltip placement in floating-ui form: the side, then `start`<br />or `end` along it, as Popover's `align` takes. Above and below,<br />`start` and `end` name inline sides, so they swap under `dir="rtl"`.<br />When set, takes precedence over `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipPosition` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Set the position of the tooltip relative to the button. | `"bottom"` |
| `tooltipAlignment` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the button. | `"center"` |

| `on:click`        |

| `on:mouseenter`   |
| `on:mouseleave`   |
