#### `GridOverlay` $$restProps

`GridOverlay` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## Heading

### Basic

A top-level heading inside a section renders as an h1 element, a semantic starting point for your document structure.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading, Section } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Section>
  <Heading>Admin console</Heading>
</Section>
```

### Standalone heading

A `Heading` used without a `Section` ancestor also defaults to h1. Wrap headings in `Section` when you need automatic level management as content nests.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Heading>Incident report</Heading>
```

### Heading levels

`Heading` reads its semantic level (h1-h6) from the nearest `Section` context. Levels advance automatically as sections nest, and can be given a custom starting point.

#### Nested sections

As you nest sections, heading levels automatically increment to maintain proper hierarchy. Each nested section increases the heading level by one (h1 → h2 → h3, and so on). Heading levels cap at h6 to ensure valid HTML structure, even when nested deeper than six levels.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading, Section } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Section>
  <Heading>Admin console</Heading>
  <Section>
    <Heading>User management</Heading>
    <Section>
      <Heading>Permissions</Heading>
      <Section>
        <Heading>Role assignments</Heading>
        <Section>
          <Heading>Audit trail</Heading>
          <Section>
            <Heading>Session details</Heading>
            <Section>
              <Heading>Capped at h6</Heading>
            </Section>
          </Section>
        </Section>
      </Section>
    </Section>
  </Section>
</Section>
```

#### Custom starting level

Set a custom starting heading level with `level` on the section. Child sections continue to increment from this level.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading, Section } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Section level={5}>
  <Heading>Audit trail</Heading>
  <Section>
    <Heading>Session details</Heading>
  </Section>
</Section>
```

### Visual size

Semantic heading level comes from `Section` context, so every level renders at the same browser default size. Set `type` to a Carbon type token to control the visual size independently of the semantic level, the same tokens `Text` uses.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading, Section } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Section level={2}>
  <Heading type="heading-03">Account settings</Heading>
</Section>
```

### Custom section element

The section renders a semantic section element by default. Set `tag` to render a different element (such as div, article, or aside) while keeping automatic heading level management.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Heading, Section } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Section tag="div">
  <Heading>Admin console</Heading>
</Section>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Heading` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"heading-compact-01" \| "heading-compact-02" \| "heading-01" \| "heading-02" \| "heading-03" \| "heading-04" \| "heading-05" \| "heading-06" \| "heading-07" \| "fluid-heading-03" \| "fluid-heading-04" \| "fluid-heading-05" \| "fluid-heading-06" \| "fluid-display-01" \| "fluid-display-02" \| "fluid-display-03" \| "fluid-display-04" \| undefined` | Set the visual size using a Carbon type token. The semantic heading level<br />stays driven by `Section` context; this only changes how the heading looks. | _undefined_ |

#### `Heading` typedefs

```ts
type SectionLevel = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
```

#### `Heading` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Heading` $$restProps

`Heading` spreads `$$restProps` to the `h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6` element.

#### `Section` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | `SectionLevel \| undefined` | Specify the heading level the section should start at.<br />When omitted, the level is one more than the parent section (1 at the top).<br />When nested, child sections automatically increment from this level.<br />Levels are capped at 6 (h6). | _undefined_ |
| `tag` | `keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap` | Specify the HTML tag name to render instead of the default `section` element.<br />Useful when you need to use a different semantic element while maintaining<br />the heading level context functionality. | `"section"` |

#### `Section` typedefs

```ts
type SectionLevel = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
```

#### `Section` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Section` $$restProps

`Section` spreads `$$restProps` to the `section` element.


## IconIndicator

### Basic

Create an icon indicator with `kind` and `label`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Succeeded" />
```

### Kinds

Set `kind` to match the status being communicated.

Each kind reads a Carbon v11 `status-*` theme token, such as `status-red` for `failed`, so it follows the theme.

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={3}>
  <IconIndicator kind="failed" label="Failed" />
  <IconIndicator kind="caution-major" label="Caution major" />
  <IconIndicator kind="caution-minor" label="Caution minor" />
  <IconIndicator kind="undefined" label="Undefined" />
  <IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Succeeded" />
  <IconIndicator kind="normal" label="Normal" />
  <IconIndicator kind="in-progress" label="In progress" />
  <IconIndicator kind="incomplete" label="Incomplete" />
  <IconIndicator kind="not-started" label="Not started" />
  <IconIndicator kind="pending" label="Pending" />
  <IconIndicator kind="unknown" label="Unknown" />
  <IconIndicator kind="informative" label="Informative" />
</Stack>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to control the icon and label size.

#### 16px (default)

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Succeeded" />
```

#### 20px

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Succeeded" size={20} />
```

### Hidden label

Set `hideLabel` to show only the icon, such as in a list where nearby text already says the status. Screen readers still read the label.

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Delivered" hideLabel />
```

### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot for custom label content instead of `label`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { IconIndicator } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<IconIndicator kind="succeeded" label="Succeeded">
  <strong slot="labelChildren">Deploy to production succeeded</strong>
</IconIndicator>
```

---

### Component API

#### `IconIndicator` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` (Required) | `"failed" \| "caution-major" \| "caution-minor" \| "undefined" \| "succeeded" \| "normal" \| "in-progress" \| "incomplete" \| "not-started" \| "pending" \| "unknown" \| "informative"` | Specify the kind of the icon indicator. | _undefined_ |
| `label` (Required) | `string` | Specify the label displayed next to the icon. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `16 \| 20` | Specify the size of the icon indicator. | `16` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to show only the icon, keeping the label for screen<br />readers, such as when nearby text already says the status. | `false` |

#### `IconIndicator` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `IconIndicator` $$restProps

`IconIndicator` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## ImageLoader

### Basic

Load an image with the default configuration. The component handles the loading process automatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
```

### Alt text

Set `alt` to provide alternative text for the image.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  alt="IBM logo"
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
```

### Aspect ratio

Maintain consistent image dimensions using aspect ratios. The component uses [AspectRatio](/components/AspectRatio) to constrain the image.

Supported aspect ratios include `"2x1"`, `"2x3"`, `"16x9"`, `"4x3"`, `"1x1"`, `"3x4"`, `"3x2"`, `"9x16"` and `"1x2"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  ratio="16x9"
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
```

### Lazy loading

ImageLoader starts loading as soon as `src` is set, so an image far down the page downloads with the page. Set `lazy` to wait until the image comes within `rootMargin` (600px by default) of the viewport. The server-rendered markup then marks the image `loading="lazy"`, so the browser's preload scanner skips it too.

Pair it with `ratio`, which reserves the image's space, so the page doesn't shift when it loads. Leave `lazy` off for images visible when the page opens, such as a hero image: they should load as early as possible.

Raise `rootMargin`, for example to `"1200px"`, if images still appear blank during fast scrolling. The margin grows the viewport only. Inside a scroll container, such as a modal body, an image starts loading as it scrolls into the container's view.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  lazy
  ratio="16x9"
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
```

### Fade in

Enable a smooth fade-in animation when the image loads successfully.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Button
  kind="ghost"
  on:click={() => {
    key++;
  }}>Reload image</Button
>
{#key key}<ImageLoader
    fadeIn
    ratio="16x9"
    src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
  />{/key}
```

### Loading and error states

ImageLoader tracks its own loading, loaded, and error state internally. Customize the UI shown at each stage, read the state directly, or listen for events.

#### Slots

Customize the loading and error states using named slots.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader, InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="loading">
    <InlineLoading />
  </svelte:fragment>
  <svelte:fragment slot="error">Unable to load company logo.</svelte:fragment>
</ImageLoader>
```

#### Bindable state

Bind to `loading`, `loaded`, and `error` to read the image's state. All three props are readonly outside the component and are set automatically as the image loads.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import imageError from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/imageError.svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  bind:loading
  bind:loaded
  bind:error={imageError}
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
<p>loading: {loading} · loaded: {loaded} · error: {imageError}</p>
```

#### Events

Dispatches `load` when the image loads successfully, and `error` when it fails to load.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ImageLoader
  on:load={() => console.log("loaded")}
  on:error={() => console.log("error")}
  src="https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg"
/>
```

### Updating the image source

Change the image displayed by the same ImageLoader instance, either imperatively or by reacting to a changing `src` value.

#### Programmatic

Control image loading programmatically using component references.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ImageLoader } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const src =
    "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/5/51/IBM_logo.svg";
  const srcError = `${src}1`;

  let imageLoader;
  let imageLoadError;
</script>

<Button
  kind="ghost"
  disabled={!imageLoader || imageLoadError}
  on:click={() => imageLoader.loadImage(srcError)}
>
  Simulate error
</Button>

<ImageLoader bind:this={imageLoader} bind:error={imageLoadError} fadeIn {src}>
  <svelte:fragment slot="error">
    <Button kind="ghost" on:click={() => imageLoader.loadImage(src)}>
      Error. Try again
    </Button>
  </svelte:fragment>
</ImageLoader>
```

#### Dynamic

Update the image source dynamically using the same image loader instance for smooth transitions between images.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Button, ImageLoader, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const images = [
    {
      src: "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/1/1b/Svelte_Logo.svg",
      alt: "Svelte logo",
    },
    {
      src: "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/b9/Carbon-design-system-logo.png",
      alt: "Carbon Design System logo",
    },
  ];

  let index = 0;

  $: image = images[index];
</script>

<Stack gap={5} align="start">
  <Button
    kind="ghost"
    on:click={() => {
      index = index === 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }}
  >
    Toggle image
  </Button>

  <Box width="100%" maxWidth="120px">
    <ImageLoader ratio="1x1" fadeIn src={image.src} alt={image.alt} />
  </Box>
</Stack>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ImageLoader` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `loading` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` while the image is loading: `src` is set and<br />neither `loaded` nor `error` is `true`. | `false` |
| `loaded` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` when the image is loaded. | `false` |
| `error` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` if an error occurs when loading the image. | `false` |
| `src` | `string` | Specify the image source. | `""` |
| `alt` | `string` | Specify the image alt text. | `""` |
| `ratio` | `"2x1" \| "16x9" \| "4x3" \| "1x1" \| "3x4" \| "3x2" \| "9x16" \| "1x2" \| undefined` | Specify the aspect ratio for the image wrapper. | _undefined_ |
| `fadeIn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to fade in the image on load.<br />The duration uses the `fast-02` value following Carbon guidelines on motion. | `false` |
| `lazy` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to start loading the image once it comes within<br />`rootMargin` of the viewport, instead of as soon as `src` is set.<br />Server-rendered markup then marks the image `loading="lazy"`. | `false` |
| `rootMargin` | `string` | Specify how far outside the viewport counts as near with `lazy`, as a<br />CSS margin. The image starts loading before it scrolls into view, so it<br />is ready when it does. | `"600px"` |
| `loadImage` | `(url?: string) => void` | Method invoked to load the image provided a `src` value.<br />If no URL is provided, uses the component's `src` prop. | _undefined_ |

#### `ImageLoader` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `error`   | `Record<string, never>` |
| `loading` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ImageLoader` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail |
| ---------- | ------ |
| `on:error` | `null` |
| `on:load`  | `null` |

#### `ImageLoader` $$restProps

`ImageLoader` spreads `$$restProps` to the `img` element.


## InlineEdit

### Basic

Click the text, or the edit button that appears on hover, to start editing. <kbd>Enter</kbd> saves and keeps editing, <kbd>Escape</kbd> reverts and exits, and moving focus away saves a real change or cancels an unchanged one.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineEdit
  labelText="Project name"
  editLabel="Edit project name"
  saveLabel="Save"
  cancelLabel="Cancel"
  value="Q3 roadmap"
/>
```

### Always visible

By default the edit button only appears on hover. Set `editAlwaysVisible` to `true` to keep it visible.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineEdit
  editAlwaysVisible
  labelText="Project name"
  editLabel="Edit project name"
  saveLabel="Save"
  cancelLabel="Cancel"
  value="Q3 roadmap"
/>
```

### Select text on focus

Set `selectTextOnFocus` to `true` to select the input's text when entering edit mode, so typing immediately replaces it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineEdit
  selectTextOnFocus
  labelText="Project name"
  editLabel="Edit project name"
  saveLabel="Save"
  cancelLabel="Cancel"
  value="Q3 roadmap"
/>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to control the vertical size of the control. The default is `"sm"`.

#### Extra small

`"xs"` matches the row height of a `compact` [DataTable](/components/DataTable), for use in a table cell.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineEdit
  size="xs"
  labelText="Project name"
  editLabel="Edit project name"
  saveLabel="Save"
  cancelLabel="Cancel"
  value="Q3 roadmap"
/>
```

#### Medium

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineEdit
  size="md"
  labelText="Project name"
  editLabel="Edit project name"
  saveLabel="Save"
  cancelLabel="Cancel"
  value="Q3 roadmap"
/>
```

#### Large

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineEdit
  size="lg"
  labelText="Project name"
  editLabel="Edit project name"
  saveLabel="Save"
  cancelLabel="Cancel"
  value="Q3 roadmap"
/>
```

### Inherit typography

Set `inheritTypography` to `true` for the input to inherit the surrounding container's font settings, useful when editing a heading in place. `size` still clamps the input's vertical size.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<h3>
  <InlineEdit
    inheritTypography
    labelText="Page title"
    editLabel="Edit page title"
    saveLabel="Save"
    cancelLabel="Cancel"
    value="Quarterly planning"
  />
</h3>
```

### Invalid

Set `invalid` to `true` and provide `invalidText` to show a validation message. Save stays disabled while invalid, even with a change.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineEdit
  invalid
  invalidText="Project name is required"
  labelText="Project name"
  editLabel="Edit project name"
  saveLabel="Save"
  cancelLabel="Cancel"
  value=""
/>
```

### Readonly

Set `readonly` to `true` to disable editing while keeping the field focusable. The edit button is replaced with a toggletip explaining why, set through `readonlyLabel` and `readonlyToggletipText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineEdit
  readonly
  readonlyLabel="Edit off"
  readonlyToggletipText="You don't have permission to edit this field"
  labelText="Project name"
  editLabel="Edit project name"
  saveLabel="Save"
  cancelLabel="Cancel"
  value="Q3 roadmap"
/>
```

### Disabled

Set `disabled` to `true` to turn off the field entirely: no edit affordance, and the input itself isn't focusable. Use `readonly` instead when the field should stay visible and focusable with an explanation.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineEdit
  disabled
  labelText="Project name"
  editLabel="Edit project name"
  saveLabel="Save"
  cancelLabel="Cancel"
  value="Q3 roadmap"
/>
```

### DataTable cells

Use the `cell` slot to render `InlineEdit` for inline editing of a row field, the same way as other form inputs.

In a table cell, the field fills the cell's padding, so its text lines up with the column header. Pick the `size` that matches the table's row size, and the row keeps its height:

| DataTable `size` | InlineEdit `size` |
| ---------------- | ----------------- |
| `compact`        | `"xs"`            |
| `short`          | `"xs"`            |
| `medium`         | `"sm"`            |
| default          | `"md"`            |
| `tall`           | `"lg"`            |

A `short` row is 32px, and no InlineEdit size matches it, so an `"xs"` field sits centered in the row. Bind to the row field, then call `refreshRow(id)` from `on:save` so columns that derive from other fields on the same row (like `Total` below) stay in sync -- `on:save` only fires on a real commit, unlike an input's `on:input`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { DataTable, InlineEdit } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let dataTable;

  const rows = [
    { id: "a", item: "Widget", unitPrice: 10, qty: 3 },
    { id: "b", item: "Gadget", unitPrice: 25, qty: 1 },
    { id: "c", item: "Gizmo", unitPrice: 8, qty: 5 },
  ];
</script>

<DataTable
  bind:this={dataTable}
  size="compact"
  headers={[
    { key: "item", value: "Item" },
    { key: "unitPrice", value: "Unit price" },
    { key: "qty", value: "Quantity" },
    {
      key: "total",
      value: "Total",
      sort: false,
      display: (_value, row) => `$${row.unitPrice * row.qty}`,
    },
  ]}
  {rows}
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="cell" let:row let:cell>
    {#if cell.key === "item"}
      <InlineEdit
        size="xs"
        id="item-{row.id}"
        labelText="Item name"
        editLabel="Edit item name"
        saveLabel="Save"
        cancelLabel="Cancel"
        bind:value={row.item}
        on:save={() => {
          // Rebuild cells so the Total column stays paired with the right row.
          dataTable.refreshRow(row.id);
        }}
      />
    {:else}
      {cell.display ? cell.display(cell.value, row) : cell.value}
    {/if}
  </svelte:fragment>
</DataTable>
```

---

### Component API

#### `InlineEdit` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `labelText` (Required) | `string` | Screen-reader label for the input. | _undefined_ |
| `editLabel` (Required) | `string` | Label for the edit button. | _undefined_ |
| `saveLabel` (Required) | `string` | Label for the save button. | _undefined_ |
| `cancelLabel` (Required) | `string` | Label for the cancel button. | _undefined_ |
| `value` (Reactive) | `string` | Current value of the input. | `""` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the outer HTML element. | `null` |
| `id` | `string` | Specify a custom id for the input. | `uniqueId()` |
| `editAlwaysVisible` | `boolean` | By default the edit button is shown on hover only. | `false` |
| `inheritTypography` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to have the input inherit the container's font settings.<br />`size` still clamps the input's vertical size. | `false` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state. | `false` |
| `invalidText` | `string` | Specify the invalid state text. | `""` |
| `placeholder` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the input placeholder text. | _undefined_ |
| `selectTextOnFocus` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to select the input's text when entering edit mode. | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the field entirely: no edit affordance, not<br />focusable. Use `readonly` instead to keep the field visible and<br />focusable while explaining why it can't be edited. | `false` |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable editing. | `false` |
| `readonlyLabel` | `string \| undefined` | Label for the "edit off" icon shown in readonly mode. Defaults to<br />`"Edit off"`. | _undefined_ |
| `readonlyToggletipText` | `string \| undefined` | Toggletip text shown in readonly mode, explaining why the field can't<br />be edited. Defaults to `"This field is read-only and cannot be edited"`. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Vertical size of the control: 24px (`"xs"`), 40px (`"sm"`), 48px (`"md"`)<br />or 64px (`"lg"`). In a DataTable cell, `"xs"` fits a `compact` row. | `"sm"` |

#### `InlineEdit` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:blur` | `FocusEvent` | Forwarded after the auto-save/auto-cancel decision runs. |
| `on:cancel` | `null` | Fires on the cancel button, or on blur/Escape with no real change. |
| `on:save` | `null` | Fires on the save button, or on blur/Enter with a changed value. |

#### `InlineEdit` $$restProps

`InlineEdit` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## InlineLoading

### Basic

Display a basic loading indicator with the default configuration.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading />
```

### With description

Add a descriptive text to provide context about the loading operation.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading description="Loading metrics..." />
```

### Small size

Set `size="sm"` for a status in a line of small text, such as "Saving..." in a toolbar or list row: 12px text and no minimum height.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading size="sm" description="Saving..." />
```

### Statuses

The component supports different status states to indicate progress:

| Status       | Description                         |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------- |
| **active**   | Shows an animated loading indicator |
| **inactive** | Displays a static state             |
| **finished** | Shows a success state               |
| **error**    | Displays an error state             |

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading status="active" description="Submitting..." />
<InlineLoading status="inactive" description="Cancelling..." />
<InlineLoading status="finished" description="Changes saved" />
<InlineLoading status="error" description="Failed to save changes" />
```

#### Icon description

Set `iconDescription` to override the accessible label announced for the status icon. For the `"finished"` and `"error"` states, it defaults to the `status` value if not set.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading
  status="error"
  iconDescription="Upload failed"
  description="Failed to upload file"
/>
```

#### Live region roles

The `"error"` status renders `role="alert"`, interrupting the screen reader immediately, as demonstrated by the four `<InlineLoading>` examples above. Every other status renders `role="status"`, announced politely so it doesn't interrupt. Pass `role` through rest props to override either default.

### Delay

Set `delay` to wait a number of milliseconds after `status` becomes `"active"` before showing the spinner. Work that finishes within the delay goes straight to the next status. Once shown, the spinner stays for at least 500 ms so it does not flash. A status that arrives in that time waits for it, and the spinner keeps the description it had, so a spinner never blinks before "Saved". The `success` event fires `successDelay` milliseconds after the checkmark shows.

`"inactive"`, `"finished"`, and `"error"` render at once when no spinner is showing. While the spinner waits, it is in the page but hidden, so the server HTML holds it too.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InlineLoading, Stack, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const descriptionMap = {
    active: "Saving...",
    finished: "Saved",
  };

  let status;

  async function simulateSave(duration) {
    status = "active";
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, duration));
    status = "finished";
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={5} align="center">
    <Button on:click={() => simulateSave(150)}>Fast save (150 ms)</Button>
    <Button kind="secondary" on:click={() => simulateSave(400)}>
      Save (400 ms)
    </Button>
    <Button kind="tertiary" on:click={() => simulateSave(2000)}>
      Slow save (2 s)
    </Button>
    {#if status}
      <InlineLoading
        {status}
        description={descriptionMap[status]}
        delay={300}
      />
    {/if}
  </Stack>

  <Text type="helper-text-01">
    The fast save finishes before the 300 ms delay, so it goes straight to
    "Saved". The 400 ms save shows the spinner at 300 ms and keeps it until 800
    ms, then shows "Saved".
  </Text>
</Stack>
```

### Events

Listen for `on:success`, dispatched `successDelay` milliseconds (default `1500`) after `status` is set to `"finished"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineLoading
  status="finished"
  description="Changes saved"
  successDelay={1000}
  on:success={() => console.log("success")}
/>
```

### UX example

See how to integrate the loading indicator in a real-world scenario.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, ButtonSet, InlineLoading } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { onMount } from "svelte";

  const descriptionMap = {
    active: "Submitting...",
    finished: "Changes saved",
    inactive: "Cancelling...",
  };

  const stateMap = {
    active: "finished",
    inactive: "dormant",
    finished: "dormant",
  };

  let timeout;
  let state = "dormant"; // "dormant" | "active" | "finished" | "inactive"

  function reset(incomingState) {
    if (typeof timeout === "number") {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
    }

    if (incomingState) {
      timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        state = incomingState;
      }, 2000);
    }
  }

  onMount(() => {
    return () => {
      reset();
    };
  });

  $: reset(stateMap[state]);
</script>

<ButtonSet>
  <Button
    kind="ghost"
    disabled={state === "dormant" || state === "finished"}
    on:click={() => (state = "inactive")}
  >
    Cancel
  </Button>
  {#if state !== "dormant"}
    <InlineLoading status={state} description={descriptionMap[state]} />
  {:else}
    <Button on:click={() => (state = "active")}>Submit</Button>
  {/if}
</ButtonSet>
```

---

### Component API

#### `InlineLoading` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `"active" \| "inactive" \| "finished" \| "error"` | Set the loading status. | `"active"` |
| `description` | `string \| undefined` | Set the loading description. | _undefined_ |
| `iconDescription` | `string \| undefined` | Specify a description for the loading icon.<br />Defaults to the `status` prop for the "error" and "finished" states. | _undefined_ |
| `successDelay` | `number` | Specify the timeout delay (ms) before the `success` event fires after `status` is set to "finished" | `1500` |
| `delay` | `number` | Wait this many milliseconds after `status` turns `"active"` before<br />showing the spinner. Once shown, the spinner stays for at least 500 ms,<br />so fast work shows nothing and slow work never flashes. A status that<br />arrives inside that time waits for it. While it waits, the spinner is<br />in the page but hidden, so server HTML already holds it. `"inactive"`,<br />`"finished"` and `"error"` render at once.<br />Set to `0` to show the spinner at once. | `0` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md"` | Set the size: `"sm"` fits a line of small text, such as a "Saving..."<br />status in a toolbar or list row, with 12px text and no minimum height. | `"md"` |

#### `InlineLoading` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `InlineLoading` dispatched events

| Event        | Detail |
| ------------ | ------ |
| `on:success` | `null` |

#### `InlineLoading` $$restProps

`InlineLoading` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## InlineNotification

### Basic

Display a basic error notification with title and subtitle by default. See [detailed usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/notification/usage) and the related [ToastNotification](ToastNotification).

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  title="Access denied:"
  subtitle="You do not have permission to edit this record."
/>
```

### Reusable

Control notification visibility by binding to `open` to show, hide, and reuse the same component with different messages. Open defaults to true.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    InlineNotification,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let kind = "error";
  let title = "Error:";
  let subtitle = "An internal server error occurred.";

  function showError() {
    kind = "error";
    title = "Save failed:";
    subtitle =
      "Your changes could not be saved. Check your connection and try again.";
    open = true;
  }

  function showSuccess() {
    kind = "success";
    title = "Success:";
    subtitle = "Changes saved successfully.";
    open = true;
  }

  function showWarning() {
    kind = "warning";
    title = "Warning:";
    subtitle = "Some fields require your attention before you continue.";
    open = true;
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <ButtonSet>
    <Button on:click={showSuccess}>Show success</Button>
    <Button kind="ghost" on:click={showWarning}>Show warning</Button>
    <Button kind="danger-ghost" on:click={showError}>Show error</Button>
  </ButtonSet>

  <InlineNotification bind:open {kind} {title} {subtitle} />
</Stack>
```

### Autoclose

Automatically close the notification after a specified duration (in milliseconds) with `timeout`. Set `pauseOnHover` to pause the timeout while the pointer is over the notification or while focus is inside it, so users can finish reading (opt-in).

A notification with an action, or an actionable notification, ignores `timeout`. It stays open until users act on it or close it, so the action never disappears before they reach it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { fade } from "svelte/transition";

  let timeout;
  $: showNotification = timeout !== undefined;
</script>

<Button
  disabled={showNotification}
  on:click={() => {
    timeout = 3_000; // 3 seconds
  }}
>
  Show notification
</Button>

{#if showNotification}
  <div transition:fade>
    <InlineNotification
      {timeout}
      pauseOnHover
      kind="success"
      title="Export complete:"
      subtitle="This notification will autoclose in {timeout.toLocaleString()} ms. Hover to pause the countdown."
      on:close={(e) => {
        timeout = undefined;
        console.log(e.detail.timeout); // true if closed via timeout
      }}
    />
  </div>
{/if}
```

### Full width

Set `fullWidth` to fill the parent's width without the default width limits and outer margin. Use it when the notification sits inside a card, form, or other layout that sizes and spaces its own content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  fullWidth
  kind="warning"
  title="Usage:"
  subtitle="Build minutes are close to the Team limit."
/>
```

### Title and subtitle

Both the title and subtitle are optional and can be customized with slots.

#### Optional

Title and subtitle only render when provided.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  subtitle="You do not have permission to perform this action."
/>
<InlineNotification title="Unable to process your request." />
```

#### Custom (slots)

Customize the notification content using slots for more flexibility.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification>
  <svelte:fragment slot="titleChildren">Error:</svelte:fragment>
  <strong slot="subtitleChildren">Your API key has expired.</strong>
</InlineNotification>
```

### Actions

Add interactive elements to notifications using the actions slot. The notification's title describes a `NotificationActionButton` for screen readers, with no extra setup.

#### Action button

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    InlineNotification,
    NotificationActionButton,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  kind="warning"
  title="Storage limit approaching:"
  subtitle="Your workspace has used 90% of its allocated storage."
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="actions">
    <NotificationActionButton>Learn more</NotificationActionButton>
  </svelte:fragment>
</InlineNotification>
```

#### Link

The notification action button accepts an href prop to render as a link instead of a button.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    InlineNotification,
    NotificationActionButton,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  kind="info"
  title="New features available:"
  subtitle="Check out what's new in this release."
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="actions">
    <NotificationActionButton
      href="https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-components-svelte/releases"
      target="_blank">View release notes</NotificationActionButton
    >
  </svelte:fragment>
</InlineNotification>
```

### Actionable

Set `actionable` to `true` when users must reach the action, such as an undo after a delete or a retry after a failed save. The notification becomes an `alertdialog` named by its title and described by its subtitle. When it opens, focus moves to the first action, or to the close button if there is no action. Tab stays inside the notification, and <kbd>Escape</kbd> closes it. Focus then returns to where it was before, such as the button that opened it.

Set `focusOnOpen` to `false` to leave focus in place, or `closeOnEscape` to `false` to keep it open on <kbd>Escape</kbd>. If the close button is also hidden, Tab can leave the notification, so keyboard users are never trapped. Keep the default for a notification that only informs.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    InlineNotification,
    NotificationActionButton,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Stack gap={5} align="start">
  <Button kind="danger" disabled={open} on:click={() => (open = true)}>
    Delete API key
  </Button>

  <InlineNotification
    bind:open
    actionable
    kind="success"
    title="API key deleted:"
    subtitle="Requests that use the key now fail."
  >
    <svelte:fragment slot="actions">
      <NotificationActionButton on:click={() => (open = false)}>
        Undo
      </NotificationActionButton>
    </svelte:fragment>
  </InlineNotification>
</Stack>
```

### Close button

Hide the close button or customize its behavior and label.

#### Hidden

Create a persistent notification by hiding the close button. For static guidance that screen readers shouldn't announce, use a [Callout](/components/Callout) instead.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  hideCloseButton
  kind="warning"
  title="Scheduled downtime:"
  subtitle="The system will be unavailable during tonight's maintenance window."
/>
```

#### Translated label

Translate the close button label via `closeButtonDescription`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  title="错误"
  subtitle="发生内部服务器错误"
  closeButtonDescription="关闭通知"
/>
```

#### Prevent default

Prevent the default close behavior using `e.preventDefault()` in the `on:close` event handler.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  title="Delete failed"
  subtitle="This resource is still in use by another service."
  on:close={(e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    // custom close logic (e.g., transitions)
  }}
/>
```

### ARIA role

Screen readers announce a notification when it appears. The default, `role="status"`, waits until the user pauses. Use it for most messages, such as a saved change.

Set `role="alert"` for an urgent error that needs action now, such as a failed payment. An alert interrupts whatever the screen reader is reading, so keep it rare. Set `role="log"` for a running log of messages.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  kind="success"
  title="Profile updated:"
  subtitle="Your changes are saved."
/>
<InlineNotification
  role="alert"
  kind="error"
  title="Payment failed:"
  subtitle="Update your card to keep the workspace active."
/>
```

### Status icon label

The status icon has a label for screen readers, such as "Warning" for the warning kinds. Translate it with `statusIconDescription`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { InlineNotification } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InlineNotification
  kind="warning"
  title="Maintenance planifiée :"
  subtitle="La facturation est en lecture seule samedi de 02:00 à 04:00 UTC."
  statusIconDescription="Avertissement"
  closeButtonDescription="Fermer la notification"
/>
```

### Component API

#### `InlineNotification` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to show the notification, `false` to hide it. | `true` |
| `kind` | `"error" \| "info" \| "info-square" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "warning-alt"` | Specify the kind of notification. | `"error"` |
| `lowContrast` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the low contrast variant | `false` |
| `timeout` | `number` | Set the timeout duration (ms) to hide the notification after opening it.<br />Ignored when the notification is `actionable` or has an `actions` slot. | `0` |
| `pauseOnHover` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to pause the auto-dismiss timeout while the pointer is over the notification or while focus is inside it. | `false` |
| `role` | `"alert" \| "log" \| "status"` | Specify the ARIA `role` for the notification container.<br />`actionable` overrides it with `alertdialog`. | `"status"` |
| `actionable` | `boolean` | Set to `true` when the notification holds an action that users must<br />reach, such as an undo or a retry. The notification becomes an<br />`alertdialog` named by its title, moves focus to its first action<br />(or the close button) when it opens, keeps Tab inside, and closes<br />on Escape. | `false` |
| `focusOnOpen` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to keep focus where it is when an actionable<br />notification opens. Has no effect unless `actionable` is `true`. | `true` |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to keep an actionable notification open on Escape.<br />With `hideCloseButton` also set, Tab can leave the notification.<br />Has no effect unless `actionable` is `true`. | `true` |
| `title` | `string` | Specify the title text | `""` |
| `subtitle` | `string` | Specify the subtitle text | `""` |
| `hideCloseButton` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the close button | `false` |
| `closeButtonDescription` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the close button | `"Close notification"` |
| `statusIconDescription` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the label of the status icon for screen readers.<br />Defaults to the kind, such as "Warning". | _undefined_ |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for the notification to fill its parent's width, without<br />the default width limits and outer margin, as when it sits inside a card,<br />a form, or another layout that spaces its own content. | `false` |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | Set an id for the top-level element. The title and subtitle ids derive<br />from it as `{id}-title` and `{id}-subtitle`, so the server and the<br />browser render the same ids. | _undefined_ |

#### `InlineNotification` slots

| Slot               | Detail                  |
| ------------------ | ----------------------- |
| `default`          | `Record<string, never>` |
| `actions`          | `Record<string, never>` |
| `subtitleChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `titleChildren`    | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `InlineNotification` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `InlineNotification` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail                              |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `on:close` | `{<br />  timeout: boolean;<br />}` |

#### `InlineNotification` $$restProps

`InlineNotification` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `NotificationActionButton` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `NotificationActionButton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

`NotificationActionButton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `Button` component.


## InputGroup

### Basic

Wrap a field and a button in InputGroup, so the two read as one control and the button matches the field's height. Label the field itself.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InputGroup, TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InputGroup>
  <TextInput labelText="Promo code" placeholder="WELCOME10" />
  <Button kind="tertiary">Apply</Button>
</InputGroup>
```

### Helper text

Helper text sits under the whole group. Pass the `describedBy` slot prop to the field so it is announced with it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InputGroup, TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import describedBy from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/describedBy.svelte";
</script>

<InputGroup helperText="Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes" let:describedBy>
  <TextInput
    labelText="Workspace URL"
    placeholder="northwind"
    aria-describedby={describedBy}
  />
  <Button kind="tertiary">Check</Button>
</InputGroup>
```

### Icon button

An icon-only button is square at the field's height.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InputGroup, TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Send from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Send.svelte";
</script>

<InputGroup>
  <TextInput hideLabel labelText="Message" placeholder="Write a reply" />
  <Button icon={Send} iconDescription="Send" />
</InputGroup>
```

### Field set

When several fields make up one value, set `legendText` to name the set, and give each field its own hidden label. Fields share the row; to give one a fixed width, such as a currency beside an amount, wrap it in a Box with that width.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    InputGroup,
    NumberInput,
    Select,
    SelectItem,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InputGroup legendText="Price">
  <NumberInput hideLabel labelText="Amount" value={1200} hideSteppers />
  <Box width="6rem">
    <Select hideLabel labelText="Currency" selected="USD">
      <SelectItem value="USD" />
      <SelectItem value="EUR" />
      <SelectItem value="GBP" />
    </Select>
  </Box>
</InputGroup>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` on the group to size its fields; buttons match their height. The group inherits the `size` of a parent `Form`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InputGroup, TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InputGroup size="sm">
  <TextInput labelText="Promo code" placeholder="WELCOME10" />
  <Button kind="tertiary">Apply</Button>
</InputGroup>
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InputGroup, TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InputGroup size="xl">
  <TextInput labelText="Promo code" placeholder="WELCOME10" />
  <Button kind="tertiary">Apply</Button>
</InputGroup>
```

### States

Reflect validation and interaction states. The message shows under the group, so it never pushes the button out of line. Pass the `invalid` or `warn` slot prop to the field it applies to, along with `describedBy`.

#### Invalid

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InputGroup, TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import describedBy from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/describedBy.svelte";
</script>

<InputGroup
  invalid
  invalidText="Enter a valid email address"
  let:describedBy
  let:invalid
>
  <TextInput
    labelText="Email"
    value="maria@"
    aria-describedby={describedBy}
    {invalid}
  />
  <Button>Subscribe</Button>
</InputGroup>
```

#### Warning

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InputGroup, TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import describedBy from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/describedBy.svelte";
</script>

<InputGroup warn warnText="This code ends tonight" let:describedBy let:warn>
  <TextInput
    labelText="Promo code"
    value="FLASH20"
    aria-describedby={describedBy}
    {warn}
  />
  <Button kind="tertiary">Apply</Button>
</InputGroup>
```

#### Disabled

Set `disabled` to `true` to disable every field and button in the group.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, InputGroup, TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<InputGroup disabled>
  <TextInput labelText="Promo code" placeholder="WELCOME10" />
  <Button kind="tertiary">Apply</Button>
</InputGroup>
```

---

### Component API

#### `InputGroup` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `legendText` | `string` | Specify the legend text that names a set of fields, such as an<br />amount and its currency. Leave it out for a single field beside a<br />button, and label the field itself. | `""` |
| `hideLegend` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the legend text.<br />The legend remains available to screen readers. | `false` |
| `helperText` | `string` | Specify the helper text, shown below the group | `""` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state.<br />Pass the `invalid` slot prop to the field it applies to. | `false` |
| `invalidText` | `string` | Specify the invalid state text, shown below the group | `""` |
| `warn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate a warning state | `false` |
| `warnText` | `string` | Specify the warning state text, shown below the group | `""` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable every field and button in the group | `false` |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| undefined` | Set the size of the fields in the group. Buttons in the group match<br />the field height. Defaults to the size of a parent `Form`.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"` (the 40px default) and `"lg"` (`"xl"`). | _undefined_ |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the group's label and messages | `uniqueId()` |

#### `InputGroup` slots

| Slot | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | `{<br />  describedBy: string \| undefined;<br />  invalid: boolean;<br />  warn: boolean;<br />  size:<br />    \| "xs"<br />    \| "sm"<br />    \| "md"<br />    \| "xl"<br />    \| undefined;<br />}` |
| `legendChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `InputGroup` $$restProps

`InputGroup` spreads `$$restProps` to the `fieldset` element.


## InterstitialScreen

### Basic

Build an interstitial screen from `InterstitialScreenHeader`, `InterstitialScreenBody`, `InterstitialScreenFooter`, and one or more `InterstitialScreenView` steps. With a single view, the footer shows only a "Get Started" button. Bind an element to `launcherButtonRef` to return focus to it once the screen closes.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    InterstitialScreen,
    InterstitialScreenBody,
    InterstitialScreenFooter,
    InterstitialScreenHeader,
    InterstitialScreenView,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let launcherButtonRef;
</script>

<Button bind:ref={launcherButtonRef} on:click={() => (open = true)}>
  Get started
</Button>

<InterstitialScreen bind:open {launcherButtonRef}>
  <InterstitialScreenHeader
    title="Welcome to Notebooks"
    subTitle="A quick tour before you dive in."
  />
  <InterstitialScreenBody>
    <InterstitialScreenView>
      <p>
        Notebooks let you combine code, visualizations, and narrative text in a
        single document. This tour covers the basics.
      </p>
    </InterstitialScreenView>
  </InterstitialScreenBody>
  <InterstitialScreenFooter />
</InterstitialScreen>
```

### Steps

Slot more than one `InterstitialScreenView` into `InterstitialScreenBody` to switch into a step-by-step, carousel-style flow.

#### Multiple steps

With more than one view, `InterstitialScreenHeader` shows a `ProgressIndicator` built from each view's `stepTitle`, and `InterstitialScreenFooter` shows Skip/Back/Next, switching to "Get Started" on the final step.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    InterstitialScreen,
    InterstitialScreenBody,
    InterstitialScreenFooter,
    InterstitialScreenHeader,
    InterstitialScreenView,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Start tour</Button>

<InterstitialScreen bind:open>
  <InterstitialScreenHeader title="Product tour" />
  <InterstitialScreenBody>
    <InterstitialScreenView stepTitle="Overview">
      <p>See what's new across the workspace.</p>
    </InterstitialScreenView>
    <InterstitialScreenView stepTitle="Collaborate">
      <p>Invite teammates and share your work in real time.</p>
    </InterstitialScreenView>
    <InterstitialScreenView stepTitle="Automate">
      <p>Set up pipelines that run on a schedule.</p>
    </InterstitialScreenView>
  </InterstitialScreenBody>
  <InterstitialScreenFooter />
</InterstitialScreen>
```

### Hosting

By default, `InterstitialScreen` renders as a modal, reusing `ComposedModal`/`ModalHeader`/`ModalBody`/`ModalFooter` directly (see [Basic](#basic) above).

#### Full screen

Set `isFullScreen` to render a full-screen takeover instead. `InterstitialScreenHeader`/`InterstitialScreenBody`/`InterstitialScreenFooter` render their own bare elements in this mode rather than delegating to `ModalHeader`/`ModalBody`/`ModalFooter`, and <kbd>Escape</kbd> is handled directly since there is no modal to own it.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    InterstitialScreen,
    InterstitialScreenBody,
    InterstitialScreenFooter,
    InterstitialScreenHeader,
    InterstitialScreenView,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open full screen</Button>

<InterstitialScreen bind:open isFullScreen>
  <InterstitialScreenHeader
    title="Set up your workspace"
    subTitle="This takes about two minutes."
  />
  <InterstitialScreenBody>
    <InterstitialScreenView stepTitle="Connect">
      <p>Link a data source to get started.</p>
    </InterstitialScreenView>
    <InterstitialScreenView stepTitle="Configure">
      <p>Choose how often your data refreshes.</p>
    </InterstitialScreenView>
  </InterstitialScreenBody>
  <InterstitialScreenFooter />
</InterstitialScreen>
```

#### Heading level

The title is an `h1` in a full-screen takeover, or one level below an enclosing `Section`'s heading, and an `h2` in a modal. Set `headingLevel` on `InterstitialScreenHeader` to fit a different page outline. The subtitle is text, not a heading.

### Actions

`InterstitialScreenFooter` dispatches a cancelable `action` event on every Skip/Back/Next/Get-Started press, before its default behavior (navigating a step, or closing the screen) runs.

#### Take over a button press

Call `event.preventDefault()` on the `action` event to block a button's default behavior, for example to require an acknowledgment before advancing.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    InterstitialScreen,
    InterstitialScreenBody,
    InterstitialScreenFooter,
    InterstitialScreenHeader,
    InterstitialScreenView,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let acknowledged = false;

  function handleAction(event) {
    if (event.detail.actionType === "next" && !acknowledged) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Start tour</Button>

<InterstitialScreen bind:open>
  <InterstitialScreenHeader title="Terms" />
  <InterstitialScreenBody>
    <InterstitialScreenView stepTitle="Review">
      <Checkbox labelText="I have read the terms" bind:checked={acknowledged} />
    </InterstitialScreenView>
    <InterstitialScreenView stepTitle="Confirm">
      <p>You're all set.</p>
    </InterstitialScreenView>
  </InterstitialScreenBody>
  <InterstitialScreenFooter on:action={handleAction} />
</InterstitialScreen>
```

#### Async loading state

Bind `loadingAction` to the action name you're handling to show that button's `InlineLoading` state and disable the rest of the footer while async work runs, then advance or close the screen yourself when it resolves.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    InterstitialScreen,
    InterstitialScreenBody,
    InterstitialScreenFooter,
    InterstitialScreenHeader,
    InterstitialScreenView,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
  let loadingAction = "";

  async function handleAction(event) {
    if (event.detail.actionType !== "start") return;
    event.preventDefault();
    loadingAction = "start";
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
    loadingAction = "";
    open = false;
  }
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Finish setup</Button>

<InterstitialScreen bind:open>
  <InterstitialScreenHeader title="Finish setup" />
  <InterstitialScreenBody>
    <InterstitialScreenView>
      <p>Get Started saves your preferences before closing.</p>
    </InterstitialScreenView>
  </InterstitialScreenBody>
  <InterstitialScreenFooter bind:loadingAction on:action={handleAction} />
</InterstitialScreen>
```

### Closing

`InterstitialScreen` dispatches a cancelable `close` event whenever the screen is about to close: from the header close button, <kbd>Escape</kbd>, or the footer's final Skip/Get-Started action (Back/Next never close).

#### Prevent default

Call `event.preventDefault()` on the `close` event to keep the screen open, for example behind a confirmation.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    InterstitialScreen,
    InterstitialScreenBody,
    InterstitialScreenFooter,
    InterstitialScreenHeader,
    InterstitialScreenView,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;

  function handleClose(event) {
    if (!confirm("Skip the tour?")) {
      event.preventDefault();
    }
  }
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Start tour</Button>

<InterstitialScreen bind:open on:close={handleClose}>
  <InterstitialScreenHeader title="Quick tour" />
  <InterstitialScreenBody>
    <InterstitialScreenView>
      <p>Press Escape, Skip, or Get Started to see the confirmation.</p>
    </InterstitialScreenView>
  </InterstitialScreenBody>
  <InterstitialScreenFooter />
</InterstitialScreen>
```

#### Returning focus to a launcher

Bind an element to `launcherButtonRef` to return focus to it once the screen closes, as in [Basic](#basic) above.

### Events

| Component                  | Event    | Payload          | Cancelable |
| -------------------------- | -------- | ---------------- | :--------: |
| `InterstitialScreen`       | `close`  | `{ actionType }` |    Yes     |
| `InterstitialScreenFooter` | `action` | `{ actionType }` |    Yes     |

`actionType` is one of `"close"`, `"start"`, `"skip"`, `"back"`, or `"next"` on `close`, and `"start"`, `"skip"`, `"back"`, or `"next"` on `action`.

---

### Component API

#### `InterstitialScreen` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the interstitial screen. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the top-level HTML element. | `null` |
| `isFullScreen` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render as a full-screen takeover instead of a modal-hosted dialog | `false` |
| `launcherButtonRef` | `HTMLElement \| undefined` | Element to return focus to when the screen closes.<br />Defaults to the element that had focus when the screen opened. | _undefined_ |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the top-level element | `"Interstitial screen"` |

#### `InterstitialScreen` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:close` | `{<br />  actionType:<br />    \| "close"<br />    \| "start"<br />    \| "skip"<br />    \| "back"<br />    \| "next";<br />}` | Dispatched when the screen is about to close, from the header close button, Escape, or the footer's final Skip/Get Started action. Cancelable: call `preventDefault()` to keep it open. |

#### `InterstitialScreen` $$restProps

`InterstitialScreen` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `InterstitialScreenHeader` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `subTitle` | `string` | Specify the header subtitle | `""` |

| `hideProgressIndicator` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the step progress indicator (only relevant when there is more than one `InterstitialScreenView`) | `false` |

| `stepLabelText` | `(step: number) => string` | Specify the progress label of a step whose view sets no `stepTitle`. | `(step) => `Step ${step}`` |

| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `InterstitialScreenBody` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

#### `InterstitialScreenBody` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |

#### `InterstitialScreenFooter` props
