### Component API

#### `ProgressIndicator` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `currentIndex` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the current step index.<br />Ignored when `selectedId` is set. | `0` |
| `selectedId` (Reactive) | `string \| undefined` | Specify the current step by id.<br />When set, takes precedence over `currentIndex` and stays on the same<br />logical step as steps are added or removed. Pair with a stable `id` on<br />each `ProgressStep`. | _undefined_ |
| `vertical` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the vertical variant | `false` |
| `spaceEqually` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to specify whether the progress steps should be split equally in size in the div | `false` |
| `preventChangeOnClick` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to prevent `currentIndex` from updating | `false` |
| `statusText` | `(status: "complete" \| "invalid") => string` | Specify the assistive text appended to a complete or invalid step's name. | `(status) => status` |

#### `ProgressIndicator` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ProgressIndicator` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ProgressIndicator` dispatched events

| Event       | Detail   |
| ----------- | -------- |
| `on:change` | `number` |

#### `ProgressIndicator` $$restProps

`ProgressIndicator` spreads `$$restProps` to the `ul` element.

#### `ProgressStep` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `current` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the current variant. | `false` |
| `complete` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for the complete variant | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the progress step | `false` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state | `false` |
| `description` | `string` | Specify the step description | `""` |
| `label` | `string` | Specify the step label | `""` |
| `secondaryLabel` | `string` | Specify the step secondary label | `""` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the top-level element | `uniqueId()` |

#### `ProgressStep` slots

| Slot | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | `{<br />  props: {<br />    class: "bx--progress-label";<br />  };<br />}` |
| `icon` | `{<br />  complete: boolean;<br />  current: boolean;<br />  invalid: boolean;<br />  description: string;<br />}` |

#### `ProgressStep` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:keydown`    |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ProgressStep` $$restProps

`ProgressStep` spreads `$$restProps` to the `li` element.

#### `ProgressIndicatorSkeleton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vertical` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the vertical variant | `false` |
| `spaceEqually` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to specify whether the progress steps should be split equally in size in the div | `false` |
| `count` | `number` | Specify the number of steps to render | `4` |

#### `ProgressIndicatorSkeleton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ProgressIndicatorSkeleton` $$restProps

`ProgressIndicatorSkeleton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `ul` element.


## Prose

### Basic

Wrap plain HTML in `Prose` to set it as running copy: paragraphs, headings, lists, links, inline `code`, code blocks, quotes, tables, rules, and figures. Each element gets a Carbon type style, the space between elements follows one rhythm, and lines stop at a readable length.

Carbon v11 has no Prose component. The type styles come from Carbon's productive and expressive sets, as its typography guidance pairs them: productive for product pages and docs, expressive for editorial pages.

Prose's styles ship in their own stylesheet. Load it after the theme stylesheet:

| Stylesheet              | Pair with     |
| :---------------------- | :------------ |
| `css/prose.css`         | `all.css`     |
| `css/prose-<theme>.css` | `<theme>.css` |

```js
import "carbon-components-svelte/css/all.css";
import "carbon-components-svelte/css/prose.css";
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <h3>Reporting API</h3>
  <p>
    The reporting API returns usage and billing data for every project in your
    organization, so finance and engineering read the same numbers. Send
    requests with an <code>Authorization</code> header, as described in the
    <a href="#basic">setup guide</a>.
  </p>
  <h4>Limits</h4>
  <p>Requests are limited per key:</p>
  <ul>
    <li>600 requests per minute, shared by every endpoint.</li>
    <li>
      13 months of history. <strong>Export</strong> anything you need to keep
      longer.
      <ul>
        <li>The export endpoint writes one file per day.</li>
      </ul>
    </li>
  </ul>
  <pre><code
      >curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  https://api.example.com/v1/usage</code
    ></pre>
  <blockquote>
    <p>
      Choose the region when you create the project. It can't be changed later.
    </p>
  </blockquote>
  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr><th>Status</th><th>Meaning</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><code>200</code></td><td>Success</td></tr>
      <tr
        ><td><code>429</code></td><td
          >Rate limited. Retry after the number of seconds in <kbd
            >Retry-After</kbd
          >.</td
        ></tr
      >
    </tbody>
  </table>
  <hr />
  <p>
    Responses are JSON, paginated at 100 records, with a cursor for the next
    page.
  </p>
</Prose>
```

### Variants

Set `variant` to match the page the copy sits on. Each variant sets the body and heading type styles, the spacing between elements, and the line length. Space above a heading grows with its level, so a heading sits closer to what it introduces than to what came before it. No heading is smaller than the body copy: `h5` and `h6` take its size in semibold. Tables, code blocks and figures get as much room above and below as a component.

| Variant | Body | Headings | Line length | Use for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `condensed` | body-compact-01 (14px), shorter line height | Smaller productive and heading-01 | 80 characters | Side panels and inspectors, where every line counts |
| `default` | body-02 (16px) | Productive | 68 characters | Documentation, help, and other reading pages |
| `compact` | body-01 (14px) | Smaller productive, tighter spacing | 80 characters | Descriptions and help inside dense product UI, such as a side panel or modal |
| `spacious` | body-02 (16px) | Productive, one step larger, more room | 64 characters | Onboarding, getting-started guides, and other pages read once and slowly |
| `expressive` | body-02 (16px) | Expressive, scaling with the viewport | 60 characters | Editorial and marketing pages |

#### Condensed

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose variant="condensed">
  <h3>Pod checkout-7f9c</h3>
  <p>
    Restarted 3 times in the last hour after failing its readiness probe. Memory
    peaked at 94% of its limit before each restart.
  </p>
  <h4>Events</h4>
  <ul>
    <li>OOMKilled at 14:02, 14:19, and 14:41</li>
    <li>Scaled from 4 to 6 replicas at 14:45</li>
  </ul>
</Prose>
```

#### Compact

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose variant="compact">
  <h3>Retention policy</h3>
  <p>
    Logs are kept for 30 days, then deleted. Audit events are kept for a year
    and can't be deleted early.
  </p>
  <h4>Exceptions</h4>
  <ul>
    <li>Projects on a legal hold keep every log until the hold is lifted.</li>
    <li>Deleted projects lose their logs after 7 days.</li>
  </ul>
</Prose>
```

#### Spacious

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose variant="spacious">
  <h3>Welcome to the console</h3>
  <p>
    Create a project to get an API key, then send your first request. It takes
    about five minutes.
  </p>
  <h4>Before you start</h4>
  <p>You need an organization admin to approve billing.</p>
</Prose>
```

#### Expressive

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose variant="expressive">
  <h3>Designing for the people who use it most</h3>
  <p>
    We spent a month watching support agents work through their queues. Most of
    their time went to finding the customer's history, not answering the
    question.
  </p>
  <blockquote>
    <p>
      I know the answer in ten seconds. Finding the account takes two minutes.
    </p>
  </blockquote>
  <p>So the new console opens on the customer, not the ticket.</p>
</Prose>
```

### Max width

Each variant caps the line length so long lines stay easy to follow. Set `maxWidth` to a number of pixels or any CSS length to change it, or `"none"` to fill the container, for example in a narrow column that already limits the width.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose maxWidth="none">
  <p>
    This paragraph fills the whole column. It's set with the default variant's
    type and spacing, but without the 68-character line length, so it runs as
    wide as the space it's placed in.
  </p>
</Prose>
```

### Links

Links look like an inline `Link`: in the link color, underlined, and with the focus ring while pressed or focused. Heading anchors match them. Set `linkTone="muted"` for copy dense with links, such as reference docs: links take the text color, still underlined, and anchors the secondary text color, and both turn link blue on hover. Links have no visited color, like `Link` by default, and `Link`'s color properties, such as `--cds-link-text-color`, recolor them too.

#### Default

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <h4 id="prose-links-default">
    Setup <a
      class="bx--prose__heading-anchor"
      href="#prose-links-default"
      aria-label="Link to Setup">#</a
    >
  </h4>
  <p>
    Read the <a href="#links">setup guide</a>, then the
    <a href="#links">API reference</a>.
  </p>
</Prose>
```

#### Muted

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose linkTone="muted">
  <h4 id="prose-links-muted">
    Setup <a
      class="bx--prose__heading-anchor"
      href="#prose-links-muted"
      aria-label="Link to Setup">#</a
    >
  </h4>
  <p>
    Read the <a href="#links">setup guide</a>, then the
    <a href="#links">API reference</a>.
  </p>
</Prose>
```

### Keyboard keys

Keys look like flat keycaps by default. Set `kbd="muted"` for the shortcut style `Menu` uses, with no box, for dense copy and long key sequences. Either way, keys never change the space between lines.

#### Keycap

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <p>
    Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>P</kbd> to open the palette,
    then <kbd>Enter</kbd> to run the highlighted command.
  </p>
</Prose>
```

#### Muted

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose kbd="muted">
  <p>
    Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>P</kbd> to open the palette,
    then <kbd>Enter</kbd> to run the highlighted command.
  </p>
</Prose>
```

### Tables

The first and last columns line up with the copy. By default, `tableWidth="fit"` packs columns at their content width with a gap between them, so a short table reads with the copy around it. Set `tableWidth="full"` for wide or data-heavy tables: the table spans the line length with padded cells.

#### Fit

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr><th>Setting</th><th>Default</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><code>timeout</code></td><td>30 seconds</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>retries</code></td><td>3</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</Prose>
```

#### Full

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose tableWidth="full">
  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr><th>Setting</th><th>Default</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><code>timeout</code></td><td>30 seconds</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code>retries</code></td><td>3</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</Prose>
```

### Section dividers

Set `dividers` to draw a rule above each `h2`, so each section reads as one group even when examples interrupt the copy. An `h2` that opens the Prose gets no rule.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose dividers>
  <h2>Install</h2>
  <p>Add the package with your package manager.</p>
  <h2>Configure</h2>
  <p>Import the styles once, in your app's entry point.</p>
</Prose>
```

### Flow container

A page that alternates copy with live examples, such as a Markdown page rendered with one Prose per run of copy, needs space between those runs. Wrap them in an element with the `bx--prose-flow` class: siblings get the flow gap, copy after an example gets more room, and a run that opens with a heading takes that heading's space above it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { CodeSnippet, Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<div class="bx--prose-flow">
  <Prose><p>Add the package with your package manager:</p></Prose>
  <CodeSnippet code="npm i carbon-components-svelte" />
  <Prose><p>Then import the styles once, in your app's entry point.</p></Prose>
  <Prose
    ><h3>Themes</h3>
    <p>Every theme ships in the same stylesheet.</p></Prose
  >
</div>
```

### Carbon components inside

Prose doesn't style Carbon components or anything inside them, so components keep their own styles: a `Link` keeps its color, a `CodeSnippet` its background and padding, and `Text` its type style. That includes plain elements you pass into a component's slot, such as the link in this notification. Components still take part in the spacing between elements: copy after a block component, such as a `CodeSnippet`, gets more room. Copy after an inline one, such as a `Link`, gets the usual gap, and so does copy after `Text` in any tag: it counts as copy.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    CodeSnippet,
    InlineNotification,
    Link,
    Prose,
    Text,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <h3>Install</h3>
  <p>Add the package with your package manager:</p>
  <CodeSnippet code="npm i carbon-components-svelte" />
  <InlineNotification lowContrast hideCloseButton kind="info" title="Styles">
    <svelte:fragment slot="subtitleChildren"
      >Import the CSS once, as the <a href="#carbon-components-inside"
        >setup guide</a
      > shows.</svelte:fragment
    >
  </InlineNotification>
  <Text type="helper-text-01">Text keeps its own type style inside Prose.</Text>
  <p>
    Read the <Link href="#carbon-components-inside">theming guide</Link> next.
  </p>
</Prose>
```

### Rendered HTML

Prose styles markup it didn't render, such as HTML from a Markdown renderer or a CMS, set with `{@html}`. Only render HTML you trust or have sanitized.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  // HTML from a Markdown renderer or a CMS. Only render HTML you trust or
  // have sanitized.
  const html = `<h3>Release notes</h3>
<p>This release adds <strong>scheduled exports</strong> and fixes two bugs in the usage chart.</p>
<ul>
  <li>Exports run daily or weekly and land in your storage bucket.</li>
  <li>The chart no longer drops the last day of the month.</li>
</ul>
<p>See the <a href="#rendered-html">export guide</a> to set one up.</p>`;
</script>

<Prose>{@html html}</Prose>
```

### Wrapped sections

Children of a `section` or `article` inside Prose are spaced the same way as children of Prose itself, so you can wrap each section, for example to give it an `id` for a [TableOfContents](/components/TableOfContents).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <section>
    <h3>Profile</h3>
    <p>
      Your name, photo, and email address appear wherever teammates mention or
      assign you.
    </p>
  </section>
  <section>
    <h3>Security</h3>
    <p>
      Change your password, turn on two-factor authentication, and review the
      devices signed in to your account.
    </p>
  </section>
</Prose>
```

### Nested

A Prose inside another sets its own copy: each element takes its type from the nearest Prose, so a compact block inside a default page reads at 14px, and its lists keep their bullets. It has its own variant's gap above and below it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <p>
    Requests are limited per key. When you hit the limit, the API returns status
    429 with a header that says how long to wait.
  </p>
  <Prose variant="compact">
    <p>Compact Prose nested in the page's Prose, for a note or a sidebar:</p>
    <ul>
      <li>Retry after the number of seconds in the header.</li>
      <li>Batch requests to stay under the limit.</li>
    </ul>
  </Prose>
  <p>Limits reset every minute.</p>
</Prose>
```

### Markdown output

Prose styles what Markdown renderers produce for GitHub-flavored Markdown, so rendered pages need no components.

#### Aligned table columns

Cells keep the alignment renderers set with the `align` attribute for `:---:` and `---:` columns.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <table>
    <thead>
      <tr
        ><th>Region</th><th align="center">Status</th><th align="right"
          >Requests</th
        ></tr
      >
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr
        ><td>us-east</td><td align="center">OK</td><td align="right"
          >6,204,118</td
        ></tr
      >
      <tr
        ><td>ap-south</td><td align="center">Degraded</td><td align="right"
          >2,109,872</td
        ></tr
      >
    </tbody>
  </table>
</Prose>
```

#### Heading anchors

Add an `a` with the `bx--prose__heading-anchor` class inside a heading to link to it. On devices that hover, it stays hidden until the heading is hovered or the link is focused. Give it an `aria-label` that names the section, such as "Link to Setup", since screen readers would otherwise read "#".

Elements with an `id` inside Prose take `scroll-margin-top` from the `--ccs-prose-scroll-margin` custom property. Set it to a sticky header's height so links to a heading land below the header.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <h4 id="prose-anchor-setup">
    Setup <a
      class="bx--prose__heading-anchor"
      href="#prose-anchor-setup"
      aria-label="Link to Setup">#</a
    >
  </h4>
  <p>Create a project in the console, then generate an API key.</p>
</Prose>
```

#### Alerts

GitHub alerts (`> [!NOTE]`) render as a `blockquote` with `data-alert` set to `note`, `tip`, `important`, `warning`, or `caution`. They take InlineNotification's colors without its JavaScript. Code in an alert, inline or in a block, sits one layer up, so it stands out from the alert's surface. In dark themes, alerts take the layer's color and step up on a [Layer](/components/Layer) as other surfaces do. Set `data-alert-title` to show a title, in the reader's language.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <blockquote data-alert="note" data-alert-title="Note">
    <p>Keys are scoped to one project.</p>
  </blockquote>
  <blockquote data-alert="tip" data-alert-title="Tip">
    <p>Use one key per environment:</p>
    <pre><code>npm run deploy -- --env staging</code></pre>
  </blockquote>
  <blockquote data-alert="important" data-alert-title="Important">
    <p>Regions can't be changed after you create a project.</p>
  </blockquote>
  <blockquote data-alert="warning" data-alert-title="Warning">
    <p>Requests over the limit return <code>429</code>.</p>
  </blockquote>
  <blockquote data-alert="caution" data-alert-title="Caution">
    <p>Revoking a key breaks every client that uses it.</p>
  </blockquote>
</Prose>
```

#### Task lists

Items with the `task-list-item` class, as GitHub and remark-gfm render task lists, show their checkbox in place of the bullet. Wrap each checkbox and its text in a `label`, so the checkbox has an accessible name.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose>
  <ul class="contains-task-list">
    <li class="task-list-item">
      <label
        ><input type="checkbox" disabled checked /> Create the project</label
      >
    </li>
    <li class="task-list-item">
      <label><input type="checkbox" disabled /> Generate an API key</label>
    </li>
  </ul>
</Prose>
```

#### Highlighted code

Prose sets the padding, type, and surface of `pre`. For token colors, render `highlight` from `carbon-components-svelte/syntax` inside it, and load `syntax-tokens.css` and `syntax.css` as for [CodeSnippet](/components/CodeSnippet#syntax-highlighting). The colors are Carbon's syntax tokens, so code follows the theme.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { highlight } from "carbon-components-svelte/syntax";

  const code = `const response = await fetch("/v1/usage", {
  headers: { Authorization: \`Bearer \${key}\` },
});
// Usage is paginated at 100 records.
const { data, next } = await response.json();`;
</script>

<Prose>
  <p>Read the usage for the current key:</p>
  <pre><code>{@html highlight(code, "js")}</code></pre>
</Prose>
```

Other highlighters work too: color their tokens with the `--cds-syntax-*` properties from `syntax-tokens.css`. For Shiki's CSS variables theme:

```css
.bx--prose {
  --shiki-foreground: var(--cds-text-primary);
  --shiki-background: var(--cds-layer);
  --shiki-token-comment: var(--cds-syntax-comment);
  --shiki-token-keyword: var(--cds-syntax-keyword);
  --shiki-token-string: var(--cds-syntax-string);
  --shiki-token-constant: var(--cds-syntax-number);
  --shiki-token-function: var(--cds-syntax-function);
  --shiki-token-punctuation: var(--cds-syntax-punctuation);
}
```

### Offscreen code blocks

Set `deferOffscreen` on a page with many code blocks or figures. The browser then skips laying out and painting each `pre` and `figure` until it nears the viewport, with CSS `content-visibility: auto`. A code block reserves the height of its lines until it first renders, so the page doesn't move as blocks above the reader render; a figure reserves 10rem. Each then keeps its last rendered height. On a page of 60 highlighted code blocks of 20 lines each, rendering the copy took about 47 ms in Chromium, and 10 ms with `deferOffscreen`.

Skipped blocks stay in find in page, anchor navigation, and the accessibility tree. Text alone is cheap to lay out, so a page without much code gains little. Tables aren't skipped: the containment that skipping needs clips anything that overflows.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Prose } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Prose deferOffscreen>
  <p>Run the build, then serve the output:</p>
  <pre><code
      >npm run build
npx vite preview</code
    ></pre>
</Prose>
```

### Usage

| Do | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Write plain elements (`p`, `h2`, `ul`, `a`) inside Prose, not `Text` for each one. | Prose styles plain markup. `Text` and other Carbon components keep their own type styles, so they don't match the copy around them. |
| Use Prose for copy you didn't lay out element by element: rendered Markdown, CMS content, or long help text. | That's where styling each element with a component isn't possible or isn't worth it. For a few lines in a layout, `Text` gives finer control. |
| Use `compact` inside product UI and `default` on pages people read from top to bottom. | Product UI is set at 14px, so 16px copy inside a panel looks out of scale. |
| Set `maxWidth="none"` when the container already limits the width. | The line length cap would otherwise leave a gap beside the copy in a wide container. |
| Use `linkTone="muted"` and `kbd="muted"` where links and keys are dense, such as reference docs and shortcut lists. | Link-colored or boxed runs every few words pull the eye away from the copy. |
| Keep `tableWidth="fit"` for short tables, and use `"full"` for wide ones. | A two-column table stretched across the measure puts its columns far apart. |
| Set `--ccs-prose-scroll-margin` to a sticky header's height. | Links to headings and sections land below the header instead of under it. |
| Restyle an element with one class and its element, such as `p.lead`. | Prose's element rules weigh one class and one element, so a class alone ties or loses. |
| Put a Prose directly inside another Prose, or in a plain wrapper, rather than inside a Carbon component that sits in Prose. | Prose skips everything inside a Carbon component within it, and it can't tell a component's content from a Prose nested there, so Prose inside a Tile, Accordion, or Modal inside Prose renders unstyled. Telling them apart needs CSS `@scope`, which is newer than the browsers Carbon supports. |

---

### Component API

#### `Prose` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLElement` | Obtain a reference to the HTML element. | `null` |
| `variant` | `"condensed" \| "compact" \| "default" \| "spacious" \| "expressive"` | Set the type scale and spacing for the copy inside.<br />- `"default"`: 16px body copy and productive headings, for reading pages<br />- `"condensed"`: 14px body copy with a shorter line height and tighter<br /> spacing than compact, for side panels and inspectors<br />- `"compact"`: 14px body copy and tighter spacing, for dense product UI<br />- `"spacious"`: 16px body copy with larger headings and more room<br />- `"expressive"`: expressive headings that scale with the viewport and<br /> wider spacing, for editorial and marketing pages | `"default"` |
| `linkTone` | `"default" \| "muted"` | Set the link color.<br />- `"default"`: links and heading anchors in the link color<br />- `"muted"`: links in the text color, underlined, and heading anchors in<br /> the secondary text color; both take the link color on hover. For copy<br /> dense with links, such as reference docs.<br /><br />Links have no visited color, like `Link` by default. | `"default"` |
| `tableWidth` | `"fit" \| "full"` | Set how tables size. Either way, the first and last columns line up<br />with the copy.<br />- `"fit"`: columns at their content width with a gap between them, so<br /> a short table reads with the copy around it<br />- `"full"`: the table spans the line length with padded cells, for wide<br /> or data-heavy tables | `"fit"` |
| `kbd` | `"keycap" \| "muted"` | Set how `kbd` keys look. Either way, keys never change line spacing.<br />- `"keycap"`: a flat key with a heavier bottom edge<br />- `"muted"`: no box, semibold text in the secondary color, the way<br /> `Menu` shows shortcuts; for dense copy and long key sequences | `"keycap"` |
| `dividers` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to draw a rule above each `h2` but a first one, to set<br />sections apart | `false` |
| `maxWidth` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Override the max width. Each variant caps the line length: 80 characters<br />(condensed and compact), 68 (default), 64 (spacious), or 60<br />(expressive). Numbers are treated as pixels; strings accept any CSS<br />length, or `"none"` to fill the container. | _undefined_ |
| `deferOffscreen` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to skip rendering code blocks (`pre`) and figures while<br />they are offscreen, with `content-visibility: auto`. They stay in find<br />in page, anchor navigation, and the accessibility tree. A code block<br />reserves the height of its lines until it first renders, then its last<br />rendered height; a figure, and a code block in server-rendered HTML<br />before the script runs, reserves 10rem. | `false` |
| `tag` | `keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap` | Specify the tag name. | `"div"` |

#### `Prose` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Prose` $$restProps

`Prose` spreads `$$restProps` to the `any` element.


## RadioButton

### Basic

Create a group of radio buttons with a shared name and legend.

See [Standalone usage](#standalone-usage) for individual usage or [Implicit grouping](#implicit-grouping) to group multiple standalone radio buttons by name without using a radio button group.

If `name` is omitted, `RadioButtonGroup` generates and shares one internally, so grouped keyboard navigation still works. That generated name is random per component instance, so set `name` explicitly when the group is part of a submitted form.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

### Standalone usage

Use a radio button individually with bindable checked state for simple use cases.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, RadioButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let acknowledged = false;
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Stack align="start">
    <RadioButton
      bind:checked={acknowledged}
      labelText="I acknowledge this will restart the production service"
      name="maintenance-ack"
      value="acknowledged"
    />
  </Stack>
  <div>
    <Button
      size="small"
      kind="secondary"
      disabled={!acknowledged}
      on:click={() => (acknowledged = !acknowledged)}
    >
      Reset
    </Button>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

Set `readonly` to `true` on a standalone radio button to display a non-editable value. It merges with a parent `RadioButtonGroup`'s own `readonly` the same way `Checkbox` merges its own `readonly` with a group's.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack align="start">
  <RadioButton
    labelText="Production deployment window approved"
    checked
    readonly
  />
</Stack>
```

### Implicit grouping

Multiple standalone radio buttons sharing the same name automatically form a group and synchronize their checked state -- no radio button group component required.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const options = [
    { value: "immediately", label: "Immediately" },
    { value: "daily", label: "Daily digest" },
    { value: "weekly", label: "Weekly digest" },
  ];

  const checked = options.map(() => false);

  $: selected = options.find((_, i) => checked[i]);
</script>

<Stack gap={3}>
  <Stack orientation="horizontal">
    {#each options as option, i}
      <RadioButton
        bind:checked={checked[i]}
        value={option.value}
        labelText={option.label}
        name="implicit-group"
      />
    {/each}
  </Stack>

  <span>
    Selected:
    <strong>{selected?.label ?? "None"}</strong>
  </span>
</Stack>
```

### Reactive

Bind and update the selected value programmatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    RadioButton,
    RadioButtonGroup,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const plans = ["Free (1 GB)", "Standard (10 GB)", "Pro (128 GB)"];

  let plan = plans[1];
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <RadioButtonGroup
    legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
    name="plan"
    bind:selected={plan}
  >
    {#each plans as value (value)}
      <RadioButton labelText={value} {value} />
    {/each}
  </RadioButtonGroup>
  <Stack gap={4}>
    <div>
      {#each plans as value (value)}
        <Button
          size="small"
          kind="secondary"
          disabled={plan === value}
          on:click={() => (plan = value)}
        >
          Select "{value}"
        </Button>
      {/each}
    </div>
    <div>
      Selected plan:
      <strong>{plan}</strong>
    </div>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

### Labels and legend

Control the visibility and content of individual radio button labels and the group legend.

#### Hidden legend

Hide the legend visually by setting `hideLegend` to `true`. The legend remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  hideLegend
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan-legend"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

#### Hidden label

Hide an individual radio button's label text by setting `hideLabel` to `true` on `RadioButton`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButton labelText="Enable two-factor authentication" hideLabel />
```

#### Custom label

Use the `legendChildren` slot to provide custom legend content instead of `legendText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    RadioButton,
    RadioButtonGroup,
    Stack,
    Tooltip,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup name="plan-legend-slot" selected="standard">
  <Stack slot="legendChildren" orientation="horizontal">
    Storage tier (disk)
    <Tooltip>
      <p>Storage tiers may vary based on geolocation.</p>
    </Tooltip>
  </Stack>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

### Layout

Control the position and orientation of radio buttons within a group.

#### Left-aligned label

Position labels to the left of the radio buttons.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  labelPosition="left"
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan-left-aligned"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

#### Vertical

Display radio buttons in a vertical layout.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  orientation="vertical"
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan-vertical"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

### AI label

Put an `AILabel` in the `decorator` slot to mark the option as AI-generated. On a `RadioButtonGroup`, the label follows the legend.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    AILabel,
    RadioButton,
    RadioButtonGroup,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup legendText="Billing cycle" selected="annual">
  <AILabel slot="decorator">
    <p>Suggested because annual billing lowers your cost by 15%.</p>
  </AILabel>
  <RadioButton labelText="Monthly" value="monthly" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Annual" value="annual" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

### Helper text

Use `helperText` to provide additional context below the radio button group.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  legendText="Notification preferences"
  name="plan-helper"
  selected="email"
  helperText="You can change this setting at any time"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Email" value="email" />
  <RadioButton labelText="SMS" value="sms" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Push notifications" value="push" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

### States

Reflect interaction states.

#### Disabled buttons

Disable specific radio buttons to prevent selection.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  labelPosition="left"
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan-disabled"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioButton disabled labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton disabled labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

#### Disabled group

Disable all radio buttons in the group with `disabled` on RadioButtonGroup. Their labels are also visually muted.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  disabled
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan-disabled-group"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

#### Read-only

Display non-editable values with `readonly` on RadioButtonGroup.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  readonly
  labelPosition="left"
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan-readonly"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

#### Invalid

Set `invalid` to `true` and provide `invalidText` to show a validation error for the group. `aria-invalid` goes on the radiogroup, and each radio's `aria-describedby` points at the error message.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  invalid
  invalidText="Select a storage tier"
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan-invalid"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

#### Warning

Set `warn` to `true` and provide `warnText` to show a warning message for the group. `invalid` takes precedence over `warn` when both are set.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  warn
  warnText="Pro tier billing starts immediately"
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan-warn"
  selected="pro"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

#### Deselecting

Radio buttons normally keep one option selected once a choice is made. Set `allowDeselect` on RadioButtonGroup to opt out of that: clicking the already-selected radio clears the selection instead of leaving it selected.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioButton, RadioButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup
  allowDeselect
  legendText="Storage tier (disk)"
  name="plan-deselect"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioButton labelText="Free (1 GB)" value="free" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Standard (10 GB)" value="standard" />
  <RadioButton labelText="Pro (128 GB)" value="pro" />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

### Skeleton

Show a loading state for horizontal radio buttons.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    RadioButtonGroup,
    RadioButtonSkeleton,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup legendText="Storage tier (disk)">
  <RadioButtonSkeleton />
  <RadioButtonSkeleton />
  <RadioButtonSkeleton />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

Show a loading state for vertical radio buttons.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    RadioButtonGroup,
    RadioButtonSkeleton,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<RadioButtonGroup orientation="vertical" legendText="Storage tier (disk)">
  <RadioButtonSkeleton />
  <RadioButtonSkeleton />
  <RadioButtonSkeleton />
</RadioButtonGroup>
```

### Component API

#### `RadioButtonGroup` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` (Reactive) | `Value \| undefined` | Set the selected radio button value.<br />Follows the field after a reset -- becomes the value of whichever radio<br />is checked in the DOM, or `undefined`. | _undefined_ |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the radio buttons | `false` |
| `required` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to require the selection of a radio button. | _undefined_ |
| `name` | `string \| undefined` | Specify a name attribute for the radio button inputs.<br />Overrides each button's own `name`. When neither is set, the buttons<br />share a generated id so they form one radio group; set a name<br />explicitly when form submission matters. | _undefined_ |
| `form` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the id of a form element outside the component to associate<br />the fieldset and radio button inputs with. Overrides each button's own `form`. | _undefined_ |
| `legendText` | `string` | Specify the legend text.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "legendChildren". | `""` |
| `hideLegend` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the legend | `false` |
| `helperText` | `string` | Specify the helper text | `""` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state | `false` |
| `invalidText` | `string` | Specify the invalid state text | `""` |
| `warn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate a warning state | `false` |
| `warnText` | `string` | Specify the warning state text | `""` |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the read-only variant | `false` |
| `readonlyText` | `string` | Specify the assistive text announced to screen readers when read-only.<br />Exposed because VoiceOver does not announce `aria-readonly`. | `"Read-only"` |
| `allowDeselect` | `boolean` | Set to `true` so clicking an already-selected radio clears the selection<br />instead of leaving it selected. | `false` |
| `labelPosition` | `"right" \| "left"` | Specify the label position. | `"right"` |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | Specify the orientation of the radio buttons. | `"horizontal"` |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | Set an id for the container div element. | _undefined_ |

#### `RadioButtonGroup` slots

| Slot             | Detail                  |
| ---------------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`        | `Record<string, never>` |
| `decorator`      | `Record<string, never>` |
| `legendChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

| `on:mouseleave` |

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

#### `RadioButtonGroup` $$restProps

`RadioButtonGroup` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `RadioButton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to check the radio button.<br />Follows the radio button when the owning form resets. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLInputElement` | Obtain a reference to the input HTML element. | `null` |
| `value` | `Value` | Specify the value of the radio button. | `""` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the radio button | `false` |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for the radio button to be read-only | `false` |
| `readonlyText` | `string` | Specify the assistive text announced to screen readers when read-only.<br />Exposed because VoiceOver does not announce `aria-readonly`, and ARIA<br />does not support `aria-readonly` on role "radio" at all. | `"Read-only"` |
| `required` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to mark the field as required | `false` |
| `labelPosition` | `"right" \| "left"` | Specify the label position. | `"right"` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text | `false` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the input element | `uniqueId()` |
| `name` | `string \| undefined` | Specify a name attribute for the radio button input.<br />When multiple standalone RadioButton components share the same `name`,<br />they form an implicit group and their `checked` state will be synchronized. | _undefined_ |
| `form` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the id of a form element outside the component to associate<br />the radio input with. | _undefined_ |

#### `RadioButton` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `decorator`     | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `RadioButton` forwarded events

| Event       |
| ----------- |
| `on:blur`   |
| `on:change` |
| `on:focus`  |

#### `RadioButton` $$restProps

`RadioButton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `RadioButtonSkeleton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `RadioButtonSkeleton` $$restProps

`RadioButtonSkeleton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## RadioTile

### Basic

Create a group of radio tiles with a shared name and legend. Tab moves focus to the selected tile; <kbd>Up</kbd> and <kbd>Down</kbd> (or <kbd>Left</kbd> and <kbd>Right</kbd>) move the selection between tiles, and <kbd>Space</kbd> or <kbd>Enter</kbd> selects the focused tile. <kbd>Enter</kbd> does not submit the surrounding form.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup legendText="Service pricing tiers" name="plan" selected="standard">
  <RadioTile value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

### Standalone

Use `RadioTile` without `TileGroup` and bind each tile's `checked`. Tiles that share a `name` form one radio group, so checking one unchecks the others, including after a form reset.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const cycles = [
    { value: "monthly", label: "Monthly billing" },
    { value: "annual", label: "Annual billing (2 months free)" },
  ];

  // One `checked` per tile; tiles sharing a `name` uncheck each other.
  const checked = [true, false];

  $: selected = cycles.find((_, i) => checked[i]);
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Stack gap={3}>
    {#each cycles as cycle, i}
      <RadioTile
        name="billing-cycle"
        value={cycle.value}
        bind:checked={checked[i]}
      >
        {cycle.label}
      </RadioTile>
    {/each}
  </Stack>
  <div>Selected: <strong>{selected?.label ?? "None"}</strong></div>
</Stack>
```

### Reactive

#### One-way binding

Update the selected value using the `select` event.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const values = ["Lite plan", "Standard plan", "Plus plan"];

  let selected = values[1];
</script>

<TileGroup
  legendText="Service pricing tiers"
  name="plan"
  on:select={({ detail }) => (selected = detail)}
>
  {#each values as value}
    <RadioTile {value} checked={selected === value}>{value}</RadioTile>
  {/each}
</TileGroup>

<br />
Selected: <strong>{selected}</strong>
```

#### Two-way binding

Bind to `selected` for simpler state management. `selected` follows the tiles: it becomes `undefined` when the checked tile is removed, and follows a checked tile whose `value` changes.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    RadioTile,
    Stack,
    TileGroup,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const values = ["Lite plan", "Standard plan", "Plus plan"];

  let selected = values[1];
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <TileGroup legendText="Service pricing tiers" name="plan" bind:selected>
    {#each values as value}
      <RadioTile {value}>{value}</RadioTile>
    {/each}
  </TileGroup>
  <div>Selected: <strong>{selected}</strong></div>
  <Button
    size="small"
    disabled={selected === values[1]}
    on:click={() => (selected = values[1])}
  >
    Set to "{values[1]}"
  </Button>
</Stack>
```

### Legend

#### Custom content

Use the `legendChildren` slot on `TileGroup` to provide custom legend content instead of `legendText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup name="plan-legend-slot" selected="standard">
  <strong slot="legendChildren">Service pricing tiers</strong>
  <RadioTile value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

#### Hidden

Hide the legend visually by setting `hideLegend` to `true`. The legend remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup
  hideLegend
  legendText="Service pricing tiers"
  name="plan-hidden-legend"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioTile value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

### AI label

Put an `AILabel` in the `decorator` slot to mark the tile's content as AI-generated. The tile shows the AI surface, and the label sits in the top-right corner at the `"xs"` size.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AILabel, RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup legendText="Recommended region">
  <RadioTile value="us-east-1" checked>
    US East (N. Virginia)
    <AILabel slot="decorator">
      <p>Closest to most of your users, by request latency.</p>
    </AILabel>
  </RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="eu-west-1">EU West (Ireland)</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

#### Rounded corners

Set `rounded` to `true` to round the corners of a tile with a decorator. Carbon reserves rounded tiles for AI content, so a tile without a decorator stays square.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AILabel, RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup legendText="Recommended region" name="rounded-region">
  <RadioTile value="us-east-1" checked rounded>
    US East (N. Virginia)
    <AILabel slot="decorator">
      <p>Closest to most of your users, by request latency.</p>
    </AILabel>
  </RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="eu-west-1">EU West (Ireland)</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

### Small size

Set `size="sm"` on the TileGroup for compact tiles, such as rows in a list of choices: less padding, no minimum height, and the checkmark pulled in. A tile's own `size` overrides the group's.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup legendText="Delivery" name="delivery" selected="standard" size="sm">
  <RadioTile value="standard">Standard, 3 to 5 days</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="express">Express, next day</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="pickup">Pick up in store</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

### On a layer

Place the component in a [`Layer`](/components/Layer) to put it on the next surface, so it contrasts with the surface below. `Layer` replaces the v10 `light` prop.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Layer, RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Layer withBackground>
  <Box padding={5}>
    <TileGroup
      legendText="Service pricing tiers"
      name="plan-layer"
      selected="standard"
    >
      <RadioTile value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
      <RadioTile value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
      <RadioTile value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
    </TileGroup>
  </Box>
</Layer>
```

### Disabled

Disable specific tiles, or the entire group, to prevent selection.

#### Individual tiles

Disable specific tiles to prevent selection.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup
  legendText="Service pricing tiers"
  name="plan-disabled"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioTile value="lite" disabled>Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus" disabled>Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

#### Entire group

Disable every tile at once by setting `disabled` on `TileGroup`. The tiles take on the disabled styling without setting `disabled` on each `RadioTile`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup
  legendText="Service pricing tiers"
  name="plan-disabled-group"
  selected="standard"
  disabled
>
  <RadioTile value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard">Standard plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

### Checkmark title

The checkmark icon is hidden from screen readers; a tile's content is its accessible name. Set `iconDescription` to change the title shown when hovering the checkmark. Defaults to `"Tile checkmark"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { RadioTile, TileGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TileGroup
  legendText="Service pricing tiers"
  name="plan-checkmark-title"
  selected="standard"
>
  <RadioTile value="lite">Lite plan</RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="standard" iconDescription="Current plan">
    Standard plan
  </RadioTile>
  <RadioTile value="plus">Plus plan</RadioTile>
</TileGroup>
```

### Form submission

A checked tile submits its `value` under the radio's `name`. See [Form](/components/Form#tiles) for a form that submits radio and selectable tiles together.

| Do | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Set `name` on `TileGroup` when the form is submitted | Without one, the tiles share a generated name, which is not a stable key for the server to read. |
| Give every tile a unique `value` | The group tracks the selection by `value`, so tiles with equal values show as selected together. |
| Use `TileGroup` when you need the selected value | `bind:selected` gives one value, instead of a `checked` per standalone tile. |
| Set the initial choice with `selected` on `TileGroup`, not `checked` on a tile | When both are set, the tile's `checked` wins over `selected`. |

---

### Component API

#### `TileGroup` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` (Reactive) | `T \| undefined` | Specify the selected tile value.<br />Follows the field after a reset -- becomes the value of whichever tile<br />is checked in the DOM, or `undefined`. | _undefined_ |

| `required` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to require the selection of a radio button. | _undefined_ |

| `legendText` | `string` | Specify the legend text.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "legendChildren". | `""` |
| `hideLegend` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the legend | `false` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| undefined` | Set the size of every tile in the group: `"sm"` for compact tiles,<br />such as rows in a list of choices. | _undefined_ |

#### `RadioTile` props
