```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, Tabs } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tabs type="container">
  <Tab label="Engage" secondaryLabel="(21/25)" />
  <Tab label="Analyze" secondaryLabel="(12/16)" />
  <Tab label="Remediate" secondaryLabel="(0/7)" />
  <Tab label="Assets" secondaryLabel="(4/12)" />
  <Tab label="Monitoring" secondaryLabel="(0/10)" disabled />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Engage content</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Analyze content</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Remediate content</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Assets content</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Monitoring content</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</Tabs>
```

#### Partial secondary label

When only some tabs use secondaryLabel, the container still applies the taller min-height so all tab items align. Only tabs with a secondary label show the two-line layout.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, Tabs } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tabs type="container">
  <Tab label="Overview" />
  <Tab label="Details" secondaryLabel="(3)" />
  <Tab label="Settings" />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Overview content</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Details content</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Settings content</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</Tabs>
```

#### Secondary children slot

Use the `secondaryChildren` slot to customize the secondary label with custom markup (for example, `<strong>` for emphasis).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, Tabs } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tabs type="container">
  <Tab label="Engage">
    <strong slot="secondaryChildren">(21/25)</strong>
  </Tab>
  <Tab label="Analyze">
    <strong slot="secondaryChildren">(12/16)</strong>
  </Tab>
  <Tab label="Remediate">
    <strong slot="secondaryChildren">(0/7)</strong>
  </Tab>
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Engage content</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Analyze content</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Remediate content</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</Tabs>
```

#### Icons with secondary label

Container type tabs can combine icon and secondaryLabel for a primary label, icon, and optional secondary line (for example, counts or status).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, Tabs } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Calendar from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Calendar.svelte";
  import Information from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Information.svelte";
  import Settings from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Settings.svelte";
</script>

<Tabs type="container">
  <Tab label="Calendar" icon={Calendar} secondaryLabel="(12 events)" />
  <Tab label="Information" icon={Information} secondaryLabel="(3 new)" />
  <Tab label="Settings" icon={Settings} secondaryLabel="(2 pending)" disabled />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Calendar content</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Information content</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Settings content</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</Tabs>
```

#### Skeleton

Show a loading state for the container tab variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TabsSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsSkeleton type="container" count={3} />
```

#### Skeleton sizes

Container skeletons support the full size range up to `"xl"`, matching container tabs.

##### Small

```svelte
<script>
  import { TabsSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsSkeleton type="container" count={3} size="sm" />
```

##### Medium

```svelte
<script>
  import { TabsSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsSkeleton type="container" count={3} size="md" />
```

##### Large

```svelte
<script>
  import { TabsSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsSkeleton type="container" count={3} size="lg" />
```

##### Extra large

```svelte
<script>
  import { TabsSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsSkeleton type="container" count={3} size="xl" />
```

### Vertical

Use TabsVertical for a tab list beside the panel. Compose it with the same Tab and TabContent components. From the medium breakpoint up, tabs stack in a vertical column. On narrower screens, the list becomes a horizontal row with overflow scrolling. `selected`, `selectedId`, and `activation` all work the same as on Tabs (see [Selection](#selection)).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, TabsVertical } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsVertical>
  <Tab label="Dashboard" />
  <Tab label="Monitoring" />
  <Tab label="Activity" />
  <Tab label="Settings" />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Dashboard content with analytics and overview.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Monitoring content for uptime and alerts.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Activity content for recent user actions.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Settings and configuration options.</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</TabsVertical>
```

#### Orientation

By default, TabsVertical switches between the column and the row at the medium breakpoint (672px), based on the viewport width. Set `orientation` to keep one layout at every width. `aria-orientation` and the arrow keys follow the layout: Up/Down in the column, Left/Right in the row. TabsVerticalSkeleton accepts the same prop.

| Value | Layout | Use when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `undefined` (default) | Column from `md` up, row below | The tabs span most of the page width |
| `"vertical"` | Always the column | A narrow viewport should still show the list beside the panel |
| `"horizontal"` | Always the row | The tabs sit in a narrow container, such as a side panel, on a wide screen |

The breakpoint follows the viewport, not the container. In a 320px side panel on a wide screen, the default keeps the column and squeezes the panel; `orientation="horizontal"` switches to the row.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Stack,
    Tab,
    TabContent,
    TabsVertical,
    Text,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box display="flex" gap={5} wrap="wrap" align="start">
  <Stack gap={3}>
    <Text type="label-01" color="secondary">Default</Text>
    <Box width={320} border="subtle">
      <TabsVertical>
        <Tab label="Dashboard" />
        <Tab label="Monitoring" />
        <Tab label="Activity" />
        <svelte:fragment slot="content">
          <TabContent>Dashboard content</TabContent>
          <TabContent>Monitoring content</TabContent>
          <TabContent>Activity content</TabContent>
        </svelte:fragment>
      </TabsVertical>
    </Box>
  </Stack>
  <Stack gap={3}>
    <Text type="label-01" color="secondary">orientation="horizontal"</Text>
    <Box width={320} border="subtle">
      <TabsVertical orientation="horizontal">
        <Tab label="Dashboard" />
        <Tab label="Monitoring" />
        <Tab label="Activity" />
        <svelte:fragment slot="content">
          <TabContent>Dashboard content</TabContent>
          <TabContent>Monitoring content</TabContent>
          <TabContent>Activity content</TabContent>
        </svelte:fragment>
      </TabsVertical>
    </Box>
  </Stack>
</Box>
```

#### Sidebar navigation

Set `navigation` for a sidebar of page links, such as the sections of a settings page. It works as on [Tabs](#page-navigation): the links get `aria-current="page"` instead of tab semantics, and `activation` no longer applies. Put the current page in the `content` slot, without `TabContent`, so it renders beside the list.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tab, TabsVertical, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsVertical navigation aria-label="Components" selected={1}>
  <Tab label="Accordion" href="/components/Accordion" />
  <Tab label="Breadcrumb" href="/components/Breadcrumb" />
  <Tab label="Button" href="/components/Button" />
  <Box slot="content" padding={5}>
    <Text>The Breadcrumb page renders here.</Text>
  </Box>
</TabsVertical>
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabsVertical } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsVertical navigation aria-label="Settings" {selected}>
  {#each links as link}
    <Tab label={link.label} href={link.href} />
  {/each}
  <div slot="content">
    <slot />
  </div>
</TabsVertical>
```

#### Sizes

Size defaults to `"xl"`. Set `size` to change tab height in the vertical column layout. At `"sm"`, labels stay on one line. Size classes apply from the medium breakpoint up; in the horizontal overflow row below that, `"xl"` uses the large height.

##### Small

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, TabsVertical } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsVertical size="sm">
  <Tab label="Dashboard" />
  <Tab label="Monitoring" />
  <Tab label="Activity" />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Dashboard content with analytics and overview.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Monitoring content for uptime and alerts.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Activity content for recent user actions.</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</TabsVertical>
```

##### Medium

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, TabsVertical } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsVertical size="md">
  <Tab label="Dashboard" />
  <Tab label="Monitoring" />
  <Tab label="Activity" />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Dashboard content with analytics and overview.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Monitoring content for uptime and alerts.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Activity content for recent user actions.</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</TabsVertical>
```

##### Large

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, TabsVertical } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsVertical size="lg">
  <Tab label="Dashboard" />
  <Tab label="Monitoring" />
  <Tab label="Activity" />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Dashboard content with analytics and overview.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Monitoring content for uptime and alerts.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Activity content for recent user actions.</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</TabsVertical>
```

#### Selected

Set `selected` to control the active tab index on mount. As with `Tabs`, bind `selected` or `selectedId` for two-way updates (see [Selection](#selection)).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, TabsVertical } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsVertical selected={1}>
  <Tab label="Dashboard" />
  <Tab label="Monitoring" />
  <Tab label="Activity" />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Dashboard content with analytics and overview.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Monitoring content for uptime and alerts.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Activity content for recent user actions.</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</TabsVertical>
```

#### Disabled

Set disabled on a tab to prevent interaction. Keyboard navigation skips disabled tabs.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, TabsVertical } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsVertical>
  <Tab label="Dashboard" />
  <Tab label="Monitoring" disabled />
  <Tab label="Activity" />
  <Tab label="Settings" disabled />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Dashboard content with analytics and overview.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Monitoring content for uptime and alerts.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Activity content for recent user actions.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Settings and configuration options.</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</TabsVertical>
```

#### Truncated labels

Long labels wrap to two lines, then truncate with an ellipsis.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, TabsVertical } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsVertical>
  <Tab label="Dashboard" />
  <Tab
    label="Extra long label that will go two lines then truncate when it gets too long"
  />
  <Tab label="Activity" />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Dashboard content with analytics and overview.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Content for the second tab.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Activity content for recent user actions.</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</TabsVertical>
```

#### Icons

Set icon on a tab to show an icon before the label. The icon stays aligned to the first line when the label wraps or truncates.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tab, TabContent, TabsVertical } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Activity from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Activity.svelte";
  import Analytics from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Analytics.svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import Settings from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Settings.svelte";
</script>

<TabsVertical>
  <Tab label="Dashboard" icon={Dashboard} />
  <Tab label="Activity" icon={Activity} />
  <Tab label="Analyze trends across every region and team" icon={Analytics} />
  <Tab label="Settings" icon={Settings} />
  <svelte:fragment slot="content">
    <TabContent>Dashboard content with analytics and overview.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Activity content for recent user actions.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Regional trend analysis across teams.</TabContent>
    <TabContent>Settings and configuration options.</TabContent>
  </svelte:fragment>
</TabsVertical>
```

#### Skeleton

Show a loading state with TabsVerticalSkeleton. Set count to control how many placeholder tabs render.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TabsVerticalSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TabsVerticalSkeleton count={4} />
```

---

### Component API

#### `Tabs` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the selected tab index.<br />Prefer `selectedId` when tabs can be added, removed or reordered: an<br />index then points at a different tab. Ignored when `selectedId` is set. | `0` |
| `selectedId` (Reactive) | `string \| undefined` | Specify the selected tab by id. Prefer it to `selected`.<br />When set, takes precedence over `selected` and stays on the same logical<br />tab as tabs are added or removed. Pair with a stable `id` on each `Tab`. | _undefined_ |
| `activation` | `"automatic" \| "manual"` | Choose whether arrow keys change the selection on focus.<br />Defaults to `"automatic"`. Set to `"manual"` so arrow keys only move<br />focus; press Enter or Space to select.<br />Ignored when `navigation` is set. | `"automatic"` |
| `type` | `"default" \| "container"` | Specify the type of tabs. | `"default"` |
| `navigation` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render the tabs as page navigation: a list of links<br />where the selected link has `aria-current="page"`, instead of a tab list<br />that switches panels in place. Links keep the browser's Tab order and<br />arrow keys do not move between them. Give each `Tab` an `href`, set<br />`selected` or `selectedId` from the current route, and label the<br />navigation with `aria-label`. | `false` |
| `dismissible` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render a dismiss button for each tab | `false` |
| `dismissText` | `(label: string) => string` | Specify the accessible name of each tab's dismiss button.<br />Receives the tab's `label`, which is empty when the tab has none. | `(label) => label ? `Dismiss ${label}` : "Dismiss tab"` |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Set to `true` for tabs to span the full width of the container | `false` |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render icon-only tabs.<br />Each `Tab` displays only its `icon`; the `label` is used as the accessible<br />name and the tooltip shown on hover and focus. | `false` |
| `iconSize` | `"default" \| "lg"` | Specify the icon size for icon-only tabs.<br />`"lg"` uses the large scale (48px tabs with a 20px icon);<br />the default scale is 40px tabs with a 16px icon.<br />Only applies when `iconOnly` is `true`. | `"default"` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| undefined` | Specify the size of the tabs. Unset by default, which preserves the<br />original unsized height. Line tabs (`type="default"`) support up to<br />`"lg"`; container tabs support the full range up to `"xl"` -- an<br />out-of-range value clamps to the type's max. | _undefined_ |

#### `Tabs` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `content` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Tabs` dispatched events

| Event | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `on:change` | `number` |
| `on:dismiss` | `{<br />  id: string;<br />  label: string;<br />  disabled: boolean;<br />  hasSecondaryLabel: boolean;<br />  index: number;<br />}` |

#### `Tabs` $$restProps

`Tabs` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `Tab` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLAnchorElement` | Obtain a reference to the anchor HTML element. | `null` |
| `label` | `string` | Specify the tab label.<br />Alternatively, use the default slot. | `""` |
| `href` | `string` | Specify the href attribute | `"#"` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the tab | `false` |
| `tabindex` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Specify the tabindex of the selected tab.<br />Unselected tabs use `-1`, so the tab list is a single Tab-key stop<br />and arrow keys move between tabs.<br />Ignored when `Tabs` sets `navigation`. | `"0"` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the top-level element.<br />Use a stable value with `Tabs` `selectedId` when tabs are added or removed dynamically. | `uniqueId()` |
| `secondaryLabel` | `string` | Specify an optional secondary label.<br />Only rendered for container type tabs.<br />Alternatively, use the "secondaryChildren" slot. | `""` |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify the icon to render.<br />Icon is rendered to the right of the label by default.<br />When the parent `Tabs` is `dismissible`, the icon is rendered to the left.<br />When the parent `Tabs` is `iconOnly`, only the icon is rendered and the<br />`label` is used as the accessible name and the tooltip shown on hover/focus. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipAlign` | `"top" \| "top-start" \| "top-end" \| "bottom" \| "bottom-start" \| "bottom-end" \| undefined` | Set the tooltip placement in floating-ui form: the side, then `start`<br />or `end` along it, as Popover's `align` takes. Above and below,<br />`start` and `end` name inline sides, so they swap under `dir="rtl"`.<br />When set, takes precedence over `tooltipDirection` and `tooltipAlignment`. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipDirection` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | Set the direction of the tooltip relative to the tab.<br />Only used when the tab is rendered icon-only. | `"bottom"` |
| `tooltipAlignment` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the tab.<br />Only used when the tab is rendered icon-only. | `"center"` |

#### `Tab` slots

| Slot                | Detail                  |
| ------------------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`           | `{ selected: boolean }` |
| `secondaryChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Tab` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `Tab` $$restProps

`Tab` spreads `$$restProps` to the `li` element.

#### `TabContent` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` (Reactive) | `string` | Set an id for the top-level element.<br />Without one, the panel takes `{tabId}-panel` from the tab at its position.<br />Prefer a stable value when pairing panels with dynamic tabs. | `uniqueId()` |
| `lazy` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to defer mounting panel content until this tab is first selected | `false` |
| `unmountOnHide` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to unmount panel content when the tab is deselected | `false` |
| `flush` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to remove the panel's horizontal padding so its content<br />lines up with the tab list's leading edge | `false` |

#### `TabContent` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `TabContent` $$restProps

`TabContent` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `TabsVertical` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the selected tab index.<br />Prefer `selectedId` when tabs can be added, removed or reordered: an<br />index then points at a different tab. Ignored when `selectedId` is set. | `0` |
| `selectedId` (Reactive) | `string \| undefined` | Specify the selected tab by id. Prefer it to `selected`.<br />When set, takes precedence over `selected` and stays on the same logical<br />tab as tabs are added or removed. Pair with a stable `id` on each `Tab`. | _undefined_ |
| `activation` | `"automatic" \| "manual"` | Choose whether arrow keys change the selection on focus.<br />Defaults to `"automatic"`. Set to `"manual"` so arrow keys only move<br />focus; press Enter or Space to select.<br />Ignored when `navigation` is set. | `"automatic"` |
| `navigation` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render the tabs as page navigation: a list of links<br />where the selected link has `aria-current="page"`, instead of a tab list<br />that switches panels in place. Links keep the browser's Tab order and<br />arrow keys do not move between them. Give each `Tab` an `href`, set<br />`selected` or `selectedId` from the current route, label the navigation<br />with `aria-label`, and put the page in the `content` slot without<br />`TabContent`. | `false` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | Specify the size of the vertical tabs.<br />`"xl"` matches the default height. | `"xl"` |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical" \| undefined` | Specify the orientation of the tab list.<br />By default, the tabs are a vertical column at the `md` breakpoint and up,<br />and collapse into a horizontal, scrollable row below it.<br />Set to `"vertical"` to always render the column, or `"horizontal"` to<br />always render the row. | _undefined_ |

#### `TabsVertical` slots

| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| undefined` | Specify the size to match a sized `Tabs`. Unset by default.<br />Line tabs (`type="default"`) support up to `"lg"`; container tabs<br />support up to `"xl"`. An out-of-range value clamps to the type's max. | _undefined_ |

## Tag

### Basic

Create a basic tag with text content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag>IBM Cloud</Tag>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to control the tag height. The default is medium.

#### Extra small

Use the extra small size (16px) inside 24px (`size="xs"`) fields, where TagInput and MultiSelect use it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag size="xs">IBM Cloud</Tag>
```

#### Small

Use the small size variant for more compact layouts.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag size="sm">IBM Cloud</Tag>
```

#### Large

Use the large size variant for more prominent layouts.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag size="lg">IBM Cloud</Tag>
```

### Tag types

Choose from a variety of color types to match your design system.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} wrap="wrap">
  <Tag type="red">Critical</Tag>
  <Tag type="magenta">Security</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Beta</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">Info</Tag>
  <Tag type="cyan">Preview</Tag>
  <Tag type="teal">Verified</Tag>
  <Tag type="green">Healthy</Tag>
  <Tag type="gray">Inactive</Tag>
  <Tag type="cool-gray">Archived</Tag>
  <Tag type="warm-gray">Deprecated</Tag>
  <Tag type="high-contrast">Featured</Tag>
  <Tag type="outline">Draft</Tag>
</Stack>
```

### Spacing

Tags have no outer margin, as in Carbon v11. Space them with their container: a horizontal `Stack` with `gap={3}` gives the 8px Carbon recommends between tags, and `TagSet` spaces its tags for you. The `inline` prop is deprecated and has no effect.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3}>
  <Tag>IBM Cloud</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">Machine learning</Tag>
</Stack>
```

### Filterable

Create a filterable tag with a close button that dispatches `close` when clicked.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag filter on:close>carbon-components</Tag>
```

#### Disabled

Disable a filterable tag to prevent interaction.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag filter disabled on:close>carbon-components</Tag>
```

#### Extra small

Combine the filterable variant with the extra small size.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag size="xs" filter on:close>carbon-components</Tag>
```

#### Small

Combine the filterable variant with the small size.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag size="sm" filter on:close>carbon-components</Tag>
```

#### Large

Combine the filterable variant with the large size.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag size="lg" filter on:close>carbon-components</Tag>
```

#### Click and close

Filterable tags forward `on:click` from the tag body and `on:close` from the close button. Click the tag body to select; click the close icon to remove.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag
  filter
  on:click={() => console.log("click")}
  on:close={() => console.log("close")}
>
  carbon-components
</Tag>
```

#### Max width

Tags cap at 208px, as in Carbon v11. A longer label truncates with an ellipsis. Set `maxWidth` to change the cap, for example `"100%"` to fit the container. Accepts any valid CSS length, including `rem`, `px`, `ch`, and `%`.

A static tag shows the full text in a tooltip on hover and focus. Its tooltip trigger is a tab stop. Inside a widget that is one tab stop, such as a card or a grid cell, set `tabindex="-1"` on the tag. The trigger then leaves the tab order, and the tag keeps the full text as its accessible name.

A filter tag shows the full text in the label's `title`, as in Carbon v11. The close button stays its only tab stop, and its accessible name holds the full text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Stack, Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <div>
    <div>Default (208px)</div>
    <Tag filter on:close>
      status:active AND region:us-south AND service:cloud-object-storage
    </Tag>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div>maxWidth="8rem"</div>
    <Tag filter maxWidth="8rem" on:close>
      status:active AND region:us-south AND service:cloud-object-storage
    </Tag>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div>maxWidth="140px"</div>
    <Tag filter maxWidth="140px" on:close>
      status:active AND region:us-south AND service:cloud-object-storage
    </Tag>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div>maxWidth="20ch"</div>
    <Tag filter maxWidth="20ch" on:close>
      status:active AND region:us-south AND service:cloud-object-storage
    </Tag>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div>maxWidth="60%" (relative to the containing block)</div>
    <Box width={200}>
      <Tag filter maxWidth="60%" on:close>
        status:active AND region:us-south AND service:cloud-object-storage
      </Tag>
    </Box>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

#### Close button label

Set `title` to customize the close button's tooltip, shown on hover and focus, and the leading words of its accessible name. Defaults to `"Clear filter"`. The tag text is appended to the name, so each button reads as "Clear filter carbon-components". The prop labels the close button only, so the tag element gets no `title` attribute from it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag filter title="Remove filter" on:close>carbon-components</Tag>
```

### Custom icon

Add a custom icon to the tag. Note: custom icons cannot be used with the filterable variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import IbmCloud from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/IbmCloud.svelte";
</script>

<Tag icon={IbmCloud}>IBM Cloud</Tag>
```

### Clickable variants

Render the tag as a native interactive element instead of a `div`.

#### Interactive

Set `interactive` to render a button element instead of a div for clickable tags.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag interactive>Machine learning</Tag>
```

#### Link

Set `href` to render the tag as an anchor. Link tags reuse interactive styles. Do not wrap a `Tag` in an `<a>`; pass `href` on the tag itself. `href` is mutually exclusive with `filter`; when both are set, `filter` takes precedence.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} wrap="wrap">
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="red">Critical</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="magenta">Security</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="purple">Beta</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="blue">Info</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="cyan">Preview</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="teal">Verified</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="green">Healthy</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="gray">Inactive</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="cool-gray">Archived</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="warm-gray">Deprecated</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="high-contrast">Featured</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" type="outline">Draft</Tag>
</Stack>
```

### AI label

Put an `AILabel` in the `decorator` slot to mark the tag as AI-generated. The label renders as inline text in the tag's color. Static and filterable tags have the slot.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AILabel, Stack, Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} wrap="wrap">
  <Tag type="blue"
    >Forecast<AILabel slot="decorator"
      ><p>Generated from the last 90 days of usage.</p></AILabel
    ></Tag
  >
  <Tag type="green" filter
    >us-east-1<AILabel slot="decorator"
      ><p>
        Suggested because most of the alerts came from this region.
      </p></AILabel
    ></Tag
  >
</Stack>
```

### Disabled

Filterable, interactive, and link tag variants support a disabled state.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Tag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} wrap="wrap">
  <Tag filter disabled>Machine learning</Tag>
  <Tag interactive disabled>Machine learning</Tag>
  <Tag href="/components/Tag" disabled>Machine learning</Tag>
</Stack>
```

### Tooltip

Embed a tooltip within a tag to provide additional context.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TooltipDefinition } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tag>
  <TooltipDefinition
    tooltipText="IBM Corporate Headquarters is based in Armonk, New York."
  >
    Armonk
  </TooltipDefinition>
</Tag>
```

### Operational

Use `OperationalTag` for a tag that reveals related content, such as the rest of a list, in a popover. The whole tag is the trigger, and a border in the tag's color marks it as one. Press <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd> to open it. <kbd>Escape</kbd> closes it and returns focus to the tag; so does clicking outside or moving focus away. Put the popover content in the `content` slot.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link, OperationalTag, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<OperationalTag type="blue">
  3 policies
  <Stack slot="content" gap={3}>
    <Link href="#">Retention</Link>
    <Link href="#">Encryption at rest</Link>
    <Link href="#">Access review</Link>
  </Stack>
</OperationalTag>
```

#### Types

`OperationalTag` takes the ten color `type`s; it has no `high-contrast` or `outline` variant. The default is `gray`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { OperationalTag, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} wrap="wrap">
  <OperationalTag type="gray">Gray</OperationalTag>
  <OperationalTag type="purple">Purple</OperationalTag>
  <OperationalTag type="teal">Teal</OperationalTag>
  <OperationalTag type="red">Red</OperationalTag>
</Stack>
```

### Selectable

Use `SelectableTag` to create a tag that toggles between selected and unselected states. Toggling dispatches `change` with `{ selected }`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { SelectableTag } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selected = false;
</script>

<SelectableTag bind:selected on:change>
  {selected ? "Selected" : "Unselected"}
</SelectableTag>
```

#### With icon

Combine `SelectableTag` with a custom icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { SelectableTag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import IbmCloud from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/IbmCloud.svelte";

  let selected = true;
</script>

<SelectableTag bind:selected icon={IbmCloud} on:change>IBM Cloud</SelectableTag>
```

#### Type

Combine `SelectableTag` with a color `type`, matching the color types available on `Tag`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { SelectableTag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<SelectableTag type="blue">Machine learning</SelectableTag>
```

#### Disabled

Disable a selectable tag to prevent interaction.

```svelte

  import { SelectableTag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<SelectableTag disabled>Machine learning</SelectableTag>
```

#### Small

Use the small size variant for selectable tags.

```svelte

  import { SelectableTag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<SelectableTag size="sm">Compliant</SelectableTag>
```

#### Large

Use the large size variant for selectable tags.

```svelte

  import { SelectableTag } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<SelectableTag size="lg">Compliant</SelectableTag>
```

### Component API

#### `Tag` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLAnchorElement \| HTMLButtonElement \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the outer HTML element. | `null` |
| `type` | `"red" \| "magenta" \| "purple" \| "blue" \| "cyan" \| "teal" \| "green" \| "gray" \| "cool-gray" \| "warm-gray" \| "high-contrast" \| "outline" \| undefined` | Specify the type of tag. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "default" \| "lg" \| "md" \| undefined` | Specify the size of the tag.<br />Defaults to `"default"`, or to the `size` of a parent `TagSet`.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"` (`"default"`). | _undefined_ |
| `filter` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use filterable variant | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable a filterable tag | `false` |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render a `button` element instead of a `div` | `false` |
| `href` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the `href` attribute to render the tag as an anchor.<br />Mutually exclusive with `filter`; when both are set, `filter` takes precedence. | _undefined_ |
| `skeleton` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to display the skeleton state | `false` |
| `inline` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to omit the default outer margin. | `false` |
| `title` | `string` | Set the label of the close button in a filterable tag.<br />Shown in a tooltip on hover and focus, and leads the button's accessible name.<br />The tag element gets no native `title` attribute from this prop. | `"Clear filter"` |
| `maxWidth` | `string \| undefined` | Override the tag's 208px width cap.<br />Accepts any CSS length (for example `"8rem"`, `"120px"`, or `"100%"` to fit the container).<br />At any width, a truncated label shows its full text in a tooltip. | _undefined_ |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify the icon to render. | _undefined_ |
| `value` | `string \| number \| undefined` | Specify a value that identifies the tag inside a `TagSet`.<br />Returned as `tag.value` in the set's `close:tag` event. | _undefined_ |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the filterable tag | `uniqueId()` |
