## TagInput

### Basic

Type a value and press <kbd>Enter</kbd> or type a comma to add it as a tag. Bind `value` to read or set the tags as an array of strings.

To remove a tag, click its close button. From the keyboard, press <kbd>Backspace</kbd> or <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd> at the start of the field to move to the tags, then <kbd>Delete</kbd> or <kbd>Backspace</kbd> to remove the focused one. The tags are a single tab stop: the arrow keys move between them, and <kbd>Escape</kbd>, <kbd>End</kbd>, or <kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> on the last tag return to the field. Holding <kbd>Backspace</kbd> to clear the text stops at the start of the field instead of running on into the tags.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let value = ["Svelte", "TypeScript"];
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <TagInput bind:value labelText="Topics" placeholder="Add a topic" />
  <p>Bound value: {JSON.stringify(value)}</p>
</Stack>
```

| Do | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Use for open-ended values users type themselves, like keywords or email addresses | Tags show each value on its own and make it easy to remove one |
| Use `MultiSelect` when the values come from a known list | A list of options is faster to scan than typing, and avoids typos |
| Keep tags short | Long tags truncate at 13rem and show their full text on hover |

### Adding tags

#### Delimiters

Set `delimiter` to a string, an array of strings, or a regular expression. Typed text splits on it as you type. <kbd>Enter</kbd> always adds the current text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput
  labelText="Keywords"
  placeholder="Separate with commas or semicolons"
  delimiter={[",", ";"]}
/>
```

#### Pasting lists

Pasted text splits on the delimiter and on line breaks, so a column copied from a spreadsheet becomes one tag per row. Set `addOnPaste` to `false` to paste text as-is.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput labelText="Allowed domains" placeholder="Paste a list of domains" />
```

#### Adding on blur

Set `addOnBlur` to add any text left in the field when it loses focus.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput labelText="Topics" placeholder="Add a topic" addOnBlur />
```

#### Normalizing

Set `normalize` to transform text before it's checked and added. The default trims whitespace.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput
  labelText="Hashtags"
  placeholder="Add a hashtag"
  normalize={(raw) => raw.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^#/, "")}
/>
```

### Validation

A rejected value stays in the field with an inline message, so the user can fix it. Each rejection also dispatches `invalid` with the value and a `reason`.

#### Duplicates

Duplicates are rejected by default, compared case-insensitively. Set `isDuplicate` to change the comparison, or `allowDuplicates` to accept repeats. Set `duplicateText` to change the message.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput
  labelText="Topics"
  value={["Svelte"]}
  placeholder="Try adding svelte"
/>
```

#### Maximum

Set `max` to cap the number of tags. Set `maxText` to change the message.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput
  labelText="Top three skills"
  value={["Svelte", "TypeScript"]}
  max={3}
  placeholder="Add a skill"
/>
```

#### Custom validation

Set `validate` to check each value. Return `true` to accept it, or a message to reject it. Returning `false` rejects it with `invalidTagText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput
  labelText="Recipients"
  placeholder="Add an email address"
  validate={(tag) =>
    /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+$/.test(tag) || "Enter a valid email address"}
/>
```

### Custom tags

Use the `tag` slot to render each tag yourself, for example with a color `type` or an icon. Spread the slot's `props` onto the tag so closing it still removes the value. Leave out `filter` to lock a tag in place.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput labelText="Environments" value={["production", "staging", "dev"]}>
  <svelte:fragment slot="tag" let:tag let:props>
    <Tag {...props} type={tag === "production" ? "red" : "gray"}>{tag}</Tag>
  </svelte:fragment>
</TagInput>
```

In Svelte 5, pass a snippet instead: `{#snippet tag({ tag, props })}`.

### Placement

#### Below the field

Set `tagPlacement` to `"below"` to list the tags under the field instead of inside it. Use it for long lists, so the field keeps a fixed height.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput
  labelText="Topics"
  value={["Svelte", "TypeScript", "Carbon"]}
  tagPlacement="below"
  placeholder="Add a topic"
/>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to match the surrounding fields. Tags scale with the field. Inside a `Form`, the field takes the form's `size` unless it sets its own.

#### Extra small

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput size="xs" labelText="Topics" value={["Svelte", "TypeScript"]} />
```

#### Small

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput size="sm" labelText="Topics" value={["Svelte", "TypeScript"]} />
```

#### Extra large

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput size="xl" labelText="Topics" value={["Svelte", "TypeScript"]} />
```

### States

#### Invalid

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput
  labelText="Recipients"
  value={["ada@example.com"]}
  invalid
  invalidText="Add at least two recipients"
/>
```

#### Warning

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput
  labelText="Recipients"
  value={["ada@example.com"]}
  warn
  warnText="One recipient is outside your organization"
/>
```

#### Read-only

A read-only field shows its tags without close buttons.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput labelText="Topics" value={["Svelte", "TypeScript"]} readonly />
```

#### Disabled

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput labelText="Topics" value={["Svelte", "TypeScript"]} disabled />
```

### Skeleton

An empty tag input is a labelled field the height of a text input, so `TextInputSkeleton` at the same `size` stands in for it while it loads. Tags that wrap onto more lines make the filled input taller.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInputSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInputSkeleton />
```

### Forms

Set `name` to submit each tag as its own form value under that name. The text still being typed is not submitted. A form reset restores the tags the field started with. Set `required` to require at least one tag; text that isn't a tag yet doesn't count. Set `requiredText` to change the message.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    Form,
    Stack,
    TagInput,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let submitted = [];

  function handleSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    submitted = new FormData(event.target).getAll("topics");
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Form on:submit={handleSubmit}>
    <Stack gap={5}>
      <TagInput
        name="topics"
        value={["Svelte"]}
        labelText="Topics"
        placeholder="Add a topic"
      />
      <ButtonSet>
        <Button kind="secondary" type="reset">Reset</Button>
        <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
      </ButtonSet>
    </Stack>
  </Form>
  <p>Submitted topics: {JSON.stringify(submitted)}</p>
</Stack>
```

### Events

`add` and `remove` fire before a tag is added or removed. Both are cancelable: call `preventDefault()` to stop the change. `change` fires after, with the new array of tags.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TagInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagInput
  labelText="Topics"
  placeholder="Add a topic"
  on:add={(e) => console.log(e.detail)}
  // { value, source }
  on:remove={(e) => console.log(e.detail)}
  // { value, index }
  on:invalid={(e) => console.log(e.detail)}
  // { value, reason, message }
  on:change={(e) => console.log(e.detail)} // string[]
/>
```

---

### Component API

#### `TagInput` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (Reactive) | `string[]` | Specify the tags.<br />Follows the field when the owning form resets. | `[]` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLInputElement` | Obtain a reference to the text input element. | `null` |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| undefined` | Set the size of the field. Tags scale with it.<br />Inherits the parent `Form` size when unset.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"` (the 40px default, which overrides a<br />`Form` size) and `"lg"` (`"xl"`). | _undefined_ |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Specify the placeholder text | `""` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the field and its tags | `false` |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to show the tags without letting users add or remove any | `false` |
| `required` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to require at least one tag | `false` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text | `false` |
| `helperText` | `string` | Specify the helper text | `""` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state | `false` |
| `invalidText` | `string` | Specify the invalid state text | `""` |
| `warn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate a warning state | `false` |
| `warnText` | `string` | Specify the warning state text | `""` |
| `tagPlacement` | `"inline" \| "below"` | Where the tags render: `"inline"` inside the field, ahead of the text<br />input, or `"below"` the field, for long lists. | `"inline"` |
| `delimiter` | `string \| string[] \| RegExp` | Characters (or a pattern) that split typed or pasted text into tags.<br />Enter always adds the current text; pasted line breaks always split. | `","` |
| `addOnPaste` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to paste text as-is instead of splitting it into tags | `true` |
| `addOnBlur` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to add the current text as a tag when the field loses focus | `false` |
| `normalize` | `(raw: string) => string` | Transform raw text into a tag before it's checked and added.<br />Return an empty string to skip it. | `(raw) => raw.trim()` |
| `allowDuplicates` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to allow the same tag more than once | `false` |
| `isDuplicate` | `(a: string, b: string) => boolean` | Decide whether two tags are duplicates.<br />Defaults to a case-insensitive comparison. | `(a, b) => a.toLowerCase() === b.toLowerCase()` |
| `validate` | `(tag: string) => boolean \| string` | Check a tag before it's added. Return `true` to accept it, or a message<br />to reject it. Returning `false` rejects it with `invalidTagText`. | `() => true` |
| `max` | `number \| undefined` | Maximum number of tags. | _undefined_ |
| `removeTagText` | `string` | Specify the accessible name prefix of each tag's remove button | `"Remove"` |
| `duplicateText` | `string` | Specify the message shown when a duplicate tag is rejected | `"This tag has already been added"` |
| `requiredText` | `string` | Specify the validation message shown when `required` blocks a form<br />that has text in the field but no tags yet. | `"Add at least one tag"` |
| `invalidTagText` | `string` | Specify the message shown when `validate` rejects a tag without one | `"This tag isn't valid"` |
| `maxText` | `string` | Specify the message shown when a tag is rejected at `max` | `"You've reached the maximum number of tags"` |
| `instructionsText` | `string` | Specify the visually hidden keyboard instructions read with the field | `"Press Enter to add a tag. Press Backspace in an empty field to move to the tags, then Delete to remove one."` |
| `addedText` | `(tags: string[], count: number) => string` | Announcement after tags are added. | `(tags, count) => `${tags.length === 1 ? tags[0] : `${tags.length} tags`} added. ${count} ${count === 1 ? "tag" : "tags"}.`` |
| `removedText` | `(tag: string, count: number) => string` | Announcement after a tag is removed. | `(tag, count) => `${tag} removed. ${count} ${count === 1 ? "tag" : "tags"}.`` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the text input | `uniqueId()` |
| `name` | `string \| undefined` | Specify a name to submit each tag as a hidden input with the form. | _undefined_ |

#### `TagInput` slots

| Slot | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `tag` | `{<br />  tag: string;<br />  index: number;<br />  props: {<br />    filter: boolean;<br />    disabled: boolean;<br />    value: string;<br />    title: string;<br />    maxWidth: string;<br />  };<br />}` |

#### `TagInput` forwarded events

| Event        |
| ------------ |
| `on:blur`    |
| `on:focus`   |
| `on:keydown` |

#### `TagInput` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:add` | `{<br />  value: string;<br />  source:<br />    \| "enter"<br />    \| "delimiter"<br />    \| "paste"<br />    \| "blur";<br />}` | Cancelable. Dispatched before a tag is added; call `preventDefault()` to keep it out. |
| `on:change` | `string[]` | Dispatched after tags are added or removed. |
| `on:invalid` | `{<br />  value: string;<br />  reason:<br />    "duplicate" \| "max" \| "validate";<br />  message?: string;<br />}` | Dispatched when a value is rejected. |
| `on:remove` | `{<br />  value: string;<br />  index: number;<br />}` | Cancelable. Dispatched before a tag is removed; call `preventDefault()` to keep it. |

#### `TagInput` $$restProps

`TagInput` spreads `$$restProps` to the `input` element.

#### `TextInputSkeleton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| undefined` | Set the size of the skeleton to match the field it stands in for.<br />Inherits the parent `Form` size when unset.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"` (the 40px default, which overrides a<br />`Form` size) and `"lg"` (`"xl"`). | _undefined_ |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the label text | `false` |

#### `TextInputSkeleton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `TextInputSkeleton` $$restProps

`TextInputSkeleton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## TagSet

### Basic

Compose `TagSet` from ordinary `Tag` children. `TagSet` measures the available width and shows as many as fit.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagSet>
  <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
</TagSet>
```

### Alignment

Set `align` to change how the visible tags are positioned within the row when they don't fill the available width.

#### Center

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagSet align="center">
  <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
</TagSet>
```

#### End

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagSet align="end">
  <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
</TagSet>
```

### Overflow

Once the row runs out of space, the remaining tags collapse into a "+N" indicator. Hovering it shows the hidden labels in a tooltip.

There is no fixed number of tags that triggers this. `TagSet` measures the actual pixel width available and fits as many tags as space allows, so the count that overflows depends on the container's width and each tag's label length, not a set threshold.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const categories = [
    { label: "Compute", type: "red" },
    { label: "Storage", type: "blue" },
    { label: "Networking", type: "purple" },
    { label: "Database", type: "green" },
    { label: "Analytics", type: "magenta" },
    { label: "Security", type: "cyan" },
    { label: "Identity", type: "teal" },
    { label: "Monitoring", type: "cool-gray" },
    { label: "Billing", type: "warm-gray" },
    { label: "DevOps", type: "outline" },
  ];
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <TagSet>
    {#each categories as category}
      <Tag type={category.type}>{category.label}</Tag>
    {/each}
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

#### Max visible

Set `maxVisible` to cap the number of visible tags regardless of how much space is available.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const categories = [
    { label: "Compute", type: "red" },
    { label: "Storage", type: "blue" },
    { label: "Networking", type: "purple" },
    { label: "Database", type: "green" },
    { label: "Analytics", type: "magenta" },
    { label: "Security", type: "cyan" },
    { label: "Identity", type: "teal" },
    { label: "Monitoring", type: "cool-gray" },
    { label: "Billing", type: "warm-gray" },
    { label: "DevOps", type: "outline" },
  ];
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <TagSet maxVisible={3}>
    {#each categories as category}
      <Tag type={category.type}>{category.label}</Tag>
    {/each}
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

#### Multiline

Set `multiline` to wrap every tag onto multiple lines instead of collapsing into an overflow indicator.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const categories = [
    { label: "Compute", type: "red" },
    { label: "Storage", type: "blue" },
    { label: "Networking", type: "purple" },
    { label: "Database", type: "green" },
    { label: "Analytics", type: "magenta" },
    { label: "Security", type: "cyan" },
    { label: "Identity", type: "teal" },
    { label: "Monitoring", type: "cool-gray" },
    { label: "Billing", type: "warm-gray" },
    { label: "DevOps", type: "outline" },
  ];
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <TagSet multiline>
    {#each categories as category}
      <Tag type={category.type}>{category.label}</Tag>
    {/each}
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

#### Measurement offset

Set `measurementOffset` to subtract a fixed amount from the measured available width before fitting tags -- useful when other content shares the same row and should be reserved space.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Stack, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <div>
    <div>measurementOffset={0} (default)</div>
    <Box maxWidth="14rem">
      <TagSet>
        <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
        <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
        <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
        <Tag type="green">QA</Tag>
        <Tag type="magenta">Sandbox</Tag>
      </TagSet>
    </Box>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div>measurementOffset={80}</div>
    <Box maxWidth="14rem">
      <TagSet measurementOffset={80}>
        <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
        <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
        <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
        <Tag type="green">QA</Tag>
        <Tag type="magenta">Sandbox</Tag>
      </TagSet>
    </Box>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

#### Custom measurement target

Set `containingElement` to measure a different element instead of `TagSet`'s own wrapper -- useful when the width `TagSet` should fit within isn't its own box, for example when matching the width of another element on the page.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  // An empty reference element whose width TagSet should fit within,
  // instead of its own (wider) wrapper -- for example, to match the width
  // of an unrelated column elsewhere on the page.
  let target;
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Box bind:ref={target} maxWidth="8rem" />
  <TagSet containingElement={target}>
    <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
    <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
    <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
    <Tag type="green">QA</Tag>
    <Tag type="magenta">Sandbox</Tag>
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

#### Indicator label

Screen readers announce the "+N" indicator as "+3 more tags" by default. Set `overflowLabel` to a function of the hidden count to localize it or name what the tags are. Start the label with the visible "+N" so speech-input users can say what they see.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="12rem">
  <TagSet overflowLabel={(count) => `+${count} more environments`}>
    <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
    <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
    <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
    <Tag type="green">QA</Tag>
    <Tag type="magenta">Sandbox</Tag>
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

### Overflow tooltip

Control the content and positioning of the tooltip shown by the "+N" indicator.

#### Alignment

Set `overflowAlign` to align the tooltip relative to the "+N" indicator.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Stack, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <div>
    <div>overflowAlign="start"</div>
    <Box maxWidth="12rem">
      <TagSet overflowAlign="start">
        <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
        <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
        <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
        <Tag type="green">QA</Tag>
        <Tag type="magenta">Sandbox</Tag>
      </TagSet>
    </Box>
  </div>
  <div>
    <div>overflowAlign="end"</div>
    <Box maxWidth="12rem">
      <TagSet overflowAlign="end">
        <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
        <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
        <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
        <Tag type="green">QA</Tag>
        <Tag type="magenta">Sandbox</Tag>
      </TagSet>
    </Box>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

#### Direction

Set `overflowDirection` to `"top"` to show the tooltip above the indicator instead of below.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="12rem">
  <TagSet overflowDirection="top">
    <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
    <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
    <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
    <Tag type="green">QA</Tag>
    <Tag type="magenta">Sandbox</Tag>
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

#### Custom content

Override the `overflowTooltip` slot to replace the default plain-text tooltip with custom content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const certifications = [
    { label: "SOC 2", type: "red" },
    { label: "HIPAA", type: "blue" },
    { label: "GDPR", type: "purple" },
    { label: "PCI DSS", type: "green" },
    { label: "ISO 27001", type: "magenta" },
    { label: "FedRAMP", type: "cyan" },
  ];
</script>

<Box maxWidth="12rem">
  <TagSet>
    {#each certifications as certification}
      <Tag type={certification.type}>{certification.label}</Tag>
    {/each}
    <svelte:fragment slot="overflowTooltip" let:tags let:count>
      <strong>{count} more:</strong>&nbsp;{tags
        .map((tag) => tag.label)
        .join(", ")}
    </svelte:fragment>
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

### Overflow popover

Set `overflowMode="popover"` to turn the "+N" indicator into a button that opens the hidden tags themselves, in their own colors. Unlike the hover tooltip, it works on touch screens, and dismissible tags can still be closed from inside it. Closing one moves focus to the next tag in the popover. The `overflowTooltip` slot replaces the popover content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let tags = [
    { id: "prod", label: "Production", type: "red" },
    { id: "staging", label: "Staging", type: "blue" },
    { id: "dev", label: "Development", type: "purple" },
    { id: "qa", label: "QA", type: "green" },
    { id: "sandbox", label: "Sandbox", type: "magenta" },
    { id: "canary", label: "Canary", type: "teal" },
  ];

  function handleTagClose({ detail }) {
    tags = tags.filter((tag) => tag.id !== detail.tag.value);
  }
</script>

<Box maxWidth="16rem">
  <TagSet overflowMode="popover" on:close:tag={handleTagClose}>
    {#each tags as tag (tag.id)}
      <Tag type={tag.type} value={tag.id} filter>{tag.label}</Tag>
    {/each}
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

#### Overflow type

Set `overflowType` to choose how the hidden tags are listed: `"default"` lists their labels as text, and `"tag"` lists them as tags in their own colors. The popover defaults to `"tag"`, which keeps dismissible tags closable; the tooltip defaults to `"default"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Stack, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const environments = [
    { id: "prod", label: "Production", type: "red" },
    { id: "staging", label: "Staging", type: "blue" },
    { id: "dev", label: "Development", type: "purple" },
    { id: "qa", label: "QA", type: "green" },
    { id: "sandbox", label: "Sandbox", type: "magenta" },
  ];
</script>

<Box minHeight="14rem">
  <Stack gap={5}>
    <Box maxWidth="16rem">
      <TagSet overflowMode="popover" overflowType="default">
        {#each environments as tag (tag.id)}
          <Tag type={tag.type}>{tag.label}</Tag>
        {/each}
      </TagSet>
    </Box>
    <Box maxWidth="16rem">
      <TagSet overflowType="tag">
        {#each environments as tag (tag.id)}
          <Tag type={tag.type}>{tag.label}</Tag>
        {/each}
      </TagSet>
    </Box>
  </Stack>
</Box>
```

### View all

With more hidden tags than `viewAllThreshold` (10 by default), the popover lists the first ten and a "View all" button. It opens a modal of every tag with a search field, so long sets stay reachable from the keyboard and on touch screens. In tooltip mode, selecting "+N" opens the modal; call `preventDefault()` on `click:overflow` to handle the click yourself. Set `viewAllText`, `allTagsTitle`, `allTagsSearchLabel` and `allTagsResultsLabel` to translate it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let regions = [
    "us-south",
    "us-east",
    "eu-de",
    "eu-gb",
    "eu-es",
    "jp-tok",
    "jp-osa",
    "au-syd",
    "ca-tor",
    "br-sao",
    "in-che",
    "kr-seo",
    "fr-par",
    "ch-zur",
  ];

  function handleTagClose({ detail }) {
    regions = regions.filter((region) => region !== detail.tag.value);
  }
</script>

<Box maxWidth="16rem">
  <TagSet overflowMode="popover" on:close:tag={handleTagClose}>
    {#each regions as region (region)}
      <Tag type="teal" value={region} filter>{region}</Tag>
    {/each}
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

### Dismissible

Set `filter` on a `Tag` to render it as closable. `TagSet` dispatches `close:tag` with `{ tag, index }` instead of taking a per-tag handler: remove the tag from your own state in response. Set `value` on each `Tag` to read it back as `tag.value`, so you can remove by id rather than by position or label.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let tags = [
    { id: "beta", label: "Beta access", type: "red" },
    { id: "dark", label: "Dark mode", type: "blue" },
    { id: "dashboard", label: "New dashboard", type: "purple" },
    { id: "early", label: "Early adopter", type: "green" },
  ];

  function handleTagClose({ detail }) {
    tags = tags.filter((tag) => tag.id !== detail.tag.value);
  }
</script>

<TagSet on:close:tag={handleTagClose}>
  {#each tags as tag (tag.id)}
    <Tag type={tag.type} value={tag.id} filter>{tag.label}</Tag>
  {/each}
</TagSet>
```

#### Single tab stop

By default, every dismissible or interactive tag is its own tab stop. Set `navigation="roving"` to make the whole set one tab stop instead: Tab enters the set, the arrow keys, Home, and End move between tags and the "+N" indicator, and Delete or Backspace closes the focused tag. Read-only tags are skipped. Use it when a set holds more than a handful of dismissible tags.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let tags = [
    { id: "beta", label: "Beta access", type: "red" },
    { id: "dark", label: "Dark mode", type: "blue" },
    { id: "dashboard", label: "New dashboard", type: "purple" },
    { id: "early", label: "Early adopter", type: "green" },
    { id: "export", label: "CSV export", type: "teal" },
  ];

  function handleTagClose({ detail }) {
    tags = tags.filter((tag) => tag.id !== detail.tag.value);
  }
</script>

<TagSet navigation="roving" multiline on:close:tag={handleTagClose}>
  {#each tags as tag (tag.id)}
    <Tag type={tag.type} value={tag.id} filter>{tag.label}</Tag>
  {/each}
</TagSet>
```

### Selectable

`SelectableTag` children take the set's `size` and collapse into the "+N" indicator like `Tag` children do.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, SelectableTag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="16rem">
  <TagSet size="sm">
    <SelectableTag selected>Machine learning</SelectableTag>
    <SelectableTag>Analytics</SelectableTag>
    <SelectableTag>Security</SelectableTag>
    <SelectableTag>Automation</SelectableTag>
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

### Events

Respond to interactions with the "+N" overflow indicator.

#### Overflow click

Use `on:click:overflow` to listen for clicks on the "+N" indicator. The event detail includes the current overflow count.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="12rem">
  <TagSet on:click:overflow={(e) => console.log(e.detail.count)}>
    <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
    <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
    <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
    <Tag type="green">QA</Tag>
    <Tag type="magenta">Sandbox</Tag>
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

#### Overflow count change

Use `on:overflow:change` to listen for changes to the overflow count, whether from a resize, a slotted-children change, or a `maxVisible` change. The event detail includes the new count.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="12rem">
  <TagSet on:overflow:change={(e) => console.log(e.detail.count)}>
    <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
    <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
    <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
    <Tag type="green">QA</Tag>
    <Tag type="magenta">Sandbox</Tag>
  </TagSet>
</Box>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` on `TagSet` to apply it to every slotted tag (including the "+N" overflow indicator) that doesn't set its own `size`.

#### Small

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagSet size="sm">
  <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
</TagSet>
```

#### Large

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TagSet size="lg">
  <Tag type="red">Production</Tag>
  <Tag type="blue">Staging</Tag>
  <Tag type="purple">Development</Tag>
</TagSet>
```

### Gap

Set `gap` to control the spacing between tags. Accepts a Carbon layout scale (`0`-`13`) or a CSS length string.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tag, TagSet } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const environments = [
    { label: "Production", type: "red" },
    { label: "Staging", type: "blue" },
    { label: "Development", type: "purple" },
    { label: "QA", type: "green" },
  ];
</script>

<TagSet gap="1.5rem">
  {#each environments as environment}
    <Tag type={environment.type}>{environment.label}</Tag>
  {/each}
</TagSet>
```

---

### Component API

#### `TagSet` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allTagsOpen` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the "View all" modal. | `false` |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Horizontal alignment of the visible tag row. | `"start"` |
| `overflowAlign` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Alignment of the overflow tooltip relative to the "+N" indicator. | `"center"` |
| `overflowDirection` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | Direction of the overflow tooltip relative to the "+N" indicator. | `"bottom"` |
| `overflowMode` | `"tooltip" \| "popover"` | How the "+N" indicator shows the hidden tags. `"tooltip"` lists their<br />labels in a hover tooltip. `"popover"` makes the indicator a button that<br />opens a popover of the hidden tags themselves, so dismissible ones can<br />still be closed and touch users can reach them. | `"tooltip"` |
| `overflowType` | `"default" \| "tag" \| undefined` | How the "+N" indicator lists the hidden tags: `"default"` lists their<br />labels as text, `"tag"` as tags in their own colors. In the popover and<br />the "View all" modal, `"tag"` keeps dismissible tags closable.<br />Defaults to `"default"` for the tooltip and `"tag"` for the popover. | _undefined_ |
| `viewAllThreshold` | `number` | With more hidden tags than this, the popover lists only this many and<br />adds a "View all" button, and clicking a tooltip-mode "+N" opens the<br />modal directly. The modal lists every tag, with a search field.<br />Set to `Infinity` to never offer it. | `10` |
| `viewAllText` | `string` | Text of the popover's "View all" button. | `"View all"` |
| `allTagsTitle` | `string` | Heading of the "View all" modal, also the name of its tag list. | `"All tags"` |
| `allTagsSearchLabel` | `string` | Label and placeholder of the "View all" modal's search field. | `"Search tags"` |
| `allTagsResultsLabel` | `(count: number) => string` | Text announced, and shown when nothing matches, for the number of tags<br />the "View all" search finds. | `(count) => count === 0 ? "No matching tags" : count === 1 ? "1 tag" : `${count} tags`` |
| `overflowLabel` | `(count: number) => string` | Accessible name of the "+N" overflow indicator. Keep the visible "+N"<br />in the name so speech-input users can say what they see. | `(count) => `+${count} more tags`` |
| `maxVisible` | `number \| undefined` | Hard cap on visible tags regardless of available space. | _undefined_ |
| `navigation` | `"tab" \| "roving"` | Keyboard navigation between tags. `"tab"` puts every interactive tag in<br />the tab order. `"roving"` makes the set a single tab stop: arrow keys,<br />Home, and End move between tags and the "+N" indicator, and Delete or<br />Backspace closes a focused dismissible tag. | `"tab"` |
| `multiline` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to wrap all tags instead of collapsing to overflow. | `false` |
| `measurementOffset` | `number` | Subtracted from the measured available width before fitting tags. | `0` |
| `containingElement` | `HTMLElement \| undefined` | Custom element to measure instead of `TagSet`'s own wrapper. | _undefined_ |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "default" \| "lg" \| "md" \| undefined` | Size of every tag, including the "+N" overflow indicator. Applies to<br />slotted `Tag` children without their own `size`.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"` (`"default"`). | _undefined_ |
| `gap` | `import("../Stack/Stack.svelte").StackScale \| string` | Spacing between tags. Accepts a Carbon layout scale (`0`-`13`) or a CSS<br />length string. | `3` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the top-level element.<br />The overflow tooltip id derives from it as `{id}-overflow`. | `uniqueId()` |

#### `TagSet` typedefs

```ts
type TagSetItem = {
  id: string;
  node: HTMLElement;
  label: string;
  value?: string | number;
  type?: import("../Tag/Tag.svelte").TagProps["type"];
  size: string;
  disabled: boolean;
  filter: boolean;
};
```

#### `TagSet` slots

| Slot | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `overflowTooltip` | `{<br />  tags: TagSetItem[];<br />  count: number;<br />}` |

#### `TagSet` dispatched events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `on:click:overflow` | `{ count: number }` | User clicks the "+N" indicator. Cancelable: prevent it to keep a tooltip-mode set from opening the "View all" modal. |
| `on:close:tag` | `{<br />  tag: TagSetItem;<br />  index: number;<br />}` | User clicks the close icon on a dismissible (`filter`) tag. |
| `on:overflow:change` | `{ count: number }` | Dispatched when the number of overflowing tags changes, from a resize, a slotted-children change, or a `maxVisible` change. |

#### `TagSet` $$restProps

`TagSet` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## Text

### Basic

The default component renders a `<p>` with the body-01 type style.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text>Carbon Components Svelte implements the Carbon Design System.</Text>
```

### Text color

#### Semantic tokens

Set `color` to a Carbon semantic text token. Each token describes intent and resolves to the active theme, so colors update when the theme changes.

| Token | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `primary` | Primary text for headings and body copy |
| `secondary` | Secondary text for supplementary copy |
| `placeholder` | Placeholder text in form inputs |
| `helper` | Helper and caption text |
| `on-color` | Text on a colored background, such as a button or tag |
| `inverse` | Text on an inverse surface, such as a tooltip or notification |
| `error` | Error and validation text |
| `success` | Success and positive status text |
| `link` | Link-colored text that is not itself a link |
| `disabled` | Disabled text |

Carbon v11 has no success text token, and its `support-success` color is too light for small text. `success` reads `--ccs-text-success`, a green that meets 4.5:1 wherever `error` does: on the page background and the first two layers. Override it with CSS, such as `:root { --ccs-text-success: #0e6027; }`; the `Theme` `tokens` prop only sets Carbon's `--cds-*` tokens.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text color="primary">Primary text</Text>
<Text color="secondary">Secondary text</Text>
<Text color="placeholder">Placeholder text</Text>
<Text color="helper">Helper text</Text>
<Text color="error">Error text</Text>
<Text color="success">Success text</Text>
<Text color="link">Link text</Text>
<Text color="disabled">Disabled text</Text>
```

#### Inherit type

Set `type="inherit"` to color or weight text without resetting its size, for example inside a component slot that already has its own type style.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text, Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Automatic backups">
  <Text slot="labelA" tag="span" type="inherit" color="error">Off</Text>
  <Text slot="labelB" tag="span" type="inherit" color="success">On</Text>
</Toggle>
```

#### On-color and inverse surfaces

On-color and inverse tokens are meant for colored or inverse surfaces, where the default text tokens would be unreadable. Both read light in the white theme but track different surfaces, so they diverge in other themes. Each example places the token on the surface it is designed for.

Use `on-color` for text on a colored background, such as a button or tag fill:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box fill="brand" padding={5}>
  <Text color="on-color">Text on a colored background</Text>
</Box>
```

Use `inverse` for text on an inverse surface, such as a tooltip or notification:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box fill="inverse" padding={5}>
  <Text color="inverse">Text on an inverse surface</Text>
</Box>
```

### Type styles

Set `type` to a Carbon v11 type token. The scale covers supporting text, body copy, fixed headings for product UI, and fluid styles that scale with the viewport for editorial layouts.

| Token                | Description                                   |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `label-01`           | Form field and UI labels                      |
| `label-02`           | Label text, one step larger                   |
| `helper-text-01`     | Helper text beneath form inputs               |
| `helper-text-02`     | Helper text, one step larger                  |
| `legal-01`           | Legal and fine-print text                     |
| `legal-02`           | Legal text, one step larger                   |
| `body-compact-01`    | Dense, single-line body text                  |
| `body-compact-02`    | Dense body text, one step larger              |
| `body-01`            | Paragraph body text for multiple lines        |
| `body-02`            | Paragraph body text, one step larger          |
| `code-01`            | Inline code set in IBM Plex Mono              |
| `code-02`            | Code text, one step larger                    |
| `heading-compact-01` | Dense heading, step 1 (smallest)              |
| `heading-compact-02` | Dense heading, step 2                         |
| `heading-01`         | Heading scale, step 1                         |
| `heading-02`         | Heading scale, step 2                         |
| `heading-03`         | Heading scale, step 3                         |
| `heading-04`         | Heading scale, step 4                         |
| `heading-05`         | Heading scale, step 5                         |
| `heading-06`         | Heading scale, step 6 (light weight)          |
| `heading-07`         | Heading scale, step 7 (largest, light weight) |
| `fluid-heading-03`   | Fluid heading, step 3                         |
| `fluid-heading-04`   | Fluid heading, step 4                         |
| `fluid-heading-05`   | Fluid heading, step 5                         |
| `fluid-heading-06`   | Fluid heading, step 6 (largest)               |
| `fluid-paragraph-01` | Fluid paragraph for editorial layouts         |
| `fluid-quotation-01` | Fluid quotation set in IBM Plex Serif         |
| `fluid-quotation-02` | Quotation, one step larger                    |
| `fluid-display-01`   | Fluid display text                            |
| `fluid-display-02`   | Display text, one step larger                 |
| `fluid-display-03`   | Display text, one step larger                 |
| `fluid-display-04`   | Display text (largest)                        |

#### Supporting text

Labels, helper text, and legal text support the smallest UI elements.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text type="label-01">Label 01</Text>
<Text type="label-02">Label 02</Text>
<Text type="helper-text-01">Helper text 01</Text>
<Text type="helper-text-02">Helper text 02</Text>
<Text type="legal-01">Legal 01</Text>
<Text type="legal-02">Legal 02</Text>
```

#### Body text

`body-compact` styles suit dense, single-line text; `body` styles suit multi-line paragraphs.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text type="body-compact-01">Body compact 01</Text>
<Text type="body-compact-02">Body compact 02</Text>
<Text type="body-01">Body 01</Text>
<Text type="body-02">Body 02</Text>
```

#### Code

Set in IBM Plex Mono.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text tag="code" type="code-01">const carbon = "components-svelte";</Text>
<Text tag="pre" type="code-02">const carbon = "components-svelte";</Text>
```

#### Headings

Fixed sizes for application UI. `heading-compact` styles use tighter line heights for dense layouts.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text tag="h6" type="heading-compact-01">Heading compact 01</Text>
<Text tag="h5" type="heading-compact-02">Heading compact 02</Text>
<Text tag="h6" type="heading-01">Heading 01</Text>
<Text tag="h5" type="heading-02">Heading 02</Text>
<Text tag="h4" type="heading-03">Heading 03</Text>
<Text tag="h3" type="heading-04">Heading 04</Text>
<Text tag="h2" type="heading-05">Heading 05</Text>
<Text tag="h2" type="heading-06">Heading 06</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="heading-07">Heading 07</Text>
```

#### Fluid type

Sizes that scale with the viewport, for editorial layouts.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text type="fluid-paragraph-01">Fluid paragraph 01</Text>
<Text tag="h3" type="fluid-heading-03">Fluid heading 03</Text>
<Text tag="h2" type="fluid-heading-04">Fluid heading 04</Text>
<Text tag="h2" type="fluid-heading-05">Fluid heading 05</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="fluid-heading-06">Fluid heading 06</Text>
```

#### Quotation

Set in IBM Plex Serif.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text tag="blockquote" type="fluid-quotation-01">Quotation 01</Text>
<Text tag="blockquote" type="fluid-quotation-02">Quotation 02</Text>
```

#### Display

The largest fluid sizes, for hero moments.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text tag="h1" type="fluid-display-01">Display 01</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="fluid-display-02">Display 02</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="fluid-display-03">Display 03</Text>
<Text tag="h1" type="fluid-display-04">Display 04</Text>
```

### Custom element

Set `tag` to render a different element. Type and color apply to whichever tag you choose.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text tag="em" type="body-compact-01">Inline emphasis</Text>
<Text tag="blockquote" type="fluid-quotation-01"
  >A quotation rendered as a blockquote.</Text
>
```

### Modifiers

Set modifier props alongside a type style.

#### Weight, style, and family

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Text type="body-01" weight="light">Light weight (300)</Text>
  <Text type="body-01" weight="regular">Regular weight (400)</Text>
  <Text type="body-01" weight="semibold">Semibold weight (600)</Text>
  <Text type="body-01" italic>Italic body text</Text>
  <Text type="body-01" family="mono">IBM Plex Mono</Text>
  <Text type="body-01" family="serif">IBM Plex Serif</Text>
  <Text type="body-01" family="sans-condensed">IBM Plex Sans Condensed</Text>
  <Text type="body-01" family="sans-hebrew">IBM Plex Sans Hebrew</Text>
</Stack>
```

#### Wrapping

Set `wrap` to `break-word` to break long words, or `nowrap` to keep text on one line.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="12rem" border="subtle" padding={3}>
  <Text type="body-compact-01" wrap="break-word"
    >supercalifragilisticexpialidocious@example.com</Text
  >
</Box>
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="12rem" border="subtle" padding={3}>
  <Text type="body-compact-01" wrap="nowrap"
    >This line will not wrap to the next row.</Text
  >
</Box>
```

Set `balance` to even out line lengths across a wrapped heading.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text tag="h2" type="heading-04" balance maxWidth="20rem"
  >Balanced heading across multiple lines</Text
>
```

#### Pretty formatting

Set `pretty` to avoid a single orphaned word on the last line of a wrapped paragraph. Unlike `balance`, which evens out line lengths and suits short headings, `pretty` only adjusts the last line and works well for longer body copy.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Stack, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={6}>
  <Stack gap={2}>
    <Text type="label-01" color="secondary">Without pretty</Text>
    <Box maxWidth="13rem" border="subtle" padding={3}>
      <Text type="body-01">
        Carbon Components Svelte is a Svelte component library that implements
        the Carbon Design System, an open source design system by IBM.
      </Text>
    </Box>
  </Stack>
  <Stack gap={2}>
    <Text type="label-01" color="secondary">With pretty</Text>
    <Box maxWidth="13rem" border="subtle" padding={3}>
      <Text type="body-01" pretty>
        Carbon Components Svelte is a Svelte component library that implements
        the Carbon Design System, an open source design system by IBM.
      </Text>
    </Box>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

#### Max width and full width

Set `maxWidth` to any CSS length. Numbers are treated as pixels; strings accept units such as ch, rem, %, or px. Text fills its container by default. Width caps are opt-in -- neither maxWidth nor fullWidth applies unless you set one.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack gap={5}>
  <Text type="body-01" maxWidth="38ch">
    Character measure (`38ch`) scales with the font size and is useful for
    readable line length.
  </Text>
  <Text type="body-01" maxWidth="20rem">
    Rem-based width (`20rem`) tracks the root font size.
  </Text>
  <Text type="body-01" maxWidth={480}>
    Pixel width (`480`) when you need a fixed cap.
  </Text>
</Stack>
```

Set `fullWidth` when the row should span its container (`width: 100%`). A block element already spans its parent; use it in flex or grid layouts where width must be explicit. Pair with maxWidth when the row is full width but the copy should stay capped. Use [Box](/components/Box) for the bordered container:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box border="subtle" padding={5} fullWidth>
  <Text type="body-01" fullWidth maxWidth="38ch">
    This paragraph fills the container row but stops at 38ch.
  </Text>
</Box>
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box border="subtle" padding={5} fullWidth>
  <Text type="body-01" fullWidth>
    Without `maxWidth`, `fullWidth` stretches across the entire container.
  </Text>
</Box>
```

### Truncate

Set `lines` to truncate overflow while keeping the Carbon type style. See also [Truncate](/components/Truncate) for wrapping inline text, or the truncate action on native elements.

#### Single line

Set `lines` to `1` to truncate a single line with an ellipsis. Pair with `maxWidth` (or a constrained container) so there is a boundary to truncate against.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text type="body-compact-01" maxWidth="16rem" lines={1}>
  Carbon Components Svelte is a Svelte component library that implements the
  Carbon Design System.
</Text>
```

Set `clamp` to `"front"` to truncate from the start instead of the end. `clamp` only takes effect when `lines` is `1`; multiline mode always clamps at the end.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text type="body-compact-01" maxWidth="16rem" lines={1} clamp="front">
  Carbon Components Svelte is a Svelte component library that implements the
  Carbon Design System.
</Text>
```

#### Multiline

Values of `lines` above `1` use multiline mode (end clamp only).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Text type="body-01" maxWidth="20rem" lines={3}>
  Carbon Components Svelte is a Svelte component library that implements the
  Carbon Design System, an open source design system by IBM. It is maintained by
  the open source community and is available on npm.
</Text>
```

Alternatively, wrap inline Text with the Truncate component:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text, Truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Truncate lines={3}>
    <Text tag="span" type="body-02">
      Carbon Components Svelte is a Svelte component library that implements the
      Carbon Design System, an open source design system by IBM. It is
      maintained by the open source community and is available on npm.
    </Text>
  </Truncate>
</Box>
```

Combine type, color, and element choice as you would on an IBM product page: expressive type for editorial moments, productive type for application UI.


### Utility classes

Apply Carbon type utilities directly when you do not need the component. Classes use the `bx--` prefix.

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `bx--type-{token}` | Carbon type style. See [Type styles](#type-styles) for tokens |
| `bx--type-text-primary` | Primary text color |
| `bx--type-text-secondary` | Secondary text color |
| `bx--type-text-placeholder` | Placeholder text color |
| `bx--type-text-helper` | Helper text color |
| `bx--type-text-on-color` | Text on a colored background |
| `bx--type-text-inverse` | Text on an inverse surface |
| `bx--type-text-error` | Error text color |
| `bx--type-text-disabled` | Disabled text color |
| `bx--type-mono` | IBM Plex Mono |
| `bx--type-sans` | IBM Plex Sans |
| `bx--type-sans-condensed` | IBM Plex Sans Condensed |
| `bx--type-sans-hebrew` | IBM Plex Sans Hebrew |
| `bx--type-serif` | IBM Plex Serif |
| `bx--type-light` | Font weight 300 |
| `bx--type-regular` | Font weight 400 |
| `bx--type-semibold` | Font weight 600 |
| `bx--type-italic` | Italic |
| `bx--type-break-word` | Break long words |
| `bx--type-nowrap` | Keep text on one line |
| `bx--type-balance` | Balance line lengths |
| `bx--type-full-width` | Span the full container width (`width: 100%`) |

```svelte
<p class="bx--type-heading-02">Styled with bx--type-heading-02</p>
<p class="bx--type-body-01 bx--type-semibold">Semibold body text</p>
<p class="bx--type-body-01 bx--type-nowrap">
  Kept on one line with bx--type-nowrap
</p>
```

### Component API

#### `Text` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `"inherit" \| "label-01" \| "label-02" \| "helper-text-01" \| "helper-text-02" \| "legal-01" \| "legal-02" \| "body-compact-01" \| "body-compact-02" \| "body-01" \| "body-02" \| "code-01" \| "code-02" \| "heading-compact-01" \| "heading-compact-02" \| "heading-01" \| "heading-02" \| "heading-03" \| "heading-04" \| "heading-05" \| "heading-06" \| "heading-07" \| "fluid-heading-03" \| "fluid-heading-04" \| "fluid-heading-05" \| "fluid-heading-06" \| "fluid-paragraph-01" \| "fluid-quotation-01" \| "fluid-quotation-02" \| "fluid-display-01" \| "fluid-display-02" \| "fluid-display-03" \| "fluid-display-04"` | Set the Carbon type style. Use `"inherit"` to apply no type style and<br />keep the parent's font size, weight, and line height, for example to<br />recolor text inside a component slot. | `"body-01"` |
| `color` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "placeholder" \| "helper" \| "on-color" \| "inverse" \| "error" \| "success" \| "link" \| "disabled" \| undefined` | Set the text color using a Carbon text token. | _undefined_ |
| `weight` | `"light" \| "regular" \| "semibold" \| undefined` | Set the font weight. | _undefined_ |
| `italic` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render italic text | `false` |
| `family` | `"mono" \| "sans" \| "serif" \| "sans-condensed" \| "sans-hebrew" \| undefined` | Set the font family. | _undefined_ |
| `wrap` | `"break-word" \| "nowrap" \| undefined` | Set text wrapping behavior. | _undefined_ |
| `balance` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to balance line lengths across broken headings and short blocks | `false` |
| `pretty` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to avoid orphaned words at the end of wrapped paragraphs | `false` |
| `maxWidth` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Set the max width. Numbers are treated as pixels; strings accept any CSS length (e.g. `"38ch"`, `"20rem"`). | _undefined_ |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to span the full width of the container | `false` |
| `lines` | `number \| undefined` | Truncate text after this many lines. Values above `1` use multiline mode (end clamp only). | _undefined_ |
| `clamp` | `"end" \| "front"` | Specify `"end"` or `"front"`. `"front"` only works when `lines` is `1`. | `"end"` |
| `tag` | `Tag` | Specify the tag name. | `"p"` |

#### `Text` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Text` $$restProps

`Text` spreads `$$restProps` to the `svelte:element` element.


## TextArea

### Basic

Create a basic textarea with a label and placeholder text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  labelText="Incident summary"
  placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
/>
```

### Rows and columns

Control the visible size of the textarea.

#### Rows

Adjust visible rows with `rows`. The default is `4`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  rows={10}
  labelText="Incident summary"
  placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
/>
```

#### Columns

Adjust visible columns with `cols`. Setting `cols` disables the default resize handle; override this with the `resize` style property.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  cols={40}
  labelText="Incident summary"
  placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
/>
```

#### Grow with content

Set `grow` to expand the textarea as its content grows, using `rows` as the minimum height. Cap the height with `maxRows`; once the content exceeds it, the field scrolls instead of growing further.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  grow
  maxRows={8}
  labelText="Incident summary"
  placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
/>
```

### Maximum character count

Specify the max count with `maxCount`. It counts characters by default. A counter appears to the right of the label. Use the native maxlength attribute instead if you prefer not to show a counter.

Screen readers hear the count read as words (for example, "2 of 100 characters"), and hear "Character limit reached" once typing pauses at the limit. Override either message with the `counterText` and `limitReachedText` props.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  labelText="Incident summary"
  placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
  maxCount={100}
/>
```

#### Hidden label

The counter still shows when the label is hidden, and stays aligned to the trailing edge of the field. Prefer `hideLabel` over an empty `labelText` so the field keeps an accessible name for screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  hideLabel
  labelText="Incident summary"
  placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
  maxCount={100}
/>
```

#### Value already over the limit

`maxCount` only stops typing past the limit; it does not truncate a value that is set from script and already exceeds it. In that case the field is marked `aria-invalid` and the counter turns red, without rewriting the bound value.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  labelText="Incident summary"
  maxCount={100}
  value="A previously saved draft that happens to be well over the current one hundred character limit for this field."
/>
```

#### Word counter

Set `counterMode` to `"word"` to limit words instead of characters. The counter, the screen-reader text, and the limit announcement switch to words.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  labelText="Executive summary"
  placeholder="Summarise the incident for leadership"
  maxCount={50}
  counterMode="word"
/>
```

Words are counted with `Intl.Segmenter` where the browser supports it; older browsers split on whitespace, so a hyphenated term may count differently.

### Helper text

Add helper text below the textarea to provide additional context or instructions.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  labelText="Deployment notes"
  helperText="Include the rollback plan and any risks the on-call engineer should know about"
  placeholder="Summarize what changed and why..."
/>
```

### Select on focus

Set `selectTextOnFocus` to select the full value when the field receives focus.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  selectTextOnFocus
  labelText="Deployment notes"
  value="Rolled out v2.4.1 to production; no issues observed."
/>
```

### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  hideLabel
  labelText="Internal note"
  placeholder="Add a note visible only to the support team..."
/>
```

### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to provide custom label content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  labelText=""
  placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
>
  <strong slot="labelChildren">Incident summary</strong>
</TextArea>
```

### AI label

Put an `AILabel` in the `decorator` slot to mark the value as AI-generated. The field shows the AI gradient. See [AI label](/components/AILabel#fields) for the revert flow.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AILabel, TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  labelText="Release notes"
  value="Adds regional failover and faster cold starts."
>
  <AILabel slot="decorator">
    <p>Drafted from the merged pull requests in this release.</p>
  </AILabel>
</TextArea>
```

### On a layer

Place the component in a [`Layer`](/components/Layer) to put it on the next surface, so it contrasts with the surface below. `Layer` replaces the v10 `light` prop.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Layer, TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Layer withBackground>
  <Box padding={5}>
    <TextArea
      labelText="Incident summary"
      placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
    />
  </Box>
</Layer>
```

### Fluid

Set `fluid` to embed the label inside the field. Fluid text areas work standalone or inside [FluidForm](/components/FluidForm), which applies the variant automatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  fluid
  labelText="Change request justification"
  placeholder="Explain why this change is needed and the impact of delaying it..."
/>
```

#### Maximum character count

The character counter sits at the trailing edge of the field, opposite the embedded label.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  fluid
  labelText="Change request justification"
  placeholder="Explain why this change is needed and the impact of delaying it..."
  maxCount={100}
/>
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to render custom label content, such as a tooltip icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea, TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Information from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Information.svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  fluid
  labelText="Change request justification"
  placeholder="Explain why this change is needed and the impact of delaying it..."
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
    Change request justification
    <TooltipIcon
      tooltipText="Include the business impact and urgency to help the approver prioritize this request."
      icon={Information}
    />
  </svelte:fragment>
</TextArea>
```

#### Invalid

Fluid text areas display the error message inside the field boundary. Long messages wrap to multiple lines.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  fluid
  invalid
  invalidText="Justification must be at least 20 characters. HTML tags, markdown formatting, and special characters will be stripped from your submission."
  labelText="Change request justification"
  placeholder="Explain why this change is needed and the impact of delaying it..."
/>
```

#### Warning

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  fluid
  warn
  warnText="This justification is shorter than typically approved for high-risk changes"
  labelText="Change request justification"
  placeholder="Explain why this change is needed and the impact of delaying it..."
/>
```

#### Disabled

Invalid and warning states are not displayed while the text area is disabled.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  fluid
  disabled
  invalid
  invalidText="Justification must be at least 20 characters"
  labelText="Change request justification"
  placeholder="Explain why this change is needed and the impact of delaying it..."
/>
```

#### Read-only

Invalid and warning states are not displayed while the text area is read-only.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  fluid
  readonly
  warn
  warnText="This justification is shorter than typically approved"
  labelText="Change request justification"
  value="Rolling back the payments-service deployment due to elevated error rates."
/>
```

#### Skeleton

Display a loading skeleton for the fluid text area variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { FluidTextAreaSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<FluidTextAreaSkeleton />
```

### States

Reflect validation and interaction states.

#### Invalid

Show validation errors with `invalid` and a message in `invalidText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  invalid
  invalidText="Summary must be at least 20 characters"
  labelText="Incident summary"
  placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
/>
```

#### Warning

Show a warning with `warn` and a message in `warnText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  warn
  warnText="This summary is shorter than recommended for a post-incident review"
  labelText="Incident summary"
  placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
/>
```

#### Disabled

Disable the textarea with `disabled`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  disabled
  labelText="Incident summary"
  placeholder="Describe what happened, the impact, and any mitigation steps taken so far..."
/>
```

#### Read-only

Display a non-editable value with `readonly`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextArea } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextArea
  readonly
  labelText="Incident summary"
  value="Database connection pool exhausted during peak traffic; scaled up replicas to mitigate."
/>
```

### Skeleton

Show a loading state with the default skeleton variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextAreaSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextAreaSkeleton />
```

#### Without label

Show a loading state without a label by setting `hideLabel` to `true`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextAreaSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextAreaSkeleton hideLabel />
```

### Component API

#### `TextArea` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (Reactive) | `null \| string` | Specify the textarea value.<br />Follows the field when the owning form resets. | `""` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLTextAreaElement` | Obtain a reference to the textarea HTML element. | `null` |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Specify the placeholder text | `""` |
| `cols` | `number \| undefined` | Specify the number of cols.<br />If specified, the textarea will not be resizable.<br />Override this using the `resize` style attribute. | _undefined_ |
| `rows` | `number` | Specify the number of rows | `4` |
| `grow` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to grow the textarea with its content.<br />`rows` is the minimum height. Default `false`. | `false` |
| `maxRows` | `number \| undefined` | Maximum number of rows when `grow` is `true`.<br />Unset means the field grows without a cap. | _undefined_ |
| `maxCount` | `number \| undefined` | Specify the max count.<br />Counts characters by default; see `counterMode`. | _undefined_ |
| `counterMode` | `"character" \| "word"` | Specify what `maxCount` limits.<br />`"word"` counts words with `Intl.Segmenter` when available. | `"character"` |
| `counterText` | `((count: number, max: number) => string) \| undefined` | Override the counter text read by screen readers. | ``${count} of ${max} characters`, or `${count} of ${max} words` when `counterMode` is `"word"`` |
| `limitReachedText` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the text announced when the limit is reached. | `"Character limit reached", or "Word limit reached" when `counterMode`is`"word"`` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the input | `false` |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the read-only variant | `false` |
| `helperText` | `string` | Specify the helper text | `""` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text | `false` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state | `false` |
| `invalidText` | `string` | Specify the text for the invalid state | `""` |
| `warn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate a warning state | `false` |
| `warnText` | `string` | Specify the warning state text | `""` |
| `fluid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the fluid variant.<br />Inherited from the parent `FluidForm` context,<br />so it does not need to be set when used inside `FluidForm`. | `false` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the textarea element | `uniqueId()` |
| `name` | `string \| undefined` | Specify a name attribute for the input. | _undefined_ |
| `selectTextOnFocus` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to select the textarea's text when it receives focus | `false` |

## TextInput

### Basic

Create a basic text input with a label and placeholder text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput labelText="Workspace name" placeholder="Enter workspace name..." />
```

### Helper text

Add helper text below the input to provide additional context or instructions.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  labelText="Workspace name"
  helperText="This name appears in your workspace URL and can be changed later in settings"
  placeholder="Enter workspace name..."
/>
```

### Hidden label

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  hideLabel
  labelText="Workspace name"
  placeholder="Enter workspace name..."
/>
```

### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to provide custom label content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput labelText="" placeholder="Enter workspace name...">
  <strong slot="labelChildren">Workspace name</strong>
</TextInput>
```

### Maximum character count

Specify the max character count with `maxCount`. A character counter appears to the right of the label. Use the native maxlength attribute instead if you prefer not to show a counter.

Screen readers hear the count read as words (for example, "3 of 10 characters"), and hear "Character limit reached" once typing pauses at the limit. Override either message with the `counterText` and `limitReachedText` props.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput labelText="Tag name" placeholder="Enter tag name..." maxCount={10} />
```

### Events

Respond to value changes.

#### Value change

Use `on:input` to listen for every keystroke, and `on:change` to listen for committed changes on blur. Both events dispatch the current value directly as `event.detail`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  labelText="Workspace name"
  placeholder="Enter workspace name..."
  on:input={(e) => console.log(e.detail)}
  // string | null
  on:change={(e) => console.log(e.detail)} // string | null
/>
```

#### Numeric values

Set the native `type` attribute to `"number"` to parse `value` as a number. The bound value--and the event detail dispatched by `on:input` and `on:change`--is `null` when the input is empty, otherwise a `number`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  type="number"
  labelText="Port number"
  placeholder="Enter port number..."
/>
```

### Select on focus

Set `selectTextOnFocus` to select the full value when the field receives focus.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  selectTextOnFocus
  labelText="Workspace name"
  value="acme-production"
/>
```

#### Native text fields

`TextInput`, `TextArea`, `NumberInput`, `Search`, and the other text fields keep the selection after a click in Safari, where the `mouseup` that ends a click would collapse it. For a native field you build yourself, use the `preserveFocusSelection` action. It does not select anything itself: select the text in your own `focus` handler and pass `true` to turn the action on.

```svelte
<script>
  import { preserveFocusSelection } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let value = "prod-us-east-1";
</script>

<label class="bx--label" for="cluster-name">Cluster name</label>
<input
  id="cluster-name"
  class="bx--text-input"
  bind:value
  on:focus={(e) => e.currentTarget.select()}
  use:preserveFocusSelection={true}
/>
```

The action takes a boolean, so pass an expression to turn it on and off. Pass `false` when the field is disabled or when selecting on focus is switched off, which mirrors how [TimePicker](/components/TimePicker) applies it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { preserveFocusSelection, Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selectTextOnFocus = true;
  let disabled = false;
  let value = "prod-us-east-1";
</script>

<Toggle bind:toggled={selectTextOnFocus} labelText="Select text on focus" />
<Toggle bind:toggled={disabled} labelText="Disabled" />

<label class="bx--label" for="cluster-name-toggle">Cluster name</label>
<input
  id="cluster-name-toggle"
  class="bx--text-input"
  bind:value
  {disabled}
  on:focus={(e) => {
    if (selectTextOnFocus) e.currentTarget.select();
  }}
  use:preserveFocusSelection={selectTextOnFocus && !disabled}
/>
```

### AI label

Put an `AILabel` in the `decorator` slot to mark the value as AI-generated. The field shows the AI gradient. See [AI label](/components/AILabel#fields) for the revert flow.

```svelte
<script>
  import { AILabel, TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput labelText="Workspace name" value="analytics-prod">
  <AILabel slot="decorator">
    <p>Suggested from the project you selected.</p>
  </AILabel>
</TextInput>
```

### On a layer

Place the component in a [`Layer`](/components/Layer) to put it on the next surface, so it contrasts with the surface below. `Layer` replaces the v10 `light` prop.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Layer, TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Layer withBackground>
  <Box padding={5}>
    <TextInput
      labelText="Workspace name"
      placeholder="Enter workspace name..."
    />
  </Box>
</Layer>
```

### Fluid

Use the fluid variant with `fluid`, which embeds the label inside the field. Fluid text inputs can be used standalone or inside [FluidForm](/components/FluidForm), where the fluid variant is applied automatically. The fluid variant cannot be combined with the inline variant.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  fluid
  labelText="Workspace name"
  placeholder="Enter workspace name..."
/>
```

#### Maximum character count

The character counter sits at the trailing edge of the field, opposite the embedded label.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  fluid
  labelText="Region code"
  placeholder="Enter region code..."
  maxCount={10}
/>
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to render custom label content, such as a tooltip icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TextInput, TooltipIcon } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Information from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Information.svelte";
</script>

<TextInput
  fluid
  labelText="Workspace name"
  placeholder="Enter workspace name..."
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
    Workspace name
    <TooltipIcon
      tooltipText="This name is also used to generate your workspace's URL."
      icon={Information}
    />
  </svelte:fragment>
</TextInput>
```

#### Invalid

Fluid text inputs display the error message inside the field boundary. Long messages wrap to multiple lines.

```svelte
<script>

  fluid
  invalid
  invalidText="This workspace name is already taken. Please choose a different name that is not in use by another organization on this platform."
  labelText="Workspace name"
  placeholder="Enter workspace name..."
/>
```

Invalid and warning states are not displayed while the input is read-only.

### Sizes

Set `size` to control input height. The default is `md`.

Carbon v11's names also work. `"md"` sets the 40px default explicitly, even inside a sized `Form`, and `"lg"` renders as `"xl"`.

#### Extra-large

```svelte
  size="xl"
  labelText="Workspace name"
  placeholder="Enter workspace name..."
/>
```

```svelte
<TextInput

  labelText="Workspace name"
  placeholder="Enter workspace name..."
/>
```
