## Toggle

### Basic

Display a basic toggle in its untoggled state by default.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Email notifications" />
```

### Toggled

Display the toggle in its on state with `toggled`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Auto-save" toggled />
```

### Labels

Customize or hide the toggle labels.

#### Hidden

Hide the label visually by setting `hideLabel` to `true`. The label remains available to screen readers.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Dark mode" hideLabel />
```

#### Custom

Customize toggle labels with `labelA` and `labelB`. The toggle's width includes the longer of the two, so it does not shift neighboring content when the state changes. Set both to `""` to show the switch alone.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Maintenance mode" labelA="No" labelB="Yes" />
```

#### Slottable

Use slots to customize the toggle labels with additional styling or content.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Text, Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Two-factor authentication">
  <Text slot="labelA" tag="span" type="inherit" color="error">No</Text>
  <Text slot="labelB" tag="span" type="inherit" color="success">Yes</Text>
</Toggle>
```

#### Custom label

Use the `labelChildren` slot to provide custom label content instead of `labelText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Fallback label">
  <svelte:fragment slot="labelChildren">
    Automatic security updates <strong>(recommended)</strong>
  </svelte:fragment>
</Toggle>
```

### States

Reflect validation and interaction states.

#### Helper text

Set `helperText` to explain what the setting does. It shows under the switch and describes it for assistive technology.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle
  labelText="Auto-scaling"
  helperText="Adds instances when CPU stays over 70%"
/>
```

#### Invalid

Set `invalid` to `true` and provide `invalidText` when the setting must change before the form can be submitted, such as accepting terms. An invalid state takes precedence over a warning and replaces the helper text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle
  labelText="Accept the terms"
  invalid
  invalidText="Accept the terms to continue"
/>
```

#### Warning

Set `warn` to `true` and provide `warnText` when a setting is valid but has consequences worth calling out. Tie `warn` to the state it describes so the message clears when the toggle changes.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let toggled = true;
</script>

<Toggle
  labelText="Public link sharing"
  bind:toggled
  warn={toggled}
  warnText="Anyone with the link can view this workspace."
/>
```

#### Disabled

Disable interaction with `disabled`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Enforce single sign-on (SSO)" disabled />
```

#### Read-only

Display a non-editable value with `readonly`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle readonly toggled labelText="Session timeout enforcement (on)" />
```

### Small

Use the small size variant by setting `size` to `"sm"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle size="sm" labelText="Compact density" />
```

### Reactive

Use two-way binding with `bind:toggled` to track and update the toggle state programmatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack, Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let toggled = true;
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Toggle labelText="Push notifications" bind:toggled />
  <div>
    <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" on:click={() => (toggled = !toggled)}>
      Toggle
      {toggled ? "off" : "on"}
    </Button>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Events

Use `on:toggle` to listen for state changes. The event dispatches `{ toggled: boolean }` as `event.detail`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggle } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggle labelText="Email digest" on:toggle={(e) => console.log(e.detail)} />
```

### Form value

Set `name` so the toggle submits with the form. A toggled switch submits `value` (`"on"` by default); an untoggled one submits nothing, so read it on the server with `formData.has(name)` or compare against `value`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Form, Toggle, Button } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Form method="POST" action="?/preferences">
  <Toggle name="digest" value="weekly" labelText="Weekly digest" />
  <Button type="submit">Save</Button>
</Form>
```

### Skeleton

Show a loading state with the skeleton component.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleSkeleton />
```

#### Small

Use the small size variant for the skeleton component.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleSkeleton size="sm" />
```

---

### Component API

#### `Toggle` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `toggled` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to toggle the checkbox input.<br />Follows the switch when the owning form resets. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLInputElement` | Obtain a reference to the input HTML element. | `null` |
| `size` | `"default" \| "sm" \| "md"` | Specify the toggle size.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"` (`"default"`). | `"default"` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable checkbox input | `false` |
| `labelA` | `string` | Specify the label for the untoggled state | `"Off"` |
| `labelB` | `string` | Specify the label for the toggled state | `"On"` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text | `false` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the input element | `uniqueId()` |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the read-only variant | `false` |
| `readonlyText` | `string` | Specify the assistive text announced to screen readers when read-only.<br />Exposed because VoiceOver does not announce `aria-readonly`. | `"Read-only"` |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate an invalid state | `false` |
| `invalidText` | `string` | Specify the invalid state text | `""` |
| `warn` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to indicate a warning state | `false` |
| `warnText` | `string` | Specify the warning state text | `""` |
| `helperText` | `string` | Specify the helper text, shown under the switch | `""` |
| `name` | `string \| undefined` | Specify a name attribute for the checkbox input. | _undefined_ |
| `form` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the id of a form element outside the component to associate<br />the checkbox with. | _undefined_ |
| `value` | `string` | Specify the value submitted with the form while toggled. | `"on"` |

#### `Toggle` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `labelA`        | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelB`        | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Toggle` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:change`     |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:keyup`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `Toggle` dispatched events

| Event       | Detail                 |
| ----------- | ---------------------- |
| `on:toggle` | `{ toggled: boolean }` |

#### `Toggle` $$restProps

`Toggle` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `ToggleSkeleton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"default" \| "sm" \| "md"` | Specify the toggle size.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"md"` (`"default"`). | `"default"` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text | `false` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the input element | `uniqueId()` |

#### `ToggleSkeleton` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToggleSkeleton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ToggleSkeleton` $$restProps

`ToggleSkeleton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## ToggleButtonGroup

### Selection

#### Multiple (default)

A group of pressable buttons where zero, one, or many can be pressed at once, for immediate-effect on/off commands like text formatting, map-layer visibility, or chart-series toggles. Wrap `ToggleButton` components in a `ToggleButtonGroup` and give each a unique `value`.

The root renders `role="toolbar"`. Set `labelText` or `aria-label` so assistive technologies get a meaningful name, since there is no visible label otherwise. Arrow keys move focus between buttons, wrapping at the ends and skipping disabled ones, without changing the selection; Space/Enter presses the focused button.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="underline">Underline</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Initial selection

Set `selected` to pre-press one or more buttons.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup selected={["bold"]} labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="underline">Underline</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Single

Set `selectionMode="single"` so at most one button is pressed. Pressing the pressed button clears the selection.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup selectionMode="single" labelText="Alignment">
  <ToggleButton value="left">Left</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="center">Center</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="right">Right</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Required

Set `required` so the last pressed button can't be cleared. Works in both `multiple` and `single` mode.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup
  selectionMode="single"
  required
  selected={["center"]}
  labelText="Alignment (required)"
>
  <ToggleButton value="left">Left</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="center">Center</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="right">Right</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Reactive

`selected` is bindable and always an array, even in `single` mode.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Stack,
    ToggleButton,
    ToggleButtonGroup,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let selected = ["bold"];
</script>

<Stack gap={6} align="start">
  <ToggleButtonGroup labelText="Text formatting" bind:selected>
    <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
    <ToggleButton value="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
    <ToggleButton value="underline">Underline</ToggleButton>
  </ToggleButtonGroup>
  <p>Selected: {selected.join(", ") || "none"}</p>
  <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" on:click={() => (selected = [])}>
    Clear selection
  </Button>
</Stack>
```

### Content

#### Text

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Icon-only

An icon-only button needs `iconDescription`, which becomes both the accessible label and the hover/focus tooltip text. Press <kbd>Escape</kbd> to hide the tooltip without moving the pointer or focus. It shows again on the next hover or focus.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TextBold from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextBold.svelte";
  import TextItalic from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextItalic.svelte";
  import TextUnderline from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextUnderline.svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold" icon={TextBold} iconDescription="Bold" />
  <ToggleButton value="italic" icon={TextItalic} iconDescription="Italic" />
  <ToggleButton
    value="underline"
    icon={TextUnderline}
    iconDescription="Underline"
  />
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Custom tooltip position

Set `tooltipAlign` on `ToggleButton` to control where its tooltip appears, with Popover's `align` names. It replaces `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`, which still work and are deprecated.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TextBold from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextBold.svelte";
  import TextItalic from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextItalic.svelte";
  import TextUnderline from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextUnderline.svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton
    value="bold"
    icon={TextBold}
    iconDescription="Bold"
    tooltipAlign="top-start"
  />
  <ToggleButton
    value="italic"
    icon={TextItalic}
    iconDescription="Italic"
    tooltipAlign="top"
  />
  <ToggleButton
    value="underline"
    icon={TextUnderline}
    iconDescription="Underline"
    tooltipAlign="top-end"
  />
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### With icon

Set `icon` alongside default slot content to render both.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TextBold from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextBold.svelte";
  import TextItalic from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextItalic.svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold" icon={TextBold}>Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic" icon={TextItalic}>Italic</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

### Grid

Set `grid` to `true` to lay the buttons out as an even grid that wraps onto as many rows as it needs, such as for time slots. Columns are at least 5rem wide, so their number follows the width of the container. <kbd>↑</kbd> and <kbd>↓</kbd> move between rows.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup
  labelText="Appointment time"
  size="sm"
  selectionMode="single"
  grid
>
  <ToggleButton value="0900">9:00 AM</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="0930">9:30 AM</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="1000" disabled>10:00 AM</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="1030">10:30 AM</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="1100">11:00 AM</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="1400">2:00 PM</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="1430">2:30 PM</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="1500">3:00 PM</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to `"sm"`, `"md"` (default), or `"lg"`.

#### Small

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup size="sm" labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Large

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup size="lg" labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

### Layout

#### Vertical

Set `orientation="vertical"` to stack the buttons and use Up/Down to move focus instead of Left/Right. Text is left-aligned in this orientation.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup orientation="vertical" labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="underline">Underline</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Small

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup orientation="vertical" size="sm" labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="underline">Underline</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Large

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup orientation="vertical" size="lg" labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="underline">Underline</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Icon-only

The tooltip defaults to the right in a vertical group instead of `"bottom"`, since a bottom tooltip would land on the next stacked segment. Set `tooltipAlign` on `ToggleButton` to override it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TextBold from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextBold.svelte";
  import TextItalic from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextItalic.svelte";
  import TextUnderline from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextUnderline.svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup orientation="vertical" labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold" icon={TextBold} iconDescription="Bold" />
  <ToggleButton value="italic" icon={TextItalic} iconDescription="Italic" />
  <ToggleButton
    value="underline"
    icon={TextUnderline}
    iconDescription="Underline"
  />
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Custom tooltip position

Override the `"right"` default with `tooltipAlign`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TextBold from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextBold.svelte";
  import TextItalic from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextItalic.svelte";
  import TextUnderline from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextUnderline.svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup orientation="vertical" labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton
    value="bold"
    icon={TextBold}
    iconDescription="Bold"
    tooltipAlign="right-start"
  />
  <ToggleButton
    value="italic"
    icon={TextItalic}
    iconDescription="Italic"
    tooltipAlign="right"
  />
  <ToggleButton
    value="underline"
    icon={TextUnderline}
    iconDescription="Underline"
    tooltipAlign="right-end"
  />
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### With icon

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TextBold from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextBold.svelte";
  import TextItalic from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextItalic.svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup orientation="vertical" labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold" icon={TextBold}>Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic" icon={TextItalic}>Italic</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

### States

#### Disabled buttons

Set `disabled` on an individual `ToggleButton` to disable just that segment. Arrow-key navigation skips it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic" disabled>Italic</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="underline">Underline</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

#### Disabled group

Set `disabled` on `ToggleButtonGroup` to disable every button.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup disabled labelText="Text formatting">
  <ToggleButton value="bold">Bold</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton value="italic">Italic</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

### Rich text editor toolbar

Compose `ToggleButtonGroup` with other components for a realistic toolbar. `Dropdown` handles the paragraph style picker, since it has many mutually exclusive options rather than a small icon set. `Button` handles undo, redo, and inserting a link, since those are momentary actions rather than persistent on/off state.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Button,
    Divider,
    Dropdown,
    ToggleButton,
    ToggleButtonGroup,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Link from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Link.svelte";
  import ListBulleted from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/ListBulleted.svelte";
  import ListNumbered from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/ListNumbered.svelte";
  import Redo from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Redo.svelte";
  import TextAlignCenter from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextAlignCenter.svelte";
  import TextAlignLeft from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextAlignLeft.svelte";
  import TextAlignRight from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextAlignRight.svelte";
  import TextBold from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextBold.svelte";
  import TextItalic from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextItalic.svelte";
  import TextStrikethrough from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextStrikethrough.svelte";
  import TextUnderline from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextUnderline.svelte";
  import Undo from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Undo.svelte";

  const paragraphStyles = [
    { id: "paragraph", text: "Paragraph" },
    { id: "h1", text: "Heading 1" },
    { id: "h2", text: "Heading 2" },
    { id: "h3", text: "Heading 3" },
  ];

  let paragraphStyle = "paragraph";
  let formatting = ["bold"];
  let alignment = ["left"];
  let list = [];
</script>

<Box
  display="inline-flex"
  align="center"
  gap={3}
  padding={2}
  fill="layer-01"
  border="subtle"
>
  <Button kind="ghost" size="small" icon={Undo} iconDescription="Undo" />
  <Button kind="ghost" size="small" icon={Redo} iconDescription="Redo" />

  <Divider orientation="vertical" />

  <Dropdown
    type="inline"
    size="sm"
    hideLabel
    labelText="Paragraph style"
    items={paragraphStyles}
    bind:selectedId={paragraphStyle}
  />

  <Divider orientation="vertical" />

  <ToggleButtonGroup
    size="sm"
    labelText="Text formatting"
    bind:selected={formatting}
  >
    <ToggleButton value="bold" icon={TextBold} iconDescription="Bold" />
    <ToggleButton value="italic" icon={TextItalic} iconDescription="Italic" />
    <ToggleButton
      value="underline"
      icon={TextUnderline}
      iconDescription="Underline"
    />
    <ToggleButton
      value="strikethrough"
      icon={TextStrikethrough}
      iconDescription="Strikethrough"
    />
  </ToggleButtonGroup>

  <Divider orientation="vertical" />

  <ToggleButtonGroup
    size="sm"
    selectionMode="single"
    required
    labelText="Text alignment"
    bind:selected={alignment}
  >
    <ToggleButton
      value="left"
      icon={TextAlignLeft}
      iconDescription="Align left"
    />
    <ToggleButton
      value="center"
      icon={TextAlignCenter}
      iconDescription="Align center"
    />
    <ToggleButton
      value="right"
      icon={TextAlignRight}
      iconDescription="Align right"
    />
  </ToggleButtonGroup>

  <Divider orientation="vertical" />

  <ToggleButtonGroup
    size="sm"
    selectionMode="single"
    labelText="Lists"
    bind:selected={list}
  >
    <ToggleButton
      value="bulleted"
      icon={ListBulleted}
      iconDescription="Bulleted list"
    />
    <ToggleButton
      value="numbered"
      icon={ListNumbered}
      iconDescription="Numbered list"
    />
  </ToggleButtonGroup>

  <Divider orientation="vertical" />

  <Button kind="ghost" size="small" icon={Link} iconDescription="Insert link" />
</Box>
```

### Tool palette

A vertical, icon-only, single-select group works well for a compact tool palette like Photoshop's or Figma's.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Crop from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Crop.svelte";
  import Eyedropper from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Eyedropper.svelte";
  import Move from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Move.svelte";
  import PaintBrush from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/PaintBrush.svelte";
  import Pen from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Pen.svelte";
  import SelectWindow from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/SelectWindow.svelte";
  import Shapes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Shapes.svelte";
  import TextFont from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TextFont.svelte";

  let tool = ["move"];
</script>

<ToggleButtonGroup
  orientation="vertical"
  selectionMode="single"
  required
  labelText="Tools"
  bind:selected={tool}
>
  <ToggleButton value="move" icon={Move} iconDescription="Move" />
  <ToggleButton value="select" icon={SelectWindow} iconDescription="Select" />
  <ToggleButton value="crop" icon={Crop} iconDescription="Crop" />
  <ToggleButton value="brush" icon={PaintBrush} iconDescription="Brush" />
  <ToggleButton value="pen" icon={Pen} iconDescription="Pen" />
  <ToggleButton value="shapes" icon={Shapes} iconDescription="Shapes" />
  <ToggleButton value="text" icon={TextFont} iconDescription="Text" />
  <ToggleButton
    value="eyedropper"
    icon={Eyedropper}
    iconDescription="Eyedropper"
  />
```

### Custom toolbars

`ToggleButtonGroup` gives its buttons a single tab stop and moves between them with arrow keys. For a toolbar or tab list you build yourself, use the `rovingFocus` action on the container. Pass a `selector` that matches the items, a `getActiveIndex` function that returns the current index, and an `onMove` callback that stores the next index.

#### Arrow keys

Press <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd> or <kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> to move between items, and <kbd>Home</kbd> or <kbd>End</kbd> to jump to the first or last item. Set `focusOnMove` to `true` so the action focuses the new item. Give only the active item `tabindex="0"` and the rest `tabindex="-1"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, rovingFocus, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const actions = ["Restart", "Scale", "Rollback", "Delete"];
  let active = 0;
</script>

<Stack as orientation="horizontal" gap={3} let:props>
  <div
    {...props}
    role="toolbar"
    aria-label="Deployment actions"
    use:rovingFocus={{
      selector: "button",
      getActiveIndex: () => active,
      onMove: (index) => (active = index),
      focusOnMove: true,
    }}
  >
    {#each actions as action, i}
      <Button
        kind="tertiary"
        size="small"
        tabindex={i === active ? 0 : -1}
        on:focus={() => (active = i)}
      >
        {action}
      </Button>
    {/each}
  </div>
</Stack>
```

#### Orientation

Set `orientation` to `"vertical"` to respond to <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> and <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> instead. Set it to `"both"` to respond to all four arrow keys, which suits a grid of items.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Button, rovingFocus, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const environments = ["Production", "Staging", "Development"];
  let active = 0;
</script>

<Box width="12rem">
  <Stack as gap={3} let:props>
    <div
      {...props}
      role="toolbar"
      aria-orientation="vertical"
      aria-label="Environments"
      use:rovingFocus={{
        selector: "button",
        orientation: "vertical",
        getActiveIndex: () => active,
        onMove: (index) => (active = index),
        focusOnMove: true,
      }}
    >
      {#each environments as environment, i}
        <Button
          kind="tertiary"
          size="small"
          tabindex={i === active ? 0 : -1}
          on:focus={() => (active = i)}
        >
          {environment}
        </Button>
      {/each}
    </div>
  </Stack>
</Box>
```

#### Wrapping and disabled items

Focus wraps from the last item to the first by default. Set `wrap` to `false` to stop at the ends. Set `skipDisabled` to `true` to skip items that are disabled or have `aria-disabled`, so the arrow keys never land on them.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, rovingFocus, Stack } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const actions = [
    { label: "Restart", disabled: false },
    { label: "Scale", disabled: true },
    { label: "Rollback", disabled: false },
    { label: "Delete", disabled: false },
  ];
  let active = 0;
</script>

<Stack as orientation="horizontal" gap={3} let:props>
  <div
    {...props}
    role="toolbar"
    aria-label="Deployment actions"
    use:rovingFocus={{
      selector: "button",
      wrap: false,
      skipDisabled: true,
      getActiveIndex: () => active,
      onMove: (index) => (active = index),
      focusOnMove: true,
    }}
  >
    {#each actions as action, i}
      <Button
        kind="tertiary"
        size="small"
        disabled={action.disabled}
        tabindex={i === active ? 0 : -1}
        on:focus={() => (active = i)}
      >
        {action.label}
      </Button>
    {/each}
  </div>
</Stack>
```

---

### Component API

#### `ToggleButtonGroup` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` (Reactive) | `ReadonlyArray<Value>` | Set the values of the pressed buttons.<br />Always an array, even in `single` mode (0 or 1 entries). | `[]` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the HTML element. | `null` |
| `selectionMode` | `"multiple" \| "single"` | Specify the selection behavior. `single` allows at most one pressed<br />button; pressing the pressed button clears it unless `required` is set. | `"multiple"` |
| `required` | `boolean` | Set to `true` so the last pressed button can't be un-pressed | `false` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Specify the size of the buttons. | `"md"` |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | Specify the orientation of the group. | `"horizontal"` |
| `grid` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to lay the buttons out as an even grid that wraps onto<br />as many rows as it needs, such as for time slots. Columns are at<br />least 5rem wide, so the count follows the width of the container.<br />Up and Down move between rows. Has no effect on a vertical group. | `false` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable all buttons in the group | `false` |
| `labelText` | `string \| undefined` | Accessible name for the group.<br />Prefer setting this (or `aria-label`) since the root has no visible<br />label of its own. | _undefined_ |

#### `ToggleButtonGroup` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToggleButtonGroup` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ToggleButtonGroup` dispatched events

| Event       | Detail                 |
| ----------- | ---------------------- |
| `on:change` | `ReadonlyArray<Value>` |

#### `ToggleButtonGroup` $$restProps

`ToggleButtonGroup` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.

#### `ToggleButton` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLButtonElement` | Obtain a reference to the HTML element. | `null` |
| `value` | `string \| number` | Specify the value used to identify this button in the group's `selected` array. | `""` |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify the icon to render.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "icon". | _undefined_ |
| `iconDescription` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the accessible label for an icon-only button.<br />Required when no default slot content is provided; also used as the<br />hover/focus tooltip text. | _undefined_ |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable this button | `false` |
| `tooltipAlign` | `"top" \| "top-start" \| "top-end" \| "bottom" \| "bottom-start" \| "bottom-end" \| "left" \| "left-start" \| "left-end" \| "right" \| "right-start" \| "right-end" \| undefined` | Set the tooltip placement in floating-ui form: the side, then `start`<br />or `end` along it, as Popover's `align` takes. Above and below,<br />`start` and `end` name inline sides, so they swap under `dir="rtl"`.<br />When set, takes precedence over `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipPosition` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left" \| undefined` | Set the position of the portalled tooltip relative to the icon. Icon-only buttons only.<br />Defaults to `"bottom"` when the group is horizontal and `"right"` when<br />vertical, since a top/bottom tooltip would otherwise land on top of the<br />next stacked segment. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipAlignment` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the portalled tooltip relative to the icon. Icon-only buttons only. | `"center"` |

#### `ToggleButton` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `icon`    | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToggleButton` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ToggleButton` $$restProps

`ToggleButton` spreads `$$restProps` to the `button` element.


## Toggletip

### Basic

Unlike a tooltip, a toggletip opens and closes on click. Click the button to toggle the content. Press <kbd>Escape</kbd> or click outside to close it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip>
  API keys are limited to 1,000 requests per minute. Requests beyond this limit
  return an HTTP 429 status until the next window.
</Toggletip>
```

### Reactive example

Control the toggletip state programmatically by binding to `open`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = true;
</script>

<Stack gap={12} align="start">
  <Toggletip bind:open labelText="Resource list" align="start">
    Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.
  </Toggletip>
  <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" on:click={() => (open = !open)}>
    {open ? "Close toggletip" : "Open toggletip"}
  </Button>
</Stack>
```

### Custom labels

Customize the toggletip's visible label and the button's accessible name.

#### Label prop

Render an inline label beside the button using the `labelText` prop.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip labelText="Density">
  Controls the row height and spacing across tables in this workspace.
</Toggletip>
```

#### Label slot

Alternatively, use the `labelChildren` slot for custom markup.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip>
  <strong slot="labelChildren">Density</strong>
  Controls the row height and spacing across tables in this workspace.
</Toggletip>
```

#### Accessible label

Set the button's ARIA label with `iconDescription`. It defaults to `"Show information"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip iconDescription="Density settings">
  Controls the row height and spacing across tables in this workspace.
</Toggletip>
```

### Actions

Use `ToggletipFooter` to render one or two actions at the base of the content.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Link,
    Toggletip,
    ToggletipFooter,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip>
  Your billing cycle renews on the 1st of each month. Usage-based charges are
  calculated at the end of the cycle.
  <ToggletipFooter>
    <Link href="#">View invoices</Link>
    <Button size="small">Manage billing</Button>
  </ToggletipFooter>
</Toggletip>
```

### Custom icon

#### Component

Pass an icon component to the `icon` prop.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip icon={Add} iconDescription="Add environment variable">
  Environment variables are encrypted at rest and injected into your build at
  deploy time.
</Toggletip>
```

#### Slot

Alternatively, use the `"icon"` slot.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
</script>

<Toggletip iconDescription="Add environment variable">
  <Add slot="icon" />
  Environment variables are encrypted at rest and injected into your build at deploy
  time.
</Toggletip>
```

### Placement

Position the content with `direction` (`"top"`, `"right"`, `"bottom"`, `"left"`) and `align` (`"start"`, `"center"`, `"end"`). The defaults are `direction="bottom"` and `align="center"`.

#### Directions

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={10}>
  <Toggletip direction="top">top</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip direction="right">right</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip direction="bottom">bottom</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip direction="left">left</Toggletip>
</Stack>
```

#### Alignment

With `align` set to `"start"` or `"end"`, the caret points at the button's center whatever its size. If the content would run past its container, such as a table's scroll area, it opens toward the other side. Above and below the button, `start` and `end` swap sides in RTL. See [LayoutDirection](/components/LayoutDirection#tooltips-and-popovers).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={10}>
  <Toggletip direction="bottom" align="start">start</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip direction="bottom" align="center">center</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip direction="bottom" align="end">end</Toggletip>
</Stack>
```

### Portal

Content that a container would cut off, such as a box with `overflow: hidden` or a scroll area, opens in a portal. Inside a Modal, the content always opens in a portal.

Set `portalTooltip` to `true` to always render the content in a portal, or to `false` to keep it in place. Portalled content leaves its container in the DOM, so CSS that targets it as a descendant of the container does not match it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box padding={5} border="subtle" maxWidth="8rem" overflow="hidden">
  <Toggletip portalTooltip>
    Deleting this workspace also removes its API keys, webhooks, and audit logs.
  </Toggletip>
</Box>
```

#### Directions

Portalled content supports every `direction`. The portal flips to the opposite side when there is not enough space.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={10}>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="top">top</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="right">right</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="bottom">bottom</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="left">left</Toggletip>
</Stack>
```

#### Alignment

Portalled content supports every `align` value.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Toggletip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={10}>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="bottom" align="start">start</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="bottom" align="center">center</Toggletip>
  <Toggletip portalTooltip direction="bottom" align="end">end</Toggletip>
</Stack>
```

### Inside a modal

When a toggletip is used inside a [Modal](/components/Modal), the content is portalled by default so it is not clipped by the modal overflow or z-index stacking. Set `portalTooltip` to override this behavior.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Link,
    Modal,
    Portal,
    Stack,
    Toggletip,
    ToggletipFooter,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button>

<Portal>
  <Modal
    bind:open
    passiveModal
    modalHeading="Toggletip in modal"
    on:close={() => (open = false)}
  >
    <Stack orientation="horizontal" align="center" gap={3}>
      Resource list
      <Toggletip>
        Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.
        <ToggletipFooter>
          <Link href="#">Learn more</Link>
          <Button size="small">Manage</Button>
        </ToggletipFooter>
      </Toggletip>
    </Stack>
  </Modal>
</Portal>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Toggletip` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the toggletip. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLButtonElement` | Obtain a reference to the button HTML element. | `null` |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the content relative to the button.<br />Above and below the button, `start` and `end` name inline sides, so<br />they swap under `dir="rtl"`. | `"center"` |
| `direction` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Set the direction of the content relative to the button. | `"bottom"` |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render for the toggletip button.<br />Defaults to `<Information />`. | `Information` |
| `iconName` | `string` | Specify the icon name attribute | `""` |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the toggletip button.<br />Set to `""` to name the button by its content instead. | `"Show information"` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Set the toggletip label text.<br />Alternatively, use the "labelChildren" slot. | `""` |
| `portalTooltip` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to always render the content in a portal, or `false` to<br />keep it in place. Left unset, the content moves to a portal inside a<br />`Modal`, or when a box around it (`overflow` other than `visible`) would<br />cut it off. | _undefined_ |
| `popoverClass` | `string \| undefined` | Specify a class for the popover.<br />The class is also applied when the popover is portalled. | _undefined_ |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the toggletip element.<br />The content id derives from it as `{id}-content`. | `uniqueId()` |

#### `Toggletip` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`       | `Record<string, never>` |
| `icon`          | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `labelText`     | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Toggletip` dispatched events

| Event      | Detail |
| ---------- | ------ |
| `on:close` | `null` |
| `on:open`  | `null` |

#### `Toggletip` $$restProps

`Toggletip` spreads `$$restProps` to the `span` element.

#### `ToggletipFooter` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToggletipFooter` $$restProps

`ToggletipFooter` spreads `$$restProps` to the `div` element.


## Toolbar

### Basic

Create a basic toolbar with content inside toolbar content. **Toolbar** can be used independently of DataTable--it provides its own context for child components like **ToolbarMenu**, **ToolbarSearch**, and **ToolbarBatchActions**, so every example on this page works standalone. To use a toolbar with a data table instead, see [DataTable's Toolbar section](/components/DataTable#toolbar).

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Toolbar, ToolbarContent } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

### Accessible label

Set `ariaLabel` to override the toolbar's accessible name. The default, `"data table toolbar"`, is inherited from Toolbar's original use inside DataTable--override it for standalone toolbars so assistive technology announces something more meaningful.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Toolbar, ToolbarContent } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar ariaLabel="Product actions">
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to control the toolbar height. The default is medium.

#### Small

Set `size="sm"` for a compact toolbar.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Toolbar, ToolbarContent } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar size="sm">
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Extra-small

Set `size="xs"` for an extra-small toolbar, intended to pair with a compact data table.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Toolbar, ToolbarContent } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar size="xs">
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

### Search

Add search functionality using toolbar search.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch />
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Persistent

Set `persistent` on toolbar search to keep it always expanded.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch persistent placeholder="Search..." />
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Select on focus

Set `selectTextOnFocus` to select the full value when the field receives focus.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch persistent selectTextOnFocus value="Cloud functions" />
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Disabled

Set `disabled` to `true` to disable the search field.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch disabled placeholder="Search..." />
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Reactive

Bind to `value` for reactive updates. `expanded` is also bindable, so you can read or programmatically set whether the search field is open.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    Stack,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let value = "";
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Toolbar>
    <ToolbarContent>
      <ToolbarSearch bind:value placeholder="Search..." />
      <Button size="small">Create</Button>
    </ToolbarContent>
  </Toolbar>
  <Stack gap={5}>
    <div>
      <ButtonSet>
        <Button
          size="small"
          disabled={value === "products"}
          on:click={() => (value = "products")}
        >
          Set value
        </Button>
        <Button
          kind="ghost"
          size="small"
          disabled={value.length === 0}
          on:click={() => (value = "")}
        >
          Clear value
        </Button>
      </ButtonSet>
    </div>
    <div>
      <strong>Search value:</strong>
      {value}
    </div>
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

#### Clear programmatically

Use `bind:this` to obtain a ToolbarSearch reference and call `clear()` to reset the value.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Stack,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let toolbarSearch;
  let value = "";
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Toolbar>
    <ToolbarContent>
      <ToolbarSearch
        bind:this={toolbarSearch}
        bind:value
        persistent
        placeholder="Search..."
      />
      <Button
        kind="ghost"
        size="small"
        disabled={value.length === 0}
        on:click={() => toolbarSearch.clear()}
      >
        Clear search
      </Button>
    </ToolbarContent>
  </Toolbar>
  <div>
    <strong>Search value:</strong>
    {value}
  </div>
</Stack>
```

#### Clear event

Listen for `on:clear` to know when the user clears the field--by clicking the built-in clear icon or pressing <kbd>Escape</kbd> while focused. This is distinct from calling the exported `clear()` method yourself, which updates `value` and `expanded` directly without dispatching the event.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <ToolbarSearch
      persistent
      placeholder="Search..."
      on:clear={() => console.log("cleared")}
    />
    <Button>Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Debounce

Set `debounce` to delay client-side filtering until typing pauses, in milliseconds. `value` still updates on every keystroke; only the filter run waits. This keeps large tables responsive without wrapping `value` yourself. Clearing the field, by the clear icon, <kbd>Escape</kbd>, or an empty value, restores the full row set immediately, without waiting for the debounce period.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    DataTable,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const rows = Array.from({ length: 30 }).map((_, i) => ({
    id: i,
    name: `Load Balancer ${i + 1}`,
    protocol: "HTTP",
    port: 3000 + i * 10,
    rule: i % 2 ? "Round robin" : "DNS delegation",
  }));

  let filteredRowIds = [];
</script>

<DataTable
  headers={[
    { key: "name", value: "Name" },
    { key: "protocol", value: "Protocol" },
    { key: "port", value: "Port" },
    { key: "rule", value: "Rule" },
  ]}
  {rows}
>
  <Toolbar>
    <ToolbarContent>
      <ToolbarSearch
        persistent
        shouldFilterRows
        debounce={250}
        bind:filteredRowIds
      />
    </ToolbarContent>
  </Toolbar>
</DataTable>

<p>Filtered rows: {filteredRowIds.length}</p>
```

**ToolbarMenu** extends [OverflowMenu](/components/OverflowMenu), inheriting props such as `icon`. The default icon is a settings gear--pass a different icon component to change it.

### Batch actions

Toolbar batch actions display batch actions when items are selected.

Although intended for use with [DataTable](/components/DataTable), batch actions can be used standalone when `selectedIds` is provided. That prop is not required when used with a data table.

#### Basic usage

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarBatchActions,
    ToolbarContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarBatchActions selectedIds={[1, 2, 3]}>
    <Button icon={TrashCan}>Delete</Button>
  </ToolbarBatchActions>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Manually controlling visibility

Set `active` to `true` or `false` to override the automatic visibility based on `selectedIds`. This is useful when the batch action bar should be driven by application state instead of a selection count. Here, the bar is forced open even though no items are selected.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarBatchActions,
    ToolbarContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarBatchActions active>
    <Button icon={TrashCan}>Delete</Button>
  </ToolbarBatchActions>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Custom cancel label

Override the Cancel button's text using the `cancel` slot.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarBatchActions,
    ToolbarContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarBatchActions selectedIds={[1, 2, 3]}>
    <Button icon={TrashCan}>Delete</Button>
    <svelte:fragment slot="cancel">Discard</svelte:fragment>
  </ToolbarBatchActions>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Total selected label

Override the "N items selected" text with `formatTotalSelected`.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarBatchActions,
    ToolbarContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";
</script>

<Toolbar>
  <ToolbarBatchActions
    selectedIds={[1, 2, 3]}
    formatTotalSelected={(total) =>
      `${total} item${total === 1 ? "" : "s"} chosen`}
  >
    <Button icon={TrashCan}>Delete</Button>
  </ToolbarBatchActions>
  <ToolbarContent>
    <Button size="small">Create</Button>
  </ToolbarContent>
</Toolbar>
```

#### Standalone with dynamic selection

In standalone usage there's no `DataTable` context to reset the selection automatically, so listen for `on:cancel` and clear your own selection state in the handler.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Checkbox,
    Stack,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarBatchActions,
    ToolbarContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";

  let items = [
    { id: 1, name: "Load Balancer 1", checked: false },
    { id: 2, name: "Load Balancer 2", checked: false },
    { id: 3, name: "Load Balancer 3", checked: false },
  ];
  let nextId = items.length + 1;

  $: selectedIds = items.filter((item) => item.checked).map((item) => item.id);
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <Toolbar>
    <ToolbarBatchActions
      {selectedIds}
      on:cancel={() => {
        items = items.map((item) => ({ ...item, checked: false }));
      }}
    >
      <Button
        kind="danger"
        icon={TrashCan}
        on:click={() => {
          items = items.filter((item) => !item.checked);
        }}
      >
        Delete
      </Button>
    </ToolbarBatchActions>
    <ToolbarContent>
      <Button
        icon={Add}
        size="small"
        on:click={() => {
          items = [
            ...items,
            { id: nextId, name: `Load Balancer ${nextId}`, checked: false },
          ];
          nextId++;
        }}
      >
        Add balancer
      </Button>
    </ToolbarContent>
  </Toolbar>
  <Stack>
    {#each items as item (item.id)}
      <Checkbox labelText={item.name} bind:checked={item.checked} />
    {/each}
  </Stack>
</Stack>
```

### Sticky

#### Pinned toolbar

Set `sticky` to keep the toolbar pinned to the top of its nearest scrolling ancestor as the page scrolls, including an active [ToolbarBatchActions](#basic-usage) bar, which would otherwise scroll out of view along with the table body. This differs from [DataTable's sticky header](/components/DataTable#sticky-header), which pins the column headers while the table body scrolls within its own container; a sticky toolbar instead sticks to the page (or another ancestor with `overflow`), since the toolbar sits outside the table's scroll wrappers. Select some rows below and scroll the example to see the batch bar stay in view.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    DataTable,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarBatchActions,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";

  let rows = Array.from({ length: 40 }).map((_, i) => ({
    id: i,
    name: `Load Balancer ${i + 1}`,
    protocol: "HTTP",
    port: 3000 + i * 10,
    rule: i % 2 ? "Round robin" : "DNS delegation",
  }));

  let selectedRowIds = [];
</script>

<DataTable
  batchSelection
  bind:selectedRowIds
  headers={[
    { key: "name", value: "Name" },
    { key: "protocol", value: "Protocol" },
    { key: "port", value: "Port" },
    { key: "rule", value: "Rule" },
  ]}
  {rows}
>
  <Toolbar sticky>
    <ToolbarBatchActions>
      <Button
        icon={TrashCan}
        on:click={() => {
          rows = rows.filter((row) => !selectedRowIds.includes(row.id));
        }}
      >
        Delete
      </Button>
    </ToolbarBatchActions>
    <ToolbarContent>
      <ToolbarSearch persistent shouldFilterRows />
    </ToolbarContent>
  </Toolbar>
</DataTable>
```

#### Offset

Set `stickyOffset` to add clearance above the stuck toolbar, useful when a fixed UI Shell header would otherwise overlap it. Pass a number for pixels or a string for any CSS length.

If a [Header](/components/UIShell#header) is rendered on the page, `stickyOffset` defaults to its height (48px) automatically, so the toolbar clears it without any extra configuration. Set `stickyOffset` explicitly, including `stickyOffset={0}`, to opt out of this default.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Content,
    DataTable,
    Header,
    SkipToContent,
    Toolbar,
    ToolbarBatchActions,
    ToolbarContent,
    ToolbarSearch,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import TrashCan from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/TrashCan.svelte";

  let rows = Array.from({ length: 40 }).map((_, i) => ({
    id: i,
    name: `Load Balancer ${i + 1}`,
    protocol: "HTTP",
    port: 3000 + i * 10,
    rule: i % 2 ? "Round robin" : "DNS delegation",
  }));

  let selectedRowIds = [];
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
</Header>

<Content>
  <DataTable
    batchSelection
    bind:selectedRowIds
    headers={[
      { key: "name", value: "Name" },
      { key: "protocol", value: "Protocol" },
      { key: "port", value: "Port" },
      { key: "rule", value: "Rule" },
    ]}
    {rows}
  >
    <Toolbar sticky>
      <ToolbarBatchActions>
        <Button
          icon={TrashCan}
          on:click={() => {
            rows = rows.filter((row) => !selectedRowIds.includes(row.id));
          }}
        >
          Delete
        </Button>
      </ToolbarBatchActions>
      <ToolbarContent>
        <ToolbarSearch persistent shouldFilterRows />
      </ToolbarContent>
    </Toolbar>
  </DataTable>
</Content>
```

```svelte
    <ToolbarMenu>
      <ToolbarMenuItem primaryFocus>Restart all</ToolbarMenuItem>

        API documentation
      </ToolbarMenuItem>
      <ToolbarMenuItem hasDivider danger>Stop all</ToolbarMenuItem>

```


---

### Component API

#### `Toolbar` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "default" \| "lg" \| undefined` | Specify the toolbar size.<br />If unset, the size is inherited from the parent `DataTable`<br />("xs" for "compact", "sm" for "short", "default" otherwise).<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"lg"` (`"default"`). | _undefined_ |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the toolbar. | `"data table toolbar"` |
| `sticky` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to keep the toolbar pinned while its scroll container scrolls. | `false` |
| `stickyOffset` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Distance from the top edge while stuck. Numbers are treated as pixels;<br />strings may be any CSS length (for example `"3rem"`).<br /><br />If unset, defaults to `0`, or to the fixed UI Shell header height<br />(48px) when a `Header` is rendered on the page, so the toolbar doesn't<br />stick underneath it. Set explicitly (including `0`) to opt out. | _undefined_ |

#### `Toolbar` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Toolbar` $$restProps

`Toolbar` spreads `$$restProps` to the `section` element.

#### `ToolbarContent` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToolbarSearch` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (Reactive) | `number \| string` | Specify the value of the search input. | `""` |
| `expanded` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to expand the search bar. | `false` |
| `filteredRowIds` (Reactive) | `ReadonlyArray<Row["id"]>` | The filtered row ids. | `[]` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLInputElement` | Obtain a reference to the input HTML element. | `null` |
| `persistent` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to keep the search bar expanded | `false` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text. It is visually hidden and names the search<br />field for assistive technology. | `"Search"` |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to disable the search bar | `false` |
| `shouldFilterRows` | `boolean \| ((row: Row, value: number \| string) => boolean)` | Set to `true` to filter table rows using the search value.<br /><br />If `true`, the default search excludes `id`, `cells` fields and<br />only does a basic comparison on string and number type cell values.<br /><br />To implement your own client-side filtering, pass a function<br />that accepts a row and value and returns a boolean. | `false` |
| `tabindex` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Specify the tabindex | `"0"` |
| `debounce` | `number` | Milliseconds of quiet time before rows are filtered. Filtering waits<br />until typing pauses; `value` still updates immediately; clearing<br />applies at once. `0` filters synchronously on every keystroke. A<br />starting `value` filters on mount without waiting.<br /><br />Unrelated to the `search` event, which fires on <kbd>Enter</kbd><br />regardless of this delay. | `0` |
| `deferFilter` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to yield to the browser before rows are filtered, so the<br />input and the clear button paint before a large table re-renders.<br />`value` still updates immediately.<br /><br />Filtering becomes asynchronous: `filteredRowIds` and the table rows<br />update shortly after `value`, and clearing no longer applies at once.<br />Rapid changes coalesce, so only the latest value is filtered. Combined<br />with `debounce`, the debounce delay elapses first, then the filter yields.<br />The first filter on mount and server rendering stay synchronous. | `false` |
| `selectTextOnFocus` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to select the input's text when it receives focus | `false` |
| `clear` | `() => void` | Programmatically clear the search input.<br />Resets `value` and collapses the search bar (unless `persistent`). | _undefined_ |

#### `ToolbarSearch` forwarded events

| Event        |
| ------------ |
| `on:blur`    |
| `on:change`  |
| `on:clear`   |
| `on:focus`   |
| `on:input`   |
| `on:keydown` |
| `on:keyup`   |
| `on:paste`   |
| `on:search`  |

#### `ToolbarSearch` $$restProps

`ToolbarSearch` spreads `$$restProps` to the `input` element.

| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToolbarMenu` $$restProps

`ToolbarMenu` spreads `$$restProps` to the `OverflowMenu` component.

#### `ToolbarMenuItem` slots

| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ToolbarMenuItem` forwarded events

| Event        |
| ------------ |
| `on:click`   |
| `on:keydown` |

#### `ToolbarMenuItem` $$restProps

`ToolbarMenuItem` spreads `$$restProps` to the `OverflowMenuItem` component.

#### `ToolbarBatchActions` props

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formatTotalSelected` | `(totalSelected: number) => string` | Override the total items selected text. | `(totalSelected) => `${totalSelected} item${totalSelected === 1 ? "" : "s"} selected`` |
| `active` | `undefined \| boolean` | Use a boolean to show or hide the toolbar. | _undefined_ |

## Tooltip

### Basic

Display a tooltip triggered by the default information icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip>
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

### Custom labels

Customize the tooltip's visible trigger text and the icon button's accessible name.

#### Trigger text

Use custom trigger text instead of the default icon with `triggerText`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Resource list">
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Trigger text slot

Alternatively, use the `triggerChildren` slot for custom markup.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip>
  <strong slot="triggerChildren">Resource list</strong>
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Accessible label

Set the button's ARIA label with `iconDescription`. It defaults to `"Show information"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip iconDescription="View resource details">
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

### Reactive example

Control the tooltip state programmatically.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Stack, Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = true;
</script>

<Stack gap={12}>
  <Tooltip bind:open triggerText="Resource list" align="start">
    <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
  </Tooltip>
  <div>
    <Button kind="tertiary" size="small" on:click={() => (open = !open)}>
      {open ? "Close tooltip" : "Open tooltip"}
    </Button>
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Dispatched events

The component dispatches `open` and `close` events.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let events = [];
</script>

<Stack gap={4}>
  <Tooltip
    triggerText="Resource list"
    on:open={() => (events = [...events, "open"])}
    on:close={() => (events = [...events, "close"])}
  >
    <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
  </Tooltip>
  <p>Dispatched events: {events.join(", ")}</p>
</Stack>
```

### Placement

Position the tooltip with direction and alignment.

#### Directions

Position the tooltip with `direction`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Top" direction="top"><p>Top</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip triggerText="Right" direction="right"><p>Right</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip triggerText="Bottom" direction="bottom"><p>Bottom</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip triggerText="Left" direction="left"><p>Left</p></Tooltip>
```

#### Alignment

Align the tooltip content with `align`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Start" align="start"><p>Start</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip triggerText="End" align="end"><p>End</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip triggerText="Center" align="center"><p>Center</p></Tooltip>
```

### Interactive

Add interactive elements like links and buttons using the tooltip footer.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Link,
    Tooltip,
    TooltipFooter,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Resource list">
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
  <TooltipFooter selectorPrimaryFocus="#d">
    <Link href="/">Learn more</Link>
    <Button id="d" size="small">Manage</Button>
  </TooltipFooter>
</Tooltip>
```

### Custom icon

Customize or hide the default trigger icon.

#### Component

Use a custom icon component with `icon`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Catalog from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Catalog.svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Resource list" icon={Catalog}>
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Slot

Customize the icon using the `icon` slot for more flexibility.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Resource list">
  <Box slot="icon" width="1rem" height="1rem" border="interactive" />
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Hidden icon

Hide the trigger icon while keeping tooltip behavior with `hideIcon`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip hideIcon triggerText="Resource list">
  <p>Resources are provisioned based on your account's organization.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

### Custom delay

Customize the enter and leave delay with `enterDelayMs` and `leaveDelayMs`. Defaults are 100ms and 300ms.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip triggerText="Slow open" enterDelayMs={500} leaveDelayMs={200}>
  <p>This tooltip has a 500ms enter delay and a 200ms leave delay.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

### Tooltip group

Wrap related tooltips in a [TooltipGroup](/components/TooltipGroup). Once one is open on hover, moving to the next trigger opens it right away, with no enter delay, and closes the first. A tooltip opened with the keyboard stays open so focus inside it isn't lost. Inside a group, `enterDelayMs` and `leaveDelayMs` default to the group's delays.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, Tooltip, TooltipGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TooltipGroup>
  <Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={7}>
    <Tooltip triggerText="Region">
      <p>Where your resources run. Pick the one closest to your users.</p>
    </Tooltip>
    <Tooltip triggerText="Plan">
      <p>Sets your monthly quota. You can change plans at any time.</p>
    </Tooltip>
    <Tooltip triggerText="Retention">
      <p>How long logs are kept before they are deleted.</p>
    </Tooltip>
  </Stack>
</TooltipGroup>
```

### Portal

A tooltip that a container would cut off, such as a box with `overflow: hidden` or a scroll area, opens in a portal. Inside a Modal, the tooltip always opens in a portal.

Set `portalTooltip` to `true` to always render the tooltip in a portal, or to `false` to keep it in place. A portalled tooltip leaves its container in the DOM, so CSS that targets the tooltip as a descendant of the container does not match it.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip portalTooltip triggerText="Portalled">
  <p>This tooltip is rendered in a portal.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Hidden icon

Portal tooltips also work with a hidden trigger icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip portalTooltip hideIcon triggerText="Portalled (hidden icon)">
  <p>This tooltip is rendered in a portal without the icon.</p>
</Tooltip>
```

#### Directions

Position portalled tooltips in different directions.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Tooltip portalTooltip triggerText="Top" direction="top"><p>Top</p></Tooltip>
<Tooltip portalTooltip triggerText="Right" direction="right"
  ><p>Right</p></Tooltip
>
<Tooltip portalTooltip triggerText="Bottom" direction="bottom"
  ><p>Bottom</p></Tooltip
>
<Tooltip portalTooltip triggerText="Left" direction="left"><p>Left</p></Tooltip>
```

### Inside a modal

When a tooltip is used inside a [Modal](/components/Modal), it is automatically portalled so it is not clipped by the modal overflow or z-index stacking. Set `portalTooltip` to override this behavior.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Modal, Portal, Tooltip } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button>

<Portal>
  <Modal
    bind:open
    size="sm"
    modalHeading="Tooltip in modal"
    primaryButtonText="Done"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  >
    <Tooltip triggerText="Top" direction="top"><p>Top</p></Tooltip>
    <Tooltip triggerText="Right" direction="right"><p>Right</p></Tooltip>
    <Tooltip triggerText="Bottom" direction="bottom"><p>Bottom</p></Tooltip>
    <Tooltip triggerText="Left" direction="left"><p>Left</p></Tooltip>
  </Modal>
</Portal>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Tooltip` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the tooltip. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the trigger text HTML element. | `null` |
| `refTooltip` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the tooltip HTML element. | `null` |
| `refIcon` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLDivElement` | Obtain a reference to the icon HTML element. | `null` |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the icon.<br />Above and below the icon, `start` and `end` name inline sides, so they<br />swap under `dir="rtl"`. | `"center"` |
| `direction` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Set the direction of the tooltip relative to the button. | `"bottom"` |
| `hideIcon` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to hide the tooltip icon. | `false` |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render for the tooltip button.<br />Defaults to `<Information />`. | `Information` |
| `iconDescription` | `string` | Specify the ARIA label for the tooltip button | `"Show information"` |
| `iconName` | `string` | Specify the icon name attribute | `""` |
| `tabindex` | `number \| string \| undefined` | Set the button tabindex | `"0"` |
| `tooltipId` | `string` | Set an id for the tooltip. | `uniqueId()` |
| `triggerId` | `string` | Set an id for the tooltip button. | `uniqueId()` |
| `triggerText` | `string` | Set the tooltip button text.<br />Alternatively, use the "triggerChildren" slot. | `""` |
| `enterDelayMs` | `number \| undefined` | Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before displaying the tooltip.<br />Defaults to the enclosing `TooltipGroup`'s delay, or `100`. | _undefined_ |
| `leaveDelayMs` | `number \| undefined` | Specify the duration in milliseconds to delay before hiding the tooltip.<br />Defaults to the enclosing `TooltipGroup`'s delay, or `300`. | _undefined_ |
| `portalTooltip` | `boolean \| undefined` | Set to `true` to always render the tooltip in a portal, or `false` to<br />keep it in place. Left unset, the tooltip moves to a portal inside a<br />`Modal`, or when a box around it (`overflow` other than `visible`)<br />would cut it off. | _undefined_ |

| -------------- |

| `on:mousedown` |

| `on:open`  | `null` |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
