          id: "3-3",
          text: "Tier 3",
          nodes: [{ id: "3-3-1", text: "Ticket-3005.md" }],
        },
      ],
    },
  ];

  let searchValue = "";
  let expandedIds = [];

  $: filteredNodes =
    searchValue.trim() === ""
      ? allNodes
      : filterTreeByText(allNodes, searchValue);

  $: if (searchValue.trim() !== "" && filteredNodes.length > 0) {

      const ids = [];

  } else {

  }
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>

##### By ID

Use `filterTreeById` to filter nodes by their ID. Accepts either a single ID or an array of IDs. Click the buttons to filter by a single ID or multiple IDs. Matching nodes and their ancestors are included by default.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    filterTreeById,
    Stack,
    TreeView,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const allNodes = [
    {
      id: "1",
      text: "Engineering",
      nodes: [
        {
          id: "1-1",
          text: "Runbooks",
          nodes: [
            { id: "1-1-1", text: "Incident Response.md" },
            { id: "1-1-2", text: "Deployment Playbook.md" },
            { id: "1-1-3", text: "On-Call Rotation.md" },
          ],
        },
        {
          id: "1-2",
          text: "Architecture",
          nodes: [
            { id: "1-2-1", text: "System Design.pdf" },
            { id: "1-2-2", text: "API Contracts.pdf" },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "2",
      text: "Finance",
      nodes: [
        { id: "2-1", text: "Q1-Invoice.pdf" },
        { id: "2-2", text: "Q2-Invoice.pdf" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "3",
      text: "Support",
      nodes: [
        {
          id: "3-1",
          text: "Tier 1",
          nodes: [
            { id: "3-1-1", text: "Ticket-1042.md" },
            { id: "3-1-2", text: "Ticket-1043.md" },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
  ];

  let filteredNodes = allNodes;
  let expandedIds = [];

  function filterBySingleId() {
    filteredNodes = filterTreeById(allNodes, "1-1-1");
    expandedIds = ["1", "1-1", "1-1-1"];
  }

  function filterByMultipleIds() {
    filteredNodes = filterTreeById(allNodes, ["1-1-1", "1-2-1", "2-1"]);
    expandedIds = ["1", "1-1", "1-1-1", "1-2", "1-2-1", "2", "2-1"];
  }

  function resetFilter() {
    filteredNodes = allNodes;
    expandedIds = [];
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <ButtonSet>
    <Button size="small" on:click={filterBySingleId}>Filter single ID</Button>
    <Button size="small" on:click={filterByMultipleIds}>
      Filter multiple IDs
    </Button>
    <Button size="small" kind="tertiary" on:click={resetFilter}>Reset</Button>
  </ButtonSet>
  <div>
    <TreeView labelText="Shared Drive" nodes={filteredNodes} {expandedIds} />
  </div>
</Stack>
```

##### Custom predicate

Use `filterTreeNodes` with a predicate function to implement custom filtering logic. The example demonstrates filtering by file extension, filtering leaf nodes only, and using the `includeChildren` option to include all descendants of matching nodes. By default, matching nodes and their ancestors are included.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    filterTreeNodes,
    Stack,
    TreeView,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const allNodes = [
    {
      id: "1",
      text: "Engineering",
      nodes: [
        {
          id: "1-1",
          text: "Incidents",
          nodes: [
            { id: "1-1-1", text: "RCA-2024-041.docx" },
            { id: "1-1-2", text: "Postmortem Deck.pptx" },
            { id: "1-1-3", text: "Capacity Plan.xlsx" },
          ],
        },
        {
          id: "1-2",
          text: "Architecture",
          nodes: [
            { id: "1-2-1", text: "System Design.pdf" },
            { id: "1-2-2", text: "API Contract.pdf" },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "2",
      text: "Finance",
      nodes: [
        { id: "2-1", text: "Q1-Invoice.csv" },
        { id: "2-2", text: "Q2-Invoice.csv" },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: "3",
      text: "Support",
      nodes: [
        {
          id: "3-1",
          text: "Tier 1",
          nodes: [
            { id: "3-1-1", text: "Ticket-1042.log" },
            { id: "3-1-2", text: "Ticket-1043.log" },
          ],
        },
      ],
    },
  ];

  let filteredNodes = allNodes;
  let expandedIds = [];

  function filterByExtension() {
    filteredNodes = filterTreeNodes(
      allNodes,
      (node) => node.text?.endsWith(".pdf") || node.text?.endsWith(".docx"),
    );
    expandedIds = ["1", "1-1", "1-1-1", "1-2", "1-2-1"];
  }

  function filterLeafNodes() {
    filteredNodes = filterTreeNodes(
      allNodes,
      (node) => !node.nodes || node.nodes.length === 0,
    );
    expandedIds = [
      "1",
      "1-1",
      "1-1-1",
      "1-1-2",
      "1-1-3",
      "1-2",
      "1-2-1",
      "1-2-2",
      "2",
      "2-1",
      "2-2",
      "3",
      "3-1",
      "3-1-1",
      "3-1-2",
    ];
  }

  function filterWithChildren() {
    filteredNodes = filterTreeNodes(allNodes, (node) => node.id === "1-1", {
      includeChildren: true,
    });
    expandedIds = ["1", "1-1", "1-1-1", "1-1-2", "1-1-3"];
  }

  function resetFilter() {
    filteredNodes = allNodes;
    expandedIds = [];
  }
</script>

<Stack gap={6}>
  <ButtonSet>
    <Button size="small" on:click={filterByExtension}>
      Filter by extension (.pdf, .docx)
    </Button>
    <Button size="small" on:click={filterLeafNodes}>Filter leaf nodes</Button>
    <Button size="small" on:click={filterWithChildren}>
      Filter with children
    </Button>
    <Button size="small" kind="tertiary" on:click={resetFilter}>Reset</Button>
  </ButtonSet>
  <div>
    <TreeView labelText="Shared Drive" nodes={filteredNodes} {expandedIds} />
  </div>
</Stack>
```

### Skeleton

Show a loading state with `TreeViewSkeleton`. Match the tree's `size` and its number of top-level rows with `count`, and set `hideLabel` when the tree hides its label.

```svelte
<script>
  import { TreeViewSkeleton } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<TreeViewSkeleton count={5} />
```

### Component API

#### `TreeView` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activeId` (Reactive) | `Node["id"]` | Set the current active node id.<br />Only one node can be active. | `""` |
| `selectedIds` (Reactive) | `ReadonlyArray<Node["id"]>` | Set the node ids to be selected. | `[]` |
| `expandedIds` (Reactive) | `ReadonlyArray<Node["id"]>` | Set the node ids to be expanded. | `[]` |
| `checkedIds` (Reactive) | `ReadonlyArray<Node["id"]>` | The node ids that are checked in `selectionMode="checkbox"`. Distinct from<br />`selectedIds`, which tracks row highlighting and is unused in checkbox mode. | `[]` |
| `indeterminateIds` (Reactive) | `ReadonlyArray<Node["id"]>` | The node ids that are partially checked in `selectionMode="checkbox"`.<br />Derived from `checkedIds`; writes to this prop are overwritten. | `[]` |
| `scrollContainerRef` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLUListElement` | Reference to the scrollable container when `virtualize` is enabled.<br />`null` otherwise. | `null` |
| `nodes` | `ReadonlyArray<Node>` | Provide an array of nodes to render. | `[]` |
| `size` | `"default" \| "compact" \| "sm" \| "xs"` | Specify the TreeView size.<br />Also accepts Carbon v11's `"sm"` (`"default"`, 32px) and `"xs"`<br />(`"compact"`, 24px). | `"default"` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the label text | `""` |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to visually hide the label text | `false` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the tree element.<br />The label, node label, subtree, and checkbox ids derive from it,<br />for example `{id}-label` and `{id}-{node.id}-subtree`. | `uniqueId()` |
| `autoCollapse` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to automatically collapse sibling nodes when expanding a node.<br />When enabled, only one node at each level can be expanded at a time. | `false` |
| `multiselect` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to enable multi-select mode.<br />Supports Ctrl/Cmd+Click (toggle) and Shift+Click (range select). | `false` |
| `multiselectMode` | `'node' \| 'shallow' \| 'deep'` | When `multiselect` is true, `multiselectMode` controls how many nodes a selection gesture includes:<br />- `'node'`: only the clicked/active node (default)<br />- `'shallow'`: the node plus its direct non-disabled children<br />- `'deep'`: the node plus all non-disabled descendants | `"node"` |
| `selectionMode` | `"highlight" \| "checkbox"` | Specify how a selection is presented.<br />`"checkbox"` renders a tri-state checkbox on every node and implies<br />multi-selection; `multiselect` and `multiselectMode` are ignored in that mode. | `"highlight"` |
| `checkMode` | `'node' \| 'deep'` | In `selectionMode="checkbox"`, `checkMode` controls how far a check propagates:<br />- `'node'`: only the clicked node; parents and children never follow each other<br />- `'deep'`: the node plus all non-disabled descendants, with ancestors deriving<br /> an indeterminate state (default) | `"deep"` |
| `virtualize` | `undefined \| boolean \| {<br />  maxVisibleRows?: number,<br />  containerHeight?: number \| string,<br />  overscan?: number,<br />}` | Enable virtualization for large trees. Virtualization renders only the<br />rows currently visible in the viewport, improving performance for large<br />datasets.<br /><br />Virtualization is opt-in. TreeView cannot tell from `nodes` alone whether<br />the tree will stay small or grow through expansion, so it does not<br />auto-enable based on row count. Set `virtualize={true}` to enable with<br />default settings, or pass a configuration object to customize. Leave<br />`undefined` for the default recursive rendering.<br /><br />Row height is derived from `size` (32px default, 24px compact).<br /><br />Collapsed subtrees mount lazily on first expansion and stay mounted.<br />Virtualization is per subtree. Enable it when a node may hold a large<br />child list. | _undefined_ |
| `expandAll` | `() => void` | Programmatically expand all expandable nodes (those with loaded children<br />or `hasChildren: true`). Leaf ids are omitted -- they do not affect<br />expansion. | _undefined_ |
| `collapseAll` | `() => void` | Programmatically collapse all nodes | _undefined_ |
| `expandNodes` | `(filterNode?: (node: Node) => boolean) => void` | Programmatically expand a subset of nodes.<br />Expands all nodes if no argument is provided.<br />Filter function should return `true` for nodes to expand. If not provided, expands all nodes. | _undefined_ |
| `collapseNodes` | `(filterNode?: (node: Node) => boolean) => void` | Programmatically collapse a subset of nodes.<br />Collapses all nodes if no argument is provided.<br />Filter function should return `true` for nodes to collapse. If not provided, collapses all nodes. | _undefined_ |
| `showNode` | `(id: Node["id"], options?: ShowNodeOptions) => void` | Programmatically show a node by `id`.<br />By default, the matching node will be expanded, selected, and focused.<br />Use the options parameter to customize this behavior. | _undefined_ |
| `getNode` | `(id: Node["id"]) => Node \| null` | Look up a node by `id` without re-implementing tree traversal.<br />Returns `null` if no node with the given `id` exists. | _undefined_ |
| `getNodes` | `(ids: ReadonlyArray<Node["id"]>) => Array<Node>` | Look up multiple nodes by `id`. Ids without a matching node are omitted. | _undefined_ |

#### `TreeView` typedefs

```ts
type TreeNode<Id = string | number> = {
  id: Id;
  text: any;
  icon?: any;
  /** Whether the node is disabled */
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Optional URL the node links to */
  href?: string;
  /** Optional link target (e.g., "_blank") */
  target?: string;
  /** Whether the node has children that have not been loaded yet. Renders an expander even without a `nodes` array; expanding fires `toggle` so children can be loaded lazily. */
  hasChildren?: boolean;
  nodes?: TreeNode<Id>[];
};

type ShowNodeOptions = {
  /** Whether to expand the node and its ancestors (default: true) */
  expand?: boolean;
  /** Whether to select the node (default: true) */
  select?: boolean;
  /** Whether to focus the node (default: true) */
  focus?: boolean;
};

type TreeViewExpandedChange<Id = string | number> = {
  /** The full set of expanded node ids after the change */
  expandedIds: ReadonlyArray<Id>;
  /** Node ids expanded since the previous change */
  added: Array<Id>;
  /** Node ids collapsed since the previous change */
  removed: Array<Id>;
};

type TreeViewSelectionChange<Id = string | number> = {
  /** The full set of selected node ids after the change */
  selectedIds: ReadonlyArray<Id>;
  /** Node ids selected since the previous change */
  added: Array<Id>;
  /** Node ids deselected since the previous change */
  removed: Array<Id>;
};

type TreeViewCheckChange<Id = string | number> = {
  /** The full set of checked node ids after the change */
  checkedIds: ReadonlyArray<Id>;
  /** Node ids checked since the previous change */
  added: Array<Id>;
  /** Node ids unchecked since the previous change */
  removed: Array<Id>;
  /** The partially checked node ids after the change */
  indeterminateIds: ReadonlyArray<Id>;
};
```

| --- | --- |
| `default` | `{<br />  node: Node & {<br />    expanded: boolean;<br />    leaf: boolean;<br />    selected: boolean;<br />    checked: boolean;<br />    indeterminate: boolean;<br />  };<br />}` |
| `childNodes` | `{<br />  node: Node & {<br />    expanded: boolean;<br />    leaf: boolean;<br />    selected: boolean;<br />    checked: boolean;<br />    indeterminate: boolean;<br />  };<br />}` |
| `labelChildren` | `Record<string, never>` |

| `on:focus` | `Node & {<br />  expanded: boolean;<br />  leaf: boolean;<br />  selected: boolean;<br />  checked: boolean;<br />  indeterminate: boolean;<br />}` |

## Truncate

### Component

#### Basic

Truncate offers two ways to clip overflowing text: the `Truncate` component, which wraps content in a `<p>`, and the `truncate` action, which applies the same clipping to any element. For truncating text that also needs a specific Carbon type style, see [Text](/components/Text#truncate).

The default component wraps text in a paragraph and truncates at the end of the line.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Truncate>
    Failed to deploy revision 214: container image
    ghcr.io/acme-corp/payments-api:2.4.1-rc3 exceeded the memory limit
    configured for the production namespace.
  </Truncate>
</Box>
```

#### Clamp front

Set `clamp` to `"front"` to keep the end of the text visible. `clamp` only takes effect when `lines` is `1`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Truncate clamp="front">
    /var/log/kubernetes/production/payments-api/pods/payments-api-7f9c8d6b4d-x2kql/container.log
  </Truncate>
</Box>
```

#### Multiline

Set `lines` above 1 to limit how many lines show. Multiline mode always clamps from the end, regardless of `clamp`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Truncate lines={3}>
    The nightly reconciliation job failed after three retries because the
    upstream billing service returned inconsistent invoice totals for 42
    accounts. Support has been notified and a manual review is in progress.
  </Truncate>
</Box>
```

#### Tooltip

Set `reveal` to `"tooltip"` to show the full text in a tooltip. While the text is clipped, it joins the tab order, and the tooltip opens on hover and focus. Press <kbd>Escape</kbd> to hide it. Text that fits stays plain. Set `tooltipAlign` to place the tooltip, with Popover's `align` names. It replaces `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`, which still work and are deprecated.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Truncate reveal="tooltip">
    Failed to deploy revision 214: container image
    ghcr.io/acme-corp/payments-api:2.4.1-rc3 exceeded the memory limit
    configured for the production namespace.
  </Truncate>
</Box>
```

#### Expand

Set `reveal` to `"expand"` to add a button that shows the full text. The button appears only while the text is clipped. Bind `expanded` to read or set the state, and set `expandLabel` and `collapseLabel` to change the button text.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Truncate reveal="expand" lines={2}>
    The nightly reconciliation job failed after three retries because the
    upstream billing service returned inconsistent invoice totals for 42
    accounts. Support has been notified and a manual review is in progress.
  </Truncate>
</Box>
```

#### Inline test

Truncating a span mid-sentence needs a normal block ancestor so the truncated text keeps the surrounding line height, otherwise descenders get clipped.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box tag="p" maxWidth="20rem">
  Deploy failed for image <Box tag="span" display="inline-flex" maxWidth="9rem"
    ><Truncate tag="span">ghcr.io/acme-corp/payments-api:2.4.1-rc3</Truncate
    ></Box
  > during rollout.
</Box>
```

#### Nested text

Set `tag` when the content is itself a block element such as Text, since paragraphs cannot nest.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, Text, Truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <Truncate tag="div">
    <Text tag="span">
      Failed to deploy revision 214: container image
      ghcr.io/acme-corp/payments-api:2.4.1-rc3 exceeded the memory limit
      configured for the production namespace.
    </Text>
  </Truncate>
</Box>
```

### Action

Use the `truncate` action on any element for the same behavior without the `Truncate` component's wrapping `<p>`.

#### Basic

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <h4 use:truncate>
    Failed to deploy revision 214: container image
    ghcr.io/acme-corp/payments-api:2.4.1-rc3 exceeded the memory limit
    configured for the production namespace.
  </h4>
</Box>
```

#### Clamp front

Pass `clamp: "front"` to keep the end of the text visible. Wrap the text in `<bdi>`, as the component does, so a leading slash or a trailing period stays in place.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <h4 use:truncate={{ clamp: "front" }}>
    <bdi
      >/var/log/kubernetes/production/payments-api/pods/payments-api-7f9c8d6b4d-x2kql/container.log</bdi
    >
  </h4>
</Box>
```

#### Multiline

Pass `lines` for multiline truncation.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Box, truncate } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Box maxWidth="20rem">
  <p use:truncate={{ lines: 3 }}>
    The nightly reconciliation job failed after three retries because the
    upstream billing service returned inconsistent invoice totals for 42
    accounts. Support has been notified and a manual review is in progress.
  </p>
</Box>
```

---

### Component API

#### `Truncate` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expanded` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to show the full text.<br />Only applies when `reveal` is `"expand"`. | `false` |
| `clamp` | `"end" \| "front"` | Specify `"end"` or `"front"`. `"front"` only works when `lines` is `1`. | `"end"` |
| `lines` | `number` | Number of visible lines before truncating. Values above `1` use multiline mode (end clamp only). | `1` |
| `tag` | `keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap` | Specify the tag name. | `"p"` |
| `reveal` | `"none" \| "tooltip" \| "expand"` | Specify how to reveal clipped text.<br />`"tooltip"` shows the full text in a tooltip on hover and focus, and makes the text focusable while it is clipped.<br />`"expand"` adds a button that removes the clamp.<br />`"none"` only clips. | `"none"` |
| `expandLabel` | `string` | Specify the label of the button that shows the full text.<br />Only applies when `reveal` is `"expand"`. | `"View more"` |
| `collapseLabel` | `string` | Specify the label of the button that clamps the text again.<br />Only applies when `reveal` is `"expand"`. | `"View less"` |
| `tooltipAlign` | `"top" \| "top-start" \| "top-end" \| "bottom" \| "bottom-start" \| "bottom-end" \| "left" \| "left-start" \| "left-end" \| "right" \| "right-start" \| "right-end" \| undefined` | Set the tooltip placement in floating-ui form: the side, then `start`<br />or `end` along it, as Popover's `align` takes. Above and below,<br />`start` and `end` name inline sides, so they swap under `dir="rtl"`.<br />When set, takes precedence over `tooltipPosition` and `tooltipAlignment`. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipPosition` | `"top" \| "right" \| "bottom" \| "left"` | Set the position of the tooltip relative to the text.<br />Only applies when `reveal` is `"tooltip"`. | `"top"` |
| `tooltipAlignment` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the text.<br />Only applies when `reveal` is `"tooltip"`. | `"center"` |

#### `Truncate` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Truncate` $$restProps

`Truncate` spreads `$$restProps` to the `svelte:element` element.


## UIShell

### Header

Create a basic header with the header component. Open these examples in a new tab to experience them in full.

#### Basic header

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderNavMenu,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/support" text="Support" />
    <HeaderNavMenu text="Manage">
      <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/iam" text="Access (IAM)" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing and usage" />
    </HeaderNavMenu>
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Navigation menus

Group related links behind a dropdown with `HeaderNavMenu` inside `HeaderNav`, as shown in the "Manage" menu in the example above. Clicking the trigger toggles the dropdown; clicking a `HeaderNavItem` link inside it also collapses the dropdown, since the click bubbles up to the trigger.

Keyboard support follows the WAI-ARIA menu pattern: <kbd>Enter</kbd>, <kbd>Space</kbd>, <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>, or <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> open the menu and move focus to the first or last item, <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> move between items once open, and <kbd>Escape</kbd> closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.

`HeaderNav` is a WAI-ARIA menubar, so its top-level items (`HeaderNavItem`s and `HeaderNavMenu` triggers) are a single <kbd>Tab</kbd> stop: the current page item (or the first item) takes focus, and the arrow keys move between the rest. <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> move between top-level items (wrapping at either end), <kbd>Home</kbd>/<kbd>End</kbd> jump to the first or last, and typing a character focuses the next item whose label starts with it. While a menu is open, <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> close it and move to the adjacent top-level item, opening its menu and focusing the first item when it is a `HeaderNavMenu`. In a right-to-left layout, <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd> and <kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> swap. Typing a character focuses the next menu item starting with it.

Set `icon` on `HeaderNavMenu` to render a trailing icon between the text and the chevron, or use the `icon` slot. Replace the label with the `textChildren` slot when it needs custom content; the trigger's accessible name follows what is rendered.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderNavMenu,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
    Tag,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Settings from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Settings.svelte";
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" isSelected />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/resources" text="Resources" />
    <HeaderNavMenu text="Manage" icon={Settings}>
      <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/access" text="Access (IAM)" />
    </HeaderNavMenu>
    <HeaderNavMenu>
      <svelte:fragment slot="textChildren">
        Products <Tag size="sm" type="blue">New</Tag>
      </svelte:fragment>
      <HeaderNavItem href="/watson" text="Watson Studio" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/quantum" text="Quantum" />
    </HeaderNavMenu>
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>Navigation menu triggers</h1>
        <p>
          Press Tab to reach the navigation, then use the arrow keys, Home, End,
          or type a letter to move between items.
        </p>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

`HeaderNavMenu` dispatches `close` with `event.detail.trigger` set to `"escape-key"`, `"outside-click"`, or `"blur"` (focus moved elsewhere, including with the arrow keys):

```svelte
<script>
  import { HeaderNavItem, HeaderNavMenu } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<HeaderNavMenu
  text="Manage"
  on:close={(event) => console.log(event.detail.trigger)}
>
  <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
</HeaderNavMenu>
```

#### Current page

Set `isSelected` on `HeaderNavItem` to mark the current page. It adds `aria-current="page"` and a persistent underline style. The same prop is available on `SideNavLink` and `SideNavMenuItem` in the side navigation section below.

```svelte
<script>
  import { HeaderNavItem } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" isSelected />
```

#### External links

Set the `icon` prop on `HeaderNavItem` to add a trailing icon after the text. For external links that open in a new tab, set `target="_blank"` and an external `href`. Use `Launch` from [carbon-icons-svelte](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-icons-svelte). The icon is decorative and inherits the link color on hover, focus, and active.

Duplicate those items in `HeaderSideNavItems` so the links stay in the side nav below the large breakpoint.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderSideNavItems,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Launch from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Launch.svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
    <HeaderNavItem
      href="https://cloud.ibm.com/docs"
      target="_blank"
      text="Docs"
      icon={Launch}
    />
    <HeaderNavItem
      href="https://cloud.ibm.com/status"
      target="_blank"
      text="Status"
      icon={Launch}
    />
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <HeaderSideNavItems hasDivider>
      <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
      <HeaderNavItem
        href="https://cloud.ibm.com/docs"
        target="_blank"
        text="Docs"
        icon={Launch}
      />
      <HeaderNavItem
        href="https://cloud.ibm.com/status"
        target="_blank"
        text="Status"
        icon={Launch}
      />
    </HeaderSideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" isSelected />
    <SideNavLink href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Skip to content

Pair `SkipToContent` with `Content` so keyboard users can jump past the header and navigation straight to the main content. By default `SkipToContent` links to `href="#main-content"` and `Content` renders with `id="main-content"`, so the two work together without extra configuration. Override both `href` and `id` together if you render more than one `Content` region, or need a different anchor.

### Side navigation

Pair the header with a `SideNav`. It collapses behind a hamburger menu by default and also supports responsive, fixed, and rail layouts.

#### Collapsible

The hamburger menu is automatically rendered when the side nav component is used.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderNavMenu,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavDivider,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/support" text="Support" />
    <HeaderNavMenu text="Manage">
      <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/iam" text="Access (IAM)" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing and usage" />
    </HeaderNavMenu>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/status" text="Status" />
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" isSelected />
    <SideNavLink href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
    <SideNavLink href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
    <SideNavMenu text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/registry" text="Container registry" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavDivider />
    <SideNavLink href="/settings" text="Account settings" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Side nav menus

Group related links behind a dropdown with `SideNavMenu`, wrapping `SideNavMenuItem` children, as shown in the "Kubernetes" menu in the example above. Set `expanded` to open the dropdown by default, and `icon` to render a leading icon on the trigger. Separate groups of items with `SideNavDivider`.

In the [rail](#rail) variant, an expanded `SideNavMenu` automatically collapses when the rail returns to its narrow state.

#### Nested menus

Nest a `SideNavMenu` inside another for deeper hierarchies. Each level's text starts 16px past its parent's.

A menu that contains the current page opens on mount, at any depth. Here, `isSelected` on "Deployments" opens "Controllers", "Workloads", and "Kubernetes".

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Activity from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Activity.svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import DataBase from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/DataBase.svelte";
  import Kubernetes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Kubernetes.svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink icon={Dashboard} href="/" text="Dashboard" />
    <SideNavMenu icon={Kubernetes} text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenu text="Workloads">
        <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/workloads/pods" text="Pods" />
        <SideNavMenu text="Controllers">
          <SideNavMenuItem
            href="/kubernetes/workloads/controllers/deployments"
            text="Deployments"
            isSelected
          />
          <SideNavMenuItem
            href="/kubernetes/workloads/controllers/stateful-sets"
            text="Stateful sets"
          />
          <SideNavMenuItem
            href="/kubernetes/workloads/controllers/daemon-sets"
            text="Daemon sets"
          />
        </SideNavMenu>
      </SideNavMenu>
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/namespaces" text="Namespaces" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavMenu icon={DataBase} text="Storage">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/storage/volumes" text="Volumes" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/storage/snapshots" text="Snapshots" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavLink icon={Activity} href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Deployments</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

A nested item with an icon places the icon where its siblings' text starts, as at the top level, and its children start past its own text. See "Workloads" and "Rollouts".

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Application from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Application.svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import Kubernetes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Kubernetes.svelte";
  import Renew from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Renew.svelte";
  import Settings from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Settings.svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink icon={Dashboard} href="/" text="Dashboard" />
    <SideNavMenu icon={Kubernetes} text="Kubernetes" expanded>
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenu icon={Application} text="Workloads" expanded>
        <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/workloads/pods" text="Pods" />
        <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/workloads/jobs" text="Jobs" />
      </SideNavMenu>
      <SideNavLink icon={Renew} href="/kubernetes/rollouts" text="Rollouts" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/namespaces" text="Namespaces" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavLink icon={Settings} href="/settings" text="Settings" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

| Do | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Nest at most two levels below the top level | The default side nav is 256px wide. Past the third level, labels have little room before they truncate. For deeper trees, use a [resizable](#resizable) side nav. |
| Keep icons on top-level items | A nested icon adds its width to that row and to every row below it. |
| Mark the current page with `isSelected` instead of setting `expanded` | Every menu that contains the current page opens on mount. |

#### Badges

Compose a `badge` named slot into `SideNavLink` or `SideNavMenu` to render a status or count indicator next to the label, such as [BadgeIndicator](/components/BadgeIndicator).

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    BadgeIndicator,
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavDivider,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Activity from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Activity.svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import Kubernetes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Kubernetes.svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink icon={Dashboard} href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" isSelected>
      <BadgeIndicator slot="badge" count={3} />
    </SideNavLink>
    <SideNavLink icon={Activity} href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
    <SideNavMenu icon={Kubernetes} text="Kubernetes">
      <BadgeIndicator slot="badge" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavDivider />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Border

Set `border` on the side nav to render a border between it and the content. Useful when both share the same background and would otherwise blend together. Composes with `theme="classic"`, using a themed gray instead of white.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Activity from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Activity.svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen} border>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink
      icon={Dashboard}
      href="/dashboard"
      text="Dashboard"
      isSelected
    />
    <SideNavLink icon={Activity} href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Current page

Set `isSelected` on `SideNavLink` or `SideNavMenuItem` to mark the current page -- see "Dashboard" in the example above. It adds `aria-current="page"` and a persistent highlight style so the current location stays visible even while hovering other items.

A collapsed `SideNavMenu` that contains the current page, at any depth, shows the selected background and accent bar. In the [nested menus](#nested-menus) example, collapse "Kubernetes" to see it.

Set `isActive` on a `SideNavMenu` to mark it for a page the nav doesn't list, such as a detail route under a listed section.

#### Large

Set `large` on `SideNavLink` or `SideNavMenu` to increase the item's height from 32px to 48px -- useful for a top-level item that should stand out, or for larger touch targets. Not available on `SideNavMenuItem` (nested items). Composes with `icon` on both components.

Only the row that sets `large` grows. Its children stay 32px unless they set it too.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderNavMenu,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavDivider,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Activity from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Activity.svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import Kubernetes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Kubernetes.svelte";
  import ListBoxes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/ListBoxes.svelte";
  import Settings from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Settings.svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/support" text="Support" />
    <HeaderNavMenu text="Manage">
      <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/iam" text="Access (IAM)" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing and usage" />
    </HeaderNavMenu>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/status" text="Status" />
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink
      large
      icon={Dashboard}
      href="/dashboard"
      text="Dashboard"
      isSelected
    />
    <SideNavLink
      large
      icon={ListBoxes}
      href="/resources"
      text="Resource list"
    />
    <SideNavLink
      large
      icon={Activity}
      href="/activity"
      text="Activity tracker"
    />
    <SideNavMenu large icon={Kubernetes} text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/registry" text="Container registry" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavDivider />
    <SideNavLink
      large
      icon={Settings}
      href="/settings"
      text="Account settings"
    />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Responsive

On smaller screens, header links belong in the side nav, above the regular side nav items.

Carbon hides the header nav below the large breakpoint (66rem). Duplicate those links with `HeaderSideNavItems`; its children only appear below that breakpoint. Set `hasDivider` to separate them from the regular side nav items below.

`HeaderSideNavItems` is the same menubar laid out vertically: its items are a single <kbd>Tab</kbd> stop, <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> move between them (wrapping at either end), and <kbd>Home</kbd>/<kbd>End</kbd> and typing a character work as in the header. Because Up and Down move between items, a `HeaderNavMenu` opens with <kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> (as well as <kbd>Enter</kbd> or <kbd>Space</kbd>) and <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd> or <kbd>Escape</kbd> closes it and returns focus to the trigger. In a right-to-left layout, the two arrows swap.

Resize the viewport to see the switch.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderNavMenu,
    HeaderSideNavItems,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/support" text="Support" />
    <HeaderNavMenu text="Manage">
      <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/iam" text="Access (IAM)" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing and usage" />
    </HeaderNavMenu>
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <HeaderSideNavItems hasDivider>
      <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/support" text="Support" />
      <HeaderNavMenu text="Manage">
        <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
        <HeaderNavItem href="/iam" text="Access (IAM)" />
        <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing and usage" />
      </HeaderNavMenu>
    </HeaderSideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" isSelected />
    <SideNavLink href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
    <SideNavLink href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Custom expansion breakpoint

By default, the expansion breakpoint is 1056px (Carbon's [large breakpoint](/components/Breakpoint)).

Below that width the side nav is collapsed and the hamburger is shown; opening it shows the overlay. At 1056px and above the side nav is expanded and the hamburger is hidden.

Set `expansionBreakpoint` on both the header and side nav to change that threshold. For example, set it to `Infinity` to keep the overlay collapsed at every viewport size.

The header nav and `HeaderSideNavItems` switch at the same width, so the header links move into the side nav wherever the hamburger appears.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderSideNavItems,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavDivider,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header
  companyName="IBM"
  platformName="Cloud"
  bind:isSideNavOpen
  expansionBreakpoint={Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY}
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/deployments" text="Deployments" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/incidents" text="Incidents" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing" />
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<SideNav
  bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}
  expansionBreakpoint={Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY}
>
  <SideNavItems>
    <HeaderSideNavItems hasDivider>
      <HeaderNavItem href="/deployments" text="Deployments" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/incidents" text="Incidents" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing" />
    </HeaderSideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" />
    <SideNavLink href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
    <SideNavLink href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
    <SideNavMenu text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/registry" text="Container registry" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavDivider />
    <SideNavLink href="/settings" text="Account settings" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>Custom Breakpoint (Infinity)</h1>
        <p>
          By default the side nav expands and the hamburger hides at 1056px and
          above. Here, the hamburger is always visible and the side nav stays
          collapsed with overlay at all viewport sizes. The header links move
          into the side nav at the same width. When opened, the overlay appears
          behind the side nav.
        </p>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Rail hover delay

A rail expands once the pointer rests on it for `enterDelayMs` (default `100`), so passing over it on the way to the content doesn't flash it open. It collapses `leaveDelayMs` after the pointer leaves (default `0`). Keyboard focus expands it at once, and touch never does.

This example waits `300` ms in both directions.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderNavMenu,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavDivider,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Activity from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Activity.svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import Kubernetes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Kubernetes.svelte";
  import ListBoxes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/ListBoxes.svelte";
  import Settings from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Settings.svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/support" text="Support" />
    <HeaderNavMenu text="Manage">
      <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/iam" text="Access (IAM)" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing and usage" />
    </HeaderNavMenu>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/status" text="Status" />
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen} rail enterDelayMs={300} leaveDelayMs={300}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink
      icon={Dashboard}
      text="Dashboard"
      href="/dashboard"
      isSelected
    />
    <SideNavLink icon={ListBoxes} text="Resource list" href="/resources" />
    <SideNavLink icon={Activity} text="Activity tracker" href="/activity" />
    <SideNavMenu expanded icon={Kubernetes} text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/registry" text="Container registry" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavDivider />
    <SideNavLink icon={Settings} text="Account settings" href="/settings" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Pin toggle

`rail` is a plain bindable prop, so a consumer can flip it from a button click to let users pin a collapsed rail open (full width) or unpin it back to its narrow, hover-expand state -- no dedicated pin API is needed on `SideNav` itself.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderGlobalAction,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderNavMenu,
    HeaderUtilities,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavDivider,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Activity from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Activity.svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import Kubernetes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Kubernetes.svelte";
  import ListBoxes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/ListBoxes.svelte";
  import Pin from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Pin.svelte";
  import PinFilled from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/PinFilled.svelte";
  import Settings from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Settings.svelte";

  let rail = true;
  // A non-rail SideNav is an "open/closed" overlay: `rail=false` alone won't
  // show it. Pinning must also open it; unpinning hands isOpen back to the
  // rail (always visible) and the mobile hamburger below.
  let isOpen = false;

  function togglePin() {
    rail = !rail;
    isOpen = !rail;
  }
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen={isOpen}>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/support" text="Support" />
    <HeaderNavMenu text="Manage">
      <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/iam" text="Access (IAM)" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing and usage" />
    </HeaderNavMenu>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/status" text="Status" />
  </HeaderNav>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderGlobalAction
      icon={rail ? Pin : PinFilled}
      isActive={!rail}
      iconDescription={rail ? "Pin side nav open" : "Unpin side nav"}
      tooltipAlignment="end"
      on:click={togglePin}
    />
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen {rail}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink
      icon={Dashboard}
      text="Dashboard"
      href="/dashboard"
      isSelected
    />
    <SideNavLink icon={ListBoxes} text="Resource list" href="/resources" />
    <SideNavLink icon={Activity} text="Activity tracker" href="/activity" />
    <SideNavMenu icon={Kubernetes} text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/registry" text="Container registry" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavDivider />
    <SideNavLink icon={Settings} text="Account settings" href="/settings" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Resizable

Set `resizable` to let the user drag the side nav's trailing edge to resize it with a mouse, pen, or touch. `width` is a bindable prop in pixels (default `256`), rendered clamped to `[minWidth, maxWidth]`, and `Content` offsets its left margin to match.

The handle is also focusable: <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowRight</kbd> step by 16px (64px with <kbd>Shift</kbd>), <kbd>Home</kbd>/<kbd>End</kbd> jump to `minWidth`/`maxWidth`, and double-clicking it restores the starting width. In a right-to-left layout the handle sits on the nav's left edge, and <kbd>ArrowLeft</kbd> widens it. Customize its accessible name with `resizeHandleLabel`. Hovering highlights the handle and shows the resize cursor after `resizeEnterDelayMs` (default `150`), so passing over it on the way to the content doesn't flash it.

`bind:width` updates on every step of a drag; the `resize` event fires once the gesture ends, with the final `width`. This example persists the width with `LocalStorage`, so it survives a reload.

`resizable` has no effect when `rail` is set, since a rail's width is defined by its icon-only vs. hover-expanded state. On mobile, the overlay uses the same width, capped at the viewport width.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    LocalStorage,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Activity from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Activity.svelte";
  import Dashboard from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Dashboard.svelte";
  import ListBoxes from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/ListBoxes.svelte";
  import Settings from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Settings.svelte";

  let width = 256;
  let lastResize;
</script>

<LocalStorage key="side-nav-width" bind:value={width} />

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/support" text="Support" />
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<SideNav
  fixed
  isOpen
  resizable
  bind:width
  minWidth={200}
  maxWidth={480}
  on:resize={(e) => (lastResize = e.detail.width)}
>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink
      icon={Dashboard}
      text="Dashboard"
      href="/dashboard"
      isSelected
    />
    <SideNavLink icon={ListBoxes} text="Resource list" href="/resources" />
    <SideNavLink icon={Activity} text="Activity tracker" href="/activity" />
    <SideNavLink icon={Settings} text="Account settings" href="/settings" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>Dashboard</h1>
        <p>Side nav width: {width}px</p>
        <p>Last resize event: {lastResize ?? "none"}</p>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Events

`SideNav` dispatches `open` and `close` when `isOpen` changes, and `click:overlay` when the mobile overlay behind the panel is clicked (just before it closes):

```svelte
<script>
  import { SideNav, SideNavItems } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<SideNav
  bind:isOpen
  on:open={() => console.log("opened")}
  on:close={() => console.log("closed")}
  on:click:overlay={() => console.log("overlay clicked")}
>
  <SideNavItems>...</SideNavItems>
</SideNav>
```

#### Scroll gradient

When the side nav's content overflows, wrap `SideNavItems` in [ScrollGradient](/components/ScrollGradient) to fade its top and bottom edges as a scroll affordance, hiding each edge's gradient once it's scrolled into view. The side nav's background uses the `background` token rather than `layer`, so pass `color="background"` to match it -- otherwise `ScrollGradient` fades to the wrong color.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    ScrollGradient,
    SideNav,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<SideNav fixed isOpen>
  <ScrollGradient color="background">
    <SideNavItems>
      <SideNavLink href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" isSelected />
      <SideNavLink href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
      <SideNavLink href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
    </SideNavItems>
  </ScrollGradient>
</SideNav>
```
