### Switcher

A `HeaderAction` reveals a panel from the right edge.

#### App switcher

The panel does not animate by default. Enable a slide transition by passing [transition:slide params](https://svelte.dev/docs#slide) to `transition`, for example `{ duration: 200 }`, to customize duration, delay, and easing.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderAction,
    HeaderPanelGroup,
    HeaderPanelLink,
    HeaderPanelLinks,
    HeaderUtilities,
    RadioTile,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
    TileGroup,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import { expoIn } from "svelte/easing";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
  let isOpen = false;
  let selected = "0";
  const transitions = {
    0: {
      text: "None (default)",
      value: false,
    },
    1: {
      text: "Slide (duration: 200ms)",
      value: { duration: 200 },
    },
    2: {
      text: "Custom (duration: 600ms, delay: 50ms, easing: expoIn)",
      value: { duration: 600, delay: 50, easing: expoIn },
    },
  };
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderAction bind:isOpen transition={transitions[selected].value}>
      <HeaderPanelLinks>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Switch product">
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/cloud" isSelected
            >Cloud console</HeaderPanelLink
          >
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/watson-studio">Watson Studio</HeaderPanelLink>
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/maximo"
            >Maximo Application Suite</HeaderPanelLink
          >
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Resources">
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/docs">Documentation</HeaderPanelLink>
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/status">Status page</HeaderPanelLink>
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/community">Community</HeaderPanelLink>
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
      </HeaderPanelLinks>
    </HeaderAction>
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" />
    <SideNavLink href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
    <SideNavLink href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
    <SideNavMenu text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/registry" text="Container registry" />
    </SideNavMenu>
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>App switcher</h1>
        <p>
          Select a transition option below and click on the App Switcher icon in
          the top right.
        </p>
        <TileGroup legendText="App switcher transitions" bind:selected>
          {#each Object.keys(transitions) as key}
            <RadioTile value={key}>{transitions[key].text}</RadioTile>
          {/each}
        </TileGroup>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Multiple switchers

You can mount multiple switchers and customize each button. For example, add a tooltip with `iconDescription`. Press <kbd>Escape</kbd> to hide the tooltip without moving the pointer or focus. While the action has focus and its panel is open, the same press also closes the panel. When the panel closes with focus inside it, focus returns to the action without showing the tooltip. Only one panel stays open at a time: opening a panel closes any other open `HeaderAction`, `ProfileMenu`, or `HeaderSwitcher`.

Control tooltip alignment with `tooltipAlignment`. Providing button text overrides the tooltip.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderAction,
    HeaderPanelGroup,
    HeaderPanelLink,
    HeaderPanelLinks,
    HeaderUtilities,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Help from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Help.svelte";
  import Notification from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Notification.svelte";
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderAction
      iconDescription="Notifications"
      tooltipAlignment="start"
      icon={Notification}
    >
      <HeaderPanelLinks>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Today">
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/activity">
            Cluster "mycluster-prod" was updated
          </HeaderPanelLink>
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Earlier">
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/billing">
            Your monthly invoice is ready
          </HeaderPanelLink>
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
      </HeaderPanelLinks>
    </HeaderAction>
    <HeaderAction iconDescription="Help" icon={Help}>
      <HeaderPanelLinks>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Support">
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/docs">Documentation</HeaderPanelLink>
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Community">
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/support">Open a case</HeaderPanelLink>
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
      </HeaderPanelLinks>
    </HeaderAction>
    <HeaderAction text="IBM Cloud">
      <HeaderPanelLinks>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Switch product">
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/watson-studio">Watson Studio</HeaderPanelLink>
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
      </HeaderPanelLinks>
    </HeaderAction>
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Panel composition

Compose the panel content from `HeaderPanelLinks` and `HeaderPanelLink`, as shown in both examples above. `HeaderPanelLinks` renders the list wrapper and `HeaderPanelLink` renders each item. Group related links under a heading with `HeaderPanelGroup`, and separate groups that have no heading with a plain `HeaderPanelDivider`. The same components compose the notification and help panels in the multiple-switchers example -- panel composition is not specific to the app switcher icon.

| Component | Use it for |
| :-- | :-- |
| `HeaderPanelGroup` | A labelled group of links. Screen readers announce the group by its label. |
| `HeaderPanelDivider` | A plain rule between links. A label passed to it is visual only, so prefer `HeaderPanelGroup` for labelled groups. |

Set `isSelected` on `HeaderPanelLink` to mark the current selection -- see "Cloud console" in the app switcher example above. It adds `aria-current="page"` and a persistent highlight style, the same pattern used by `isSelected` on `HeaderNavItem`, `SideNavLink`, and `SideNavMenuItem`.

#### Panel groups

`HeaderPanelGroup` wraps its links in a nested list named by `label`, so a screen reader announces "Resources, list, 2 items" instead of reading the label as another list item. The visible label and rule are hidden from assistive technology to avoid announcing the label twice. It looks the same as a `HeaderPanelDivider` followed by links. Use the `labelChildren` slot for custom label content.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    HeaderPanelGroup,
    HeaderPanelLink,
    HeaderPanelLinks,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<HeaderPanelLinks>
  <HeaderPanelGroup label="Resources">
    <HeaderPanelLink href="/docs">Documentation</HeaderPanelLink>
    <HeaderPanelLink href="/status">Status page</HeaderPanelLink>
  </HeaderPanelGroup>
</HeaderPanelLinks>
```

#### Panel items

`HeaderPanelLink` renders an anchor when `href` is set. Omit `href` for an action that does not navigate, such as switching a theme; it renders a `<button>` that is reachable with Tab and styled like the link. Set `text` instead of the default slot for a plain label, and `icon` (or the `icon` slot) to render an icon after it. Long labels wrap onto more lines while the icon keeps its size.

Within a `HeaderPanelLinks` list, ArrowUp and ArrowDown move focus between links, including across groups, and wrap at the ends. Home and End jump to the first and last link.

Activating a link closes the panel and dispatches `close` with `trigger: "select"`. Call `event.preventDefault()` in the link's `click` handler to keep the panel open. Focus returns to the panel button only if it would otherwise be lost.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderAction,
    HeaderPanelGroup,
    HeaderPanelLink,
    HeaderPanelLinks,
    HeaderUtilities,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Launch from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Launch.svelte";
  import Settings from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Settings.svelte";

  let theme = "white";
  let trigger = "none";
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderAction
      icon={Settings}
      iconDescription="Settings"
      on:close={(event) => (trigger = event.detail.trigger)}
    >
      <HeaderPanelLinks>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Resources">
          <HeaderPanelLink
            href="https://cloud.ibm.com/docs"
            target="_blank"
            text="Documentation"
            icon={Launch}
          />
          <HeaderPanelLink
            href="https://cloud.ibm.com/status"
            target="_blank"
            text="Service status and incident history"
            icon={Launch}
          />
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Preferences">
          <HeaderPanelLink
            isSelected={theme === "white"}
            text="Light theme"
            on:click={() => (theme = "white")}
          />
          <HeaderPanelLink
            isSelected={theme === "g100"}
            text="Dark theme"
            on:click={() => (theme = "g100")}
          />
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
      </HeaderPanelLinks>
    </HeaderAction>
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>Panel items</h1>
        <p>
          Open the settings panel in the top right. The resource links open in a
          new tab; the theme options are buttons.
        </p>
        <p>Theme: {theme}</p>
        <p>Last close trigger: {trigger}</p>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Events

`HeaderAction` dispatches `open` and `close` as the panel toggles, with `event.detail.trigger` set to `"toggle"`, `"outside-click"`, `"escape-key"`, or `"select"`. Set `preventCloseOnClickOutside` to keep the panel open when the user clicks elsewhere on the page -- useful when the panel hosts its own dismiss controls.

```svelte
<script>
  import { HeaderAction, HeaderPanelLinks } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<HeaderAction
  bind:isOpen
  preventCloseOnClickOutside
  on:open={(event) => console.log(event.detail.trigger)}
  on:close={(event) => console.log(event.detail.trigger)}
>
  <HeaderPanelLinks>...</HeaderPanelLinks>
</HeaderAction>
```

### Search

A `HeaderSearch` adds global search to the header, with customizable result rendering.

#### Global search

Add a global search component to the header.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    Button,
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderSearch,
    HeaderUtilities,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const data = [
    {
      id: "kubernetes-service",
      href: "/",
      text: "Kubernetes Service",
      description:
        "Deploy secure, highly available apps in a native Kubernetes experience. IBM Cloud Kubernetes Service creates a cluster of compute hosts and deploys highly available containers.",
    },
    {
      id: "red-hat-openshift",
      href: "/",
      text: "Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud",
      description:
        "Deploy and secure enterprise workloads on native OpenShift with developer focused tools to run highly available apps. OpenShift clusters build on Kubernetes container orchestration that offers consistency and flexibility in operations.",
    },
    {
      id: "container-registry",
      href: "/",
      text: "Container Registry",
      description:
        "Securely store container images and monitor their vulnerabilities in a private registry.",
    },
    {
      id: "code-engine",
      href: "/",
      text: "Code Engine",
      description:
        "Run your application, job, or container on a managed serverless platform.",
    },
  ];

  let ref = null;
  let active = false;
  let value = "";
  let selectedResultIndex = 0;
  let events = [];

  $: lowerCaseValue = value.toLowerCase();
  $: results =
    value.length > 0
      ? data.filter((item) => {
          return (
            item.text.toLowerCase().includes(lowerCaseValue) ||
            item.description.includes(lowerCaseValue)
          );
        })
      : [];

  $: console.log("ref", ref);
  $: console.log("active", active);
  $: console.log("value", value);
  $: console.log("selectedResultIndex", selectedResultIndex);
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderSearch
      shortcut="mod+k"
      bind:ref
      bind:active
      bind:value
      bind:selectedResultIndex
      placeholder="Search services"
      {results}
      on:active={() => {
        events = [...events, { type: "active" }];
      }}
      on:inactive={() => {
        events = [...events, { type: "inactive" }];
      }}
      on:clear={() => {
        events = [...events, { type: "clear" }];
      }}
      on:select={(e) => {
        events = [...events, { type: "select", ...e.detail }];
      }}
    />
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>HeaderSearch</h1>
        <Button
          on:click={() => {
            active = true;
          }}
        >
          Activate the search bar
        </Button>
        <h2>Reactive values</h2>
        <p><strong>active</strong>: {active}</p>
        <p><strong>value</strong>: {value}</p>
        <p><strong>selectedResultIndex</strong>: {selectedResultIndex}</p>
        <h2>Events</h2>
        <p>
          Click the button and search for something. Dispatched events are
          logged below:
        </p>
        <Box overflowX="auto">
          <Stack gap={2}>
            {#each events as { type, ...rest }}
              <div>
                <div><strong>on:{type}</strong></div>
                {#if Object.keys(rest).length > 0}
                  <pre>{JSON.stringify(rest, null, 2)}</pre>
                {/if}
              </div>
            {/each}
          </Stack>
        </Box>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Keyboard shortcut

Set `shortcut` to open the search from anywhere on the page, such as `"mod+k"` (<DocKbd shortcut="mod+k" /> on your platform). While closed, the search shows the keys beside its icon, or the icon alone on small screens, and announces them with `aria-keyshortcuts`. The global search above uses `mod+k`. To do something else, such as opening a command palette, handle `on:shortcut` and call `preventDefault()`.

#### Custom results

Override the default slot to customize each result. The slot exposes `let:result`, `let:index`, and `let:selected` for the highlighted row.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Content,
    Header,
    HeaderSearch,
    HeaderUtilities,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const data = [
    {
      id: "kubernetes-service",
      href: "/",
      text: "Kubernetes Service",
      description: "Deploy secure, highly available apps.",
    },
    {
      id: "red-hat-openshift",
      href: "/",
      text: "Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud",
      description: "Deploy and secure enterprise workloads.",
    },
    {
      id: "container-registry",
      href: "/",
      text: "Container Registry",
      description: "Securely store container images.",
    },
  ];

  let active = false;
  let value = "";
  let selectedResultIndex = 0;

  $: lowerCaseValue = value.toLowerCase();
  $: results =
    value.length > 0
      ? data.filter((item) => item.text.toLowerCase().includes(lowerCaseValue))
      : [];
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderSearch
      bind:active
      bind:value
      bind:selectedResultIndex
      placeholder="Search services"
      {results}
      let:result
      let:selected
    >
      <div>
        <strong>{result.text}</strong>
        {#if selected}
          <span>&nbsp;(selected)</span>
        {/if}
      </div>
      <div>{result.description}</div>
    </HeaderSearch>
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<Content>
  <p>Activate the search bar and type "service" to see custom results.</p>
</Content>
```

#### Customization

Set `icon` to render a different trigger icon. Use `placeholder`, `labelText`, and `closeButtonLabelText` to localize the input placeholder, the assistive field label, and the clear button label.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Header,
    HeaderSearch,
    HeaderUtilities,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import ImageSearchAlt from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/ImageSearchAlt.svelte";

  const data = [
    { id: "kubernetes-service", href: "/", text: "Kubernetes Service" },
    { id: "code-engine", href: "/", text: "Code Engine" },
    { id: "container-registry", href: "/", text: "Container Registry" },
  ];

  let value = "";

  $: results =
    value.length > 0
      ? data.filter((item) =>
          item.text.toLowerCase().includes(value.toLowerCase()),
        )
      : [];
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderSearch
      bind:value
      icon={ImageSearchAlt}
      placeholder="Search secure services"
      labelText="Search secure services"
      closeButtonLabelText="Clear the search query"
      {results}
    />
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>
```

#### Menu slot

Use the `menu` slot to render [SearchMenu](/components/SearchMenu) items in the header. Compose `SearchMenuGroup` and `SearchMenuItem` for grouped, fuzzy-highlighted results with icons, persistent footer actions, and a `loading` skeleton state.

When the `menu` slot is present, it replaces the `results` prop. Keyboard navigation uses `role="option"`. Press <kbd>Enter</kbd> with no selection to dispatch `submit`. Use the `noResults` slot when nothing matches. The `results` prop still works if you do not use `menu`.

Set `size` to `"sm"` (default), `"lg"`, or `"xl"` to control row density. Result text stays flush with the header input at every size. Pass `icon` or `iconRight` to each `SearchMenuItem`, or use the default slot with `let:segments` to highlight the query in secondary text like a description.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Content,
    FormGroup,
    Header,
    HeaderSearch,
    HeaderUtilities,
    RadioButton,
    RadioButtonGroup,
    SearchMenuGroup,
    SearchMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Document from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Document.svelte";
  import Launch from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Launch.svelte";

  const docs = [
    { id: "accordion", text: "Accordion", href: "/components/Accordion" },
    { id: "button", text: "Button", href: "/components/Button" },
    { id: "data-table", text: "DataTable", href: "/components/DataTable" },
    { id: "dropdown", text: "Dropdown", href: "/components/Dropdown" },
    { id: "search-menu", text: "SearchMenu", href: "/components/SearchMenu" },
    { id: "header-search", text: "HeaderSearch", href: "/components/UIShell" },
  ];

  let value = "";
  let active = false;
  let size = "sm";
  let events = [];
</script>

<Header companyName="Carbon" platformName="Svelte">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderSearch
      bind:value
      bind:active
      {size}
      placeholder="Search..."
      on:select={(e) => (events = [{ type: "select", ...e.detail }, ...events])}
      on:submit={(e) => (events = [{ type: "submit", ...e.detail }, ...events])}
      on:close={(e) => (events = [{ type: "close", ...e.detail }, ...events])}
    >
      <svelte:fragment slot="menu">
        <SearchMenuGroup label="Docs">
          {#each docs as doc (doc.id)}
            <SearchMenuItem text={doc.text} href={doc.href} icon={Document} />
          {/each}
        </SearchMenuGroup>

        <SearchMenuGroup divider>
          <SearchMenuItem
            persistent
            iconRight={Launch}
            href="https://www.google.com/search?q={encodeURIComponent(value)}"
          >
            Search "{value}" in <strong>Docs</strong>
          </SearchMenuItem>
        </SearchMenuGroup>
      </svelte:fragment>

      <svelte:fragment slot="noResults">No matching components</svelte:fragment>
    </HeaderSearch>
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<Content>
  <h1>HeaderSearch (menu slot)</h1>
  <p>
    Open search and type a component name (e.g. "data"). Results fuzzy-match and
    highlight, grouped under a header, with a persistent footer action.
  </p>

  <FormGroup legendText="Menu size">
    <RadioButtonGroup bind:selected={size}>
      <RadioButton value="sm" labelText="Small" />
      <RadioButton value="lg" labelText="Large" />
      <RadioButton value="xl" labelText="Extra large" />
    </RadioButtonGroup>
  </FormGroup>

  <pre>{JSON.stringify(events.slice(0, 5), null, 2)}</pre>
</Content>
```

#### Select on focus

Set `selectTextOnFocus` to select the full value when the search bar receives focus.

```svelte
<script>
  import { HeaderSearch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<HeaderSearch selectTextOnFocus bind:value />
```

#### Debounce

Set `debounce` to delay a `search` event until typing pauses, in milliseconds -- useful for fetching results (`results` or the `menu` slot) without a request per keystroke. `value` stays immediate; only `search` waits. The default `debounce` of `0` never dispatches `search`.

Selecting a result or submitting with <kbd>Enter</kbd> cancels a pending `search` rather than also firing it. Clearing the field is always instant and also cancels a pending `search` -- with the clear icon, or with <kbd>Escape</kbd> when it clears the value (pressing <kbd>Escape</kbd> to close an open `menu` slot, like `SearchMenu`, leaves the value and any pending `search` untouched).

#### Events

`HeaderSearch` dispatches `active` and `inactive` as the search bar opens and closes, `clear` when the clear ("x") button is clicked, `select` when a result is chosen (from `results` or the `menu` slot), `submit` with the value when <kbd>Enter</kbd> is pressed with no result selected, and `search` after the `debounce` pause (see [Debounce](#debounce)).

It also dispatches `close` -- with `event.detail.trigger` set to `"escape-key"`, `"outside-click"`, `"blur"` (<kbd>Tab</kbd> moved focus out of it), or `"select"` -- whenever the search bar deactivates, whether the user dismissed it or selected a result:

```svelte
<script>
  import { HeaderSearch } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<HeaderSearch
  bind:value
  on:active={() => console.log("active")}
  on:inactive={() => console.log("inactive")}
  on:clear={() => console.log("cleared")}
  on:select={(event) => console.log(event.detail)}
  on:close={(event) => console.log(event.detail.trigger)}
/>
```

#### Action links

Use `HeaderActionLink` instead of `HeaderGlobalAction` when the utility is a plain link rather than a button that toggles a panel -- for example, a link out to a GitHub repository. Set `icon`, `href`, and `target="_blank"` as needed; set `linkIsActive` to style it as active.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderActionLink,
    HeaderGlobalAction,
    HeaderUtilities,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import LogoGithub from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/LogoGithub.svelte";
  import Notification from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Notification.svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderActionLink
      href="https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-components-svelte"
      target="_blank"
      icon={LogoGithub}
      aria-label="GitHub repository"
    />
    <HeaderGlobalAction
      iconDescription="Notifications"
      tooltipAlignment="end"
      icon={Notification}
    />
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

### Profile menu

Use `ProfileMenu` for an account menu in the header.

#### Fallback avatar

When the `avatar` slot is empty, a default [UserAvatar](/components/UserAvatar) renders. The menu closes on outside click and <kbd>Escape</kbd>.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Content,
    Header,
    HeaderUtilities,
    ProfileMenu,
    ProfileMenuDivider,
    ProfileMenuHeader,
    ProfileMenuItem,
    ProfileMenuList,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Logout from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Logout.svelte";
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Carbon Svelte">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <ProfileMenu iconDescription="Profile">
      <ProfileMenuHeader
        name="Richard Hendricks"
        username="rhendricks"
        href="/"
      />
      <ProfileMenuDivider />
      <ProfileMenuList>
        <ProfileMenuItem href="/">Settings</ProfileMenuItem>
        <ProfileMenuItem href="/">Privacy</ProfileMenuItem>
      </ProfileMenuList>
      <ProfileMenuDivider />
      <ProfileMenuList>
        <ProfileMenuItem icon={Logout} on:click={() => {}}>
          Log out
        </ProfileMenuItem>
      </ProfileMenuList>
    </ProfileMenu>
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<Content>
  <h1>Welcome</h1>
</Content>
```

From the trigger, <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> open the menu and move focus to the first or last `ProfileMenuItem`. Once inside, <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> move between items (wrapping at either end), and <kbd>Home</kbd>/<kbd>End</kbd> jump to the first or last item.

#### Composed menu

Render the avatar with [UserAvatar](/components/UserAvatar) in the `avatar` slot, and compose the card from `ProfileMenuHeader`, `ProfileMenuList`, `ProfileMenuItem`, and `ProfileMenuDivider`.

```svelte
<script>

    Content,
    Header,
    HeaderUtilities,
    ProfileMenu,
    ProfileMenuDivider,
    ProfileMenuHeader,
    ProfileMenuItem,
    ProfileMenuList,

    UserAvatar,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Logout from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Logout.svelte";
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Carbon Svelte">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <ProfileMenu iconDescription="Profile">
      <UserAvatar
        slot="avatar"
        size="md"
        name="Monica Hall"
        backgroundColor="purple"
      />

      <ProfileMenuHeader name="Monica Hall" username="mhall" text="">
        <UserAvatar
          slot="avatar"
          size="lg"
          name="Monica Hall"
          backgroundColor="purple"
        />
      </ProfileMenuHeader>
      <ProfileMenuDivider />
      <ProfileMenuList>
        <ProfileMenuItem href="/">Settings</ProfileMenuItem>
        <ProfileMenuItem href="/">Privacy</ProfileMenuItem>
      </ProfileMenuList>
      <ProfileMenuDivider />
      <ProfileMenuList>
        <ProfileMenuItem icon={Logout} on:click={() => {}}>
          Log out
        </ProfileMenuItem>
      </ProfileMenuList>
    </ProfileMenu>
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<Content>
  <h1>Welcome</h1>
</Content>
```

#### Events

`ProfileMenu` dispatches `open` and `close` as the menu toggles, with `event.detail.trigger` set to `"toggle"`, `"outside-click"`, `"escape-key"`, or `"select"` (`close` only). Activating a `ProfileMenuItem` closes the menu and dispatches `close` with `trigger: "select"`. Call `event.preventDefault()` in the item's `click` handler to keep the menu open. Focus returns to the trigger only if it would otherwise be lost. Set `preventCloseOnClickOutside` to keep the menu open when the user clicks elsewhere on the page, and `transition` (for example `{ duration: 200 }`) to animate the menu open and closed -- by default it does not animate.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ProfileMenu, ProfileMenuList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<ProfileMenu
  bind:isOpen
  preventCloseOnClickOutside
  on:open={(event) => console.log("opened", event.detail.trigger)}
  on:close={(event) => console.log("closed", event.detail.trigger)}
>
  <ProfileMenuList>...</ProfileMenuList>
</ProfileMenu>
```

### Account switcher

Use `HeaderSwitcher` in place of the header logo to let users switch between accounts or workspaces. The trigger shows the active account name; the chevron rotates to indicate the open state.

_Prototype -- pending review._

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderSwitcher,
    ProfileMenuDivider,
    ProfileMenuItem,
    ProfileMenuList,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
    UserAvatar,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Add from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Add.svelte";
  import Checkmark from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Checkmark.svelte";

  const workspaces = [
    { id: "acme", name: "Acme Corp" },
    { id: "globex", name: "Globex Industries" },
    { id: "initech", name: "Initech" },
    {
      id: "umbrella",
      name: "Umbrella Regional Distribution & Logistics Cooperative",
    },
  ];

  let activeId = "acme";
  let isOpen = false;

  $: active = workspaces.find((workspace) => workspace.id === activeId);
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderSwitcher text={active.name} bind:isOpen>
    <svelte:fragment slot="avatar">
      <UserAvatar name={active.name} backgroundColor="auto" size="sm" />
    </svelte:fragment>
    <ProfileMenuList>
      {#each workspaces as workspace (workspace.id)}
        <ProfileMenuItem
          icon={workspace.id === activeId ? Checkmark : undefined}
          on:click={() => {
            activeId = workspace.id;
            isOpen = false;
          }}
        >
          <svelte:fragment slot="avatar">
            <UserAvatar
              name={workspace.name}
              backgroundColor="auto"
              size="sm"
            />
          </svelte:fragment>
          {workspace.name}
        </ProfileMenuItem>
      {/each}
    </ProfileMenuList>
    <ProfileMenuDivider />
    <ProfileMenuList>
      <ProfileMenuItem icon={Add}>Create workspace</ProfileMenuItem>
    </ProfileMenuList>
  </HeaderSwitcher>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>{active.name}</h1>
        <p>Switch workspaces from the trigger in the header above.</p>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

Compose the dropdown from [`ProfileMenuList`](#profile-menu) and `ProfileMenuItem`, as shown above. Pass an `icon` to `ProfileMenuItem` to mark the active account, and use its `avatar` slot for a leading avatar. The label truncates with an ellipsis when the name overflows the menu width, as shown by the last item.

The trigger's `text` truncates with an ellipsis past `maxWidth`, defaulting to `"10rem"`, so a long account name does not push the header wider. Set `maxWidth` to a different CSS length, or to `"none"` to let the trigger grow with the text instead.

<kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> and <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> from the trigger open the menu and move focus to the first or last item. Once inside, <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>/<kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> move between items (wrapping at either end), <kbd>Home</kbd>/<kbd>End</kbd> jump to the first or last item, and <kbd>Escape</kbd> closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.

#### No avatar

Neither `HeaderSwitcher` nor `ProfileMenuItem` renders a default avatar -- the `avatar` slot is empty unless you provide one. Omit it on both for a text-only trigger and menu.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderSwitcher,
    ProfileMenuItem,
    ProfileMenuList,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Checkmark from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Checkmark.svelte";

  const accounts = [
    { id: "acme", name: "Acme Corp" },
    { id: "globex", name: "Globex Industries" },
    { id: "initech", name: "Initech" },
  ];

  let activeId = "acme";
  let isOpen = false;

  $: active = accounts.find((account) => account.id === activeId);
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderSwitcher text={active.name} bind:isOpen>
    <ProfileMenuList>
      {#each accounts as account (account.id)}
        <ProfileMenuItem
          icon={account.id === activeId ? Checkmark : undefined}
          on:click={() => {
            activeId = account.id;
            isOpen = false;
          }}
        >
          {account.name}
        </ProfileMenuItem>
      {/each}
    </ProfileMenuList>
  </HeaderSwitcher>
</Header>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <h1>{active.name}</h1>
        <p>
          No avatar slot on the trigger or the items -- a text-only switcher.
        </p>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Events

`HeaderSwitcher` dispatches `open` and `close` as the menu toggles, with `event.detail.trigger` set to `"toggle"`, `"outside-click"`, `"escape-key"`, or `"select"` (`close` only). ```svelte
<script>
  import { HeaderSwitcher, ProfileMenuList } from "carbon-components-svelte";

<HeaderSwitcher

### Integrations

The UI Shell coordinates body scroll locking and notifications with other components.

#### Modal

Opening a modal while the mobile side nav overlay is also open keeps body scroll locked until both close. The lock is ref-counted across components.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    Modal,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
  let open = false;
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud" bind:isSideNavOpen>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
  </HeaderNav>
</Header>

<SideNav bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" />
    <SideNavLink href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
    <SideNavMenu text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
    </SideNavMenu>
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Modal
  bind:open
  modalHeading="Create cluster"
  primaryButtonText="Create"
  secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
  on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  on:submit={() => (open = false)}
>
  <p>
    The body scroll lock is ref-counted, so opening this modal while the side
    nav overlay is also open keeps the page locked until both are closed.
  </p>
</Modal>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <Stack gap={6}>
          <h1>Clusters</h1>
          <Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Create cluster</Button>
        </Stack>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

#### Toast notification

Integrate toasts with the UI Shell. This example triggers a toast, which appears in the top right corner, below the header.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Button,
    ButtonSet,
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    NotificationQueue,
    Row,
    SkipToContent,
    Stack,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let queue;
  let queuePosition = "top-right";

  const triggerToast = (position) => {
    queuePosition = position;
    queue.add({
      kind: "success",
      title: "Cluster created",
      subtitle: "Your Kubernetes cluster is now provisioning.",
      timeout: 5000,
    });
  };
</script>

<Header companyName="IBM" platformName="Cloud">
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
</Header>

<NotificationQueue bind:this={queue} position={queuePosition} />

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column>
        <Stack gap={6}>
          <h1>Clusters</h1>
          <p>
            Click the buttons below to trigger toast notifications in different
            positions.
          </p>
          <ButtonSet>
            <Button on:click={() => triggerToast("top-right")}>
              Top right
            </Button>
            <Button on:click={() => triggerToast("bottom-right")}>
              Bottom right
            </Button>
          </ButtonSet>
        </Stack>
      </Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

### Classic theme

Before version 0.105.0, the UI Shell defaulted to a mixed theme: **Gray 100** header and **White** side navigation. Now it follows the active theme (`white`, `g10`, `g80`, `g90`, `g100`).

Set `theme="classic"` on both the header and side nav for the classic look: **Gray 100** header and **White** side navigation, independent of the global theme. The classic theme requires **carbon-components-svelte/css/all.css** because it relies on CSS custom properties.

```css
import "carbon-components-svelte/css/all.css";
```

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Column,
    Content,
    Grid,
    Header,
    HeaderAction,
    HeaderNav,
    HeaderNavItem,
    HeaderNavMenu,
    HeaderPanelGroup,
    HeaderPanelLink,
    HeaderPanelLinks,
    HeaderUtilities,
    Row,
    SideNav,
    SideNavDivider,
    SideNavItems,
    SideNavLink,
    SideNavMenu,
    SideNavMenuItem,
    SkipToContent,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let isSideNavOpen = false;
  let isOpen = false;
</script>

<Header
  companyName="IBM"
  platformName="Cloud"
  theme="classic"
  bind:isSideNavOpen
>
  <svelte:fragment slot="skipToContent"><SkipToContent /></svelte:fragment>
  <HeaderNav>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/catalog" text="Catalog" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/docs" text="Docs" />
    <HeaderNavItem href="/support" text="Support" />
    <HeaderNavMenu text="Manage">
      <HeaderNavItem href="/account" text="Account" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/iam" text="Access (IAM)" />
      <HeaderNavItem href="/billing" text="Billing and usage" />
    </HeaderNavMenu>
    <HeaderNavItem href="/status" text="Status" />
  </HeaderNav>
  <HeaderUtilities>
    <HeaderAction bind:isOpen>
      <HeaderPanelLinks>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Switch product">
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/cloud">Cloud console</HeaderPanelLink>
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
        <HeaderPanelGroup label="Resources">
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/docs">Documentation</HeaderPanelLink>
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/status">Status page</HeaderPanelLink>
          <HeaderPanelLink href="/community">Community</HeaderPanelLink>
        </HeaderPanelGroup>
      </HeaderPanelLinks>
    </HeaderAction>
  </HeaderUtilities>
</Header>

<SideNav theme="classic" bind:isOpen={isSideNavOpen}>
  <SideNavItems>
    <SideNavLink href="/dashboard" text="Dashboard" />
    <SideNavLink href="/resources" text="Resource list" />
    <SideNavLink href="/activity" text="Activity tracker" />
    <SideNavMenu text="Kubernetes">
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/clusters" text="Clusters" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/worker-pools" text="Worker pools" />
      <SideNavMenuItem href="/kubernetes/registry" text="Container registry" />
    </SideNavMenu>
    <SideNavDivider />
    <SideNavLink href="/settings" text="Account settings" />
  </SideNavItems>
</SideNav>

<Content>
  <Grid>
    <Row>
      <Column><h1>Dashboard</h1></Column>
    </Row>
  </Grid>
</Content>
```

### Component API

#### `Header` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `isSideNavOpen` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the side nav. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLAnchorElement` | Obtain a reference to the HTML anchor element. | `null` |
| `expandedByDefault` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to hide the side nav by default | `true` |
| `uiShellAriaLabel` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the ARIA label for the header. | _undefined_ |
| `href` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the `href` attribute. | _undefined_ |
| `companyName` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the company name.<br /><br />Alternatively, use the named slot "company". | _undefined_ |
| `platformName` | `string` | Specify the platform name.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "platform". | `""` |
| `persistentHamburgerMenu` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to persist the hamburger menu | `false` |
| `expansionBreakpoint` | `number` | The window width (px) at which the SideNav is expanded and the<br />hamburger menu is hidden. Defaults to Carbon's "large" breakpoint<br />(`breakpoints.lg` in `src/Breakpoint/breakpoints.js`). | `1056` |
| `iconMenu` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render for the closed state. | `Menu` |
| `iconClose` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render for the opened state. | `Close` |
| `ariaLabelMenu` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the ARIA label for the hamburger menu.<br />Defaults to "Open menu" or "Close menu" based on `isSideNavOpen` state. | _undefined_ |
| `theme` | `"classic" \| undefined` | Set to `"classic"` for the mixed UI Shell theme (Gray 100 header).<br />Use with `SideNav` `theme="classic"` (White side nav).<br />Requires `carbon-components-svelte/css/all.css`. | _undefined_ |

#### `Header` slots

| Slot            | Detail                  |
| --------------- | ----------------------- |
| `default`       | `Record<string, never>` |
| `company`       | `Record<string, never>` |
| `platform`      | `Record<string, never>` |
| `skipToContent` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `Header` forwarded events

| Event      |
| ---------- |
| `on:click` |

#### `Header` $$restProps

`Header` spreads `$$restProps` to the `a` element.

#### `HeaderAction` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `isOpen` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to open the panel. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLButtonElement` | Obtain a reference to the button HTML element. | `null` |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render when the action panel is closed. | `Switcher` |
| `closeIcon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render when the action panel is open. | `Close` |
| `text` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the text displayed next to the icon.<br />Alternatively, use the named slot "textChildren". | _undefined_ |

#### `HeaderSearch` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` (Reactive) | `string` | Specify the search input value. | `""` |
| `active` (Reactive) | `boolean` | Set to `true` to activate and focus the search bar. | `false` |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLInputElement` | Obtain a reference to the input HTML element. | `null` |
| `selectedResultIndex` (Reactive) | `number` | Specify the selected result index. | `0` |
| `results` | `ReadonlyArray<Result>` | Render a list of search results. | `[]` |
| `icon` | `Icon` | Specify the icon to render for the search trigger. | `IconSearch` |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Specify the `placeholder` attribute of the search input. | `"Search..."` |
| `labelText` | `string` | Specify the text for the assistive label associated with the search input. | `"Search"` |
| `closeButtonLabelText` | `string` | Specify the label for the clear button. | `"Clear search input"` |
| `shortcut` | `string` | Specify a keyboard shortcut that opens the search and focuses it, such<br />as `"mod+k"` or `"/"`. `mod` is Command on Apple platforms and Ctrl<br />elsewhere. The closed search button shows the keys in its tooltip and<br />gets `aria-keyshortcuts`. | `""` |
| `shouldFilter` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to filter `menu`-slot items by the search value using fuzzy<br />matching. Requires the `menu` slot; ignored when using the `results` prop. | `true` |
| `match` | `(text: string, query: string) => { matched: boolean; indices?: number[] }` | Override how the search value is matched against each `menu`-slot item's<br />`text`. Receives the item `text` and the current search value, and returns<br />whether the item `matched` along with the `indices` of characters to<br />highlight. Defaults to fuzzy matching. Requires the `menu` slot. | `fuzzyMatch` |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render a skeleton menu while results are loading.<br />Override the placeholder rows with the `loading` slot. Requires the<br />`menu` slot. | `false` |
| `skeletonCount` | `number` | Number of skeleton rows while `loading`. Requires the `menu` slot. | `4` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "lg" \| "xl"` | Row density for the `menu` slot. Result text stays flush with the header<br />input; smaller sizes shorten rows to fit more results. | `"sm"` |
| `selectTextOnFocus` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to select the input's text when it receives focus | `false` |
| `debounce` | `number` | Milliseconds to wait after the last input before dispatching `search`.<br />0 (default) does not dispatch `search`. `value` stays immediate; only<br />`search` waits. Selecting a result or submitting cancels a pending<br />`search` instead of also firing it. Clearing is always instant. | `0` |
| `id` | `string` | Set an id for the top-level element.<br />The input, label, menu, and result ids derive from it as `{id}-input`,<br />`{id}-label`, `{id}-menu`, and `{id}-menuitem-{result id or index}`.<br />Previously a passed `id` was discarded; it now sets the top-level element<br />id and the input id becomes `{id}-input`. | `uniqueId()` |

`SideNavMenuItem` spreads `$$restProps` to the `a` element.

#### `SideNavDivider` $$restProps

`SideNavDivider` spreads `$$restProps` to the `li` element.

#### `Content` props

#### `Content` slots

## UnorderedList

### Basic

Create a basic unordered list with list item components. For tree-structured data, consider [RecursiveList](/components/RecursiveList).

```svelte
<script>
  import { ListItem, UnorderedList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UnorderedList>
  <ListItem>Rotate the service account key at least every 90 days</ListItem>
  <ListItem>Grant the least privilege required for the integration</ListItem>
  <ListItem>Review audit logs weekly for anomalous access</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
```

### With links

Add links to list items by wrapping them in link components.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link, ListItem, UnorderedList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UnorderedList>
  <ListItem>
    <Link href="#">API reference</Link>
  </ListItem>
  <ListItem>
    <Link href="#">Deployment runbook</Link>
  </ListItem>
  <ListItem>
    <Link href="#">Incident response playbook</Link>
  </ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
```

### Nested lists

Create hierarchical lists by setting `nested` on a child unordered list component.

```svelte
<script>
  import { ListItem, UnorderedList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UnorderedList>
  <ListItem>
    Workspace settings
    <UnorderedList nested>
      <ListItem>Billing</ListItem>
      <ListItem>
        Access control
        <UnorderedList nested>
          <ListItem>Role assignments</ListItem>
          <ListItem>SSO configuration</ListItem>
        </UnorderedList>
      </ListItem>
    </UnorderedList>
  </ListItem>
  <ListItem>Audit logs</ListItem>
  <ListItem>API keys</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
```

### Expressive styles

Use Carbon's expressive typesetting with `expressive`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Link, ListItem, UnorderedList } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UnorderedList expressive>
  <ListItem><Link size="lg" href="#">Read the onboarding guide</Link></ListItem>
  <ListItem>Request access to the staging environment</ListItem>
  <ListItem>Schedule a walkthrough with your team lead</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
```

### Virtualization

Render thousands of items with [VirtualList](/components/VirtualList). Set `spacerTag` to `"li"` so it renders only the items in view, straight into the list. Wrap the list in a [ScrollGradient](/components/ScrollGradient), pass its `scrollElementRef` as `scrollElement`, and pad the list on the left so the bullets are not clipped. Set `measured` if items can wrap.

```svelte
<script>
  import {
    Box,
    ListItem,
    ScrollGradient,
    UnorderedList,
    VirtualList,
  } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  const services = ["checkout-api", "billing-worker", "search-indexer"];
  const findings = [
    "uses a key older than 90 days",
    "grants write access it never uses",
    "has no owner on call",
    "logs request bodies",
  ];

  const items = Array.from({ length: 3000 }, (_, i) => ({
    id: i,
    label: `${services[i % services.length]} ${findings[i % findings.length]}`,
  }));

  let scrollElementRef = null;
</script>

<ScrollGradient height="240px" bind:scrollElementRef>
  <Box paddingY={4} paddingX={5}>
    <UnorderedList>
      <VirtualList
        {items}
        itemHeight={20}
        containerHeight={240}
        scrollElement={scrollElementRef}
        spacerTag="li"
        measured
        getKey={(item) => item.id}
        let:item
      >
        <ListItem>{item.label}</ListItem>
      </VirtualList>
    </UnorderedList>
  </Box>
</ScrollGradient>
```

---

### Component API

#### `UnorderedList` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nested` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use the nested variant | `false` |
| `expressive` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to use Carbon's expressive typesetting | `false` |

#### `UnorderedList` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `UnorderedList` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `UnorderedList` $$restProps

`UnorderedList` spreads `$$restProps` to the `ul` element.

#### `ListItem` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |

#### `ListItem` forwarded events

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

#### `ListItem` $$restProps

`ListItem` spreads `$$restProps` to the `li` element.


## UserAvatar

### Content

The avatar renders the first available of custom slotted content, an image, a custom icon, initials, or the default user icon. It is designed for the UI Shell [profile menu](/components/UIShell#profile-menu).

#### Fallback icon

Render the avatar without any content to show the default user icon.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar />
```

#### Initials

Set `name` to derive the user's initials. The first character of each word is used, capped at two.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar name="Monica" />
<UserAvatar name="Richard Hendricks" />
```

Set `initials` to override the derived initials while keeping `name` for display purposes such as tooltips.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  name="Richard J. Hendricks"
  initials="RH"
  tooltipText="Richard J. Hendricks"
/>
```

Initials come from `getInitials`, which takes the first user-perceived character of each word so emoji and accented letters stay intact. Import it from the package to compute the same initials elsewhere, for example in a legend.

```html
<script context="module">
  import { getInitials } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  getInitials("Richard J. Hendricks"); // "RJ"
  getInitials("Richard J. Hendricks", { max: 3 }); // "RJH"
</script>
```

Set `locale` for language-specific casing, such as `"tr"`.

#### Custom icon

Set `icon` to render a custom icon instead of the default user icon, such as an icon from [carbon-icons-svelte](https://github.com/carbon-design-system/carbon-icons-svelte).

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Bot from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Bot.svelte";
  import Group from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Group.svelte";
  import Password from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Password.svelte";
  import UserAvatarFilledAlt from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/UserAvatarFilledAlt.svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar icon={UserAvatarFilledAlt} />
<UserAvatar icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
<UserAvatar icon={Password} backgroundColor="teal" />
<UserAvatar icon={Group} backgroundColor="cool-gray" />
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import Bot from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/Bot.svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar size="sm" icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
<UserAvatar size="md" icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
<UserAvatar size="lg" icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
<UserAvatar size="xl" icon={Bot} backgroundColor="purple" />
```

#### Custom content

Use the default slot to render arbitrary content, such as a status badge, instead of the computed image, icon, or initials. Slotted content takes priority over `image`, `icon`, and `initials`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar backgroundColor="cyan">99+</UserAvatar>
```

### Image

Set `image` to render a photo. Provide `imageDescription` for the alternative text. The image fills the circle (`object-fit: cover`) and takes priority over the icon and initials.

If the image fails to load, the avatar falls back to the icon or initials and dispatches `image:error`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  size="xl"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
/>
```

#### Image attributes

Pass HTML attributes to the image with `imageAttributes`. Use this for values such as `loading`, `srcset`, or `referrerPolicy`. Rest props stay on the host element; `image` and `imageDescription` still set `src` and `alt`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  size="xl"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
  imageAttributes={{ loading: "lazy" }}
/>
```

### Sizes

Set `size` to control avatar size. The default is `"md"`. The sizes are 24, 32, 48 and 64 pixels, as in Carbon. The size applies to any content; the image fills the frame at every size, and initials step up the type scale.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  size="sm"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
/>
<UserAvatar
  size="md"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
/>
<UserAvatar
  size="lg"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
/>
<UserAvatar
  size="xl"
  image="https://i.pravatar.cc/300?img=12"
  imageDescription="Richard Hendricks"
/>
```

```svelte
<script>
  import { Stack, UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<Stack orientation="horizontal" gap={3} align="center">
  <UserAvatar size="sm" name="Richard Hendricks" />
  <UserAvatar size="md" name="Richard Hendricks" />
  <UserAvatar size="lg" name="Richard Hendricks" />
  <UserAvatar size="xl" name="Richard Hendricks" />
</Stack>
```

### Background colors

Set `backgroundColor` to choose the color rendered behind the initials or icon. The default is `"gray"`. Dark themes use a lighter step of each color with dark initials, so the text keeps at least 5:1 contrast.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar backgroundColor="red" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="magenta" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="purple" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="blue" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="cyan" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="teal" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="green" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="gray" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="cool-gray" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="warm-gray" name="Richard Hendricks" />
```

#### Strong shade

Set `shade` to `"strong"` for a fill that stands further from the page: a darker step in light themes and a lighter one in dark themes, as in Carbon's `order-7` to `order-12` colors. Every color has a strong shade, and `"auto"` keeps its hue.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar backgroundColor="red" shade="strong" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="magenta" shade="strong" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="purple" shade="strong" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="blue" shade="strong" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="cyan" shade="strong" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="teal" shade="strong" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="green" shade="strong" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="gray" shade="strong" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar
  backgroundColor="cool-gray"
  shade="strong"
  name="Richard Hendricks"
/>
<UserAvatar
  backgroundColor="warm-gray"
  shade="strong"
  name="Richard Hendricks"
/>
```

#### Automatic background color

Set `backgroundColor` to `"auto"` to pick a color from `name` (or `initials`). The name is hashed into one of the palette swatches. The same name always gets the same color.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Richard Hendricks" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Dinesh Chugtai" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Bertram Gilfoyle" />
<UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Jared Dunn" />
```

### Clickable avatar

Render the avatar as an interactive element instead of a static `span` -- a `button` for a custom control, or an anchor for a link.

#### Interactive

Set `interactive` to render a `button` instead of a `span` when the avatar is a clickable control, such as a custom profile menu trigger. The button receives a focus ring. `name` is used as the accessible name when `aria-label` is not set.

Do not set `interactive` when slotting the avatar into [ProfileMenu](/components/UIShell#profile-menu) -- that component already wraps the avatar in a labelled trigger button.

The button forwards `keydown`, focus, and blur events, so it can control a popover or a menu.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar interactive name="Richard Hendricks" backgroundColor="purple" />
```

#### Link

Set `href` to render an anchor, for example a profile page link. `href` takes priority over `interactive`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar href="/profile" name="Richard Hendricks" backgroundColor="blue" />
```

### Status

Set `status` to show a presence indicator at the bottom-right of the avatar. Use `"online"`, `"away"`, `"busy"`, or `"offline"`.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar name="Monica" status="online" />
<UserAvatar name="Richard Hendricks" status="away" />
<UserAvatar name="Dinesh Chugtai" status="busy" />
<UserAvatar name="Bertram Gilfoyle" status="offline" />
```

#### Custom badge

Use the `badge` slot to replace the status indicator with custom overlay content. The slot sits at the bottom-right with a ring in the surrounding background color.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
  import CheckmarkFilled from "carbon-icons-svelte/lib/CheckmarkFilled.svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar name="Jared Dunn" status="online">
  <CheckmarkFilled slot="badge" size={8} />
</UserAvatar>
```

### Tooltip

Set `tooltipText` to show the display name on hover or focus. The tooltip closes on <kbd>Escape</kbd>.

Setting `tooltipText` wraps the avatar in a focusable button. Do not combine it with `interactive` or `href`, and do not set it when slotting the avatar into the `ProfileMenu` trigger.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar name="Richard Hendricks" tooltipText="Richard Hendricks" />
```

#### Position

Set `direction` to `"top"` or `"bottom"` to position the tooltip relative to the avatar.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  direction="top"
/>
<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  direction="bottom"
/>
```

#### Alignment

Set `align` to `"start"`, `"center"`, or `"end"` to align the tooltip relative to the avatar.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  align="start"
/>
<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  align="center"
/>
<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  align="end"
/>
```

#### Inline tooltip

By default, the tooltip renders in a floating portal so it is not clipped by the avatar's circular frame or an `overflow: hidden` container. Set `portalTooltip` to `false` to render the tooltip inline.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar
  name="Richard Hendricks"
  tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  portalTooltip={false}
/>
```

#### Inside a modal

The floating portal keeps the tooltip from being clipped by the modal's overflow and z-index stacking.

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Modal, Portal, UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";

  let open = false;
</script>

<Button on:click={() => (open = true)}>Open modal</Button>

<Portal>
  <Modal
    bind:open
    size="sm"
    modalHeading="UserAvatar in modal"
    primaryButtonText="Done"
    secondaryButtonText="Cancel"
    on:click:button--secondary={() => (open = false)}
  >
    <UserAvatar
      name="Richard Hendricks"
      tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
      direction="bottom"
    />
  </Modal>
</Portal>
```

### Use within ProfileMenu

Slot the avatar into [ProfileMenu](/components/UIShell#profile-menu) for the header trigger and the profile header. Use `size="md"` for the trigger and `size="lg"` for the header to match the menu frame. Leave `interactive`, `href`, and `tooltipText` unset on the slotted avatar so the menu owns focus and labelling.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatar size="md" name="Richard Hendricks" />
```

---

### Component API

#### `UserAvatar` props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` (Reactive) | `null \| HTMLElement` | Obtain a reference to the avatar HTML element. | `null` |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg" \| "xl" \| undefined` | Specify the size of the avatar.<br />Defaults to `"md"`, or to the `size` of a parent `UserAvatarGroup`. | _undefined_ |
| `backgroundColor` | `"auto" \| "red" \| "magenta" \| "purple" \| "blue" \| "cyan" \| "teal" \| "green" \| "gray" \| "cool-gray" \| "warm-gray"` | Specify the background color rendered behind the initials or icon.<br />Set to `"auto"` to pick a stable color from `name` (or `initials`). | `"gray"` |
| `shade` | `"default" \| "strong"` | Set to `"strong"` for a fill that stands further from the page: the 80<br />step in light themes and the 30 step in dark themes, as in Carbon's<br />`order-7` to `order-12` colors. Applies to every `backgroundColor`,<br />including `"auto"`. | `"default"` |
| `name` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the user's full name. Initials are derived from the name when `initials` is not set.<br />Also the default alt text for `image`. Set `imageDescription=""` to mark the<br />image decorative when the name is already visible next to the avatar. | _undefined_ |
| `initials` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the initials to display. Takes priority over initials derived from `name`. | _undefined_ |
| `image` | `string \| undefined` | Specify an image source to render a photo.<br />Takes priority over the icon and initials.<br />If the image fails to load, the avatar falls back to the icon or initials<br />and dispatches `image:error`. | _undefined_ |
| `imageDescription` | `string \| undefined` | Specify alternative text for the image.<br />Falls back to `imageAttributes.alt`, then `name`. Without either, the<br />image is marked decorative (`alt=""`).<br />Set to `""` to mark the image decorative when the name is already visible<br />next to the avatar, which avoids announcing it twice. | _undefined_ |
| `imageAttributes` | `Record<string, string> \| undefined` | Pass additional attributes through to the image element<br />(for example `loading`, `srcset`, or `referrerPolicy`).<br />Does not replace `image` or `imageDescription`. Rest props stay on the host. | _undefined_ |
| `icon` | `Icon \| undefined` | Specify the icon to render. Falls back to a default user icon. | _undefined_ |
| `status` | `"online" \| "away" \| "busy" \| "offline" \| undefined` | Specify a presence status. Renders a status indicator as the default<br />`badge` slot content. A custom `badge` slot overrides this. | _undefined_ |
| `tooltipText` | `string \| undefined` | Specify the tooltip text. When set, the avatar is wrapped in a tooltip.<br />Do not combine with `interactive` or `href` -- the tooltip trigger is already<br />focusable, and nesting an interactive avatar inside it is invalid. | _undefined_ |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | Set an id for the avatar element.<br />With `tooltipText`, the tooltip id derives from it as `{id}-tooltip`. | _undefined_ |
| `align` | `"start" \| "center" \| "end"` | Set the alignment of the tooltip relative to the avatar. | `"center"` |
| `direction` | `"top" \| "bottom"` | Set the direction of the tooltip relative to the avatar. | `"bottom"` |
| `portalTooltip` | `boolean` | Set to `false` to render the tooltip inline instead of in a floating portal.<br />The portal prevents the tooltip from being clipped by the avatar's `overflow: hidden`<br />frame or an `overflow: hidden` container such as a `Modal`. | `true` |
| `interactive` | `boolean` | Set to `true` to render a `button` element instead of a `span`.<br />Use when the avatar is a clickable control (for example, a custom profile menu<br />trigger). Prefer this over attaching `on:click` to a non-interactive `span`.<br />Ignored when `href` is set. | `false` |
| `href` | `string \| undefined` | Set an `href` to render an anchor element instead of a `span`.<br />Takes priority over `interactive`. | _undefined_ |

#### `UserAvatar` slots

| Slot      | Detail                  |
| --------- | ----------------------- |
| `default` | `Record<string, never>` |
| `badge`   | `Record<string, never>` |

| Event           |
| --------------- |
| `on:blur`       |
| `on:click`      |
| `on:focus`      |
| `on:keydown`    |
| `on:mouseenter` |
| `on:mouseleave` |
| `on:mouseover`  |

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

#### `UserAvatar` $$restProps

`UserAvatar` spreads `$$restProps` to the `span | button | a` element.


## UserAvatarGroup

### Basic

Put [UserAvatar](/components/UserAvatar) children inside the group. The default layout stacks them with a slight overlap. A ring keeps the circles distinct, and hover brings an avatar to the front. Set `tooltipText` on each avatar to show the name on hover or focus.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup>
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Richard Hendricks"
    tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```

### Overflow

Set `max` to limit how many avatars show. Everyone else goes into a "+N" overflow avatar. Hover it for the hidden names. Counts above 99 show as `99+` so the label fits the circle.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup max={3}>
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Richard Hendricks"
    tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Bertram Gilfoyle"
    tooltipText="Bertram Gilfoyle"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Jared Dunn"
    tooltipText="Jared Dunn"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Erlich Bachman"
    tooltipText="Erlich Bachman"
  />

```

Set `max` to `0` to show every avatar without an overflow.

#### Large groups

Every slotted avatar still mounts; CSS hides the ones past `max`. For large lists, render only the faces you need and set `total` to the real headcount so the "+N" chip gets the right number without mounting hundreds of nodes. Set `overflowTooltipText` when the hidden people are not slotted, since the default tooltip only lists mounted `name` values.

```svelte
<script>
  import { UserAvatar, UserAvatarGroup } from "carbon-components-svelte";
</script>

<UserAvatarGroup
  max={3}
  total={250}
  overflowTooltipText="Gilfoyle, Jared, Erlich, and 244 others"
>
  <UserAvatar backgroundColor="auto" name="Monica" tooltipText="Monica" />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Richard Hendricks"
    tooltipText="Richard Hendricks"
  />
  <UserAvatar
    backgroundColor="auto"
    name="Dinesh Chugtai"
    tooltipText="Dinesh Chugtai"
  />
</UserAvatarGroup>
```
